Highly recommended for a peaceful adventure and sightseeing.See more reviewsBest Tours and Activities in Ras Al KhaimahRas Al Khaimah is the UAE’s northernmost emirate, with an enchanting mix of urban marvels and a natural, rugged landscape. It is about 120 kilometers from Dubai and 250 kilometers from Abu Dhabi (the capital city). The best part is that it is one of the lesser-known emirates, making Ras Al Khaimah activities a favorite, especially for those seeking a pleasant retreat, intense action, or exciting adventure in a laid-back setting. The UAE’s highest mountain peak, Jebel Jais, is easily accessible from Ras Al Khaimah. That’s not alone; its challenging terrain with breathtaking views of Ras Al Khaimah and beyond is a treat for adventurists and anyone daring at heart. One of its main highlights is the Jebel Jais Zipline, which allows you to fly over the mighty mountains on the world’s highest zipline (set at an altitude of 1680 meters) at 160 kilometers per hour. Our dedicated Jebel Jais adventure tours ensure you maximize your visit here. Want to feel the spirit of heights without flying? We have an amazing aerial activity that lets you absorb the magnificent mountain and cityscape views in the safest way possible. Simply sign up for our Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Ride in Ras Al Khaimah. Contrary to the usual balloon flight, it is a tethered experience, which means you can experience the thrill of an airborne adventure with absolute peace of mind. Experience the ultimate water thrill with our exclusive tour portfolio. Set sail on a heart-racing Yellow Boat Tour or sign up for a mesmerizing Dubai Fountain Show Lake Ride, arranged from Ras Al Khaimah. You can further explore this northern emirate’s wonders on a Ras Al Khaimah City Tour, as it travels you through the diverse landscape and covers must-sees like the National Museum of Ras Al Khaimah, the pulsating Al Marjan Island, the mysterious Jazirat Al Hamra, and historic forts, mainly Falayah Fort and Dhayah Fort. Things to do in Ras Al Khaimah also include a desert safari in Ras Al Khaimah. Besides unfolding the compelling beauty and tranquility of the Arabian Desert, this off-the-beaten-path tour is sure to satisfy the adventurer within you. Start with a dune bashing session, where you will discover the endless oceans of golden sand aboard a powerful 4X4 vehicle. The first of its kind in the UAE, the concept of this park is far beyond ensuring an amazing outing to visitors, as its prime goal is to provide an exceptionally safe and undisturbed environment for its residents including rescued animals, through its cutting-edge conservation and rehabilitation efforts. Within its four distinct sections: Asian Village, African Village, Open Safari Village, and Arab Village with a Bedouin oasis, you’ll see more than 2500 residents covering 250 plus rare species that are almost at the brink of extinction – all conscientiously obtained from various zoos across the world. Displaying a wide diversity of culture and habitats, these sections will effortlessly transport you to the fascinating landscapes of African savannah and Arabian steppes while allowing you to engage in many activities like camel ride, falconry, hunting dogs etc. Also, don’t miss the chance to feed giraffe and ride elephants. The most thrilling part of this park is undeniably the drive-through safari experience in a safe powerful vehicle. This will bring you incredibly close to the freely roaming creatures at Open Safari Village, such as fierce Bengal tigers, wolfs, hippopotamus and more. What’s more; it even includes a crocodile drive-through exhibit which is the first of its kind in the world, besides the UAE’s biggest lion and elephant drive-through exhibit. There is also a 1000-seater theater, where you can spectacle intriguing binturong and raccoon shows. From skiing ground and kids’ play area to adventure zone, the park offers several leisure and dining options in its Wadi region, which is also home to a variety of unique bird and animal species. Coming to its major highlights, this park is totally energy efficient, with most of its facilities powered by solar energy. In its lush landscape, it has over 100 varieties of plants and is noteworthy for its brilliant waste disposable and water renewable techniques, along with air-conditioned rocks, misting machines and specially chilled pools which protect the inhabitants from the scorching summer heat. Quite surely, a visit to Dubai Safari Park will beguilingly have you at the intersection of education, exploration, and heart-pounding thrill. Dubai Safari Park Important InformationSuper taxi service is available in the park which can be used for visiting the different areas and charges AED 10 for Adults and AED 5 for Children one way.Please wear comfortable clothing and shoes. meta_description: Visit the Middle East’s first Madame Tussauds Museum! You’ll not only get to meet your favorite celebrities here but also take some amazing pictures with them. Call us for ticket information.
content: Madame Tussauds Dubai Tickets - Famous Waxwork Museum in DubaiHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeActivitiesDubai CityCulture And AttractionsMadame Tussauds DubaiShareAdd to Wishlist4 ImagesView GalleryMadame Tussauds Dubai5(7 Reviews)Operating HoursApprox 11:00 am to 08:30 pmInstant ConfirmationInstant Tour Confirmation will be Provided.Mobile Voucher AcceptedUse your phone or print your voucherNon RefundableEnglishGoogle MapMadame Tussauds Dubai Highlights Enter the world of celebrities on your visit to the Middle East’s first Madame Tussauds Museum in Dubai. Wander through its seven themed zones with the real-like life-size wax models of the most influential leaders, musicians, super models, big screen personalities, sporting figures and Bollywood stars. Capture endless snaps with your most beloved celebs representing movies, television, politics and sports. Grab a seat next to the Queen of England, get up-close with the international fashion icons, meet your most adored Bollywood celebs, and pose with the legends from the Middle East. Be in awe at the intricate detailing of your favorite stars as the museum continues to follow the same 200-year-old technique for the perfect crafting of each wax figure here. Once you have visited Madame Tussauds, you can spend the rest of the day enjoying sweeping views of Dubai with a Dhow Brunch in Dubai Marina. Reserve your tickets for Dinner in the Sky and  Sky View Dubai to enjoy fascinating aerial views of Dubai’s scintillating skyline.Madame Tussauds Dubai InclusionsEntry tickets to Madame Tussauds Museum Dubai Hotel pick up and drop off (only if transfer option selected at the time of booking)Madame Tussauds Dubai How to RedeemPlease check your mailbox and download the ticket. Present it at the venue for scanning. Once scanned, you can enter the VenueMadame Tussauds Dubai OverviewYour Madame Tussauds Dubai tickets give you the chance to meet your most adored personalities from almost all spheres of fame in one location on Bluewaters Island. With no ropes or rods to distance you from these acclaimed figures, come here prepared to enjoy endless poses and snaps with the celebrity icons. What To Expect? Step into the GCC’s first Madame Tussauds Museum Madame Tussauds Museum has made its debut in the Middle East, with its newest location in Dubai. Madame Tussauds Museum has its origin back to 1830s when the brilliant wax sculptor, Marie Tussauds, opened a museum in London. As with its other locations across the world, you will find here the larger-than-life wax replicas of the renowned figures, representing diverse fields including art, history, entertainment, sports, politics and science.Discover Seven Zones in an Exuberant Setting Located on one of Dubai’s latest hotspots - Bluewater Island, the museum is one of its 25 plus locations across the globe. Placed right adjacent to the highest of its kind Ain Dubai, Madame Tussauds Dubai boasts of seven amazing zones,  featuring the wax depictions of the popular ever movie stars, prominent sports personalities, legendary leaders, and most importantly, the icons from the Middle Eastern world. Be Amazed by the Age-Old Wax Modeling Technique Each of the wax figures on display here is deigned down to immaculate detail by a highly talented team of 20 sculptors, thus giving it an unbelievable real-life look. The most intriguing part is that the museum employs a 200-year-old process to finish these wax models with utmost perfection. This indicates the same old yet creative and fail-safe technique used by Marie Tussauds herself back in the 19th century.Strike Poses for Ultimate Snaps A visit here not only allows you to see your favorite celebrities like Audrey Hepburn, Balqees, and Justin Bieber, but also lets you get up close and personal with them. meta_description: Explore Dubai affordably with this Budget Explorer holiday package featuring Dubai Mall attractions, sightseeing, and hotel stays for a value-packed Dubai holidays.
content: Dubai Budget Explorer with Dubai Mall | Smart Dubai HolidayHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Budget Explorer With Dubai Mall AttractionsShareAdd to Wishlist3N / 4D1 ImagesView GalleryDubai Budget Explorer with Dubai Mall AttractionsNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewExplore Dubai in four days on a budget with the best-priced Dubai package for first-time visitors, solo and budget travelers, and family holidaymakers. Experience the city’s modern and traditional highlights on this affordable Dubai holiday package: ascend the world’s tallest building, Burj Khalifa; enjoy an evening dhow cruise along Dubai Creek; and venture into the golden desert dunes on an exciting Evening Desert Safari. This value-for-money holiday package offers a comprehensive experience at the colossal Dubai Mall, with access to House of Hype, Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo, and the Dubai Fountain show. With stays including breakfasts, airport transfers, guided tours, and a UAE visa, this Dubai smart travel package ensures a hassle-free getaway.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai, Evening Dhow Cruise with Dinner (Dubai Creek) After arrival at Dubai International Airport, proceed to your hotel in a private car for check-in. Settle in and relax until the evening. Hop on a dhow cruise for a serene ride on Dubai Creek. Soak in the beautiful old-world charm and waterfront views while relishing a delicious dinner on board. Wrap up your first day in Dubai with sublime memories of Dubai Creek, and return to your hotel for an overnight stay.Day 2Half-Day City Tour and Dubai Mall Experiences (Burj Khalifa ‘At the Top,’ Dubai Mall Aquarium, and House of Hype) After a hearty breakfast at the hotel, explore the city’s highlights on a half-day city tour. Admire the modern and cultural wonders scattered across the city, including the Jumeirah Mosque and the Palm Jumeirah. You also get to stop, marvel, and take pictures at the luxurious Burj Al Arab. Your last stop on the tour will be at Dubai Mall, where the thrill of standing on the top of the world awaits you with the Burj Khalifa ‘At the Top: Prime Hour’ experience. The thrill heightens as you view the Dubai Fountains, enjoy marine encounters at the Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo, and surrender yourself to an interactive, futuristic world at the House of Hype. The excitement lingers long after you return to your hotel for an overnight stay.Day 3Evening Dubai Desert Safari AdventureStart your day slow with a wholesome breakfast. Today, you have ample free time from morning to afternoon to relax, shop, and stroll around the city. Just make sure you are back before your pickup time for the evening desert safari adventure. Zoom off into the vast dunes and try camel rides, dune bashing, and sandboarding. After the adventures, relax and enjoy a beautiful sunset. Then, get ready for a night filled with graceful belly dancing and a thrilling Tanoura show, along with a sumptuous BBQ dinner. The day wraps up with a shared ride back to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 4Departure from DubaiWith fond memories of Dubai’s iconic marvels and desert adventures, it is time to say goodbye to this fascinating city. With this tour package, celebrate Eid in Dubai, with sightseeing and enjoying the numerous festive delights. The tour gives you a glimpse of the architectural icons of the city, including Burj Khalifa, Dubai Frame, and more. You can also experience a fun and adventurous desert safari as well as a luxury yacht tour. After enjoying the view of the city, it is time to visit the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, along with the Penguin Cove, in the Dubai Mall, the best place to celebrate Eid in Dubai. This Dubai Eid Premium Experience tour package is perfect for both Eid Al Adha and Eid Al Fitr. With this tour, you get to experience all the ultimate attractions and activities of Dubai, including a desert safari, IMG Worlds, Burj Khalifa, and more. This is also one of the Dubai Eid premium travel packages that gives you the chance to enjoy Dubai’s luxury. Stay at a four or five-star hotel and travel around the city in private vehicles, ensuring a premium experience.ItineraryDay 1Arrival and Dhow Cruise Dinner – MarinaAs you arrive at the Dubai International Airport, you will find a private vehicle awaiting you to begin an exciting 6D/5N Dubai Eid celebration holiday. The driver would take you to your hotel. After check-in, get ready for your dhow cruise dinner tour. Sailing on the Dubai Marina, the dhow cruise gives you the chance to admire the beauty of the glamorous Marina and relish the delicious buffet dinner. A Tanoura dance performance is also organized onboard for your entertainment. When the dhow docks, you return to the hotel for the night.Day 2Premium Desert SafariDay two of your Eid Al Fitr or Eid Al Adha travel packages begins leisurely. The first half of the day is free to spend as you wish. You can go sightseeing on your own or rest at the hotel. Late afternoon, head to the desert camp in a shared vehicle for an adventurous and entertaining evening. The desert safari involves dune bashing, sandboarding, and camel riding. You can also click photos of the desert sunset and watch live performances. A BBQ dinner is arranged at the desert, before you head back to your hotel.Day 3IMG Worlds of Adventure/Motiongate DubaiDay three of your tour is dedicated to visiting theme parks. You have two options here: IMG Worlds of Adventure and Motiongate Dubai. IMG Worlds of Adventure is an indoor theme park (the largest in the world) with six zones and numerous thrilling rides, while Motiongate Dubai is a Hollywood-themed park with action-packed rollercoasters and attractions.Day 4Dubai City Tour, Burj Khalifa, & Dubai AquariumDay four of your holiday package takes you around the city of Dubai. You get to see the prominent landmarks of Dubai, including Atlantis the Palm, Jumeirah Mosque, etc. Burj Khalifa is your next stop, including a visit to its observation deck on the 124th floor. You also tour the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo in the Dubai Mall. After exploring the mall a bit more, you head back to the hotel.Day 5Abu Dhabi City Tour with Grand MosqueThis is one of the Eid premium holidays travel packages that takes you to Abu Dhabi. The city tour includes a visit to the magnificent Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, the largest mosque in the nation. Other spots included on the tour are Heritage Village, Emirates Palace, Corniche, and more. At the end of the day, you return to your hotel in Dubai.Day 6DepartureCheck out of your hotel after your Eid Al Adha or Eid Al Fitr holiday UAE and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.Hotel OptionsPalazzo Versace Hotel or similarRoyal Ascot Or Similar Previous Next12InclusionPrivate airport transfersHotel accommodation in Dubai for 5 nightsDaily breakfastTickets to dhow cruise at Dubai Marina (shared transfers)Tickets to premium desert safari with BBQ dinner (shared transfers)Half-day Dubai city tour (private transfers)Entry tickets to Burj Khalifa (prime hours)Entry tickets to Dubai Aquarium and Underwater ZooDubai Fountain ShowEntry tickets to IMG Worlds of Adventure or Motiongate Dubai (private transfers)Abu Dhabi city tour with Grand Mosque visit (private transfers)UAE single-entry tourist visaUAE travel insuranceExclusionDomestic / International Flight ticketsGST and TCS if applicable  Laundry ChargesInternational or National CallsMeals which is not mentioned in above ItineraryAdditional Transfers or Sightseeing which is not mentioned in itineraryTIPS / Porter Charges / Room serviceTourism Dirhams (15-20 AED per room per night approx.)Departure & PricingPackage price: Per person For 2 Pax | Currency: AED | Travel Date From 18th & 19th March 2026 Hotel CategoryAdult- DoubleOccupancySingle OccupancyTriple OccupancyChild With BedChild without bed4* 502974194460304922995*697511649609930492299CityStay4*5*Dubai 5 NightsRoyal AscotPalazzo Versace HotelFlights DetailsFlights are not included in this package.Visa DetailsThis package will comes with 30 days Dubai tourist Visa included. content: Dubai Jain Signature Experience Package | Dubai Jain HolidayHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Jain Signature ExperienceShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D2 ImagesView GalleryDubai Jain Signature ExperienceNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewThis Dubai tour package has been designed for Jain tourists with Jain food options. The all-inclusive Dubai Jain holiday package has been planned so that tourists can easily access Jain meals during their travel. Along with the food, travelers will also discover the most famous landmarks and attractions of Dubai, including a dhow cruise, a desert safari, the Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and more. This Dubai tour package allows you to explore the city’s adventurous, cultural, modern, and luxurious sides. A private tour of Abu Dhabi is also included, making this one of the most comprehensive tour packages of Dubai available. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai and Dhow Cruise in Dubai MarinaA private vehicle will drive you from the Dubai International Airport to the hotel. After rest, you will be taken to Dubai Marina for a dhow cruise dinner. As the dhow sails along the Dubai Marina, enjoy the beautiful views and a graceful Tanura dance performance. The Jain buffet meal served on the cruise is its highlight.Day 2Private Dubai City Tour and Dubai FrameDay two of this Dubai Jain holiday package begins with a city tour. A private vehicle will take you to see the delights of the city, like Dubai Creek, Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Marina, JBR, and more. Your tour ends with a visit to the Dubai Frame, a prominent landmark of the city. Shaped like an enormous photo frame, the Dubai Frame offers a panoramic view of the city from the observation deck and a glimpse into its past and future through its museums.Day 3Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall Aquarium, and Ain DubaiDay three of your Dubai holiday package with Jain food is dedicated to exploring the delights of Downtown Dubai. It includes a visit to the observation deck of Burj Khalifa, located on the 124th floor. After admiring the 360-degree panoramic view of the city from above, you step into Dubai Mall, the largest shopping mall in the UAE. Besides its 1200+ stores, you can also visit the Dubai Mall Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, home to over 30,000 aquatic animals. The tour also includes a ride on Ain Dubai, the world’s tallest and largest observation wheel, where you can enjoy the uninterrupted views of the city.Day 4Private Abu Dhabi City Tour + Louvre MuseumDay four is when you take a private tour of Abu Dhabi. It takes you to all the iconic attractions of Abu Dhabi, like the Grand Mosque, BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi Corniche, and Emirates Palace, ensuring that this Jain holiday package combines spirituality, leisure, and luxury. The highlight of the tour is a visit to Louvre Abu Dhabi. Located on Saadiyat Island, the museum’s unique structure and exhibits make it worth visiting.Day 5Premium Desert SafariRelax and explore the hotel’s many amenities in the morning. In the afternoon, it is time to be ready to go on a desert adventure. The premium desert safari takes you to a luxury desert camp for a memorable desert safari experience. Spend your time trying out adventurous activities like dune bashing, camel riding, and sandboarding. You will also be able to see a desert sunset and take pictures. Entertainment programs such as Tanoura dance, belly dance, and fire show are also on the itinerary. The BBQ dinner at the desert safari is exclusively made for Jains.Day 6Day of LeisureThe last day of your Dubai Jain holiday package for 7 days/6 nights can be spent the way you prefer. No tours have been planned for this day. You can visit one of the theme parks, go on a shopping trip to the souks, or explore a new place or attraction.Day 7DepartureAfter enjoying your breakfast at the hotel, you leave for the airport in a title: Dubai Sky High Thrills Package | Dubai Thrilling Holiday
meta_description: Ready to test your adrenaline with panoramic view of the city? Get set for an adventure date with Dubai Sky High Dubai thrilling holiday package.
content: Dubai Sky High Thrills Package | Dubai Thrilling HolidayHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Sky High Thrills HolidayShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D1 ImagesView GalleryDubai Sky High Thrills HolidayNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewThe Dubai Sky High Thrills Holiday brings together adventure and luxury. You get to experience a side of Dubai that is more than its landmarks and sightseeing experiences. This Dubai thrilling holiday package includes the most popular thrilling activities the city has to offer, including the extreme ones. Your holiday would be spent passing through one adrenaline-rushing activity to another. From skydiving to ziplining, this tour ensures that there will never be a dull moment. This makes it one of the best Dubai holiday packages for couples and families with kids.  ItineraryDay 1Arrival in DubaiThe day you arrive in Dubai, you will be transferred to your hotel in a private car. Once you have settled in your hotel, you are free to relax in your room, explore your hotel, or maybe go sightseeing in the city.Day 2Skydive at the PalmThe next day begins with breakfast at the hotel before going for your Dubai Skydive holiday package. When you arrive, you attend a session about the safety guidelines. Next, you gear up before you hop onto the aircraft that will take you to 4,000 feet above the ground. You jump from the airplane along with a professional. Your skydiving experience includes 60 seconds of free fall followed by 5-7 minutes of parachute glide, enjoying the views of the Palm Jumeirah. The recording of the fall will be given to you at the end of the tour. You will be driven back to your hotel to relax. You can spend the rest of the day as you please.Day 3Hot Air Balloon Ride and Evening Desert Safari with PolarisDay three begins early in the morning, when it is still dark. You will be taken to the outskirts of the desert for a hot air balloon ride. As you ascend into the air, see the sky changing its colors as the sun makes its appearance. Apart from the sunrise, you also catch an aerial view of the desert and gauge its vastness along with its rare flora and fauna. Once you descend, return to the hotel and spend the rest of the day until afternoon at leisure. Later in the evening, head back to the desert for an exciting safari experience with thrilling dune bashing and camel riding sessions. Riding on a Polaris buggy is one of the highlights of this tour. You leave the desert camp after a lavish BBQ dinner and traditional performances such as the Tanura show and belly dancing. Day 4Atlantis Aquaventure and LeisureSpend the fourth day of your Dubai holiday at Atlantis Aquaventure, one of the best waterparks in the city. Spread over 17 hectares, this waterpark is located within Atlantis, The Palm. Enjoy more than 105 slides, experiences, and attractions, including thrilling slides like Leap of Faith, Odyssey of Terror, Poseidon’s Revenge, and more. There are water coasters, water rides, a lazy river, and a water play area for little ones. Once you return to the hotel, you can rest in your room or explore the city on your own.Day 5Ziplining, Jet Skiing, and IMG WorldsDay five of your Dubai private adventure holiday package includes air, water, and land adventures. Your first stop is at XLine Marina, the longest urban zipline in the world. Stretching 1 km in length, this is one of the best ways to enjoy the aerial view of the Dubai Marina while zipping down the zipline. This is followed by an hour of jet skiing on the Arabian Gulf. Spend the rest of the day discovering the zones and delights of IMG Worlds of Adventure, the biggest indoor theme park on the planet.Day 6DepartureDepending on your flight time, you will be transferred to the airport in a private vehicle, thus concluding your adventurous holiday in Dubai.Hotel OptionsAsiana Hotel or SimilarKnight Castle Hotel or Similar Previous Next12InclusionPrivate airport transfersHotel accommodation for five daysDaily breakfast at the hotelTickets for a hot air balloon ride (with shared transfers)Evening Desert safari with Polaris buggy ride for 30 minutes (shared transfers)Entry tickets to Atlantis Aquaventure (shared transfers) + leisure dayTickets for XLine Dubai Marina (private transfers)Tickets to Jet Ski for 30 minutes (private transfers)Entry tickets to IMG Worlds of Adventure (private transfers)ExclusionDomestic / International Flight ticketsGST and TCS, if applicableLaundry ChargesInternational or National CallsMeals not mentioned in above ItineraryAdditional Transfers or Sightseeing not mentioned in itineraryTIPS / Porter Charges / Room serviceTourism Dirhams (15-20 AED per room per night approx.)Departure & PricingPackage price: Per person | Currency: AED | Travel Date: Till May 2026Hotel      CategoryAdult- Double   OccupancySingleOccupancyTripleOccupancyChild WithBedChild WithoutBed4*9055104858789826972455*913910759884982697245Stay optionsCityStay4*5*Dubai5 NightsAsiana Hotel 4* or SimilarKnight Castle Hotel 5* or          Similar        Note: Additional supplements will apply on the following dates:Christmas : 24th to 26th December 2026New Year : 31th Dec 2026 to 01st Jan 2027Eid Al Fitr : 20–22th, March 2026 Eid Al Adha : 26–29th, May 2026 Arab Health : 09th to 12th Feb 2026Gulf Food : 26 Jan 2026 – 30 Jan 2026The Big 5 Global : Nov 23–26, 2026 GITEX Global : Dec 8–11, 2026 Flights DetailsFlights are not included in this package.Visa DetailsThis package will comes with 30 days Dubai tourist Visa included. content: Royal Dubai Signature Package | Dubai Luxury PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityRoyal Dubai Signature ExperienceShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D4 ImagesView GalleryRoyal Dubai Signature ExperienceNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewDubai is a destination known for its opulence, and this tour package lets you experience all of it. From a stay at a luxurious hotel to private transfers and visits to high-end attractions, this is the ultimate travel package for luxury travelers. This Dubai luxury tour package offers attractions and experiences a step above the regular packages. Enjoy a hot air balloon ride along with the desert safari, while a visit to the Burj Khalifa takes you to its observation deck with a 36-degree view of the city. Moreover, the package includes a thrilling helicopter ride. Whether looking for Dubai tour packages from India or other international destinations, it allows you to experience Dubai in style.ItineraryDay 1Arrival and Dhow Cruise DinnerEnjoy a comfortable ride as a private car takes you from the airport to your hotel. After settling in, head over to the first attraction of your tour, i.e., the dhow cruise. Lasting two hours, the dhow offers incredible view of the city and the chance to enjoy a relaxing dinner before your Dubai tour begins. Apart from the 3-course dinner, the Tanoura dance performance will make your dhow cruise tour even more memorable.Day 2Dubai City Tour, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai MallThe Dubai city tour on the second day involves driving around the city and viewing some of its most important landmarks. You will see the skyscrapers and unique buildings along Sheikh Zayed Road, one of the most developed areas in Dubai. Burj Al Arab, Jumeirah Mosque, Jumeirah Beach, and Palm Jumeirah are among the attractions covered in the tour. The city tour ends at Burj Khalifa, and you get to visit the observation deck on the 124th floor. This is followed by a visit to Dubai Mall and its popular attractions, such as the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo and House of Hype. The fascinating Dubai Fountain Show, outside the mall, is also not to be missed.Day 3Museum of the Future and Yacht ExperienceDay three begins with a visit to the Museum of the Future. From the museum’s unique structure to its exhibits, everything about it is futuristic. The exhibits here are all about new innovations. You will also see what Dubai would look like 50 years from now. After the museum tour, it is time to board a private luxury yacht and relax while enjoying the views of Dubai’s stunning skyline from the water.Day 4Limousine Ride and Burj Al Arab TourDubai is not a stranger to luxury cars, and you get to ride in the ultimate luxury car during your holiday. Relax and enjoy the plush seats and comforts of the limousine as it takes you around the city. One of the highlights of this tour is a visit to Burj Al Arab, the sail shaped hotel in Jumeirah. Apart from the hotel’s structure, what makes it stand apart is its opulence. The tour will give you the opportunity to explore the hotel’s grand interiors and experience one of its lavish suites.Day 5Hot Air Balloon Ride and Helicopter TourDay five of your tour is dedicated to some exciting aerial experiences. Your day starts early in the morning when you are driven to the desert camp in a private vehicle. You watch as the hot air balloons are prepared for the flight before getting in the basket. As the hot air balloon takes flight, you will see a beautiful sunrise and an aerial view of the golden desert, including its flora and fauna. The hot air balloon ride ends with a breakfast in the desert. Another attraction you can enjoy is a helicopter ride. Lasting for a few minutes, you get to see the bird’s-eye view of some of the iconic landmarks of Dubai during your ride.Day 6Private Desert SafariWhile there is nothing scheduled in the first half of the day (leaving you to indulge in some shopping or sightseeing on your own), the second half is reserved for a private desert safari tour. Enjoy desert adventures like dune bashing, sandboarding, and camel riding, followed by entertainment programs like belly dancing and Tanoura dancing. Watching a fire show, getting henna designs on your palms, and smoking a shisha are a few of the things you can experience here.Day 7DepartureYour 6-night tour ends on this day. A private vehicle will drop you back to the airport from the hotel on time to catch your flight.Hotel OptionsAsiana Hotel or SimilarThe Canvas Hotel Dubai,MGallery Hotel Collection or Similar Previous It’s led by Abdulla Rashed Al Suwaidi, one of the last to carry forward the legacy of generations of pearl divers. Yes, it’s where history and heritage come alive through authentic pearl diving tales, techniques, and innovations passed down through centuries.  A Floating Escape through Nature and History  Reach this floating gem on a boat ride from the pristine Al Rams village, surrounded by untouched mangroves. Be in awe of the farm’s unique displays that reveal the secrets of pearl cultivation, from time-honored techniques to modern innovations. It promises an exciting adventure, as nature, science, and masterful craftsmanship coalesce immaculately at its every turn.  Unforgettable Experiences  Beyond admiring the artistry of centuries-old pearl fishing, soak in the farm’s enchanting surroundings at the base of the mighty Hajjar Mountains. It’s thoughtfully eco-friendly and powered by solar energy. One of the main highlights is the chance to open an oyster yourself, with the rare opportunity to discover an authentic Arabian pearl to take home.  House of Pearls Important InformationPlease carry valid ID proof/Passport along with you. Minimum number of people required is Two.Children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.You are required to wear modest and comfortable clothing (no loose dresses, skirts, flip flops, loose footwear, or long and loose scarves).For daytime visits, sunscreen is advised, while for evening tours, insect repellent is recommended.There will be no refund for unused or partially used services.Food and beverages brought from outside may not be allowed inside the premises. Loading...From:AED 250.00Check AvailabilityWhy choose Rayna Tours?Best Price GuaranteeAlways the best deal—book with total confidence.Secure Online TransactionYour transactions are protected with advanced encryption.24X7 Live Chat SupportReal humans, ready to help anytime.Happy Travelers WorldwideTrusted by millions of happy travelers.Download AppRayna ToursAbout usPartner with usBecome an affiliateGet Help 24/7[email protected]+971 42087112+971 42087112© 2026 Rayna Tours.Built byPrivacy PolicyTerms & conditionsBuilt byDownload AppRayna ToursAbout usPartner with usBecome an affiliateGet Help 24/7[email protected]+971 42087112+971 42087112© 2026 Rayna Tours.Built byPrivacy PolicyTerms & conditionsBuilt by

This 5-day Thailand itinerary blends the relaxing charm of Pattaya’s beaches with the cultural heartbeat of Bangkok, offering a seamless travel experience designed for families, couples, and curious explorers. Cruise to the sun-kissed Coral Island, enjoy the glitz of the Alcazar Show, uncover Bangkok’s spiritual soul at majestic temples, and spend a wild day at Safari World & Marine Park. With carefully arranged transfers, guided tours, and handpicked attractions - every moment is a celebration of Thailand’s rich diversityItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya | Evening Alcazar ShowWelcome to Thailand - the Land of Smiles! Upon arrival at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport, a private vehicle will greet you and transport you on a scenic drive to Pattaya, Thailand’s beachside jewel. After checking into your hotel, take some time to unwind.As night falls, get ready for a sparkling evening at the iconic Alcazar Cabaret Show, where glamour, culture, and entertainment collide. Watch as talented performers in dazzling costumes take you on a journey through dance, music, and theatrical brilliance - a truly unforgettable experience!Day 2Coral Island Tour with Speed Boat & LunchAfter breakfast, set off for a day of sun, sand, and sea as you head to the enchanting Coral Island (Koh Larn) by speedboat. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and powdery white sands, the island is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and snapping postcard-worthy photos.You can also opt for adventurous water sports (at an extra cost) like parasailing, jet skiing, or banana boat rides. A tasty Thai lunch awaits you during the tour. Spend your day soaking up the tropical beauty before returning to your Pattaya hotel for a relaxing evening.Day 3Transfer to Bangkok | Bangkok Temple TourCheck out from your Pattaya hotel and begin your return journey to Bangkok. En route, embark on a fascinating Bangkok City Tour, exploring the city's spiritual heart through its most iconic temples.Visit the magnificent Wat Traimit, home to the world’s largest solid gold Buddha, and the serene Wat Benchamabophit (Marble Temple), a masterpiece of Thai architecture. Later, stop by the famous Gems Gallery, where you can explore fine Thai craftsmanship and maybe pick up a sparkling souvenir.Arrive at your Bangkok hotel and relax for the rest of the evening or explore the nearby markets and street food stalls.Day 4Safari World & Marine Park with LunchPrepare for an action-packed family day as you head to Safari World & Marine Park, one of Thailand’s top wildlife attractions. Witness majestic animals like giraffes, zebras, and lions roaming freely on a guided drive through the open Safari Park.Then explore the Marine Park, where a series of fun and educational shows - including dolphins, sea lions, birds, and stunt acts - keep everyone entertained. A delicious buffet lunch is served inside the park, ensuring a full day of excitement and fun for both kids and adults.Return to your hotel by evening with happy hearts and unforgettable memories.Day 5Departure from BangkokEnjoy a leisurely breakfast and some last-minute shopping or relaxation, depending on your flight timing. This 6-day escape invites you to explore sun-kissed islands, immerse in local culture, stroll through historic streets, and unwind in paradise. Whether you're a beach lover, an explorer at heart, or someone simply seeking a romantic escape, this itinerary blends relaxation and adventure in perfect harmony. From the tranquil charm of Krabi’s 4 Islands to the vibrant energy of Phi Phi Island and the colorful streets of Phuket Old Town, every moment of this trip is crafted to leave you in awe.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Phuket | Scenic Transfer to KrabiYour tropical getaway begins as you arrive at Phuket International Airport, where you’ll be warmly greeted and transferred by private vehicle to the serene coastal town of Krabi. Sit back and enjoy the picturesque drive, passing through lush greenery, limestone cliffs, and glimpses of the Andaman Sea. Upon arrival in Krabi, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Take a peaceful beach walk, explore the night markets, or simply relax at your resort, soaking in the laid-back island vibe.Day 2Krabi 4 Islands Tour by Longtail BoatAwaken to the beauty of Krabi and set off on a captivating Four Island Tour aboard a traditional longtail boat. Discover the tropical wonders of Phra Nang Cave Beach, Chicken Island, Tup Island, and Poda Island - each offering a unique blend of white sandy beaches, clear turquoise waters, and spectacular limestone formations. Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing in this island paradise. A delicious local lunch will be served during the tour. After a day of sun and sea, return to your hotel with memories etched in shades of blue.Day 3Transfer from Krabi to PhuketAfter a leisurely breakfast, check out from your Krabi hotel and journey back to Phuket, the jewel of the Andaman Sea. Your private transfer ensures a comfortable and scenic ride through southern Thailand's tropical countryside. Upon arrival in Phuket, check into your hotel and unwind. The evening is yours to explore - stroll down Patong Beach, discover vibrant street markets, or enjoy a beachside dinner with ocean views.Day 4Phi Phi Island Tour by Speedboat with LunchToday, embark on a thrilling speedboat excursion to Phi Phi Islands, one of Thailand’s most iconic destinations. Marvel at the stunning cliffs of Maya Bay, the crystal waters of Loh Samah Bay, and the colorful coral reefs around Monkey Beach and Phi Phi Don. Swim, snorkel, and soak in the island vibes. A delightful Thai lunch will be served amidst this island paradise. Return to Phuket by afternoon, leaving you free to relax or explore more of the nightlife or markets.Day 5Phuket City Tour with Old Town CharmDiscover the rich heritage and diverse culture of Phuket on a half-day city tour. Visit local gems like Big Buddha, Chalong Temple, and admire panoramic views from Karon Viewpoint. Wander through the charming streets of Phuket Old Town, where colonial-era buildings, colorful shophouses, and street art offer a glimpse into the island’s past. Capture postcard-worthy photos, visit local handicraft shops, and perhaps sip a coffee at one of the quaint cafés.Day 6Departure from PhuketAs your Thai escape draws to an end, enjoy a relaxed morning before your private transfer to Phuket International Airport. Depart with memories of turquoise waters, island breezes, and sunsets that linger long after your return. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysKoh SamuiKoh Samui Escape With Phuket And KrabiShareAdd to Wishlist8N / 9D5 ImagesView GalleryKoh Samui Escape with Phuket and KrabiNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewSee Thailand’s pristine natural beauty, vibrant culture, and unique traditions on this comprehensive nine-day holiday. Start at one of the country’s most scenic islands, Krabi, where you’ll take a four-island tour by longtail boat, and then explore Koh Samui’s top attractions, such as the Angthong National Marine Park. Adding to the excitement is a ferry transfer to Phuket. Enjoy a Phuket city tour that includes a visit to Old Town and the Tiger Kingdom, as well as the renowned Phi Phi Island Tour with Maya Bay by speedboat. With accommodations, guided tours, and all transfers, you can rest assured of a stress-free island-hopping getaway!ItineraryDay 1Arrival in KrabiUpon a professional meet-and-greet at Krabi International Airport, enjoy a smooth ride to your pre-arranged accommodation. After settling into your room, unwind or start exploring the island’s compelling charm. Day 2Krabi 4 Island Tour by Longtail Boat with LunchToday’s highlight is a four-island tour, starting with a transfer to the pier to board a speedboat or traditional long-tail boat. Cruise through Krabi’s picture-perfect islands, including Tup Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and Phra Nang Cave, and marvel at their pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and unique rock formations. Snorkel, swim, or simply be in awe of the scenery, and enjoy a delicious lunch before returning to your accommodation with transfers.Day 3Road + Ferry Transfer to Koh SamuiAfter checking out of your hotel, enjoy a scenic road and ferry journey to Koh Samui. Upon arrival, check in to your accommodation and spend the rest of the day relaxing at your leisure.Day 4Angthong National Marine Park Day TourToday, you’ll set out to discover the protected Angthong National Marine Park, which consists of 42 islands in an area of 100 square kilometers. Its blend of verdant jungles, huge limestone mountains, and unspoiled turquoise waters makes it a haven for nature enthusiasts, adventurers, snorkelers, and divers alikeDay 5Koh Samui City Tour Today, you’ll visit Koh Samui’s cultural and scenic attractions on a guided city tour. The first stop is at the revered Big Buddha Temple, enshrining a 12-metre-high golden statue of Lord Buddha. Get a slice of the region’s picturesque landscape, as the tour takes you to Lad Koh View Point, the Grandfather and Grandmother Rocks, and the Guan Yu ShrineDay 6Ferry Transfer to PhuketCheck out of your Koh Samui accommodation and continue your journey to Phuket on a stunning ferry ride. As accommodation is arranged, all you need to do is check in and spend the evening at your leisure. Day 7Phi Phi Island Tour with Maya Bay by a Speedboat with LunchToday, set out on a Phi Phi Island tour by speedboat, where you’ll experience the island’s breathtaking beauty, from pristine white-sand beaches and towering limestone cliffs to lush greenery and vibrant turquoise waters teeming with marine life. Visit the famous Maya Bay, known as the filming location of Leonardo DiCaprio’s The Beach, enjoy a delicious lunch, and return to your accommodation with unforgettable memories of this tropical paradise.Day 8Phuket City Tour with Old Town | Tiger KingdomToday, enjoy a fully guided Phuket city tour that showcases the region’s top attractions. Explore stunning beaches, including Patong, visit the iconic Wat Chalong Buddhist temple, and take in panoramic views from Promthep Cape. Stroll through Old Town to admire historic Sino-Portuguese architecture, colorful street art, and bustling markets. Conclude the tour with an exciting visit to Tiger Kingdom, where you can get up close with majestic Bengal, Indo-Chinese, and Siberian tigers.Day 9 DepartureAfter breakfast and hotel check-out, sit back and enjoy a smooth transfer to Phuket Airport. Depart Thailand with a trove of memories from your island-hopping adventure.Hotel OptionsHoliday Style Ao Nang Beach Resort, KrabiThe sarann koh samuiFishermen's harbour phuket Previous Next123Inclusion 7 Nights accommodation in well-rated 3/4 hotels/resortsDaily breakfast at the hotelAirport transfers on arrival and departureInter-island transfers (by ferry or domestic flight)Sightseeing tours as per itineraryKrabi 4 Island Tour by speedboat (with lunch)Koh Samui City & Temple TourPhuket City & Cultural TourPhi Phi Island Tour by speedboat (with lunch)All tours and transfers on SIC/private basis (as per package)English-speaking local guide during excursionsAll hotel taxes and service chargesExclusion International and domestic airfareThailand visa feesTravel insuranceLunch and dinner (unless mentioned)Personal expenses (laundry, minibar, telephone, tips, shopping, etc.)Optional tours or water activities not mentioned in the itineraryEarly check-in or late check-out at hotelsAny cost due to flight delays, weather issues, or unforeseen circumstancesImportant InformationRayna Tours – Easy Terms & Conditions for Your TripWe want your travel experience to be smooth and enjoyable. Inaugurated in 1999 by then Prime Minister Tun Dr. Mahathir bin Mohamad, it held the title of the world’s tallest structure until the opening of Taipei 101 in 2004 and later, Dubai’s Burj Khalifa in 2009. Standing at approximately 452 meters, it still retains its distinction as the world’s tallest twin structure, featuring stunning architectural design and breathtaking views from its observation deck.WHAT TO EXPECTEnter Malaysia’s Ultimate Architectural IconWhether you visit by day or night, the Petronas Towers, with its impressive steel-and-glass façade, never fail to amaze. Designed by Argentinean architect César Pelli, this architectural masterpiece not only showcase stunning modern structure but also incorporate distinct Malaysian cultural elements, including Islamic art motifs and mesmerizing patterns inspired by songket cloth weaving and bertam palm matting.Sky-High AdventuresBegin your visit with a smooth entry to the double-decker Skybridge, the highest of its kind in the world. Perched at approximately 170 meters, it links the twin towers on the 41st and 42nd floors, offering panoramic views. Being a movable bridge, you may even feel it sway slightly in high winds. Next, take an elevator up another 190 meters to the 86th-floor Observation Deck. From here, enjoy stunning close-up views of the towers’ spires and sweeping vistas of Kuala Lumpur, along with interactive digital displays that showcase the tower’s design and history.Explore Beyond the Observation DeckWhile your ticket includes the Observation Deck, you can further enhance your experience by visiting other exciting attractions in the vicinity. Originally known as Menara Kuala Lumpur, this towering landmark remains a perennial favorite among travelers visiting the city throughout the year. Ride a speedboat through the mangrove channels and discover a slice of nature few get to experience. Take in the mangrove ecosystem, visit attractions like the Gua Kelawar (Bat Cave), and spot wildlife including long-tailed macaques, sea eagles, dolphins, and otters. The tour also includes a delicious lunch.WHAT TO EXPECTA Journey Through Pristine NatureThe mangroves are ancient and UNESCO-listed. Rest assured, you’ll witness some of nature’s most stunning sights. From limestone karsts, cliffs, and caves to winding mangrove channels, the beauty of nature is surreal here.Impressive WildlifeKilim Geoforest Park has a wide variety of wildlife. From sea eagles that dive into the water to catch fish and little otters that live in adorable groups, the mangroves showcase the best of wildlife. They play a huge part in the ecology of the mangroves and is one of the top highlights of the tour.Unique AttractionsThe park also has many unique attractions. The Bat Cave is one such place. It not only allows you to experience one of Dubai’s most glamorous cityscapes but also take in the world’s longest urban zipline. So come sign up for your XLine Dubai Marina Zipline with Rayna Tours and get ready to see yourself as a superhero on this high-flying activity.With two cables laid out side by side, this gives you the unique chance to enjoy the ride simultaneously alongside your friend or spouse. Before you perch yourself into the air, meet the expert team who will provide comprehensive safety instructions and further help you to get fitted with your safety gear and harness.As the ride kicks off, you’ll fly over Dubai Marina’s magnificent sights like a superman in a head-first,belly-down position.  Look around and soak in the most astonishing aerial views of structures across Dubai Marina, JBR Beach and Palm Jumeirah. Dating back to 18th century, Qasr Al Hosn serves as a physical timeline which narrates the tale of Abu Dhabi’s transition from a pearling and fishing settlement to a world-class city. Find here exhibits that date back to as early as 6000 BC. Get a detailed account of the impressive Emirati past, traditions and ancient royal lifestyle as you wander through its well preserved hallways and rooms. Chance to stand under the complex’s oldest structure, a watch tower. Experience the tangible and intangible Emirati Heritage at the House of Artisans. Gain access to its renovated Cultural Foundation which is also the region’s first multipurpose community centre. At Bait Al Gahwa, learn about the secrets of Arabic coffee and its importance in the Emirati culture and hospitality. Yes, a visit to Qasr Al Hosn right in the heart of the capital city will transport you to this era. Dating back to the 18th century, it’s the region’s oldest heritage site; it was once a defensive structure, later a palace which served as a residence to the ruling Nahyan family, and then the seat of government. More than 230 years now, this elegant sandstone structure has still retained its character and remains as an impressive tribute to the region’s bygone era. So be prepared to travel back in time as you step into this well preserved national monument which is now converted into a museum. Discover the Inner Fort (built in 1795) and the Outer Palace (built in 1940s), while admiring its many art and artifacts (like weapons, images, maps etc) collected from as early as 6000 BC. Know about the Bani Yas tribe in detail and see the region’s charming historical and cultural scenes coming to life through the large, interactive screens placed all around. You’ll further get to stand under the complex’s oldest structure - a coral and sea stone watch tower, and relive the life of ancient royals as you weave your way through its painstakingly restored rooms and hallways. Your tickets also offer access to the House of Artisans where you’ll see the highly creative local artisans giving live demonstration of the region’s unique Emirati crafts. There is also the renovated Cultural Foundation which is the region’s first multipurpose community centre. It houses some strikingly intricate artworks created by the regional artists and conducts several inspiring cultural shows and workshops. Finally, you’ll step into the Bait Al Gahwa. As the name indicates, it enlightens you on everything about the renowned Arabic coffee, including its interesting facts, significance in the Emirati culture, and meticulous preparation that highlight its diverse phases such as roasting, grounding and brewing. Qasr Al Hosn Abu Dhabi Important InformationPlease be advised that a valid ID must be presented upon entry to Qasr Al Hosn. content: Dinner in the Sky Dubai - Dinner in the Sky ExperienceHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeActivitiesDubai CityAdventure ToursDinner In The SkyShareAdd to Wishlist3 ImagesView GalleryDinner in the Sky5(28 Reviews)Operating HoursSunday to Saturday: 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM.On RequestConfirmation will be Provided as per AvailabilityMobile Voucher AcceptedUse your phone or print your voucherNon RefundableEnglishGoogle MapDinner in the Sky HighlightsJoin for the most exciting and unforgettable culinary tour with this dining adventure in the sky. Treat yourself to an exclusive sky-high lunch, dinner or afternoon sea served 50 meters (about 165 feet) above the cityscape. Get the most spellbinding 360 degree views over Dubai’s icons including Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina during the experience. Enjoy unmatched food and sensational sights in an unrivaled setting as your table gently rotates throughout this mid-air session. Dinner in the Sky InclusionsDinner in the Sky entry ticketsThe aerial culinary experience at a height of over 50 metersMulti-course Lunch or DinnerTransfers ( if option is selected)NOTE: Please check Option wise inclusions for every product before bookingDinner in the Sky ExclusionsAll personal experience.Dinner in the Sky How to RedeemShortly after the completion of booking, you’ll receive your tour Tickets on your email.Make sure that you check your spam / junk folder or notify us in case you don’t find it in your inbox.  Print this voucher or show its mobile version to exchange it for your physical tickets once you arrive at the destination.Dinner in the Sky OverviewDinner in the Sky gives you once-in-the-lifetime chance to enjoy dining in a massive revolving platform that is suspended 50 meters (165 feet) in the sky. This not only lets you dine in an exceptionally safe and intimate setting (with your group of up to 22 people), but also feasts you with the most incredible 360 degree views over the city’s legendary sights across Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and more. Overall, it promises you a dining and sightseeing adventure worth remembering forever. WHAT TO EXPECTTake to the Sky Once you make your way to its location at Skydive Dubai (Al Sufouh), strap yourself to the seat before you are gently lifted to a height of about 50 meters by a crane. Recline in your comfy chair and see your feet dangling in the air as you look around for the most unhindered city skyline views. The table and the seats gently spins during this splendid 90 minutes dining experience means it lets you to take in Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina like never before. Indulge in a Gastronomic Experience like No Other With a capacity to seat up to 22 people at a time, this aerial venue serves a three-course meal or a sweet or savory treat (dependent on you choose lunch / dinner or an afternoon tea break.) The menu comprises both vegetarian and non-vegetarian specialties; each of them is prepared live right in front of you. Featuring a blend of impressive food and marvelous views, it is not a surprise that Forbes has ranked Dinner in the Sky among the list of the world’s 10 most unusual restaurants. Dine & Capture Treasured Moments with Absolute Safety Whether you choose this venue for your first date or to celebrate a milestone occasion or to simply treat your special group with an exotic dining session, you can be rest assured of its top-end safety. This Belgium-originated dining concept is designed in compliance with the German norm DIN 4112 and functions as per the strict guidelines of the UAE’s Department of Occupational Safety & Health and Civil Defense. meta_description: Prepare for a multisensory experience like never before with your Arte Museum tickets. It offers access to the MENA region’s first-of-its-kind museum. Inquire or book now for an immersive adventure.
content: ARTE Museum Dubai Tickets - Step Into a World of Light & ImaginationHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeActivitiesDubai CityCulture And AttractionsArte Museum DubaiShareAdd to Wishlist3 ImagesView GalleryArte Museum DubaiNewOperating HoursApprox 10:00 am to 12:00 pmInstant ConfirmationInstant Tour Confirmation will be Provided.Mobile Voucher AcceptedUse your phone or print your voucherNon RefundableEnglishGoogle MapArte Museum Dubai HighlightsEnter the MENA region’s first-of-its-kind ARTE Museum Dubai within the Dubai Mall, as it takes you on a sensory journey like no other, thanks to the creative minds at d’strict.  Wander through 14 creative zones depicting astonishing visual art centered on the “Eternal Nature” theme.  Don’t just marvel at the exhibitions; immerse yourself in them with the brilliant soundscape by Young-gyu Jang and the nature-inspired scents by Marianne Nawrocki Sabatier.  Be greeted by the delicate nuances of nature at every turn, from the sounds of crashing waves and authentic fragrances to the immaculate lighting that adds to the exhibits’ surreal beauty.   Relax at the Arte Bar, with the chance to relish revitalizing mocktails amid unique and colorful artworks.Arte Museum Dubai InclusionsARTE Museum Entry Tickets  Access to 14 exhibitions  Roundtrip transfers (only if selected at the time of booking)Arte Museum Dubai ExclusionsAll personal expenses spend for dining, shopping, photograph etc on-siteArte Museum Dubai How to RedeemPlease check your mail box and download the ticket. Present it at the ticket and  scan it at venueScan the physical tickets at the venue to gain entry. Arte Museum Dubai OverviewBe ready to experience MENA’s first immersive digital art attraction in Dubai with your ARTE Museum ticket. 14 exhibitions themed around “Eternal Nature” and spread across this 2,800 square-meter artscape on the Dubai Mall’s second level will journey you through a magical world. True to its theme, it allows you to experience nature at its best with a multisensory adventure, flawlessly coalescing light, sound, and scents. With temperatures rising up to 50 degrees Celsius, it may be unbearably hot, but it’s intensely cool indoors, and super chilly attractions (such as Ski Dubai, Dubai Ice Rink, and Chillout Lounge) make up for it. The added perk is that it lets you see the region’s iconic landmarks in their calmer, crowd-free version.How To Reach DubaiDubai is an internationally famed city that attracts over 16 million visitors every year. So it goes without saying that there are regular flights from different parts of the globe (almost on daily basis) to reach here. Unsurprisingly, Dubai International Airport is one of the world’s busiest airports. You can also enter Dubai via other airports or entry points across the UAE, such as Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, and Sharjah.To visit Dubai or the UAE via road from its neighboring countries including Oman, you must carry all your essential documents to ensure a smooth entry into Dubai. Now, if you are traveling to Dubai from other emirates, there are affordable yet reliable bus services that transfer you to Dubai on time and safely. You can also count on our convenient private transfers to reach Dubai.Best Places To Visit In DubaiBurj Khalifa:No introduction is probably required to describe this record-breaking attraction. At a height of about 828 meters, it is currently the world’s tallest man-made structure and undoubtedly one of Dubai’s greatest attractions. Get your admission tickets to its observatory decks on the 124th or 148th level – this is one of the best ways to access its interiors. It not only provides an unmatched overview of the city skyline but also comes with an incredibly swift elevator ride that journeys you to the viewing deck in less than a minute.The Dubai Mall:Located adjacent to Burj Khalifa in Downtown Dubai, this is a must-see on any Dubai visit, being one of the world’s largest malls. Besides its over 1200 retail outlets and some 200 dining options, it is an absolute oasis for fun and leisure lovers of all age groups. There is the wondrous Dubai Aquarium and Underwater zoo, the one-of-its-kind Dubai Ice Rink, the largest-of-its-kind VR Park Dubai, and the kid-exclusive KidZania Dubai, among others. As you step out of the mall, be sure to catch the strikingly choreographed Dubai Fountain show in perfect sync with music and light.Palm Jumeirah:This man-made island is another definite-see attraction in Dubai. Designed to resemble a vast palm tree topped by a crescent, it is an epicenter of fantastic sights and extraordinary experiences in the city. Stroll through the breathtaking Boardwalk, take a selfie against the imposing façade of Atlantis, The Palm Resort, have some amazing water fun at Aquaventure Water Park, and mostly watch the brand-new Palm Fountain show, which is the largest fountain in the world.Dubai Parks and Resorts:Theme parks, amusement, and adventure can’t get any better than with a visit to the Middle East’s first as well as the largest integrated resort. After all, it hosts four amazing parks, such as Hollywood-based Motiongate Dubai, LEGO-themed LEGOLAND Dubai, and LEGOLAND Water Park.Bluewaters Island:This waterfront destination is one of the region’s newest landmarks. However, it is more than an impressive spot filled with intricate architecture. It boasts some of Dubai’s most astonishing and ground-breaking attractions, mainly Ain Dubai - the world’s highest Ferris wheel, Madame Tussauds Museum - the first of its kind in the Middle East, and 3D World Selfie Museum Dubai, which is the world’s largest 3D museum.Al Bastakiya Quarter:Dubai isn’t just a place to take in the towering skyscrapers and endless leisure attractions. It’s a favorite of culture and history buffs as well. For those looking for a step-back moment in Dubai, a must-visit is Al Bastakiya Quarter, also known as Al Fahidi Historical Neighborhood. This 19th-century quarter is still preserved in its original glory, giving you an enlightening insight into the region’s lifestyle before the discovery of oil.Things To Do In DubaiDubai City Tour: Whether you are a first-timer or someone who doesn’t want to explore Dubai on your own, it is highly recommended to see this wonderful city on a guided sightseeing tour. For this, Rayna Tours has several options at your disposal; take a Big Bus Tour or opt for our city tour, which includes both hotel pick-up and drop-off.Dhow Cruise:Looking for an alternative sightseeing experience in Dubai? Set out on an atmospheric cruise aboard a traditional dhow along Dubai Creek or Dubai Marina. This allows you to see Dubai’s breathtaking cityscape from an unmatched vantage point on the water. For a memorable evening in Dubai, choose from our diverse dhow cruise packages complete with buffet dining and live entertainment shows, such as Tanura.Desert Safari: A desert safari in Dubai introduces you to the region’s raw desert beauty and serenity, which still remains unscathed by any kind of development. With our vast repertoire of desert safari packages, you can make your desert safari as adventurous and action-packed or as relaxed as possible. Take your pick from a morning or evening desert safari, featuring 4X4 dune bash, camel ride, BBQ dining, and traditional performances such as belly Dance and Tanura. You can take your desert outing to the next level with an overnight desert safari.Skiing at Ski Dubai:Dubai is a land of unbelievable experiences! So, if you fancy a session of skiing or snow sledding in the desert city, it is effortlessly possible here – just head to Ski Dubai at Mall of the Emirates. This snow-themed destination is the Middle East’s first resort. Yes, it is a real wonderland where you get to enjoy your favorite winter pastimes year-round, even when the summer heat is at its peak.Capture a Pose Against Burj Al Arab: No Dubai trip is complete until you visit this iconic sail-shaped structure and at least click a picture against it. For those who don’t know, it is one of the most luxurious accommodations in the world. Set on its own private island, it is an all-suite resort.What To Eat In DubaiWith over 200 nationalities calling Dubai their second home, you can imagine the sheer diversity of its gastronomic scene. Apart from this, it is also the destination where stunning dining settings, scrumptious street food flavors, and Insta-worthy delicacies overlap. Not to mention, be it spicy Indian, traditional English-style breakfast, or authentic Japanese Sushi, you get to relish or try whatever your taste bud craves for once in Dubai. While you enjoy your favorite cuisines, be sure not to miss the opportunity to sample the traditional Arabic dishes, particularly Shawarma, Falafel with Hummus, Manakeesh, and Al Machboos. There are also a few local desserts worth trying, including Luqaimat, Kunafah, Mehalabiya, and Umm Ali.Shopping In DubaiDubai is a one-stop shopping destination! Its mix of over 70 giant malls and several traditional souks (Arabian bazaars), spread across the Deira and Bur Dubai regions, is a testament to this fact. So, whether you want to indulge in the up-to-date shopping trends or do super bargain shopping, Dubai caters to every pocket and preference. What’s more? Dubai is the venue of the Dubai Shopping Festival (DSF) – an annual event that is dedicated to shopping, dining, leisure, and entertainment. If you are a shopping enthusiast, don’t miss adding this event (that falls in January – February) to your Dubai tour package; it lets you bag the latest and most luxurious merchandise with discounts of up to 70% to 90%.Best Hotels In DubaiFrom over-the-top to the most affordable, Dubai has hotels to suit every budget and style. In fact, every accommodation in Dubai has its own character. For the comforts enhanced by epic grandeur, there are sure-fire choices like Atlantis, The Palm Resort, Burj Al Arab, Le Royal Meridian Beach Resort & Spa, and Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf. If you are looking for budget-friendly accommodation with decent comforts, there are endless (two-star and three-star) options in the Deira and Bur Dubai areas.How To Get Dubai VisaIf you are not qualified for any kind of visa exemptions, you must mandatorily apply and get your Dubai visa approved well in advance of your intended travel date. title: Dubai Essentials with Seasonal Wonders | Season's Best Package
meta_description: Enjoy Dubai’s essential attractions plus seasonal highlights with this well-crafted holiday package designed for a memorable Dubai vacation.
content: Dubai Essentials with Seasonal Wonders | Season's Best PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Essentials With Seasonal WondersShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryDubai Essentials With Seasonal WondersNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersOverviewFrom November to March, Dubai is the perfect time to visit, with pleasant weather and seasonal attractions. This five-day Dubai seasonal holiday package allows you to explore the city’s limited-time spots such as the Dubai Miracle Garden and Global Village, along with a Dubai city tour, a visit to the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall attractions, and  an adventurous desert safari with dinner. Ideal for families, couples, and friends,   our Dubai seasonal packages incudes comfortable stays, breakfast, private airport transfers, and tickets to popular and seasonal attractions.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai, Dubai Creek Dhow Cruise with DinnerAfter arrival in Dubai, our representative will meet you and transfer you to your hotel for check-in. The day is free till the evening for you to relax. Your first seasonal holiday package Dubai experience is a traditional dhow cruise on Dubai Creek. Enjoy the pleasant, cool breeze and the illuminated Old Dubai sights along Dubai Creek and relish a delicious dinner onboard amid breathtaking waterfront views, before heading back to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 2Half-Day Dubai City Tour, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain, and Dubai Mall AttractionsStart the 2nd day of your holiday with a wholesome breakfast at the hotel. Later, explore Dubai's famous landmarks and iconic sights on a half-day Dubai City Tour. Drive past architectural and cultural marvels like the Jumeirah Mosque and Palm Jumeirah. Take a short pause at the Burj Al Arab to capture its grandeur. Our driver will drop you off at the Burj Khalifa, where you will ascend this magnificent tower to witness Dubai's stunning landscape from a breathtaking vantage point with the ‘At the Top’ Burj Khalifa prime hour experience. After witnessing the panoramic view, spend the rest of the day exploring the Dubai Mall and enjoying the Dubai Fountain spectacle. Have a fascinating time at the Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo, and the House of Hype. Wrap up the day with a transfer back to your hotel. Stay overnight at the hotel in Dubai.Day 3Dubai Desert Safari Experience with BBQ DinnerAfter breakfast, relax and spend your day as you please. In the afternoon, get set for a road trip that takes you beyond the city limits and deep into the golden dunes of the Dubai desert. Here, spend the rest of the afternoon enjoying thrills like dune bashing, sandboarding, and camel rides. As evening falls, settle down for a sunset viewing experience, followed by a night filled with upbeat Arabic music, live belly dancing, and Tanoura shows. Satiate your hunger with a grand BBQ buffet dinner amid the tranquil vibes of the desert. After enjoying a side of Dubai that stands in stark contrast to its modern image, head back to the city for an overnight stay.Day 4Global Village and Dubai Miracle GardenHave breakfast at the hotel and gear up to experience two of Dubai’s most loved seasonal attractions. In the morning, head to the world's largest floral wonderland, the Dubai Miracle Garden. Over 150 million flowers adorn this sprawling landscape, making it hard to believe this site was once a barren desert land. Step inside and prepare to be amazed by the vibrant flowers arranged in stunning heart shapes, massive floral sculptures, and even a life-sized Emirates Airbus. Do not forget to take plenty of pictures. Later, head to a one-of-a-kind cultural theme park, Global Village. Get a glimpse of the world in a matter of hours by exploring the fascinating culture, cuisine, and entertainment of over 90 different countries. Transfer to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 5Departure from DubaiThis is your last day in your Dubai seasonal holiday package. Enjoy the day after breakfast at the hotel. Stroll around the city, visit that restaurant you liked once more, indulge in a spa experience, or shop for souvenirs until it is time for checkout. A private car will drop you off at the airport for your flight out of Dubai.Hotel OptionsAdmiral Plaza Hotel or SimilarAsiana Hotel or SimilarKnight Castle Hotel or Similar Previous Next12Inclusion4 nights’ accommodation in Dubai (in the mentioned hotels)Daily breakfast at the hotelReturn airport transfers on a private basisDhow Cruise on Dubai Creek (with dinner) on shared transfersHalf-day Dubai city tour on shared transfers (ends at Burj Khalifa)Burj Khalifa ‘At the Top’ Prime Hour ticketDubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo ticketHouse of Hype ticketDubai Mall and Dubai Fountain Walk with one-way shared transfer to the hotel.Evening Desert safari with BBQ dinner on shared transfersUAE Tourist VisaTravel InsuranceExclusionDomestic / International Flight ticketsGST and TCS, if applicableLaundry ChargesInternational or National CallsMeals not mentioned in above ItineraryAdditional Transfers or Sightseeing not mentioned in itineraryTIPS / Porter Charges / Room serviceTourism Dirhams (15-20 AED per room per night approx.)Departure & PricingPackage price: Per person | Currency: AED | Travel Date: Till May 2026HotelCategoryAdult- DoubleOccupancySingleOccupancyTripleOccupancyChild WithBedChild WithoutBed3*263935252545234917494*319543452989256917495*32654560303518591749Stay optionsCityStay3*4*5*Dubai4 NightsAdmiral Plaza Hotel Dubai 3* or similarAsiana Hotel 4* or SimilarKnight Castle Hotel 5* or SimilarNote: Additional supplements will apply on the following dates:Christmas : 24th to 26th December 2026New Year : 31th Dec 2026 to 01st Jan 2027Eid Al Fitr : 20–22th, March 2026 Eid Al Adha : 26–29th, May 2026 Arab Health : 09th to 12th Feb 2026Gulf Food : 26 Jan 2026 – 30 Jan 2026The Big 5 Global : Nov 23–26, 2026 GITEX Global : Dec 8–11, 2026 Flights DetailsFlights are not included in this package.Visa DetailsThis package will comes with 30 days Dubai tourist Visa included. title: Dubai Kids Adventure Holiday | Dubai Kids Theme Park Package
meta_description: Let the center of your Dubai Holiday package revolve around theme parks and kids adventure — more cheers and smiles on this theme park holiday package.
content: Dubai Kids Adventure Holiday | Dubai Kids Theme Park PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Kids Adventure And Theme Park Holiday PackageShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D3 ImagesView GalleryDubai Kids Adventure And Theme Park Holiday PackageNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewExplore the popular family holiday destination of Dubai with this tour package, designed especially for kids. This Dubai 7-day kids’ adventure package covers all of Dubai’s best sights and sounds. The package includes a stay at a cozy hotel at a prime location in Dubai. Shared transfers and access to the important landmarks, attractions, and activities are also included in this tour package. The tour begins with a dhow cruise on Dubai Marina, followed by a city tour, a visit to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, an adventurous evening with the desert safari, visits to some of the best theme and water parks in Dubai, and ends with a visit to the Museum of the Future. This Dubai tour package is not just adventurous but also fun, entertaining, and informational. ItineraryDay 1Arrival and Dhow Cruise at Dubai MarinaExploration begins on the first day of your trip. Once you are settled in your Dubai hotel, it is time to get ready for a relaxing dinner at a one-of-a-kind restaurant. The dhow cruise (a traditional wooden boat) sails along on the Dubai Marina, a Venetian-style Canal. Apart from the city’s glittering sights, the dhow cruise also includes a 3-course buffet dinner and an entertaining Tanoura dance performance.Day 2Dubai City Tour, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai MallDay two covers the city’s iconic attractions. After breakfast, you head out for a half-day city tour that takes you to the prominent landmarks of the city. The tour ends with a drop-off at the Burj Khalifa, where you head up to the observation deck on the 124th floor (At the Top). Then it is time to explore the gems of the Dubai Mall. After checking out the 33,000 marine animals at Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, parents can relax while kids play and learn at KidZania, an interactive edutainment center for children. The last stop is Play DXB, an indoor virtual reality park with games and attractions for kids and adults.Day 3Desert Safari with BBQ DinnerDay three begins with some leisure time to relax at the hotel or explore the city on your own. After a light lunch, it is time for the most exciting part of your tour, the desert safari. It begins with a thrilling dune bashing ride, followed by camel riding, sandboarding, and quad biking. Entertainment programs like Tanoura, belly dance performances, and fire show are also part of the desert safari. The desert safari tour concludes with a BBQ dinner.Day 4IMG Worlds of AdventureDubai is home to multiple world-class theme parks, and day four is dedicated to the largest indoor theme park in the world. The IMG Worlds of Adventure is spread over 1,500,000 square meters and has six zones. The rides range from kid-friendly to thrilling, ensuring that there is something for all age groups. Do not forget to check out the retail stores and restaurants here.Day 5Dubai Parks & ResortsAs part of the Dubai kids theme park package, day five of the tour is a visit to the Dubai Parks & Resorts. Here, you can choose one of the four amusement parks. Motiongate Dubai is for hardcore fans of Hollywood and thrilling rides, while Real Madrid World is for football enthusiasts. If you are visiting with kids (between 2 and 12 years), Dubai Parks & Resorts offers Legoland Dubai and Legoland Water Park.Day 6Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark & Museum of the FutureSpend the last day of your Dubai kids adventure package at Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark, located in Hotel Atlantis the Palm. It is one of the largest water parks in the UAE and is home to more than 105 slides, experiences, and attractions. You can enjoy an array of slides and attractions, right from family-friendly to record-breaking ones. There is a dedicated area for younger kids as well. You can also access a private beach here. After a fun day at the water park, spend your evening exploring the Museum of the Future and its numerous futuristic exhibitions.Day 7DeparturePack your bags, enjoy your breakfast, and head over to
