meta_description: Celebrate Eid Ul Fitr in Uzbekistan! Enjoy return flights from Sharjah, hotel stays, guided Tashkent sightseeing, cultural tours, transfers & travel insurance. Book now!
content: Explore Uzbekistan Eid Ul Fitr Special – 4N/5D Tashkent TourHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysTashkentExplore Uzbekistan Eid Ul Fitr SpecialShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryExplore Uzbekistan Eid Ul Fitr SpecialNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewUzbekistan is a Central Asian nation and former Soviet republic. It’s known for its mosques, mausoleums and other sites linked to the Silk Road, the ancient trade route between China and the Mediterranean. Samarkand, a major city on the route, contains a landmark of Islamic architecture: The Registan, a plaza bordered by 3 ornate, mosaic-covered religious schools dating to the 15th and 17th centuries.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Tashkent Midnight 02:10 AM (18th Mar)Departure on 17th March from Sharjah at 21:50 & Arrival in Tashkent 18th Mar at 02:10Once you land at Islam Karimov Tashkent International Airport, our friendly representative will greet you and escort you and transfer to the hotel in Tashkent. Check-in to the hotel. Day 2Half-Day City HighlightsToday, have breakfast at a hotel morning will be Leisure and in afternoon sightseen begins: Lal Bahadur Shastri MonumentPay homage to India’s former Prime Minister at this symbolic site commemorating his contribution and his final days in Tashkent.Tashkent TV TowerOne of the tallest structures in Central Asia, enjoy panoramic views of the city from the observation deck.     Take a relaxing stroll through this modern urban park featuring landscaped gardens, fountains, and leisure areas. Overnight stay at the hotel in TashkentDay 3Full-Day Tashkent City TourToday, following breakfast, you will enjoy a pleasant day trip of Tashkent city tour. Tashkent is the capital city of Uzbekistan. It’s known for its many museums and its mix of modern and Soviet-era architecture. The Amir Timur Museum houses manuscripts, weapons and other relics from the Timurid dynasty. Nearby, the huge State Museum of History of Uzbekistan has centuries-old Buddhist artifacts. The city’s skyline is distinguished by Tashkent Tower, which offers city views from its observation deck.Minor Mosque A beautiful modern white-marble mosque located near the Ankhor River. Chorsu Bazaar Explore this traditional and vibrant market, ideal for souvenirs, spices, and local street snacks.Plov Center (Central Asian Plov House) Taste the famous Uzbek national dish cooked in giant cauldrons. Khast Imam Square Visit the spiritual center of Tashkent including the Muyi Muborak Library, home to the world's oldest Quran. Magic CityA modern entertainment complex with European-style streets, cafes, and attractions. Drop-off at Hotel.Overnight stay at hotel in Tashkent.Day 4Amirsoy Mountain Resort, Chimgan & ChorvoqToday, following breakfast you will processed to Amirsoy Mountain Resort is the largest ski resort in Uzbekistan, and the most modern ski resort in Central Asia. It opened in 2019 in the Western Tian Shan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and has been described by Lonely Planet as “next season St Moritz.”Amirsoy Mountain Resort Enjoy scenic beauty, mountain views, and optional activities like cable car rides, zipline, ATV rides, or chair lifts. Chimgan Mountains A natural escape with stunning landscapes – perfect for nature walks, horse riding, or simply relaxing. Lunch at a local restaurant.Chorvoq Lake Visit the picturesque lake surrounded by mountains, ideal for photography, leisure walks, or a short boat ride. Deer Hills (Deer Heels)Beautiful landscape viewpoint, Overnight stay at hotel in Tashkent.Day 5Spend the Day at Your Leisure Start your day with an early morning breakfast.Evening at Leisure to explore the beauty of the town. meta_description: Book a 7 days Best of Bali tour package including Ubud, Kuta and Nusa Penida with hotels, sightseeing and smooth transfers.
content: 7 Days Best of Bali Tour: Ubud, Kuta & Nusa PenidaHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBaliBali & Nusa Penida DiscoveryShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D4 ImagesView GalleryBali & Nusa Penida DiscoveryNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewDiscover the beauty and romance of Bali with an immersive six-night itinerary crafted specifically for couples, newlyweds, and families. This all-inclusive holiday journey combines cultural exploration, relaxation, and thrilling activities, ensuring an unforgettable vacation in this mesmerizing island destination. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bali & Transfer to Ubud Arrive in Bali and get transferred to your accommodation in Ubud. After hotel check-in, spend the rest of your day unwinding in your room. Alternatively, set out to embrace the laid-back vibe, enjoy the sun, or take a leisurely walk along the shore.  Day 2Central Bali (Kintamani, Tegenungan Waterfall, Tegallalang Rice Terraces, and Bali Swing)Begin your second day with a visit to Central Bali, heading to Kintamani. Explore the Tegenungan Waterfall while taking in the sight of the cascading waters. Following this, enjoy the scenic beauty of the unparalleled Tegallalang Rice Terraces. Stroll through the lush green terraces, and don’t miss the iconic Bali Swing for an exhilarating experience above the rice fields. Day 3Leisure Day with Shopping & One-Hour Massage Spend your morning wandering through bustling local markets and chic boutiques in Ubud. Whether you’re searching for traditional crafts, local art, or fashion, the shopping experience is vibrant and diverse. Wrap up your leisurely day with a rejuvenating one-hour traditional Balinese massage session. This indulgent experience will melt away any remaining tension, leaving you refreshed and relaxed.  Day 4Handara Gate, Ulun Danu, and Tanah Lot Sunset tour After breakfast, checkout from your hotel in Ubud & proceed to check in at your Kuta Hotel. Kick off your day with a visit to the iconic Handara Gate, located in the lush Bedugul region. This picturesque gate, often featured in photos symbolizing Bali’s spiritual charm, is the entrance to the Handara Golf Course and creates a perfect frame against the misty mountains. Continue your journey to the stunning Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, nestled along the shores of Lake Beratan. Marvel at the temple’s unique location, seemingly floating on water, and its classic Balinese architecture with intricate carvings. As the day winds down, head to the legendary Tanah Lot Temple, one of Bali's most famous sea temples, perched on a rocky outcrop amidst crashing ocean waves. As the sun sets, find a spot to witness the breathtaking spectacle where the temple silhouette meets the fiery sunset sky.Day 5Water sport (Banana, Couple Parasailing, and Jet Ski) and Uluwatu Sunset tourMost thrilling experiences await you, as you enjoy a fun-filled banana boat ride, soar high above the coastal landscape with a parasailing experience, zoom across the region’s water on a Jet Ski session. In the evening, make your way to the stunning cliffs of Uluwatu, home to one of Bali’s most iconic temples, Pura Luhur Uluwatu. As the sun begins to dip into the horizon, catch the most breathtaking views of the surroundings.  Day 6Nusa Penida West tour (Broken Beach, Angel beach, Crystal beach, and klingking Beach) Set sail to Nusa Penida Island for a day of exploration. Visit incredible sites like Broken Beach, Angel’s Billabong, Crystal Bay, and Klingking Beach. Marvel at the stunning landscapes and take time for relaxation and photography. Day 7Departure Spend your final morning enjoying a relaxed breakfast and reflecting on your Balinese adventure. Prepare for departure, with memories of Bali’s culture, beauty, and adventures in your heart.Hotel OptionsRisata Bali Resort and Spaa or similar Previous Next1234Inclusion6 nights’ accommodation in well-rated hotels in Ubud and Kuta/Seminyak with daily breakfastAirport pick-up and drop-offAll sightseeing transfers as per the itineraryCentral Bali tour including Kintamani, Tegenungan Waterfall, Tegallalang Rice Terrace, and Bali SwingHandara Gate, Ulun Danu Temple, and Tanah Lot Sunset tourUluwatu Sunset tourNusa Penida West Island tour including Broken Beach, Angel’s Billabong, Crystal Bay, and Kelingking BeachWater sports activities including Banana Boat, Couple Parasailing, and Jet SkiOne-hour traditional Balinese massageAll entrance fees and parking charges for mentioned sightseeing pointReturn fast boat transfers to Nusa PenidaEnglish-speaking driver/guide throughout the toursAll applicable government taxes and service chargesExclusionInternational and domestic airfareBali visa (if applicable) and travel insuranceMeals other than daily breakfastOptional activities such as Kecak Dance at UluwatuPersonal expenses like laundry, phone calls, mini-bar, and shoppingTips or gratuities for drivers, guides, or hotel staffAnything not explicitly mentioned in the inclusionsImportant InformationRayna Tours – Easy Terms & Conditions for Your TripWe want your travel experience to be smooth and enjoyable. meta_description: Book a Kuala Lumpur Langkawi holiday package with hotels, sightseeing, island hopping and smooth transfers for a perfect getaway.
content: Kuala Lumpur and Langkawi Holiday Package | Upto 30% OffHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysKuala LumpurKuala Lumpur And Langkawi DuoShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D4 ImagesView GalleryKuala lumpur and Langkawi DuoNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewCelebrate the beginning of your forever in the heart of Malaysia - a land of timeless beauty, vibrant culture, and breathtaking landscapes. This 6-day honeymoon itinerary blends the modern charm of Kuala Lumpur with the island paradise of Langkawi, creating a perfect balance of exploration and relaxation. From iconic towers and historic cities to tranquil beaches and romantic sunset cruises, every moment is designed for connection, adventure, and lifelong memories. Whether you're strolling through cultural treasures or sipping champagne on the sea, this is your honeymoon haven.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Kuala Lumpur - City Tour & KL Tower ViewsUpon arrival at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, you’ll be warmly welcomed and privately transferred to your hotel. After check-in and a short rest, begin your Malaysian adventure with a half-day city tour. Visit highlights such as the Petronas Twin Towers (photo stop), Independence Square, National Mosque, and more. You'll also enjoy entry to KL Tower, where the panoramic cityscape will provide the perfect backdrop for your first honeymoon photo.Day 2Full-Day Historical Malacca TourToday, travel back in time with a full-day guided excursion to the UNESCO-listed city of Malacca, a place steeped in colonial charm and centuries of cultural fusion. Stroll through Dutch Square, visit the ruins of St. Paul’s Church, see A Famosa Fortress, and explore Jonker Street, known for antique shops and local treats. The serene river views and historical stories make this a charming and enriching honeymoon day.Day 3Fly to Langkawi - Check-in & LeisureAfter breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to the beautiful island of Langkawi. Upon arrival, a private transfer will take you to your resort. Spend the rest of the day at leisure - relax by the pool, take a romantic walk on the beach, or indulge in a couple’s spa treatment to unwind.Day 4Langkawi City Tour | Cable Car ComboStart your day with a half-day Langkawi city tour, where you'll visit top attractions such as Eagle Square (Dataran Lang), Atma Alam Batik Village, and Kuah Town for local shopping. Expert Guidance: With over 15 years of experience in designing memorable holidays, you can rest assured that you’ll return with the most cherished memories of your Nuwara Eliya getaway. Best Time to Visit Nuwara Eliya Knowing the weather is crucial, whether you’re considering Nuwara Eliya tour packages from India or the UAE. Nuwara Eliya, perched at an altitude of over 6,000 feet, is characterized by a subtropical highland climate. With average temperatures of 30 degrees Celsius, it can be visited during any part of the year, depending on your personal preferences. Summer: The average temperatures during the summer months (March to June) range from 15 degrees Celsius to 21 degrees Celsius. It’s one of the best times to visit the place, particularly for those looking for a thrilling holiday in the lap of nature. Visiting Nuwara Eliya in April also allows you to be part of vibrant local festivals, such as the Tamil New Year. Monsoon: From July to November, Nuwara Eliya experiences heavy rainfall averaging 15 to 17 mm. While the wet weather may limit outdoor activities and isn’t favored by all travelers, it offers an opportunity for a budget-friendly holiday and can be perfect for a cozy, romantic retreat. Winter: The winter months (December to February) are considered the peak season. Average temperatures are between 10 degrees Celsius to 20 degrees Celsius, occasionally dropping to -2 degrees Celsius. In fact, the climate is overall pleasant with less rainfall. Quick Guide Top Attractions Horton Plains National Park: It’s a UNESCO-listed attraction, where you can experience the World’s End, a dramatic cliff featuring a mesmerizing drop of over 4,000 feet. Lake Gregory: Located in the heart of Nuwara Eliya, this 19th-century lake was created during the tenure of British Governor Sir William Gregory, adding a touch of historical charm to this picturesque destination. Hakgala Botanical Gardens: It’s another historical attraction in Nuwara Eliya, founded in 1861. It’s the country’s second-largest botanical garden, situated at over 5,500 feet and spanning about 30 hectares. Seetha Amman Temple: This ancient Hindu shrine is dedicated to Sita, a revered deity of the Ramayana. It is believed to mark the spot where Lord Hanuman set fire before departing Sri Lanka. Shri Bhakta Hanuman Temple: As the name indicates, this temple is dedicated to Lord Hanuman. The focal point is an 18-foot statue of Lord Hanuman, which is the tallest of its kind in the country. Culture Nuwara Eliya’s culture is an enchanting blend of colonial British heritage and traditional Sri Lankan customs. This unique fusion is reflected in its charming Victorian-style architecture, revered Hindu temples, and the iconic red-brick post office. The city comes alive during vibrant festivals such as Pongal and the full moon Poya Day. Don’t miss the lively atmosphere of its bustling fresh produce markets, where you can truly experience the region’s local spirit. Cuisine The region’s rich culture is beautifully reflected in its cuisine. Here, your taste buds are in for a treat, from traditional delights like rice and curry with fresh vegetables and meats to international flavors including Chinese, Italian, and other Western specialties. Dining options cater to every budget, ranging from casual food courts and charming cafés to elegant, fine-dining restaurants. Practical Tips Nuwara Eliya boasts a cool, refreshing climate year-round, so pack sweaters and light jackets. Be sure to wear modest clothing, especially when visiting temples and conventional places of interest. Book your Nuwara Eliya tour packages from the UAE or Dubai in advance, especially during the peak season from December to April. Always ask locals for permission before clicking their pictures. Drink bottled or filtered water and avoid drinking tap water. Visa & Documentation A Sri Lanka visa is required for traveling to Nuwara Eliya, especially if your nationality does not qualify for visa exemption. For example, travelers booking Nuwara Eliya packages from Dubai may need to apply for a visa based on their nationality. Rayna Tours Visa Assistance At Rayna Tours and Travels, we provide expert assistance for your Sri Lanka visa application. Our team ensures a smooth process in just a few simple steps. From guiding you through the application form and compiling all necessary documents to submitting them to the embassy on your behalf, we support you at every stage until your visa is successfully issued on time. Top Things to Do in Venice Discover the Central Market: No trip to Nuwara Eliya is complete without a visit to the Central Market, where you can shop for an array of local spices, fresh fruits, vegetables, and other authentic delights. Experience Victoria Park: This park in Nuwara Eliya is a must-visit for its tranquil atmosphere and verdant charm, offering the perfect setting for a leisurely stroll during your holiday. Post a Card from the Nuwara Eliya Post Office: Don’t forget to stop at the iconic 19th-century red-brick structure, which is one of the country’s oldest post offices. Tour a Tea Plantation: Nuwara Eliya is easily recognizable for its stunning tea plantations, so ensure you visit one to gain a first-hand experience of the process behind the making of authentic Ceylon tea. Visit a Strawberry Farm: The region’s cool highland climate nurtures some delightful strawberry farms, and stop by one for an unforgettable strawberry-picking experience. How to Reach Nuwara Eliya Although Nuwara Eliya doesn’t have its own airport, it is well-connected to the rest of Sri Lanka by both road and rail. The nearest airport, Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB), is located just over a four-hour drive away. By Road: Nuwara Eliya is easily accessible from Colombo by affordable buses or comfortable private cars. Once there, you can use a tuk-tuk to get around the city. By Rail: The train ride from Colombo or Kandy to Nanu Oya is among the most scenic rail journeys in Sri Lanka. Nanu Oya station, located just a short distance from Nuwara Eliya, serves as the nearest rail stop to the hill station. content: Bali Honeymoon Tour Package | Best Deals for CouplesHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBaliBali Tropical TreasuresShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryBali Tropical TreasuresNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewImmerse yourself in the enchanting allure of Bali with this seven-night itinerary designed to fulfill every traveler's unique aspirations. Whether you're a couple in search of romantic hideaways, newlyweds celebrating your love, or family members eager for adventure, this itinerary offers a captivating fusion of breathtaking landscapes, rich cultural experiences, and exhilarating activities.  ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bali & Transfer to UbudOn arrival, take in the island's warm, tropical air as you transfer to your lush accommodations in Ubud. Spend the day settling into your serene surroundings and take the evening to explore nearby local markets and cafes at your leisure. Day 2Explore Central Bali – Kintamani, Tegenungan Waterfall, Tegallalang Rice Terraces, and Bali Swing Start your day with a scenic drive to Kintamani, where you'll be greeted by breathtaking, panoramic views of the majestic Mount Batur. This volcanic mountain is a sight to behold, with its rugged peaks and stunning Crater Lake that reflect the sky's calming hues. Next, head to Tegenungan Waterfall, a hidden gem known for its cascading waters and lush surroundings. Continue your exploration with a visit to the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces. These terraces are famous for their intricate, cascading patterns and vibrant greens, showcasing a traditional Balinese irrigation system known as subak. End your adventurous day with the renowned Bali Swing. This exhilarating experience will send you soaring over the lush canopy, offering unmatched views of the jungle and terraced landscapes. Capture the thrill and the scenic vistas with your camera, creating picture-perfect memories that will last a lifetime. Day 3Leisure and RelaxationDedicate this day to unwinding. Indulge in some retail therapy at the eclectic boutiques dotted around Ubud. Later, pamper yourselves with a rejuvenating one-hour Balinese massage. Spend the evening at leisure. Day 4Check in to Kuta & Handara Gate, Ulun Danu, and Tanah Lot Sunset tour After breakfast, checkout from your hotel in Ubud & proceed to check in at your Kuta Hotel. Begin your exploration with a visit to the renowned Handara Gate, a popular spot celebrated for its striking entrance that frames the lush, verdant background beautifully. Following this, make your way to Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, gracefully situated on the serene shores of Lake Beratan. As dusk approaches, proceed to the iconic Tanah Lot Temple, a rock formation revered not just for its cultural significance but also for its breathtaking sunsets. Stand in awe as the sun begins its descent, casting a warm glow over the ocean and illuminating the temple's silhouette, creating a scene that is nothing short of magical. Check in to Resort in Kuta.Day 5Water sport (Banana, Couple Parasailing, and Jet Ski) and Uluwatu Sunset tour Kick off your third day in Bali and quench your thirst for adventure with a morning packed full of adrenaline-pumping water sports. Ride the waves on a Banana Boat for a fun, exhilarating group experience. For those seeking the skies, indulge in parasailing, which glides you over the crystal-clear waters and relish the bird’s-eye view of Bali’s stunning coastline. Cap off your aquatic escapade by whizzing across the beach on a Jet Ski, feeling the rush of wind and surf as you zip through the sea. You’ll next venture on an Uluwatu Sunset tour, which allows you to explore the Uluwatu Temple. This ancient sea temple stands majestically on the edge of a steep cliff, offering not only panoramic views over the Indian Ocean but also an immersion into Bali's sacred traditions.  Day 6 Nusa Penida West Tour Embark on a day trip to the scenic Nusa Penida. Discover the stunning landscapes of Broken Beach, Angel’s Billabong, and the famous Kelingking Beach. Cap off this adventure with a relaxing time at Crystal Beach, where you can swim and sunbathe. Day 7ATV Ride & White River Rafting Add some excitement to your trip with an adventurous ATV ride, navigating through Bali’s varied terrains. Start the adventure by boarding a glass-bottom boat to Turtle Island. Admire the vibrant marine life visible through the boat’s floor and enjoy interacting with various species of sea turtles. It's an enriching experience for all ages. In the evening, visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple. Continue your exploration with a visit to Tegenungan Waterfall. Nestled in lush greenery, it offers an idyllic setting for a revitalizing dip or simply soaking in the serene surroundings. Wind up your day with an adrenaline-pumping Bali Swing experience. Swing high above the rice terraces, providing a unique and exhilarating way to see Bali from a new perspective. Day 4Relaxation | Leisure - Massage and Shopping After days filled with adventure and exploration, day four is dedicated to relaxation and indulgence. title: 8 Days Bali Family Holiday Package | Beaches & Culture
meta_description: Explore beaches, temples and cultural attractions with an 8 days Bali family holiday package designed for comfort and relaxation.
content: 8 Days Bali Family Holiday Package | Beaches & CultureHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBaliBali Family Bonding AdventureShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryBali Family Bonding AdventureNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewDiscover Bali’s enchanting allure with our expertly curated 7-night itinerary, ideal for adventurers, outdoor enthusiasts, and families. Each day is carefully designed to showcase the island's breathtaking scenery and cultural vibrancy, while providing ample time for leisure and adventure. Enjoy romantic strolls through emerald paddies, dive into the heart of Balinese culture, or snorkel in pristine blue waters; this journey offers unforgettable experiences. ItineraryDay 1 Arrival in Bali - Transfer to Ubud Following your arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport, you will be transferred to the lush cultural heart of the island, Ubud. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day unwinding from your travels. Take some quiet time to explore the charming streets, filled with art markets, cafes, and lush greenery.  Day 2Central Bali Adventure Today, immerse yourself in the breathtaking landscapes of Central Bali. Begin with a visit to Kintamani, where you can revel in the stunning views of Mount Batur and its surrounding crater lake. The next stop is at Tegenungan Waterfall, a favorite spot for couples and families alike for its unrivaled natural beauty and the opportunity for a refreshing swim. After this, witness the iconic lush rice terraces of Tegallalang. A romantic walk through these emerald-green fields offers perfect photo opportunities. Before the tour ends, experience the thrill of soaring above the rice fields on the famous Bali Swing, a perfect activity for adventure-seeking couples. Day 3 Relaxation and Leisure Enjoy a leisurely morning exploring Ubud’s traditional markets, where you can find bespoke souvenirs and crafts. Later, indulge in a soothing one-hour Balinese massage, perfect for couples looking to unwind and rejuvenate.Day 4North Bali Exploration After breakfast, checkout from your hotel in Ubud & proceed to check in at your Kuta Hotel. Enroute explore the cultural and spiritual beauty of North Bali. Visit the iconic Handara Gate, often referred to as the “Gateway to Heaven,” where you can capture the famous shot of the striking Balinese structure. You’ll next set out to discover the serene beauty of Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a picturesque water temple on Lake Beratan. Conclude your day with a pause at Tanah Lot, one of Bali’s most important sea temples. Enjoy breathtaking sunset views, a must-experience on your Bali trip. Check in to Kuta.Day 5Tropical Exploration and Scenic Views The day offers a blend of wildlife and breathtaking vistas. Embark on a glass-bottom boat tour to Turtle Island, where you can engage with marine life. In the evening, embark on an Uluwatu sunset tour, situated on a dramatic cliff, to catch a spectacular sunset. Don’t miss the traditional Kecak dance performance, perfect for cultural enthusiasts. Day 6Discover the Beauty of Nusa Penida Today, you’ll take a full-day excursion to Nusa Penida’s stunning west coast! Begin by exploring Broken Beach and Angel’s Billabong, where the ocean dramatically crashes into a natural pool, creating a mesmerizing landscape of rugged beauty. Next, visit the famous Klingking Beach, renowned for its iconic T-Rex shaped cliff, perfect for capturing unforgettable photos. Spend a relaxing afternoon at Crystal Bay, renowned for its crystal-clear waters, ideal for swimming and snorkeling.  Day 7GWK Temple, Tanah Barak, Dream Land Beach As your Bali journey comes to a close, balance your experiences with both cultural depth and leisurely relaxation. Visit the Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park (GWK), where impressive sculptures and engaging cultural exhibits provide an insight into Bali’s rich heritage. Afterward, head to Tanah Barak, a hidden gem featuring unique red earth formations. Wrap up your day at Dream Land Beach, where you can soak up the sun, take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear waters, or simply unwind in a tranquil setting.  Day 8Departure On your final day, enjoy a leisurely breakfast at your hotel before checking out. You will be transferred back to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your departure, taking with you unforgettable memories of your Balinese adventure.  Hotel OptionsAlam Puisi Villa Ubud or This thoughtfully curated five-day itinerary encapsulates the rich and diverse offerings of Bali, especially tailored for couples and senior citizens seeking a harmonious blend of relaxation and exploration. Every day reveals a new aspect of this tropical paradise, from lush greenery to captivating traditions.   ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bali & Transfer to Kuta Your journey begins with touching down at Ngurah Rai International Airport. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your comfortable hotel in Kuta, a lively area known for its vibrant atmosphere and stunning beaches. Spend the evening settling in and enjoying your leisure time, perhaps taking a gentle stroll along Kuta Beach as the sun sets on the horizon.  Day 2Turtle Island & Uluwatu Sunset Tour Start your morning with a serene boat ride to Turtle Island, where you can appreciate the beauty of nature during a guided tour of the turtle conservation area. It takes you on a journey through the cultural epicenter of Bali, majestic temples, striking coastlines, and unspoiled beaches, ensuring a perfect mix of thrilling adventures and tranquil moments. With each new day presenting thrilling experiences, prepare for a rewarding journey that embodies the spirit of this magical island.  ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bali and Transfer to Ubud Be greeted by a friendly guide as you touch down at Ngurah Rai International Airport. Following a smooth transfer to your accommodation in Ubud, the cultural heart of Bali, spend the day relaxing in your room or exploring the region’s vibrant arts scene, shopping options, or Balinese cuisine. Day 2Explore Central Bali Start your day with a visit to the Kintamani region, where you’ll be treated to breathtaking views of Mount Batur and its serene crater lake. Afterward, cool off with a refreshing dip at Tegenungan Waterfall, surrounded by lush, picturesque scenery. Continue your exploration with a visit to the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces, where you can meander through stunning emerald landscapes. For a dash of adrenaline and beautiful panoramic views, try the Bali Swing overlooking the rice fields.Day 3Leisure Day for Relaxation with One-Hour Massage Dedicate this day to unwinding and leisure experiences in Ubud. Explore the bustling markets to find unique souvenirs and local crafts. Later, indulge in a one-hour traditional Balinese massage, which leaves you rejuvenated for the adventures that lie ahead.Day 4 Handara Gate, Ulun Danu, and Tanah Lot Sunset tour After breakfast, checkout from your hotel in Ubud & proceed to check in at your Kuta Hotel. Embark on a cultural journey to Bali’s renowned landmarks. Begin at the Instagram-worthy Handara Gate, nestled in the lush highlands. Continue to the Ulun Danu Bratan Temple, a stunning water temple on the shores of Lake Bratan. In the evening, head to Tanah Lot Temple for a mesmerizing sunset tour, capturing the temple’s silhouette against a glistening ocean backdrop. Day 5 Turtle Island and Uluwatu Sunset Tour Start your day with a meaningful visit to Turtle Island to learn about conservation efforts and see turtles up close. Enjoy a leisurely afternoon on Bali’s pristine beaches before heading to Uluwatu for a stunning cliffside sunset. Here, witness the enchanting Kecak fire dance performance, an iconic cultural experience of Bali.Day 6Nusa Penida West Tour Today’s highlight is a day trip to the breathtaking island of Nusa Penida. Explore the dramatic formations of Broken Beach and the natural infinity pool of Angel’s Billabong. Unwind on the pristine sands of Crystal Beach, and be awestruck by the incredible views from Kelingking Beach, often likened to a T-Rex due to its iconic cliff formations. Day 7Departure After breakfast, take some time for last-minute shopping or enjoy a leisurely stroll around Ubud. content: 8 Days Best of Bali Tour | Ubud, Kuta, Nusa Penida & UluwatuHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBaliBali Together Beyond LimitsShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryBali Together Beyond LimitsNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewExplore the alluring beauty and serenity of Bali through a captivating seven-night itinerary designed for couples, families, and adventure enthusiasts. This journey seamlessly blends relaxation, cultural experiences, and exciting excursions to the island's most picturesque landscapes, ensuring that every guest leaves Bali with cherished memories and a profound sense of connection to the island's extraordinary beauty and spirit.   ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bali & Transfer to Ubud After a meet-and-greet at Ngurah Rai International Airport, you’ll be transferred to the cultural hub of Ubud. Check into your accommodation and spend the rest of the day unwinding. Stroll through Ubud's charming streets, visit local markets, or relax by the pool in preparation for the adventures ahead.Day 2Central Bali - Exploration of Kintamani, Tegenungan Waterfall, Tegallalang Rice Terraces, and Bali Swing Begin your day with a scenic drive to Kintamani, offering spectacular views of the active volcanic Mount Batur and serene Lake Batur. Next, head to Tegenungan Waterfall to experience its natural beauty. Continue to the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces for a glimpse of Bali’s unrivaled agricultural heritage. End the day with a thrilling ride on the famous Bali Swing, perfect for capturing breathtaking photos. Day 3Leisure Day – Shopping and One-Hour Massage Enjoy a leisurely day in Ubud, where time is yours to explore at your own pace. Spend the morning shopping for souvenirs and unique handicrafts in vibrant local markets. Later, indulge in a one-hour traditional Balinese massage to rejuvenate your senses. Day 4North Bali - Handara Gate, Ulun Danu, and Tanah Lot Sunset Tour Your journey to North Bali begins with a visit to the iconic Handara Gate, a perfect photo opportunity amidst lush landscapes. Proceed to the beautiful Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a breathtaking water temple on the shores of Lake Beratan. Wind up your day with a magical sunset tour at Tanah Lot Temple, poised on a rock formation along the coast.Day 5Excursion to Turtle Island and Uluwatu Sunset After breakfast, checkout from your hotel in Ubud & proceed to check in at your Kuta Hotel. Embark on a memorable day trip to Turtle Island, where you can interact with and learn about the conservation of turtles. Following this, head to the dramatic cliff-top Uluwatu Temple for awe-inspiring views and a mesmerizing sunset. Marvel at a traditional Kecak dance performance that brings the temple's legends to life.Day 6Discover Nusa Penida's West Wonders Prepare for an exciting day on Nusa Penida’s west coast. Discover the natural wonders of Broken Beach, Angel’s Billabong, and the famous Kelingking Beach, known for its T-Rex-shaped cliff. Relax and soak up the sun at Crystal Bay, where the pristine waters invite you for a swim. Day 7Southern Bali - GWK Temple, Tanah Barak, and Dreamland Beach Begin the day with a visit to the Garuda Wisnu Kencana (GWK) Cultural Park to admire the majestic statue of Lord Vishnu and Garuda. Explore Tanah Barak before unwinding at Dreamland Beach, known for its stunning coastline and gentle waves. Enjoy your final evening on the island, savoring every moment.Day 8Departure As your enchanting Bali adventure comes to an end, enjoy a leisurely breakfast before checking out. Reflect on memorable moments as you transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for your departure flight, taking home unforgettable memories of your incredible journey. title: 7 Days Luxury Bali Island Retreat Tour Package
meta_description: Indulge in luxury with premium stays, private tours, beaches & spa experiences on this Bali island retreat package with transfers and gourmet breakfast.
content: 7 Days Luxury Bali Island Retreat Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBaliBali Premium Island RetreatShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D3 ImagesView GalleryBali Premium Island RetreatNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverview The Bali Premium Island Retreat offers a harmonious blend of exploration, relaxation, and cultural immersion over seven unforgettable days. This six-night Bali Premium Island Retreat impeccably blends the island's best offerings, with personalized experiences that cater to those seeking both adventure and tranquility. Let Bali's magic captivate your senses, leaving you with a renewed sense of wonder and a deeper appreciation for its cultural and natural treasures. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bali | Ubud Relaxation As you arrive in Bali, head straight to Ubud, the cultural heart of the island. Settle into your chosen accommodation, nestled amid lush rice paddies and tropical greenery, and unwind from your journey. Spend the afternoon exploring Ubud's tranquil surroundings, perhaps visiting the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary or perusing the vibrant local art markets. As evening falls, indulge in a soothing spa treatment, experiencing the traditional Balinese massage techniques. Day 2Ubud & Central Bali Excursion Spend your second day exploring the cultural heart of Bali with an excursion to Ubud and Central Bali. Begin with a visit to the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary, where you'll wander among the lush greenery and playful macaques. Journey to the impressive Tegallalang Rice Terraces next, relishing its iconic landscapes. Afterward, explore Ubud's vibrant art scene, visiting local galleries and the Ubud Art Market. Break for lunch at a traditional warung (eatery) to savor Balinese cuisine. In the afternoon, head to Tirta Empul Temple for a spiritual experience amid its sacred waters. Conclude your day with a breathtaking view of the sunset at Campuhan Ridge Walk, offering a peaceful end to your cultural exploration. Day 3Ubud Cultural Immersion & Leisure Today offers a perfect blend of cultural immersion and leisurely activities. Prepare to explore the region’s markets and art galleries, discovering indigenous works and contemporary pieces. Next, head for a serene stroll amidst the lush rice paddies at Tegallalang, taking in stunning landscapes. Day 4Transfer to Nusa Penida | Island Exploration Embark on an early morning boat transfer to Nusa Penida, an island renowned for its untouched natural beauty and dramatic landscapes. Upon arrival, begin your island exploration with a visit to Kelingking Beach, where towering cliffs form a breathtaking backdrop against the azure waters. Continue to marvel at the region’s unique rock formations and tidal pools. Enjoy a leisurely lunch at a local eatery before heading to Crystal Bay for a relaxing afternoon of snorkeling or lounging on the sandy shores. Wrap up your island adventure as you catch the evening boat back, filled with memories of Nusaida's stunning vistas. Day 5Nusa Penida Adventure & Relaxation Start with an early morning ferry ride to this stunning island. Explore the iconic Kelingking Beach, famed for its T-Rex-shaped cliff, and snap breathtaking photos of its dramatic landscape. Later, savor a local lunch and spend a relaxing afternoon snorkeling in the vibrant underwater world or lounging on the sandy shores. Conclude your day with a picturesque sunset, returning by ferry to Bali with memories of Nusa Penida's untamed beauty. Day 6Return to Bali Mainland (Seminyak) | Jimbaran Candle Light Dinner Today, you’ll return to Bali's mainland, heading towards Seminyak for a day of leisure and relaxation. Spend your afternoon exploring Seminyak's chic boutiques and cafes, savoring the local flavors, or lounging on its pristine beaches. As the day winds down, prepare for a romantic evening with a candlelight dinner in Jimbaran. Treat yourself to a sumptuous seafood feast on the beach, with the gentle sound of waves and the soft glow of flickering candles creating a perfect backdrop for a memorable night. Day 7Departure Start your final day in Bali with a peaceful breakfast, savoring the local flavors one last time. Spend the morning at your leisure and later check out from your accommodation. Your friendly driver will transfer you to the airport, ensuring ample time for security and check-in. As you board your flight, bid farewell to Bali's enchanting landscapes and warm hospitality, knowing the island's charm will remain with you long after your departure. This 5-nights retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. ItineraryDay 1ZURICHWelcome to your tour with Europamundo! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2ZURICH - BERNE - CHILLON CASTLE - GENEVAWe’ll set off for the capital of the country, Bern, one of the most beautiful historic cities in Switzerland. We’ll go to the Rose Garden viewpoint to admire the beautiful landscape of the city, and you’ll have free time in the center. We’ll continue along a scenic road winding through stunning high mountain landscapes, passing charming villages with traditional wooden architecture and traveling through the Gstaad region, renowned for its ski resorts. We’ll include the cable car ride and lunch at Glacier 3000. From its terraces, you’ll enjoy breathtaking views and have the chance to walk across the suspension bridge that connects two peaks. After descending, we’ll journey toward Lake Geneva, an area known for its mild climate and extensive vineyards. We’ll visit Chillon Castle (tickets included), a medieval fortress built on the waters of the lake. Our journey will then take us through the heart of Montreux, an elegant town famous for its jazz festival, following the lake’s shoreline until we reach Geneva. Arrival will be at the end of the day.Note: Our hotel is usually located on the French outskirts of the city.Day 3GENEVA - LAUSANNE - GRUYRES - FRIBOURGAfter breakfast, we’ll include a panoramic tour of Geneva, a city on the shores of Lake Geneva that hosts numerous international organizations. We’ll see the Palace of Nations, the beautiful English Garden with its famous flower clock, and admire the “Jet d’Eau,” the tallest fountain in Europe. Afterwards, you’ll have free time to explore and enjoy lunch.We’ll continue along the shores of Lake Geneva, passing through landscapes of vineyards and snow-capped mountains, until we reach Lausanne, a city in western Switzerland that is home to the International Olympic Committee. We’ll stop at the Olympic Park, located by the lake, an iconic space dedicated to sports and Olympic culture. Then, we’ll head to the walled town of Gruyeres, world-famous for its cheese. Nearby, you’ll find some of Switzerland´s top chocolate makers (including Nestlé and others). We’ll visit the Cailler Chocolate Factory, with a tasting included! We’ll then continue to Fribourg, a bilingual French/German city with a charming old town.Note: Occasionally, accommodation may be in a nearby city.Day 4FRIBOURG - INTERLAKEN - AARE GORGE - LUGANO - CHIASSOWe’ll depart along a small, scenic road through the Bern canton, passing hills, forests, and green fields. We’ll make a photo stop along the way, either at Schwarzenburg Castle or, depending on accommodation, at the viewpoint overlooking Lake Thun or Lake Brienz. We’ll then continue to Interlaken, a tourist town nestled between two lakes. Afterwards, we’ll head to the Aare Gorge, where we’ll explore its impressive ravines (tickets included), followed by an included lunch. Next, we’ll journey toward one of Switzerland’s most spectacular mountain passes, the Susten Pass, with its eternal snow and glaciers. We’ll stop en route to take in the majestic glacier scenery. Surrounded by dramatic peaks, we’ll continue toward the Italian-speaking region of Switzerland, passing through the famous Gotthard Tunnel and stopping in Gandria, a charming lakeside village on Lake Lugano, known for its traditional narrow and steep streets. From there, we’ll board a boat (tickets included) to Lugano, the main city in Italian-speaking Switzerland, famous for its mild climate and beautiful lakeside promenade. Finally, we’ll head to Chiasso, arriving in the late afternoon.Note:-From late May to early October, the Susten Pass may be closed due to snow; in this case, we’ll travel through the equally stunning Brünig Pass.-Occasionally, accommodation will be in the Como metropolitan area.Day 5CHIASSO - BELLINZONA - ALTDORF - LUCERNE - ZURICHAfter breakfast, we’ll depart for Bellinzona, the capital of Italian-speaking Switzerland, renowned for its three medieval castles, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You’ll have time to stroll through the picturesque streets of the town center. After, we’ll return to the German-speaking region of Switzerland, crossing the Gotthard Pass, where we’ll stop for a photo at a breathtaking viewpoint. Next, we’ll arrive in Altdorf, the capital of the Uri canton, known as the birthplace of William Tell and one of the founding cantons of independent Switzerland. You’ll have free time for lunch before we head to Lucerne, where you can visit the famous Kapellbrücke, the Lion Monument, the impressive cathedral, the Jesuit Church, and the charming old town. Lucerne is considered the country’s tourism capital. By evening, we’ll arrive in Zurich.Day 6ZURICHAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.. Hotel Options4* MERCURE ZURICH CITY OR SIMILAR4* INTERCITY GENEVA OR SIMILAR4* IBIS BULLE - title: 12 Nights and 13 Days Essential Four Holiday Package
meta_description: The Essential Four is a 13-day European holiday that takes you to the most popular holiday destinations on the continent. With this package, you can visit Austria, Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, and Switzerland.
content: 12 Nights and 13 Days Essential Four Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBerlinEssential FourShareAdd to Wishlist12N / 13D6 ImagesView GalleryEssential FourNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as Germany, Czech Republic, Austria, Switzerland, and Italy, on a single holiday! This twelve-night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package.ItineraryDay 1BERLINWelcome to Europamundo! Upon arriving at the airport, we will be waiting to transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details of the welcome meeting with your guide and fellow travellers.Day 2BERLINTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: City tour of Berlin. We visit the Holocaust Me­morial and the Berlin Wall Museum. Ease your way into the local culture with a guided visit of Germany’s incredible capital, Berlin. We shall visit the historic centre, Museum Island, the Reichstag, the Brandenburg Gates and the city’s magnificent parks. We continue our visit by stopping at the Holocaust Memorial and the Berlin Wall Museum. This visit helps us to understand the difficult situation the city experienced during the Twentieth Century. Time to explore the city. Enjoy an evening in the lively area of Kantstrasse, a district that offers different types of ethnic restaurants to dine in (Indian, Oriental, Italian, German, and so on).Day 3BERLIN - DRESDEN - PRAGUETODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Dresden. Evening transfer in Prague. We journey through forests towards DRESDEN, a city which, due to its exceptional architectural and artistic heritage, has become one of the main tourist destinations in Germany. Time to explore some of the impressive palaces and to have lunch at one of its many restaurants and coffee shops. Later, we depart for the Czech Republic. Prague – Arrival. We will make our way to the Old Town Square. This central location provides a great introduction to Prague, full of energy and touristic activities. You can take your dinner at one of the restaurants offering international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian and Italian. Return to hotel.Day 4PRAGUETODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: City tour of Prague. Visit to Castle. Boat tour along the river. Today we will visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local expert will provide an informative city tour, which will include outstanding monuments. During the visit we walk through Prague Castle (admission included). Subsequently, we shall take a boat tour on the Vltava River. In the afternoon enjoy some free time to explore the city. In the evening, we will enjoy more time in the historic city centre and there will be an opportunity for you to take dinner. Return to hotel.Day 5PRAGUE - MUNICH - INNSBRUCKTODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Bavaria and Tyrol. We will leave early and travel to Bavaria, arriving in MUNICH free time to stroll through the monumental centre and have lunch at one of the famous traditional beer houses. In the afternoon, we will continue to Austria. Arriving to INNSBRUCK in the evening, we will have time for dinner in the Golden Roof area at the Old Town.Day 6INNSBRUCK - ZURICHTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Visit to Swarovski Museum. Breath-taking landscapes. Begin your day by discovering the Swarovski Museum, the renowned home of crystals. We shall visit its impressive gardens and learn how the pieces of crystal are produced. Then, time to stroll before leaving for Zurich, an enjoyable journey through wonderful Tyrolean sceneries towards Switzerland. In ZURICH, enjoy an evening in the historic centre next to the lake, where you can dine at your favourite restaurant (Indian, Oriental, Italian, International, Swiss, etc.).Day 7ZURICH - LUCERNE - ZURICHTODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Admire the fantastic landscapes. Cable car included to Grindelwald. Lunch included. Today’s journey has beautiful landscapes with high mountains and lakes. Breath-taking scenery in the region of Interlaken. We will stop in GRINDELWALD where we will have time for a coffee before taking the cable car up to mountain. We will walk along the winding path which will lead us to the suspended bridge. Dare to walk across the bridge amongst the fantastic scenery enjoying glaciers all around us. We will have lunch up in the mountain (included) before heading back down. We continue to LUCERNE, one of the most beautiful cities in Switzerland. In the evening we have time to stroll around enjoying the city. Return to ZURICH and free time in the city before going to the hotel. Note: The guide will offer you the possibility of a full day optional visit, leaving in the morning and, after some free time to discover Lucerne, we take a rotating cable car to reach the top of Mount Titlis. At the alpine summit, at over 3000m above sea level, you will enjoy breath-taking views of the glacier and the Alps.Day 8ZURICH - LUGANO - MORCOTE - MILANTODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Spectacular alpine landscapes, quaint villages and lakes. We will leave Zurich early in the morning and cut across the Alps in order to reach the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. Alongside the route we will get to see beautiful lakes and snow-capped mountains. LUGANO. Arrival in the cosmopolitan capital of the Italian Switzerland built next to its beautiful lake. Time to have a stroll and grab lunch. Next, we will reach the enchanting little town of MORCOTE famous for its flowery stone houses. We will then travel to Italy. Arrival in MILAN where the guide will take us to the impressive Duomo Square. Here you will find a variety of local and international restaurants to have dinner at. Transfer to the hotel.Day 9MILAN - PISA - ROMETODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Coast of Liguria, Leaning Tower of Pisa. Today we continue our journey towards PISA. On a little tourist train, we will travel to the Piazza Dei Miracoli (Square of Miracles), where there will be time to admire one of the most alluring and beautiful art complexes in Italy, including the well-known Leaning Tower of Pisa. Then, we continue to ROME, arriving at the end of the day.Day 10ROMETODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: City tour of Rome. Imperial Forums (admission price included). Evening transfer to the Trastevere area. In the morning, we have a scenic tour, which will be a great introduction to “The Eternal city”. We will visit the tiny state of the Vatican, the epicentre of Christianity in the world. You will be able to visit St. Peter’s Basilica. We include the entrance to the Imperial Forums, an impressive architectural complex formed by monumental buildings and squares, centre of the political activity of Imperial Rome. At the end of the evening we arrange a transfer to Trastevere area for a stroll in the narrow cobbled streets of the district with hidden treasures, such as some modest medieval churches, small shops with the most peculiar of objects or scenes of daily life. Many trattorias (informal Italian eating establishments) and osterias (inns) imbued with the Italian spirit will be ready to serve your local dishes. Other restaurants serving Indian, Chinese and international food can be found in this area. Return to hotel. Note: on many occasions during the low season, as well as in some specific dates of the rest of the year, instead of the entrance to the Imperial Forums, we will enter the Roman Colosseum, symbol of Rome.Day 11ROME - FLORENCETODAY’S HIGLIGHTS: Tour with a local expert from Florence. View from Piazzale Michelangelo. Today we will leave Rome, heading north. This route has beautiful landscapes. Arriving in FLORENCE, we head straight to the impressive Piazzale Michelangelo. In the evening we take a tour with a local expert, walking through the historic centre, taking in places such as the Ponte Vecchio, the Duomo, and Plaza Della Signoria. This city is truly an outdoor museum. Enjoy some leisure time to explore. In the evening you will have time for dinner, as, in this district you can find many restaurants serving international cuisine.Day 12FLORENCE - VENICETODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Boat on Venice’s Canal. Visit and admission to the St. Mark´s Basilica. Admire the technique of crafting Murano Glass. Today we enjoy stunning mountain landscapes while crossing the Apennine Mountains. We will arrive in VENICE and take the boat and cross the Giudecca to the Island of Venice. With a local guide, we will visit the marvellous St. Mark´s Square and enter the Basilica (entrance included). Afterwards, we will visit the Murano Glass Factory. It is fascinating to see the technique of how this ancient glass is made. Enjoy some time at leisure to explore. Accommodation in the Mestre district.Day 13VIENNAAfter breakfast, end of our services.Hotel OptionsAny Hotel as mentioned or similarInclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Prague to Paris Tour Package
meta_description: Enjoy a fantastic journey from Prague to Paris with this amazing tour package. Your holiday starts in Prague and continues to Pilsen, Rothenburg, Frankfurt, Cologne, Amsterdam, Bruges, and finally Paris.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Prague to Paris Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysPragueFrom Prague To ParisShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryFrom Prague to ParisNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as the Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and France, on a single holiday! This seven-night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Prague, you will travel through Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Brussels, and Bruges before your break ends in the city of lights, Paris.ItineraryDay 1PRAGUETODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Welcome to Prague! Upon arriving at the airport, we’ll transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide.In the evening, we’ll transfer you to the Old Town Square, a lively area bustling with tourist activity. You can enjoy dinner at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterward, there will be a return transfer to the hotel.Day 2PRAGUETODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 3PRAGUE - PILSEN - ROTHENBURG - FRANKFURT We’ll depart early from Prague and stop in Pilsen, in western Bohemia, a city renowned for its beer. You’ll have time to stroll through its historic center, where you’ll find the Old Town Square, the cathedral, the Plague Column, and a Renaissance-era town hall. We’ll then cross into Germany and follow part of the Romantic Road. We’ll visit Rothenburg, a town that seems to come straight out of a fairy tale and is considered one of the most beautiful villages in the country. Afterward, we’ll head to Frankfurt, the financial capital of Germany. After our arrival in the evening, enjoy free time in the historic city center, where you’ll find a wide variety of restaurants offering Indian, Asian, Italian, and international cuisines.Day 4FRANKFURT - CRUISE ON THE RIVER RHINE - COLOGNE - AMSTERDAM TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll take a scenic cruise on the Rhine between the villages of Rüdesheim and St. Goar, the river’s most picturesque section. After that, we’ll travel to Cologne, known for its immense Gothic cathedral. Then, we’ll head to Holland, arriving in Amsterdam in the evening.Day 5AMSTERDAM TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll be visiting some very picturesque spots - the Holland of our dreams. We’ll start by visiting Zaanse Schans, known for its windmills, canals, and houses. Next, we’ll explore Volendam, a picturesque fishing village. A short boat trip from Volendam will take us to Marken, an island connected to the mainland by a dike, where the houses are built on stilts. Afterward, we’ll head to Amsterdam for a panoramic tour of the city, including its narrow canals, official buildings, and parks. We’ll also see a diamond-cutting demonstration. For dinner, you’ll have time in Rembrandtplein, an area with numerous international restaurants, located near the Red Light District, celebrated for its progressive values.Day 6AMSTERDAM - BRUGES - PARIS We will head to Bruges, a charming medieval city often called the "Venice of the North" because of its scenic canals. The city offers a magical atmosphere with its cobblestone streets, historic buildings, and romantic bridges. If you’d like, you can climb the Belfry Tower for stunning views. How about trying some Belgian chocolate? Or perhaps you´d prefer a local craft beer? We will then continue our journey to Paris, arriving by the end of the day.Day 7PARIS We’ll immerse ourselves in the rich history of France at the magnificent Palace of Versailles (admission not included), renowned for its stunning gardens. On our return to Paris, we’ll visit Montmartre, where a cable car (included) will take us up to this charming bohemian neighborhood, famous for its artists, painters, and cabarets. To fully appreciate the grandeur of Paris, we’ll embark on a panoramic city tour with a local guide, showcasing the city’s impressive avenues and iconic monuments. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel. For those interested, there is an optional variety show in the evening.Day 8PARISWe’ll start our day in central Paris, beginning with a visit to the iconic Eiffel Tower. You´ll have the chance to go up to the second floor of this famous iron landmark (tickets included). Afterwards, we’ll enjoy a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine, which will last approximately one hour and fifteen minutes. You’ll have a free afternoon to explore the city at your own pace.Note: If wait times at the Eiffel Tower are too long, we might reschedule the visit to a different time (or on Sunday) for your convenience.Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of your flight in case you might need an additional night.Hotel OptionsAny from title: 6 Night and 7 Days Frankfurt to Paris Tour Package
meta_description: Embark on a grand European tour from Frankfurt to Paris, complete with accommodations, guided tours, and convenient transfers. Reach out to our specialists to learn more or make a booking.
content: 6 Night and 7 Days Frankfurt to Paris Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysFrankfurtFrom Frankfurt To ParisShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D3 ImagesView GalleryFrom Frankfurt to ParisNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as the Germany, the Netherlands, and France, on a single holiday! This six-night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Frankfurt, you will travel through Cologne, Amsterdam, and Bruges before your break ends in the city of lights, Paris.ItineraryDay 1FRANKFURTWelcome to your tour with Europamundo! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2FRANKFURT - CRUISE ON THE RHINE - COLOGNE - AMSTERDAMToday, we’ll take a scenic cruise on the Rhine between the villages of Rüdesheim and St. Goar, the river’s most picturesque section. After that, we’ll travel to Cologne, known for its immense Gothic cathedral. Then, we’ll head to Holand, arriving in Amsterdam in the evening.Day 3AMSTERDAMToday, we’ll be visiting some very picturesque spots - the Holland of our dreams. We’ll start by visiting Zaanse Schans, known for its windmills, canals, and houses. Next, we’ll explore Volendam, a picturesque fishing village. A short boat trip from Volendam will take us to Marken, an island connected to the mainland by a dike, where the houses are built on stilts. Afterward, we’ll head to Amsterdam for a panoramic tour of the city, including its narrow canals, official buildings, and parks. We’ll also see a diamond-cutting demonstration. At the end of the day, we´ll provide a transfer to the lively city center, an area with many restaurants to choose from. Day 4AMSTERDAM - BRUGES - PARISWe will head to Bruges, a charming medieval city often called the "Venice of the North" because of its scenic canals. The city offers a magical atmosphere with its cobblestone streets, historic buildings, and romantic bridges. If you’d like, you can climb the Belfry Tower for stunning views. How about trying some Belgian chocolate? Or perhaps you´d prefer a local craft beer? We will then continue our journey to Paris, arriving by the end of the day.Day 5PARISWe’ll immerse ourselves in the rich history of France at the magnificent Palace of Versailles (admission not included), renowned for its stunning gardens. On our return to Paris, we’ll visit Montmartre, a charming bohemian neighborhood famous for its artists, painters, and cabarets. To fully appreciate the grandeur of Paris, we’ll embark on a panoramic city tour with a local guide, showcasing the city’s impressive avenues and iconic monuments. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel. For those interested, there is an optional variety show in the evening.Day 6PARISWe’ll start our day in central Paris, beginning with a visit to the iconic Eiffel Tower. You´ll have the chance to go up to the second floor of this famous iron landmark (tickets included). Afterwards, we’ll enjoy a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine, which will last approximately one hour and fifteen minutes. You’ll have a free afternoon to explore the city at your own pace.Note: If wait times at the Eiffel Tower are too long, we might reschedule the visit to a different time (or on Sunday) for your convenience.Day 7PARISAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from the below mentioned hotelsInclusion• Europamundo General Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.• Includes arrival transfer• City tour in: Amsterdam, Paris• Excursion: Versailles in Paris (entrance not included)• Boat: Cruise on the Rhine, I Jsselmeer lake from Voledam to Marken • Evening transfer: Rembrandplein in Amsterdam• Transfer: Montmartre in París• Ticket admission: Diamond Cutting Workshop in Amsterdam• Funicular: Montmartre in ParisExclusion• Flight Tickets• Visa to Europe• Entrances other than mentioned• Anything not mentioned in inclusions• Travel insuranceDeparture & PricingPricing: Package Cost: For per adult on Double sharing AED   11500     (land package) Hotels: IBIS FRANKFURT CITY MESSE*** Т.: 69286070 email: [email protected] Leonardo-da-Vinci-Allee 40 60486 FRANKFURT GERMANY BEST WESTERN MACRANDER FRANKFURT**** Т.: 691534000 email: [email protected] Strahlenbergerstraße 12, 63067 Offenbach am Main, Alemania 63067 FRANKFURT GERMANY CROWNE PLAZA FRANKFURT CONGRESS**** Т.: 40600808120 email: [email protected] Lyoner Str. 44 -48 60528 FRANKFURT GERMANY FRANKFURT MESSE AFFILIATED BY MELIA**** Т.: 69707300 email: [email protected] Anschlussstelle, Frankfurt-Katharinenkreisel 60486 FRANKFURT GERMANY PARK PLAZA AMSTERDAM AIRPORT**** Т.: 206580580 email: [email protected] MELBOURNESTRAAT 1 1175 RM AMSTERDAM THE NETHERLANDS IBIS AMSTERDAM CITY WEST*** Т.: 207219174 email: [email protected] Transformatorweg 36 1014 AK AMSTERDAM THE NETHERLANDS HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS AMSTERDAM ARENA TOWERS*** Т.: 207979193 email: [email protected]; title: 8 Days and 7 Nights Switzerland Tour Package
meta_description: Explore the heart of Switzerland and beyond on this eight-day retreat, which takes you to alpine peaks, castles, and fairytale villages. Don’t delay; secure your spot now to experience Swiss elegance.
content: 8 Days and 7 Nights Switzerland Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysZurichSwitzerlandShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D4 ImagesView GallerySwitzerlandNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit Europe’s most fantastic destination Switzerland on a single holiday! This 5-nights retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. ItineraryDay 1ZURICHWelcome to your tour with Europamundo! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2ZURICH - BERNE - FRIBOURG - NYON- YVOIRE - GENEVAWe’ll set off for the capital of the country, Bern, one of the most beautiful historic cities in Switzerland. We’ll go to the Rose Garden viewpoint to admire the beautiful landscape of the city. We’ll have free time for a walk and lunch. In the afternoon, we’ll get back on the road and head to the French-speaking region of Switzerland, making a stop in Fribourg, a beautiful bilingual city. After that, we’ll travel towards Lake Geneva (commonly known in France as lac Léman) and make a stop in Nyon, a little Roman city on the shore of the lake. From there, we’ll cross Lake Geneva by boat to travel to France. We’ll arrive in Yvoire, a beautiful medieval village with fortified gates, a castle, flowery streets, and beautiful views over the lake. We’ll reach Geneva at the end of the day.Note: Accommodation will usually be in the French outskirts of the town.Day 3GENEVA- CHILLON CASTLE - GRUYRES- LEYSINAfter breakfast, we’ll include a panoramic tour in Geneva, a city by Lake Geneva that houses the European headquarters of the International Labor Organization, the Red Cross, and numerous other international entities. We’ll visit the Palais des Nations (headquarters of the United Nations in Europe), the beautiful English Garden with its flower clock, and admire the Jet d’Eau, the tallest fountain in Europe.Passing through vineyard landscapes, we’ll reach Chillon Castle, built on the waters of Lake Geneva. Admission is included to this fantastic medieval castle. Afterward, we’ll visit the picturesque walled village of Gruyeres, known worldwide for its cheese. Nearby, there are several major Swiss chocolate factories (including NESTLE). We’ll visit the Cailler Chocolate Factory, with a tasting included! We’ll continue traveling on smaller roads through bucolic mountain landscapes and picturesque wooden villages, arriving in Leysin, a beautiful holiday village. Dinner will be included.Note: At times, accommodation may be arranged in another Swiss town nestled in the heart of the Alps, often Martigny.Day 4LEYSIN- INTERLAKEN- AARE GORGE - CHIASSOWe’ll experience stunning mountain scenery today, so be sure to pack your winter clothes. We’ll ascend to Glacier 3000 by cable car ride, one of the most spectacular spots in Switzerland featuring ice and snow year-round, and where you can walk on the suspended bridge between two mountain peaks, explore the Ice Cathedral, or enjoy the Fun Park. We’ll stop in Interlaken for lunch before traveling to the Aare Gorge. Next, we’ll take the Susten Pass, one of the most beautiful roads in Switzerland between glaciers that will lead us to the Italian-speaking part of the country. We’ll stay overnight in Chiasso, a Swiss town on the border with Italy.Note: Occasionally, due to weather conditions such as rain or strong winds, the cable car to Glacier 3000 may not operate. Additionally, the Susten Pass Road is typically closed from mid-October until the end of May. In such cases, the journey will follow alternative routes.Day 5CHIASSO- LUGANO- BÜRGLEN - LUCERNEWe’ll visit Lugano, the cosmopolitan capital of Italian Switzerland with its beautiful lake, where we’ll have time to stroll. Continuing along the highway, we’ll cross the Gotthard Road Tunnel and stop in Bürglen, the charming village where William Tell was born. We’ll see the 16th-century chapel adorned with paintings illustrating his life. If you wish, you can also visit the William Tell Museum. In the neighboring city of A ltdorf, we’ll find more traces of his history. Our journey will then take us to Lucerne, where we’ll have free time to explore this beautiful city by its namesake lake. We recommend going on an optional cruise along Lake Lucerne, considered one of the most beautiful in Switzerland.Day 6LUCERNE- EINSIEDELN- VADUZ- FELDKIRCH We’ll depart for Einsiedeln, renowned for its immense baroque abbey, the most important pilgrimage center in Switzerland. Continuing east, we’ll visit Maienfeld, the village that inspired the story of Heidi. In Heididorf, we’ll explore Heidi’s House a picturesque site with stunning landscapes accessible via a pedestrian path (tickets not included, admission is free). Next, we’ll enter the independent country of Liechtenstein and visit its capital, Vaduz, known for its impressive castle. There will be time to stroll and have lunch. Afterwards, we’ll proceed to the neighboring city of Feldkirch in Austria, a charming walled city near the borders of Switzerland, Liechtenstein, and Germany, with its beautiful medieval quarter and castle. Free time.Day 7FELDKIRCH- ST. GALLEN- CONSTANCE- STEIN AM RHEIN- RHINE FALLS- ZURICHWe´ll begin our day by heading to the center of St. Gallen, recognized as a World Heritage Site for its magnificent cathedral and medieval old town. Continuing along Lake Constance, located between Germany and Switzerland, we´ll take a walk through the center of Constance before visiting Mainau Island (accessed via a pedestrian bridge), renowned for its beautiful botanical garden (admission included). Later, in Switzerland, we´ll explore Stein am Rhein, a picturesque village on the banks of the Rhine River known for its charming houses adorned with painted walls. Our itinerary also includes a visit to the Rhine Falls (ticket included), the most powerful waterfall in Europe. Our day will end upon our arrival in Zurich.Day 8ZURICHAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from below mentioned title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Central European Ring Holiday Package
meta_description: The Central European Ring tour package covers some phenomenal European countries like Austria, Czech Republic, Germany, Hungary, and Slovakia. You can visit all these countries during the 8-day tour.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Central European Ring Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysPrague8 Days Central European RingShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView Gallery8 Days Central European RingNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewTravel through some of the most famed European destinations, including the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Slovakia, with this ultimate seven-night package. Yes, it covers everything from the prized gems of Prague, Munich, and Innsbruck to the charming ski resort of Kitzbuhel and the pulsating vibe of Budapest and Bratislava. Add to this all accommodations, transfers, and guided tours, making the whole experience as smooth and stress-free as possible.  ItineraryDay 1Arrival in PragueWelcome to Prague! Upon arriving at the airport, we’ll transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide.In the evening, we’ll transfer you to the Old Town Square, a lively area bustling with tourist activity. You can enjoy dinner at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterward, there will be a return transfer to the hotel.Day 2Prague City TourTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 3Travel to Munich and InnsbruckTODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Bavaria and Tyrol. We will leave early and travel to Bavaria, arriving in MUNICH free time to stroll through the monumental center and have lunch at one of the famous traditional beerhouses. In the afternoon, we will continue to Austria. Arriving to INNSBRUCK in the evening, we will have time for dinner in the Golden Roof area at the Old Town.Day 4Swarovski Crystal Museum and KitzbuhelTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: The major draw of today is a tour of the Swarovski Museum, where you will enter the dazzling world of crystals and learn about the intricate artistry and craftsmanship behind the creation of stunning crystal pieces. Continue your tour to Innsbruck’s timeless historic center and later take a scenic drive through the mountains to Kitzbuhel, an idyllic village and a popular ski resort. Relish a tasty dinner with vegetarian options before you wind up the day. Day 5Salzburg, St. Wolfgang, Traunsee Lake, and Vienna TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll get to know Austria better. Departing in the morning, we’ll take a cable car ride in Steinplatte up to the high mountains of the Alps, where snow lasts for nine months of the year and the scenery is breathtaking. The incredible landscapes from the viewing platform and the dinosaur exhibition will create unforgettable memories. We’ll then continue exploring Austria, traveling through the mountains until we arrive in Salzburg, Mozart’s city. Its Renaissance and Baroque center is filled with beauty, all in the shadow of the grand castle. Next, we’ll travel through lakes and mountains to reach St. Wolfgang, a renowned pilgrimage site in Austria. We’ll then head to Traunkirchen, located beside the beautiful Traunsee Lake, where we’ll take a cruise to see four of the lake´s castles before disembarking in Gmunden. Afterward, we’ll continue to Vienna, arriving in the evening.Day 6Vienna city tour TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll embark on a panoramic tour of this impressive city with a local guide. We’ll explore its majestic avenues, beautiful palaces, large parks and vibrant city center. In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore on your own. In the evening, we’ll include a transfer to the Grinzing district, an old wine-growing village now part of the city, known for its traditional taverns. You’ll have free time to dine in the area.Day 7Arrival in Budapest & Boat cruise TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: After about three hours of travel, we’ll arrive in Budapest, the capital of Hungary. Our first stop will be the lively area of Váci utca, where you’ll have free time for lunch. After, we’ll kick off our exploration of Budapest with an included boat trip on the Danube River, with historic Buda on one bank and cosmopolitan Pest on the other. The views are unbeatable. Following this, we’ll begin a panoramic tour of the so-called "Queen of the Danube." You’ll have some free time afterwards.
