title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Italy and Switzerland Tour Package
meta_description: Grab the chance to visit the marvelous cities of Switzerland and Italy with this tour package. Rome, Florence, Venice, Lucerne, Zurich, Milan, and Pisa are a few of the best cities here.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Italy and Switzerland Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysRomeItaly And SwitzerlandShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryItaly and SwitzerlandNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as Italy and Switzerland, on a single holiday! This seven-night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Austria, you will travel through Italy and Switzerland before your break ends in the city of Rome.ItineraryDay 1ROMEWelcome to Rome! Upon your arrival, we’ll be there to transfer you to your hotel. Later, our guide will meet you and provide all the essential information. You can also find details on the information sign in the hotel reception area.In the evening, we’ll take you to Via Cavour, an excellent introduction to Rome. Here, you’ll find a variety of restaurants offering Italian, Indian, Chinese, and international cuisine.Day 2ROMEIn the morning, we’ll go on a three-hour panoramic tour of Rome with a local guide, combining a bus ride with a walking section through part of Imperial Rome. We’ll see, among other highlights, the Arch of Constantine, the exterior of the Colosseum, and the Imperial Forums—an architectural complex that was the political heart of the ancient world. During the bus route, we’ll pass by some of the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the Circus Maximus, the Baths of Caracalla, the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, the Pyramid of Cestius, and the exterior of Castel Sant’Angelo.The tour will end in Vatican City at around 11:00 a.m., an independent state within the city of Rome and the center of the Catholic Church. After the panoramic tour, our guide will offer an optional visit to explore the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel in greater detail. The afternoon will be free.At the end of the day, we’ll include a transfer to the popular Trastevere district, known for its charming restaurants and lively atmosphere. Return to the hotel around 8:30 p.m.**Due to the celebration of the Jubilee Year, the city visit may be affected by mobility restrictions imposed for the various events taking place.Day 3ROME - FLORENCEToday, we’ll leave Rome and head north, taking in the beautiful landscapes along the way. Upon reaching Florence, we’ll go directly to the stunning Piazzale Michelangelo for breathtaking views of the city. In the evening, we’ll enjoy a guided walking tour with a local expert through the historic center, visiting landmarks such as the Ponte Vecchio, the Duomo, and Piazza della Signoria. This city is like an open-air museum. Afterward, you´ll have some free time to explore at your leisure. In the evening, you’ll have plenty of options for dinner, as this district offers many restaurants with a variety of international cuisines.Day 4FLORENCE - VENICEToday, we’ll enjoy the stunning mountain landscapes as we cross the Apennines. Upon arriving in Venice, we’ll take a boat across the Giudecca Canal to the Island of Venice. With a local guide, we’ll visit the marvelous St. Mark’s Square. Afterwards, we’ll tour the Murano Glass Factory, where you’ll see the fascinating techniques used to create this ancient glass. You´ll have some free time to explore on your own. Accommodation will be in the Mestre district.Day 5VENICE - INNSBRUCK - ZURICHWe’ll depart Venice and make our way to Austria. Upon arriving in Innsbruck, you’ll have time to explore the historic town center and enjoy lunch. Afterward, we’ll continue our journey through the beautiful Tyrolean landscapes as we cross into Switzerland, arriving in Zurich.Day 6ZURICH - LUCERNE - ZURICHToday´s journey features stunning landscapes with tall mountains and pristine lakes. We’ll enjoy breathtaking scenery in the Interlaken region. Our first stop will be Grindelwald, where we’ll have time for a coffee before taking the cable car up the mountain. Once there, we’ll walk along a winding path leading to a suspended bridge. For those who are adventurous, crossing the bridge offers spectacular views of the surrounding glaciers. We’ll have lunch on the mountain (included) before heading back down. Our next destination is Lucerne, one of Switzerland´s most beautiful cities, where you’ll have time to explore and enjoy the charming cityscape. We’ll then return to Zurich.Note: The guide will offer an optional full-day excursion, starting in the morning. After some free time in Lucerne, we’ll take a rotating cable car to the summit of Mount Titlis. At over 3,000 meters above sea level, the alpine summit offers breathtaking views of the glacier and the Alps.Day 7ZURICH - BELLINZONA - COMO - MILANWe’ll leave Zurich early in the morning, crossing the Alps to reach the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. Our first stop will be Bellinzona, renowned for its three medieval castles, which are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Perched on the hills overlooking the city, these castles highlight Bellinzona´s historical significance as a key alpine stronghold. Enjoy some free time to wander through the charming streets of the center. Next, we´ll enter Italy and stop in the charming town of Como for lunch. This town is considered the jewel of Lombardy, known for its beautiful gardens beside the lake and its spectacular cathedral. We’ll continue to Milan, where our guide will take us to the impressive Piazza del Duomo. You’ll have some time to wander around before we transfer you to the hotel.Day 8MILAN - PISA - ROMEToday, we’ll continue our journey to Pisa. We´ll ride a small tourist train to the Piazza dei Miracoli (Square of Miracles), where you´ll have time to admire one of the most captivating and beautiful art complexes in Italy, including the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa. Afterwards, we’ll head to Rome, arriving later in the day.Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of your flight in case you might need an additional night.Hotel OptionsAny from the below mentioned listInclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: ROME, FLORENCE, VENICEBoat: to the island of VeniceEvening transfer: Via Cavour in Rome, Trastevere in RomeTransfer: Piazzale Michelangelo in FlorenceTicket admission: Murano Glass Factory in VeniceTrain: Piazza dei Miracoli in PisaFunicular: Cable Car to Grindelwald First1 Lunch Included in: LUCERNEExclusionFlight TicketsVisa to EuropeEntrances other than mentioned Anything not mentioned in inclusions Travel InsuranceDeparture & PricingDeparture dates: Month Dates May 2025 11, 18, & 25 June 2025 01, 08, 15,22 & 29 July 2025 06, 13, 20 & 27 August 2025 03, 10, 17, 24 & 31 September 2025 07, 14, 21 & 28 October 2025 05,12, 19 & 26 November 2025 02, 09, 16,23 & 30 December 2025 07, 14, 21 & 28 Pricing: Date City Night Hotel Meal As per departure date Rome 02 Night Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast As per departure date Florence 01 Night Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast As per departure date Venice 01 Night Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast As per departure date Zurich 02 Night Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast As per departure date Milan 01 Night Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast Package Cost: Ground Services Per Person on Double/Twin sharing: AED 6099 Hotels: ERGIFE**** Т.: 666441 email: [email protected] Largo Lorenzo Mossa, 8, 00165 Roma RM 00165 ROME ITALY IBIS STYLES ROMA AURELIA**** Т.: 69958851 email: [email protected] Via Andrea Ferrara, 33, 00165 Roma RM, Italia 00165 ROME ITALYc NILHOTEL**** Т.: 55795540 email: [email protected]; title: Eight Days of European Exploration: France and Switzerland
meta_description: See Europe’s breathtaking sights across France and Switzerland with this ultimate guide. Starting in Paris and culminating in Zurich, it promises a vacation of a lifetime. Contact us to secure your spot now online.
content: Eight Days of European Exploration: France and SwitzerlandHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysParisFrance And SwitzerlandShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D5 ImagesView GalleryFrance and SwitzerlandNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as France and Switzerland, on a single holiday! This seven-night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in France, you will travel through France and Switzerland before your break ends in the city of lights Paris.ItineraryDay 1PARISWelcome to your tour We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2PARISWe’ll immerse ourselves in the rich history of France at the magnificent Palace of Versailles (admission not included), renowned for its stunning gardens. On our return to Paris, we’ll visit Montmartre, a charming bohemian neighborhood famous for its artists, painters, and cabarets. To fully appreciate the grandeur of Paris, we’ll embark on a panoramic city tour with a local guide, showcasing the city’s impressive avenues and iconic monuments. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel. For those interested, there is an optional variety show in the evening.Day 3PARISWe’ll start our day in central Paris, beginning with a visit to the iconic Eiffel Tower. You´ll have the chance to go up to the second floor of this famous iron landmark (tickets included). Afterwards, we’ll enjoy a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine, which will last approximately one hour and fifteen minutes. You’ll have a free afternoon to explore the city at your own pace.Note: If wait times at the Eiffel Tower are too long, we might reschedule the visit to a different time (or on Sunday) for your convenience.Day 4PARIS - BURGUNDY - BEAUNE - LYONToday, we’ll journey to the heart of France, passing through the Bourgogne region, renowned for its picturesque vineyards and world-class wines. Our first stop will be Beaune, a charming town in the center of Burgundy known for its flower-filled streets, hospice, and wine museum. After some free time for lunch and a walk, we’ll continue to Lyon, the former capital of Roman Gaul, located on the banks of the Rhône River. Lyon´s historic center is a UNESCO World Heritage site. We’ll take a cable car up to Notre-Dame de Fourvière, where we can enjoy a stunning view of the city. You’ll have some free time to explore at your leisure.Note: In some cases, part of the group will stay in Chambéry, a city near Lyon. In these instances, we’ll travel to Chambéry in the evening for an overnight stay. In the morning, you’ll have time to visit this medieval-style city, the capital de la Saboya, known for its beautiful historic center and impressive castle.Day 5LYON - GENEVA - ZURICHToday, we’ll travel to Switzerland. Upon arrival in Geneva, we’ll pass by the Palace of Nations (the European headquarters of the United Nations) and explore the pretty English Garden with its flower clock and admire the Jet d’Eau, the tallest fountain in Europe.After lunch, we’ll continue our journey through Switzerland, traveling along the scenic routes by Lake Geneva and Lake Neuchâtel. We’ll drive along the Three Lakes region, enjoying views of magnificent vineyards set against the mountain backdrop. We’ll stop in Neuchâtel, where you can enjoy a walk by the lake, explore the historic town center, or visit the beautiful 10th-century castle. Our journey will conclude in Zurich, where we’ll arrive in the late afternoon.Note: Depending on the number of passengers traveling from Geneva to Zurich, this part of the trip may be done by train, in which case there will be no stop in Neuchâtel.Day 6ZURICHWith our guide, we’ll explore Zurich, the most populous city in Switzerland, and its financial and cultural heart. Known for its banks, Zurich has been twice recognized as the city with the best quality of life in the world. Afterwards, we’ll embark on a scenic cruise of nearly two hours on Lake Zurich, with brief stops to enjoy the charming villages along the route. We’ll disembark in Rapperswil, a picturesque village renowned for its medieval castle. We’ll return to Zurich by train, providing an opportunity to experience the efficiency and punctuality of the Swiss railway system.Note: Depending on the number of travelers, transfers to and from the city center may be via public transport.Day 7ZURICH - LUCERNE - ZURICHToday´s journey features stunning landscapes with tall mountains and pristine lakes. We’ll enjoy breathtaking scenery in the Interlaken region. Our first stop will be Grindelwald, where we’ll have time for a coffee before taking the cable car up the mountain. Once there, we’ll walk along a winding path leading to a suspended bridge. For those who are adventurous, crossing the bridge offers spectacular views of the surrounding glaciers. We’ll have lunch on the mountain (included) before heading back down. Our next destination is Lucerne, one of Switzerland´s most beautiful cities, where you’ll have time to explore and enjoy the charming cityscape. We’ll then return to Zurich.Note: The guide will offer an optional full-day excursion, starting in the morning. After some free time in Lucerne, we’ll take a rotating cable car to the summit of Mount Titlis. At over 3,000 meters above sea level, the alpine summit offers breathtaking views of the glacier and the Alps.Day 8ZURICH - STRASBOURG - PARISWe’ll depart from Zurich and travel to the French region of Alsace, where we’ll visit its capital, Strasbourg—a charming city that beautifully blends French and German influences. You’ll have time to explore and get to know the city. Afterward, we’ll continue our journey to Paris, arriving in the evening.Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of your flight in case you might need an additional night.Hotel OptionsAny from below mentioned or similarInclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: ParisExcursion: Versailles in Paris (entrance not included)Boat: River Seine in Paris, Zurich lakeTransfer: Montmartre District in Paris, Versailles Palace in Paris (entrance not included)Ticket admission: 2nd Floor Eiffel Tower in ParisTrain: Rapperswil / ZurichFunicular: Lyon, Cable Car to Grindelwald First1 Lunch Included in: LucerneExclusionFlight TicketsVisa to EuropeEntrances other than mentioned Anything not mentioned in inclusions Travel InsuranceDeparture & PricingDeparture dates: Month Dates May 2025 03,10, 17, 24 & 31 June 2025 07, 14, 21 & 28 July 2025 05, 12, 19 & 26 August 2025 02, 09, 16, 23 & 30 September 2025 06, 13, 20 & 27 October 2025 04 , 11, 18 & 25 November 2025 01, 08, 15, 22 & 29 December 2025 06, 13, 20 & 27 Pricing: Date City Night Hotel Meal As per departure date Paris 03 Night Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast As per departure date Lyon 01 Night Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast As per departure date Zurich 03 Nights Any from below mentioned or similar Breakfast Package Cost: Ground Services Per Person on Double/Twin sharing: AED 6799 Hotels: MERCURE PARIS PORTE DE VERSAILLES EXPO**** Т.: 146485555 email: [email protected] 36 38 Rue du Moulin 92170 Vanves Pars 92170 PARIS FRANCE MERCURE IVRY QUAI DE SEINE**** Т.: 146701717 email: [email protected] 5 ALLEE DE LA SEINE 94200 PARIS FRANCE MERCURE PARIS LA DEFENSE 5**** Т.: 825802727 email: [email protected] 18-30 RUE BAUDIN PLACE CHARRAS COURBEVOIE 92400 PARIS FRANCE NOVOTEL P. title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Majestic Greece Tour Package
meta_description: Majestic Greece is a tour package that lets you explore the breathtaking country of Greece. You get to enjoy the landscapes, the beaches, and the ancient ruins of the country with this tour.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Majestic Greece Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysAthensMajestic GreeceShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D7 ImagesView GalleryMajestic GreeceNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewHave the ultimate all-inclusive holiday in Greece, where every aspect, including accommodation, transfers, and guided tours, is meticulously arranged. Witness the historical landmarks of Athens and the Acropolis, discover the charm of Mykonos, and be captivated by the mesmerizing landscapes of Santorini, creating cherished memories of an unforgettable Mediterranean getaway.ItineraryDay 1ATHENSWelcome to your tour with Europamundo! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2ATHENSWe´ll embark on a city tour of Athens with a local guide, visiting landmarks such as the Presidential Mansion, the Panathenaic Stadium where the first modern Olympic Games were held, the National Library, and the bustling squares of the city center. We´ll also explore the newer neighborhoods that developed after the 2004 Olympic Games. The tour will conclude at the Acropolis (admission not included). In the evening, we´ll provide a transfer to the historical neighborhood of Plaka, renowned for its charming Greek tavernas and opportunities to immerse yourself in the rich folklore of this country.Day 3ATHENS - KAMENA VOURLA- KALABAKAWe’ll depart early in the morning towards northern Greece, stopping at Kamena Vourla, a charming seaside tourist hub surrounded by stunning landscapes. We´ll then proceed north, stopping at the Thermopylae Mountain Pass, the historic site of the famous battle. Next, we´ll visit Kastraki, a picturesque village with beautiful views of the entire valley, where you´ll have free time for lunch. Afterward, we´ll explore the Meteora, a breathtaking UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admission to one of its renowned monasteries is included. Dinner will be provided in Kalabaka.Day 4KALABAKA - DELPHI- ATHENSWe’ll journey south through the Thessaly region, where you’ll experience stunning landscapes, before reaching Delphi. Here, we´ll explore the exquisite archaeological site overlooking the Gulf of Corinth, with breathtaking views. There will be time for lunch. Following that, we´ll head to the Hosios Loukas Monastery, renowned as one of the most beautiful Byzantine monasteries in Greece and a World Heritage Site. Its magnificent 11th-century mosaics are truly remarkable. We´ll then continue our journey towards Athens, arriving in the evening.Day 5ATHENS- AEGINA- POROS - EPIDAURUS - NAFPLIOToday´s journey is quite special because Greece is home to nearly 6,000 islands, more than 100 of which are inhabited. Various ships connect these islands to the mainland, and today we’ll visit two of the Saronic Islands. Our day will start early in the morning by taking a ferry from the hotel to Aegina, an island that has been inhabited for over 4,000 years and is less than an hour away. You´ll have the chance to explore the picturesque harbor, wander through traditional neighborhoods filled with charming houses and ancient churches or visit the Greek Temple of Apollo. Afterward, we´ll take another ferry for about 1 hour and 15 minutes to reach Poros. Enjoy some free time on this charming island, filled with lively tourist activity and old houses that climb up to the clock tower. There will be time for a stroll and lunch, after which we´ll take a short 15-minute journey to Galatas, a small coastal village in the Peloponnese. From there, we´ll continue by road through stunning hillside landscapes until we reach Epidaurus. Admission is included to the Ancient Theatre, built 2,400 years ago and remarkably well-preserved. It´s still used today and can host up to 14,000 spectators for performances. Then, we´ll head to Nafplio, a charming coastal city characterized by its citadel and Venetian fortress. You´ll have free time to explore the area. Dinner will be included.Note: Ferry schedules can change, especially during the low season months when ferries between Aegina and Poros may not operate. If this is the case, we will not visit Aegina Island.Day 6NAFPLIO - TRIPOLI- OLYMPIA - PATRASWe´ll journey across the mountains of the Peloponnese hinterland to Tripoli, the capital of the Arcadia region. There will be free time to explore Areos Square with its cafes and restaurants. Afterward, we´ll continue to Olympia, where we´ll visit the Archaeological Site (ticket and guided tour included). This is where the first Olympic Games were held in 776 BC, attracting athletes from across Greece and its colonies. The most impressive landmarks here include the Temple of Zeus, the Stadium, the Gymnasium, and the Arena. Our next destination will be Patras, Greece’s third-largest city. It´s a bustling port city overlooked by a medieval fortress, home to Greece´s largest cathedral, a significant pilgrimage site, along with the nearby old church of St. Andrew. Dinner will be included.Day 7PATRAS-NAFPAKTOS- MYCENAE - CORINTH - ATHENSAfter breakfast, we’ll cross the Rio-Antirrio bridge, a spectacular cable-stayed bridge that connects the Peloponnese with the Greek mainland. Our first stop is Nafpaktos, located on the Gulf of Corinth. Its Venetian fortress overlooking the city is a reminder of its historical significance as Lepanto, where the Christian and Turkish fleets clashed in battle—a conflict during which the famous Cervantes lost his arm. You’ll have free time to stroll around its picturesque harbor and explore the beautiful old town. Continuing along the Gulf of Corinth, we’ll reach Mycenae, a colossal citadel dating back to the 18th century BC, considered the cradle of European civilization (admission included). Enjoy free time for lunch and to explore the site. Next, we’ll visit the imposing Fortress of Acrocorinth (tickets included), where the remains of an ancient temple of Aphrodite stand on the highest point of the settlement. We’ll then continue our journey, making a brief stop at the Corinth Canal. We’ll arrive in Athens in the evening.Day 8ATHENSAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from below mentioned or title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Classical Spain Tour Package
meta_description: Go on a detailed tour of Spain with Rayna Tours’ Classical Spain tour package. You can book this package that gives you the chance to stay in Spain for 7 nights and 8 days.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Classical Spain Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMadridClassical SpainShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D5 ImagesView GalleryClassical SpainNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewExplore Spain’s four iconic cities in seven nights with this ultimate holiday! From Madrid’s rich architecture and Granada’s laid-back ambiance to Seville’s artistic heritage and Barcelona’s unmatched vibrancy, a world of splendid attractions and experiences awaits you! Enjoy absolute convenience and flexibility from start to finish as you stay in the hotels of your choice, savor daily breakfasts, and bask in the comfort of fully guided excursions.ItineraryDay 1MADRID Upon arrival at the airport, we’ll be ready to transfer you to your hotel. You’ll have some free time until the tour begins. Please check the information signs in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide and fellow travelers.In the evening, we’ll provide a transfer to Plaza Mayor and La Latina, Madrid’s most famous neighborhood for nightlife and tapas restaurants. You can choose to dine at a restaurant of your preference—options include Indian, Chinese, Spanish, and Middle Eastern cuisines.Day 2MADRID The morning will begin with a comprehensive tour of central Madrid, featuring highlights like Paseo del Prado, Cibeles, Neptuno, Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Colón, and Plaza Mayor. We’ll then visit Retiro Park, a beautiful oasis in the city center, where we’ll see the lake and the Palacio de Cristal. Admission is included to the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, the home of Real Madrid—considered by many to be the best football club in the world. Enjoy the rest of the afternoon at your leisure. In the evening, we’ll provide a return transfer to the hotel.Day 3MADRID - GRANADAWe will depart from Madrid early in the morning, heading south through La Mancha. Our first stop will be in Puerto Lápice, a charming Manchego village evocative of Don Quixote. We will then continue into Andalusia via Despeñaperros, arriving in Granada, where lunch will be included. In the afternoon, if you have chosen the option that includes a visit to the Alhambra, we will explore the magnificent Alhambra Palace and its beautiful Generalife Gardens, both built during the Arab period, with a local guide.VERY IMPORTANT NOTE: The number of visitors allowed into the Alhambra is strictly regulated by law. To ensure your admission, tickets will be issued upon confirming your tour reservation. It´s essential to provide accurate personal details (full name and passport/ID number) at the time of booking. Please be aware that ticket costs are non-refundable in case of cancellation. In rare cases where the Alhambra visit is not possible, we will instead tour the Royal Alcázar of Seville, which offers similar historical and architectural significance.Day 4GRANADA – MALAGA- MARBELLA- RONDA- SEVILLEToday, Departure from Granada. We´ll head towards the Costa del Sol. First stop, Malaga, where we´ll have time for a stroll through its historic district, famous for its cathedral and the Picasso Museum. Afterward, we´ll proceed along the coastal highway, enjoying picturesque views of the Mediterranean. Puerto Banús, in Marbella, is a stunning and sophisticated recreational harbor. In the afternoon, we´ll continue our journey through the mountains listening to stories of bandits before reaching Ronda, a picturesque white town known for its cliffside location and a deep canyon that divides the town. Finally, Seville. We’ll arrive in the evening.Day 5SEVILLEIn the morning, we´ll embark on a city tour of Seville, where you´ll visit the cathedral with its famous Giralda, explore the banks of the Guadalquivir River, and wander through the popular neighborhoods of Santa Cruz and Triana. After the tour, enjoy a relaxing boat ride on the Guadalquivir River offering stunning panoramic views (included). In the evening, you´ll have the option to attend a popular flamenco tablao.Day 6SEVILLE - ZARAGOZA – POBLET- BARCELONAAfter breakfast, we’ll provide a transfer to the train station to take the high-speed train to Zaragoza, covering 850 km in just under four hours. You’ll have free time in Zaragoza to visit the impressive Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar and explore the city center.After lunch, we’ll head to the Poblet Abbey, nestled in a beautiful setting and surrounded by historic walls. It’s one of the best-preserved medieval monasteries in the world (admission included). We’ll then continue to Barcelona, arriving in the evening.Day 7BARCELONAIn the morning, we´ll embark on a panoramic tour of Barcelona, renowned as one of the most fascinating European capitals. This vibrant city, nestled along the Mediterranean Sea, is famous for Gaudi’s modernist architecture, the bustling Ramblas, and its rich history, highlighted by the Universal Exposition and the Olympics hosted here. You´ll have free time in the afternoon. In the evening, we´ll provide a transfer to Maremagnum, a contemporary entertainment and dining complex by the sea, located near Plaza de Colón. Here, you can enjoy a leisurely stroll through the lively area and choose from a variety of dining options.Day 8BARCELONAAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from the below mentioned hotelsInclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: MADRID, SEVILLE, BARCELONABoat: Guadalquivir River in SevilleEvening transfer: Plaza Mayor and la Latina in Madrid, Seville´s historic center, Maremagnum in BarcelonaTicket admission: Santiago Bernabeu Stadium in Madrid, visit to the Alhambra Palace and Generalife Gardens in Granada only option with Alhambra ticket included. title: Dubai Easter Short Break | Best Easter Holiday Package
meta_description: Celebrate Easter in Dubai with this festive short-break Easter Holiday package including seasonal attractions, hotel stays, and guided sightseeing.
content: Dubai Easter Short Break | Best Easter Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Easter Short BreakShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5DView GalleryDubai Easter Short BreakNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewMake your Easter truly magical with the Dubai and Abu Dhabi Easter Holiday Package. Spend your time with family and friends, enjoying a dhow cruise experiences in Dubai Marina, going on a desert safari, and taking a full-day trip to Abu Dhabi. Fitting neatly into Easter breaks from work or school, this 5-day Dubai Easter holiday package includes everything for smooth travel, featuring comfortable stays with breakfasts, popular sights with shared transfers, private airport transfers, and a UAE visa. Among our festive Dubai tour packages, this one is for you if you’re on the lookout for unique ways to celebrate and spend time with your family.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai, Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise with DinnerHave a safe arrival in Dubai, followed by a private transfer to your hotel. Check in and rest for a while. Your Dubai Easter experience begins with a serene glide down the Dubai Marina aboard a wooden dhow boat. Onboard, view the glistening towers and the shimmering waters while relishing a lavish buffet dinner. The soft background music, live entertainment, and gentle breeze create a calm and pleasant atmosphere, perfect for relaxed, meaningful bonding with family or friends. After the cruise, return to your hotel for a restful night.Day 2Half-Day Dubai City Tour, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Mall AttractionsSavor a delicious breakfast at the hotel and be ready to get acquainted with Dubai. Enjoy a half-day city tour where you drive past the historic sites in Old Dubai - Dubai Creek and the bustling Dubai Souks. View stunning architectural gems like the Jumeirah Mosque and Palm Jumeirah, where you will witness the magnificent Atlantis, The Palm. Stop at the Burj Al Arab to click amazing photographs of the stellar scenery. The tour will drop you off at the Burj Khalifa, where you can view Dubai from among the clouds on the 124th level of this iconic tower during prime hours. Your adventure continues at the Dubai Mall. Explore attractions such as the Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo, and marvel at the dancing, illuminated water jets of the Dubai Fountain, as you enjoy it up close on a lake ride. This memorable evening concludes with your transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 3Dubai Desert Safari Experience with BBQ DinnerAfter breakfast, you have the morning at your leisure or stroll around the city. In the afternoon, buckle up for a ride into the Dubai deserts to enjoy an adrenaline-rushing dune bashing session. Get the right dose of thrill in the desert, gliding down the dunes with sandboarding sessions, or exploring the desert at a slow pace on camel rides. As the sky hints at turning orange, sit back and enjoy the view of a fiery sunset in the desert. Next, feast on lip-smacking dishes during a BBQ dinner in the desert. During the meal, enjoy live entertainment featuring swaying, graceful belly dancers and the hypnotic spectacle of Tanoura dancers. With memories of fun adventures and warm cultural experiences, head back to Dubai for an overnight stay.Day 4Full-Day Abu Dhabi City TourToday, this Dubai Easter holiday package with 5 day itinerary, takes a detour from Dubai and lets you enjoy a whole day in Abu Dhabi. After breakfast, take a shared transfer from Dubai to Abu Dhabi to visit iconic landmarks like the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Heritage Village. Click plenty of photos at the Emirates Palace, the Corniche, and the bright, fiery-red facade of Ferrari World Abu Dhabi. Just a day in Abu Dhabi gives an admirable insight into this cultural city, which lingers as you head back to Dubai. Enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel in Dubai.Day 5Departure from DubaiEnjoy your final day in Dubai with breakfast at the hotel and use your free time to explore the city or indulge in last-minute shopping. title: Dubai Jain Discovery Holiday | Travel Package with Jain Food
meta_description: Enjoy a Dubai Jain Travel Package with  Jain Food that includes vegetarian meals, cultural visits, and curated activities respecting Jain values on your Dubai trip.
content: Dubai Jain Discovery Holiday | Travel Package with Jain FoodHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Jain Discovery HolidayShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D2 ImagesView GalleryDubai Jain Discovery HolidayNewHotelsEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewEmbark on a thoughtfully designed Dubai Jain Discovery Holiday, perfect for families and spiritual travelers seeking comfort and convenience. This itinerary combines Dubai’s iconic landmarks, cultural experiences, and family-friendly attractions, with all meals aligned to Jain dietary preferences. From a serene Marina Dhow Cruise and panoramic views at Burj Khalifa to desert adventures and Abu Dhabi sightseeing, this journey ensures a balanced blend of leisure, sightseeing, and memorable experiences.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai, Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise with DinnerAfter you arrive in Dubai, clear immigration, and meet our driver for a private transfer to the hotel. Complete your check-in formalities at the hotel and relax. Your first introduction to Dubai begins with a dhow cruise experience at the glistening Dubai Marina. Glide past sparkling yachts and twinkling skyscrapers while enjoying a delicious Jain dinner on board. Wrap up your first day in Dubai by savoring the views of the marina one last time during your transfer back to the hotel. Overnight at the hotel.Day 2Dubai City Tour (Old + New), Palm Monorail, and Burj KhalifaToday, after breakfast, explore the medley of timeless Old Dubai and the extravagant architectural gems of modern Dubai on a half-day city tour. Your tour takes you to view Dubai Creek, Jumeirah Mosque, and the Dubai Souks. Follow this with an exciting ride on the monorail to Palm Jumeirah. Keep your cameras ready to capture the breathtaking sights of the Palm Jumeirah fronds and the world-renowned Atlantis The Palm. In the evening, head back to Downtown Dubai on shared transfers to view the city skyline at sunset from the 124th level of the Burj Khalifa. After witnessing the breathtaking transformation from sunset to starry night, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 3Dubai Miracle Garden, Global Village Dubai or AYA Universe, and Dubai Frame Have a hearty breakfast in the hotel before you explore a floral spectacle - the biggest in the world -with a visit to Dubai Miracle Garden. Spend a good deal of time taking in the vivid hues at this floral oasis, wandering and clicking pictures of flower-covered dioramas and life-size installations. Later, head to Global Village Dubai to enjoy a mini-world tour of a myriad of cultural sights and sample cuisines from over 90 countries. Alternatively, you can choose to explore AYA Universe at Wafi City - a colossal digital wonderland with interactive zones. Later, head to the Dubai Frame, which together the past, present, and future of Dubai. Stay on to soak in the beauty of old and modern Dubai from the observatory bridge, then head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 4Evening Dubai Desert Safari Experience with Jain BBQ DinnerBegin the day with a leisurely breakfast at your hotel. The morning is entirely free for you to relax. Around early afternoon, a shared transfer will pick you up for a guided Dubai desert safari trip. Enjoy the change of scenery from glistening skyscrapers to endless golden dunes. Then partake in desert sports like dune-bashing, sandboarding, and camel riding. The ambience shifts to a gentler pace as the sun dips below the horizon, and you unwind with a sunset experience and live entertainment, such as belly dancing and Tanoura shows. Relish a lavish, Jain-friendly, BBQ-style buffet under the starry sky before returning to Dubai.  Overnight stay at the hotel in Dubai.Day 5Full-Day Abu Dhabi City TourAfter breakfast at the hotel, hop on a shared vehicle for a scenic ride to the charming city of Abu Dhabi. You will spend the rest of the day visiting the iconic sights of Abu Dhabi and enjoying photo opportunities at the Emirates Palace, Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, and the BAPS Hindu Mandir. This day is a memorable highlight of your trip, blending spiritual and cultural touches into an exciting outdoor adventure. Head back to Dubai and stay overnight at the hotel.Day 6Departure from DubaiOn the last day, relax, shop, and explore the city on your own until it is time to say goodbye. Your Dubai Jain travel package with Jain food experience concludes with breakfast at the hotel, followed by private transfers to the airport for your onward travel.Hotel OptionsRoyal Ascot Hotel Or title: Da Nang Delights & Hoi An Ancient Beauty Tour Package
meta_description: Discover Da Nang’s vibrant city life and Hoi An’s ancient charm on this tour package with scenic attractions, guided sightseeing, transfers, and comfortable stays.
content: Da Nang Delights & Hoi An Ancient Beauty Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDanangMystic Charms Of Da Nang & Hoi AnShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryMystic Charms of Da Nang & Hoi AnNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewDiscover the perfect blend of culture, heritage, and natural beauty on this 5 day Da Nang & Hoi An tour. From the iconic Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills to the lantern-lit charm of Hoi An Ancient Town, this journey takes you through Vietnam’s most enchanting destinations. Glide on bamboo basket boats in the Coconut Village, stroll along lantern streets, admire spiritual pagodas, and soak in the breathtaking views of Marble Mountain and Monkey Mountain. Designed for travelers who love history, culture, and scenic wonders, this trip promises Instagram-worthy moments and unforgettable experiences.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Da Nang - Welcome to Coastal VietnamWelcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Da Nang International Airport, meet your guide and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. After check-in, spend the afternoon at leisure or stroll through Da Nang’s vibrant streets. In the evening, immerse yourself in the lively local atmosphere - explore bustling night markets, taste Vietnamese street food, and enjoy the magical lantern-lit vibes that set the tone for your journey.Day 2Coconut Village Adventure & Hoi An Ancient TownAfter a relaxed morning, get ready for an immersive cultural experience. Around noon, transfer to Cam Thanh Coconut Village, where you will enjoy a basket boat ride along tranquil waterways, watch local fishermen in action, and take part in fun cultural demonstrations. In the afternoon, explore the timeless beauty of Hoi An Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Visit the Phuc Kien Assembly Hall, charming ancient merchant houses, the famous Japanese Covered Bridge, and traditional handicraft shops. Savor a delicious dinner of Hoi An specialties, followed by a magical boat ride on the Hoai River. Visit the impressive Linh Ung Pagoda, home to the towering Lady Buddha statue, and soak in panoramic views of the coastline. meta_description: Escape together to Vietnam with romantic city tours, scenic cruises and relaxing stays on this couple getaway package including transfers and guided experiences.

From the buzzing streets of Hanoi to the tranquil landscapes of Sapa and the emerald waters of Halong Bay, this tour blends cultural immersion with natural beauty and premium comfort. Explore ethnic villages, conquer the "Roof of Indochina" – Fansipan Peak, relax on a luxury cruise in Halong Bay, and soak in the timeless charm of Hanoi. Perfect for travelers seeking a mix of adventure, culture, and serenity.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Hanoi - Check-in & Leisure ExplorationArrive at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel for a 2:00 PM check-in. Once settled, spend the rest of the day at leisure exploring the vibrant Old Quarter, peaceful Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the iconic The Huc Bridge. Immerse yourself in the local life, savor street food, and capture the city's rich history and modern charm. Overnight stay in Hanoi.Day 2Journey to Sapa - Cat Cat Village Exploration (L/D)Early morning between 6:30 – 7:00 AM, you'll be picked up from your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter and begin your scenic journey to Sapa via highway. After two comfort breaks, you’ll reach Sapa around 1:00 PM, a mountainous town known for its diverse ethnic culture and breathtaking views. Check-in and enjoy lunch. In the afternoon, explore the Cat Cat and Shin Chai villages - home to the H’mong people - known for their traditional crafts, waterfalls, and a glimpse into mountain life. Return to Sapa town for a warm dinner and overnight stay at a 4★ hotel like Freesia Sapa or similar.Day 3Fansipan Peak Adventure - Return to Hanoi (B/L)After breakfast, embark on an unforgettable journey to Fansipan Peak, the highest mountain in Indochina. A short drive takes you to the cable car station, where a scenic 20-minute ride brings you to 2800 meters above sea level. Explore the spiritual pagodas and trek the final 600 steps to reach the summit, soaking in jaw-dropping panoramic views. Return to Sapa for lunch and some leisure time. By 3:30 PM, depart by bus back to Hanoi, with two comfort stops along the way. Reach your hotel in Hanoi around 9:15 PM for a well-deserved rest.Day 4Halong Bay Cruise - Ti Top Island & Pearl Farm (B/L/D)After breakfast and hotel checkout, begin your road journey to the UNESCO World Heritage Site, Halong Bay. Board the elegant Royal Palace Cruise at Tuan Chau Harbor and get ready for a spectacular voyage through limestone karsts and turquoise waters. Visit Ti Top Island for panoramic views or a beach swim, then explore a local Pearl Farm with options for kayaking or snorkeling. In the evening, enjoy a gourmet dinner onboard while the cruise anchors in a peaceful area. Overnight stay in your luxury cabin on the bay.Day 5Surprise Cave & Return to Hanoi (B/L)Start the day with a Tai Chi session on the sundeck as the sun rises over Halong Bay. After breakfast, explore the stunning Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave, the largest and most impressive grotto in the bay. Return to the cruise for a light lunch before disembarking. Your driver will transfer you back to Hanoi, where you’ll check in to your hotel for the final night. Overnight stay on the cruise.Day 3Halong Bay to Hanoi | Day at LeisureBegin your morning with a refreshing Tai Chi session on the sundeck. Explore the fascinating Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave before disembarking. Transfer back to Hanoi and check in at your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure, with optional visits to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum or the Temple of Literature. Overnight stay in Hanoi.Day 4Hanoi City Tour | Flight to Da NangAfter breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour of Hanoi, covering landmarks such as the One Pillar Pagoda, Tran Quoc Pagoda, the Old Quarter, and Huc Bridge. Later, transfer to Noi Bai Airport for your flight to Da Nang. On arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. Overnight stay in Da Nang.Day 5Full-Day Excursion to Bana HillsStart early and drive to the scenic Bana Hills. Ride the world’s longest cable car to the stunning French Village. Visit attractions like Lunar Castle, Eclipse Square, and Mat Bay Theater. Enjoy a buffet lunch before exploring Fantasy Park and taking photos at the sparkling Sunworld Globe. Later, visit the famous Golden Bridge and the Le Jardin flower garden. Return to Da Nang for an overnight stay.Day 6Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City | Day at LeisureCheck out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. On arrival, check in and spend the day at leisure exploring the vibrant streets, cafes, and markets of Saigon. Experience the tunnels, try tapioca with pandan tea, and opt for rifle shooting (with surcharge). title: Vietnam Family Cultural & Heritage Tour Package
meta_description: Experience Vietnam’s rich culture, traditions and heritage sites with your family on this cultural journey package including transfers, hotels and guided tours.
content: Vietnam Family Cultural & Heritage Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysHanoiGolden Bridges & Timeless Streets: Vietnam For FamiliesShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D5 ImagesView GalleryGolden Bridges & Timeless Streets: Vietnam for FamiliesNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverview Discover the best of Vietnam in 8 days, from the vibrant streets of Hanoi to the emerald waters of Halong Bay, the serene landscapes of Ninh Binh, and the charming Hoi An Ancient Town. Explore the Marble Mountains, stroll across the iconic Golden Bridge at Bana Hills, and end your journey in the bustling Ho Chi Minh City with the historic Cu Chi Tunnels. Perfect for couples, families, and friends, this itinerary blends culture, nature, adventure, and relaxation, offering an unforgettable Vietnamese experience.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure DayWelcome to Hanoi, Vietnam’s bustling capital! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in the charming Old Quarter. Spend the day at leisure exploring iconic landmarks like Ngoc Son Temple, strolling along the serene Hoan Kiem Lake, and crossing the iconic The Huc Bridge. Immerse yourself in the local culture, enjoy street-side cafes, or shop for souvenirs at the lively markets. This is the perfect way to unwind and acclimate before your adventure begins. Overnight stay in Hanoi.Day 2Full-Day Halong Bay Cruise with Local LunchEmbark on a scenic Halong Bay day tour, one of Vietnam’s most breathtaking UNESCO World Heritage destinations. Depart Hanoi in the morning and enjoy a comfortable drive to the bay. Board a luxury cruise to discover the dramatic limestone karsts and emerald waters. Explore the awe-inspiring Surprise Cave, swim or relax at Tip Top Island, and marvel at the natural wonder of Fighting Cock Islet. Savor a delicious local Vietnamese lunch on board while soaking in the spectacular views. Return to Hanoi in the evening for an overnight stay. This Halong Bay cruise promises an unforgettable experience for couples, families, and friends.Day 3Ninh Binh Full-Day Tour (Hoa Lu - Tam Coc - Mua Cave)Discover the natural splendor of Ninh Binh, often called “Halong Bay on land”. Travel from Hanoi to explore Hoa Lu, the ancient capital of Vietnam, with its historic temples honoring the Dinh and Le emperors. Enjoy a traditional Vietnamese lunch before cruising along the tranquil Tam Coc river on a sampan, surrounded by towering limestone cliffs and picturesque rice paddies. End the day with a climb to Mua Cave for a panoramic view of the lush countryside. Return to Hanoi in the evening. This Ninh Binh day trip is perfect for photography lovers and nature enthusiasts.Day 4Fly to Da Nang | Half-Day Monkey Mountain, Marble Mountains & Hoi An Ancient TownFly to Da Nang, the gateway to Central Vietnam, and explore its cultural landmarks. Begin with Linh Ung Pagoda, home to the impressive Lady Buddha statue overlooking the ocean. Visit the Marble Mountains, explore Tang Chon Cave, and stop at the Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village to admire local craftsmanship. Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and stroll along the lantern-lit streets, visit the Japanese Bridge, historic houses, and assembly halls. End the evening with a delicious local dinner before returning to your hotel. This tour showcases the perfect blend of Vietnamese culture, history, and nightlife.Day 5Bana Hills Tour with Golden BridgeSpend a magical day at Bana Hills, one of Vietnam’s top tourist attractions. Take the world’s longest single-roped cable car to the romantic French Village, explore Lunar Castle, Eclipse Square, and enjoy fun activities at Fantasy Park. Walk along the iconic Golden Bridge, held up by giant stone hands, surrounded by vibrant gardens and panoramic mountain views. Indulge in a buffet lunch at one of the hilltop restaurants and capture stunning photos for lasting memories. Return to your hotel in the afternoon. This Bana Hills tour combines adventure, sightseeing, and a touch of fantasy for travelers of all ages.Day 6Fly to Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure DayFly south to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam’s dynamic metropolis. After check-in, spend the day at leisure exploring the city’s vibrant streets, historic French colonial architecture, local markets, or enjoying a coffee in a traditional café. Optional activities include discovering the nightlife, shopping for souvenirs, or exploring nearby attractions at your own pace. Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.Day 7Ho Chi Minh City Tour with Cu Chi TunnelsExperience the rich history of Ho Chi Minh City with a guided city tour. Visit the War Remnants Museum, Reunification Palace, Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica, and the Saigon Central Post Office, capturing the essence of Vietnam’s past and present. After lunch, explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extensive underground network used during the Vietnam War. Witness a short documentary, walk through the tunnels, sample traditional tapioca and pandan leaf tea, and try optional rifle shooting. Return to the city in the evening. This Ho Chi Minh City and Cu Chi tour offers history, culture, and unique adventure in one day.Day 8Departure from Ho Chi Minh CityAfter breakfast, enjoy some free time for last-minute shopping or sightseeing. meta_description: Escape into Vietnam’s scenic beauty and cultural heritage with city tours, landscapes and relaxed travel on this cultural scenic tour package.
content: Vietnam Culture and Nature Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysHanoiVietnam Cultural Scenic EscapeShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D4 ImagesView GalleryVietnam Cultural Scenic EscapeNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewExperience the perfect blend of Vietnam’s vibrant cities, lush landscapes, and cultural heritage in this 7 day journey. Begin in Hanoi, where colonial architecture, bustling streets, and serene lakes introduce you to the heart of Vietnam. Venture to the scenic Ninh Binh for a tranquil boat ride through limestone caves and rice paddies. Discover the colorful Sapa highlands with trekking through ethnic villages and the breathtaking Fansipan Peak, the “Roof of Indochina.” Fly south to Da Nang and explore the charming Hoi An Ancient Town, with its lantern-lit streets, historic bridges, and artisan shops. Conclude your journey with the enchanting Ba Na Hills, stroll across the iconic Golden Bridge, and immerse in French-inspired architecture and gardens. This tour is perfect for travelers seeking culture, adventure, and scenic beauty all in one.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Hanoi - Leisure DayArrive at Noi Bai International Airport and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel in Hanoi, with check-in around 2:00 PM. Spend your first afternoon exploring the historic Old Quarter, take a peaceful stroll around Hoan Kiem Lake, and visit Ngoc Son Temple via the iconic red The Huc Bridge. Enjoy local cafés and shops at your own pace. Dinner arrangements are on your own. Overnight stay in Hanoi.Day 2Ninh Binh Day Trip (Hoa Lu & Tam Coc)Embark on a scenic full-day excursion to Ninh Binh, often referred to as “Halong Bay on Land.” Begin with a visit to Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, exploring temples dedicated to the Dinh and Le dynasties. Relish a traditional Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant before experiencing a serene boat ride through Tam Coc, gliding along the Ngo Dong River, surrounded by dramatic limestone karsts and lush rice paddies. Return to Hanoi in the evening for an overnight stay.Day 3Hanoi to Sapa - Cat Cat Village TourDepart early from Hanoi for the mountainous town of Sapa, with comfort breaks along the way. Arrive at midday, check in at the hotel, and enjoy lunch. In the afternoon, embark on a guided trek to Cat Cat & Shin Chai Villages, where you will see waterfalls, hydropower stations, and experience traditional H’Mong culture, including weaving, silver carving, and blacksmith work. Return to Sapa town for dinner and an overnight stay.Day 4Fansipan Mountain & Return to HanoiAfter breakfast, take the cable car to Fansipan Peak, the “Roof of Indochina” at 3,143 meters. Explore pagodas and viewpoints, then trek approximately 600 steps to reach the summit for panoramic views of the surrounding highlands. Return by cable car to Sapa and enjoy lunch at your hotel. In the afternoon, depart by bus back to Hanoi with comfort stops along the way, arriving in the evening. Overnight stay in Hanoi.Day 5Fly to Da Nang - Hoi An Ancient Town & Lantern Boat RideCatch a morning flight to Da Nang and transfer to your hotel. Explore the enchanting Hoi An Ancient Town, visiting the Japanese Bridge, Chinese Assembly Halls, historic merchant houses, and local handicraft shops. In the evening, enjoy a lantern boat ride on the Hoai River, followed by a delightful dinner featuring Hoi An specialties. Take a stroll through the lantern-lit night market before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.Day 6Ba Na Hills Day TripStart the day with a transfer to Ba Na Hills, where you will ride the world’s longest single-rope cable car to the French Village. Explore Lunar Castle, Eclipse Square, and enjoy entertainment at Fantasy Park. Relish a buffet lunch, then walk across the iconic Golden Bridge and explore the colorful Le Jardin flower gardens. Return to Da Nang in the evening and overnight at your hotel.Day 7DepartureAfter breakfast, enjoy some leisure time before your private transfer to Da Nang Airport for your flight back home, concluding your memorable Vietnam adventure.Hotel OptionsHong Ha Hotel Hanoi or SimilarFreesia Hotel Sapa or similarTac Bay Hotel or similar Previous Next123InclusionAccommodation in 3 or 4 star hotels on Double Sharing BasisDaily breakfast and meals as mentioned in itineraryPrivate transfers and sightseeing in air-conditioned vehiclesExperienced English-speaking local guidesEntrance fees for all attractions as per the itineraryLantern boat ride in Hoi AnCable car tickets for Fansipan Peak and Ba Na HillsSapa trekking & cultural experiencesExclusionInternational and domestic flights to and from VietnamPersonal expenses, optional activities, and tipsTravel insuranceMeals not mentioned in the itineraryVisa fees (if applicable)Important InformationRayna Tours – Easy Terms & Conditions for Your TripWe want your travel experience to be smooth and enjoyable. title: Halong Bay & Phu Quoc Island 6‑Day Tour Package
meta_description: Explore Vietnam in 6 days: Cruise Halong Bay, relax on Phu Quoc’s beaches, enjoy culture, local food & family-friendly adventures. Book now!
content: Halong Bay & Phu Quoc Island 6‑Day Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysHanoiHanoi, Halong & Phu Quoc Bliss: A Couple’S GetawayShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D4 ImagesView GalleryHanoi, Halong & Phu Quoc Bliss: A Couple’s GetawayNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewEmbark on a serene and enriching journey to Hanoi with an itinerary tailored specifically for elderly couples and friends. This six-day adventure blends cultural exploration, leisure, and breathtaking natural beauty, ensuring a comfortable pace and an enjoyable experience for all. Rest assured that it promises a memorable and enjoyable travel experience. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Hanoi & Half-Day Hanoi City TourUpon your morning arrival in Hanoi, you will be warmly greeted by your guide at the airport and transferred to your hotel for check-in. Then, embark on a half-day city tour; your exploration begins with a visit to the serene Tran Quoc Pagoda, followed by the historically significant Ho Chi Minh Complex and the striking One Pillar Pagoda.  Continue your cultural journey with a stop at the Vietnam Ethnology Museum, or if it's a Monday, the Women’s Museum instead. Enjoy a delightful lunch at a local restaurant before heading to the Temple of Literature, a symbol of Vietnam's scholarly past, and the poignant Hoa Lo Prison Museum in the afternoon.  After a day rich in history and culture, return to your hotel for a restful overnight stay in Hanoi. Day 2Ninh Binh Full-Day Tour (Hoa Lu - Tam Coc - Mua Cave)Begin your second day with an early morning drive to Ninh Binh, a province renowned for its stunning landscapes. First, explore the ancient capital of Hoa Lu, where you'll delve into Vietnam’s rich history by visiting the temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. You’ll next enjoy a scenic boat ride through the lush scenery of Tam Coc, often referred to as “Halong Bay on land,” where you'll marvel at the limestone karsts towering over emerald rice paddies. After a delicious local lunch, head to Mua Cave, climbing its 500 steps for a panoramic view of the magnificent landscapes. Return to Hanoi for a restful overnight stay at your hotel. Day 3Hanoi → Halong Bay Overnight CruiseOn the third day, embark on a morning transfer to Halong Bay, a journey of approximately 2.5 hours, where you'll board your cruise. Upon arrival, enjoy a welcome drink as you check into your cabin, ready to explore the stunning seascape dotted with limestone karsts. Kick off your adventure with a visit to the spectacular Surprise Cave, followed by a stop at Titov Island, where you can choose to swim in the inviting waters or hike to the top for breathtaking views of the bay. Relish a delightful lunch and dinner on board, featuring an array of fresh seafood that highlights the local flavors. As night falls, you have the option to partake in activities like squid fishing or simply stargaze from the deck. Enjoy a restful overnight stay on board, surrounded by the tranquil waters of Halong Bay. Day 4Halong Bay → Hanoi → Fly to Phu QuocBegin your day with a serene Tai Chi session on the sundeck as the sun rises over Halong Bay, followed by a light breakfast. Enjoy a final cruise through the bay's stunning limestone formations, passing by the iconic Fighting Cock Islet. After an early lunch on board, you'll disembark and transfer back to Hanoi. From there, catch a flight to the picturesque island of Phu Quoc, ready to explore yet another beautiful facet of Vietnam. Day 5Cable Car Ride & 4 Islands’ Trip by Speedboat with Local Lunch Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the resort before setting sail on an exhilarating island-hopping speedboat tour. Explore the vibrant Xuong Island, the quaint Gam Ghi Island, and the serene May Rut Trong Island. Dive into the crystal-clear waters to snorkel among colorful marine life, indulge in swimming, and savor a sumptuous seafood lunch right on the beach. Unwind on pristine sands under the sun or take leisurely strolls along the shoreline, immersing yourself in the tranquility. As the sun sets, return to your resort for a restful evening in Phu Quoc.  Day 6Departure from Phu QuocSpend your final day with a leisurely breakfast at your resort, savoring the island's serene ambiance one last time. Take the morning to relax and soak in the tranquility, perhaps a stroll on the beach or lounging by the pool. title: Vietnam Scenic Adventure Tour Package for Friends
meta_description: Travel with friends across Vietnam’s scenic cities, landscapes and adventure spots on this fun-filled group tour package with transfers and guided tours.
content: Vietnam Scenic Adventure Tour Package for FriendsHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysHanoiWonders Of Vietnam: A Scenic Adventure With FriendsShareAdd to Wishlist11N / 12D5 ImagesView GalleryWonders of Vietnam: A Scenic Adventure with FriendsNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewExplore the best of Vietnam in 12 days, from the bustling streets of Hanoi and the serene landscapes of Ninh Binh, to an unforgettable Halong Bay overnight cruise among towering limestone karsts. Discover the vibrant culture of Sapa, visiting colorful ethnic villages and trekking to the majestic Fansipan Peak. Fly to Da Nang and immerse yourself in the charm of Hoi An Ancient Town with its lantern-lit streets and riverside boat rides, and experience the magic of Bana Hills and the iconic Golden Bridge. Conclude your journey in Ho Chi Minh City, exploring historic landmarks, the fascinating Cu Chi Tunnels, and the lush waterways of the Mekong Delta. This journey perfectly blends culture, nature, adventure, and local experiences, leaving you with unforgettable memories of Vietnam.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Hanoi - Day at LeisureWelcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in Hanoi. Spend the day at leisure exploring the city’s charming Old Quarter, strolling along Hoan Kiem Lake, visiting Ngoc Son Temple, The Huc Bridge, and the famous Train Street. Immerse yourself in the local culture at your own pace and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 2Full-Day Ninh Binh Tour (Hoa Lu - Tam Coc - Mua Cave) with Local LunchStart your day with a scenic drive to Ninh Binh, often called “Halong Bay on Land.” Explore the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and visit temples built in honor of Emperors Dinh and Le. Enjoy a local lunch before boarding a small sampan for a relaxing boat trip along Tam Coc, marveling at limestone cliffs, caves, and picturesque rice paddies. End the day with a trek to the top of Mua Cave for panoramic views of the stunning countryside before returning to Hanoi for overnight stay.Day 3Halong Bay Overnight CruiseCheck out of your hotel and transfer to Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Board your cruise at Tuan Chau Harbour and visit Ti Top Island for kayaking and swimming. Discover the floating Pearl Farm Village and enjoy a fun onboard cooking class. Spend the night cruising past spectacular limestone karsts, surrounded by breathtaking natural scenery.Day 4Halong Bay to Hanoi - Day at LeisureBegin the day with a calming Tai Chi session on the deck before exploring the magnificent Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave. After disembarking, return to Hanoi and check in to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure exploring cultural landmarks such as Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, the Temple of Literature, or shopping in the Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.Day 5Hanoi - Sapa - Cat Cat Village Early morning, depart for Sapa. Enjoy scenic stops en route and arrive at Sapa by afternoon. After lunch and check-in, embark on a guided walk to the colorful Cat Cat Village, home to the H’Mong ethnic group. Explore traditional crafts, local culture, and scenic waterfalls. Return to Sapa town for a relaxing dinner and overnight stay.Day 6Sapa - Fansipan Peak - Return to HanoiAfter breakfast, take a cable car to Fansipan Peak, the “Roof of Indochina,” at 2,800 meters. Explore the pagodas, enjoy panoramic mountain views, and capture memorable photos. Return to Sapa for lunch and leisure, then board the bus back to Hanoi, arriving in the evening for an overnight stay.Day 7Fly to Da Nang - Half-Day Hoi An Tour with Lantern Boat Ride & DinnerFly to Da Nang and start your afternoon adventure with a visit to Cam Thanh Coconut Village. Experience traditional fishing techniques and explore the serene coconut waterways. Next, explore Hoi An Ancient Town, including Phuc Kien Chinese Assembly Hall, Japanese Bridge, and historic merchant houses. Conclude with a lantern boat ride on the Hoai River, enjoy Hoi An’s night market, and savor a local dinner.Day 8Full-Day Bana Hills TourBegin the day with a visit to a traditional craft village en route to Bana Hills. Take the world’s longest one-rope cable car to the romantic French Village and explore Lunar Castle, Eclipse Square, and Mat Bay Theater. Enjoy a buffet lunch, explore Fantasy Park, and visit the iconic Golden Bridge surrounded by colorful Le Jardin flowers before returning to your hotel.Day 9Fly to Ho Chi Minh City – Day at LeisureArrive in Ho Chi Minh City and check in at your hotel. Spend the day exploring nearby attractions like Ben Thanh Market, Saigon River, and local cafes. Experience the vibrant city atmosphere and enjoy the nightlife at your own pace.Day 10Ho Chi Minh City Full-Day Tour with Cu Chi TunnelsStart your day with a city tour, visiting iconic landmarks including the War Remnants Museum, Reunification Palace, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Central Post Office. After lunch, explore the historic Cu Chi Tunnels, learn about the war, experience local dishes, and try optional rifle shooting. Return to your hotel in the evening.Day 11Mekong Delta TourEmbark on a scenic journey through the Mekong Delta’s lush landscapes, visiting Dragon Island, Unicorn Island, and Ben Tre province. Explore local villages by rowing boat, visit coconut candy workshops, sample tropical fruits, and enjoy traditional southern music. Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the late afternoon.Day 12DepartureAfter breakfast, enjoy some leisure time until your transfer to Tan Son Nhat Airport for your onward flight, bringing home unforgettable memories of Vietnam.Hotel OptionsHong Ha Hotel Hanoi or similarFreesia Hotel Sapa or similarTac Bay Hotel Danang or similarAcnos Hotel Ho chi Minh or similar Previous Next123InclusionAccommodation in below mentioned hotel or similar Daily breakfast and selected meals as mentioned in the itinerary.Airport transfers and sightseeing in modern air-conditioned vehicles.Experienced English-speaking local guides.Entrance fees to all attractions and activities mentioned.Halong Bay overnight cruise with meals and activities.Sapa 2D1N package including cable car to Fansipan.Lantern boat ride in Hoi An and Bana Hills cable car tickets.Mekong Delta tour including boat rides and local experiences.ExclusionInternational and domestic flightsPersonal expenses, optional activities, and tipsTravel insuranceMeals not mentioned in the itineraryVisa fees (if applicable)Personal Expenses Shopping, opptional tours, etcImportant InformationRayna Tours – Easy Terms & Conditions for Your TripWe want your travel experience to be smooth and enjoyable. title: Vietnam Wonders from North to Central Tour Package
meta_description: Travel from Northern to Central Vietnam exploring iconic cities, natural wonders and cultural sites on this all-inclusive tour package with transfers and stays.
content: Vietnam Wonders from North to Central Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysHanoiVietnam Wonders From North To CentralShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D5 ImagesView GalleryVietnam Wonders from North to CentralNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewExplore Vietnam's essence with a carefully curated seven-days itinerary catering to honeymooners and young couples. Start in Hanoi, blending historic allure with modern sophistication, through guided tours and culinary adventures. Create unforgettable memories in artisan villages and bustling markets and immerse yourself in the majesty of Ha Long Bay on an intimate overnight cruise. Wander hand-in-hand through Hoi An's lantern-lit streets, and marvel at Ba Na Hills' Golden Bridge before concluding with a serene beachfront brunch, reflecting on an enriching cultural journey. ItineraryDay 1Arrival at Noi Bai International AirportUpon landing at Noi Bai International Airport, you will be greeted with warm Vietnamese hospitality. A private transfer will be waiting to whisk you into the heart of Hanoi, where you’ll arrive on time. Begin your Vietnamese adventure with a leisurely afternoon spent exploring the local area or simply relaxing at your own pace. Later, take a peaceful stroll around the iconic Hoan Kiem Lake. The serene surroundings offers a picturesque setting for reflection and relaxation. You’ll next visit the Ngoc Son Temple, an enchanting sanctuary located on a small island in Hoan Kiem Lake, accessible via the iconic red Huc Bridge. Don’t miss to wander through the vibrant streets of the Old Quarter, featuring an eclectic mix of quaint cafés, bustling local shops, and historic architecture that tells the tale of old Hanoi. Enjoy dinner at your leisure, choosing from a variety of local or international cuisines to suit your preference. Day 2Ninh Binh Day Trip (Hoa Lu & Tam Coc)Begin your day with a departure from Hanoi for an enriching full-day excursion to Ninh Binh Province. Your first stop will be the historic site of Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, where you'll explore temples dedicated to the Dinh and Le dynasties, marking Vietnam’s first centralized feudal state.  In the afternoon, indulge in a traditional Vietnamese lunch at a local eatery. Afterward, prepare for a picturesque boat ride in Tam Coc, where you'll glide along the Ngo Dong River, navigating through dramatic limestone caves and karst formations set against a backdrop of lush rice paddies. As the day winds down, enjoy the return journey to Hanoi. Day 3Halong Bay Cruise (Day 1) On the third day, embark on a scenic transfer from Hanoi to Halong Bay, where you'll board a cruise to begin your maritime adventure. As you settle in, enjoy a warm welcome alongside a sumptuous lunch on board. The afternoon will be spent exploring the mesmerizing Sung Sot Cave, followed by an invigorating session of kayaking or swimming in the emerald waters. As the day transitions to evening, savor the breathtaking sunset from the deck, creating unforgettable memories. Treat your taste buds to a delightful dinner, followed by engaging onboard activities, and revel in the tranquility of your overnight stay on the cruise. Day 4Halong Bay Cruise (Day 2) Start your day with a serene sunrise Tai Chi session on deck, soaking in the tranquility of the surroundings. Afterward, hike up Ti Top Island, where you're rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views of Ha Long Bay. Return to the comfort of your cruise for a delightful brunch as you journey back to the harbor. Once disembarked, transfer to Hanoi, where you'll have leisure time to explore or relax in the evening. Unwind and enjoy your overnight stay in Hanoi.  Day 5Fly to Da Nang | Hoi An & Coconut Village Begin your journey with a morning flight to Da Nang, followed by a transfer to your hotel for check-in. In the afternoon, visit Cam Thanh Coconut Village where you can enjoy a basket boat ride, participate in a fishing experience, and learn local techniques. Continue to Hoi An Ancient Town, exploring the iconic Japanese Bridge, Chinese Assembly Halls, and Ancient Houses, while also browsing handicraft shops and enjoying art performances. In the evening, set out on a lantern boat ride on the Hoai River and savor a delightful dinner featuring Hoi An specialties. Cap off your day with free time at the vibrant, lantern-lit night market before returning for an overnight stay in Da NangDay 6 Ba Na Hills Day Trip Kick off your adventure with a morning transfer to the captivating Ba Na Hills, where you'll embark on the world's longest single-rope cable car ride. Once at the summit, explore the charming French Village, marvel at the majestic Lunar Castle, and experience the lively attractions at Fantasy Park, all while enjoying an inclusive buffet lunch. In the afternoon, take a memorable stroll on the iconic Golden Bridge, set against the backdrop of stunning vistas, and wander through the vibrant Le Jardin flower gardens. As evening approaches, descend by cable car and transfer back to Da Nang for an overnight stay. Day 7Departure Take in your last moments in this vibrant country as you enjoy a hearty breakfast. Following this, ensure all your belongings are packed and ready before being transferred to the airport. Board your departure flight back to India on a pleasant note, concluding your memorable journey through Vietnam. meta_description: Enjoy a magical family escape across Vietnam with scenic attractions, cultural experiences and smooth travel on this family-friendly tour package.

This meticulously crafted itinerary spans Vietnam’s most enchanting destinations, from Hanoi to Phu Quoc and Da Nang. So prepare to immerse yourself in Vietnam’s vast repertoire of cultural, natural, and adventurous experiences in nine days. Savor a local Vietnamese lunch amidst this natural splendor before returning to Hanoi. Day 3Halong Bay Overnight Cruise Today, experience the magical allure of Halong Bay with an overnight cruise. Revel in the bay's enchanting emerald waters and limestone karsts while enjoying activities such as kayaking or simply sunbathing on deck. Day 4Back to Hanoi || Fly to Phu Quoc After returning to Hanoi from Halong Bay, prepare for a change of scenery as a flight whisks you away to Phu Quoc. Spend the afternoon settling into your beachside retreat on this idyllic island, soaking in the sun and sea breezes. Day 5Day Tour to Vin Wonders and Vin Safari (Private transfer) Delight in a day of excitement at Vin Wonders, Vietnam’s premier amusement park, followed by an engaging visit to Vin Safari, where wildlife roams vast, open habitats. A private transfer ensures a seamless experience for the entire family. Day 64 Island speed boat tour with Cable CarBrace yourself for the most thrilling adventures as a speed boat takes you to four captivating islands surrounding Phu Quoc. meta_description: Looking to pack your Azerbaijan getaway with the most exciting and enigmatic moments? All you need is our four-night Awesome Azerbaijan. But don’t delay; book your retreat now at the best rates.
content: 4 Nights and 5 Days Azerbaijan PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBaku5 Days Awesome AzerbaijanShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView Gallery5 Days Awesome AzerbaijanNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewAzerbaijan, where East meets West, offers a unique blend of ancient history, modern luxury, and stunning landscapes. From the bustling capital, Baku, with its futuristic architecture, to the serene beauty of the Caspian Sea, Azerbaijan is a land of contrasts. Explore ancient temples, vibrant markets, and diverse natural wonders. Perfect for culture seekers and adventure lovers alike, this holiday package promises a truly unforgettable experience in this fascinating country.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Baku and Transfer to HotelUpon your arrival at Baku Heydar Aliyev International Airport, meet our representative, who will escort you to the vehicle and transfer you to the hotel in Baku. Rest day at your leisure.Day 2Baku City Tour Explore the Old City (Inner City), the historic heart of Baku and the oldest part of the capital, surrounded by well-preserved protective walls. In 2000, this area, including the stunning Palace of the Shirvanshahs and the iconic Maiden Tower, was designated Azerbaijan’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site. With a small community living within its walls, the Old City offers a fascinating glimpse into Baku’s rich past.Next, stroll along Nizami Street, a lively shopping and cultural hub that dates back to Baku’s 1864 town-planning project. Stretching over 3.5 kilometers through the city center, Nizami Street is lined with shops, cafes, and vibrant city life, making it a favorite for both locals and visitors.Then, visit Fountains Square, a popular public gathering spot in downtown Baku known for its numerous fountains originally built during Soviet times. This square comes alive especially after work hours and on weekends, offering a lively atmosphere in the heart of the city.Finally, admire the breathtaking Heydar Aliyev Center, a masterpiece of modern architecture designed by Iraqi-British architect Zaha Hadid. Known for its flowing, curved design that avoids sharp angles, this 57,500 m² building is a symbol of contemporary Azerbaijan and a favorite spot for photos outside.End your day with a comfortable stay in BakuDay 3Gabala Tour Today, following breakfast, you will enjoy a pleasant day trip from Baku on a guided Gabala tour with transfers. A refreshing drive of up to three hours (approximately 225 kilometers away) will lead you to the ancient city of Gabala, enveloped by unrivaled mountainous charm.One of the major stops on this tour is Tufandag Mountain Resort, a year-round attraction known for its irresistible winter and summer activities. Thanks to its cable car ride, ski schools, and skiing tracks that are ideal for all abilities and age groups.You will next tour Nohur Lake, a stunning, crystal-clear lake that is tucked away amidst lush scenery. The tour comes to an end as you will be dropped off at your hotel or desired location in Baku. Day 4Absheron Flame TourStart your day with a delicious breakfast at your hotel before heading out for an exciting Absheron Tour. Begin with a visit to the Ateshgah (Fire Worshippers Temple), a historic site used by Hindu and Zoroastrian communities for worship. This pentagonal complex, built in the 17th and 18th centuries, features a courtyard surrounded by monks’ cells and a central tetra pillar altar.Next, travel to the famous Yanardag (Fire Mountain), located about 25 km north of Baku on the Absheron Peninsula. Known as the "Blazing Mountain," Yanardag is a natural gas fire that has been burning continuously on a hillside for centuries, symbolizing Azerbaijan’s title as the “Land of Fire.” Witness the mesmerizing flames dancing on the rocks, creating a truly unforgettable experience.
