title: Baku Gabala Classic Azerbaijan Package | From UAE & India
meta_description: Explore Azerbaijan with our Baku–Gabala City Explorer Package featuring city tours, Gabala mountains, Gobustan, Absheron fire temples & comfortable stays. Book now!
content: Baku Gabala Classic Azerbaijan Package | From UAE & IndiaHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBakuClassic Azerbaijan With GabalaShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryClassic Azerbaijan With GabalaNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewAzerbaijan, where East meets West, offers a unique blend of ancient history, modern luxury, and stunning landscapes. From the bustling capital, Baku, with its futuristic architecture, to the serene beauty of the Caspian Sea, Azerbaijan is a land of contrasts. Explore ancient temples, vibrant markets, and diverse natural wonders. Perfect for culture seekers and adventure lovers alike, this holiday package promises a truly unforgettable experience in this fascinating country.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Baku and Transfer to GabalaUpon your arrival at Baku Heydar Aliyev International Airport, meet our representative, who will escort you to the vehicle and transfer you to the hotel in Gabala. Rest day at your leisure.Overnight in Gabala.Day 2Gabala Mountain tour – transfer to BakuAfter breakfast at the hotel, Checkout from Gabala hotel -  proceed for Gabala sightseeing. The excursion includes a visit to the Tufandaq Winter-Summer Tourism Complex, which offers cable car rides throughout the year, skiing on various difficulty levels, ski training and a ski school, as well as catering services including cafes and restaurants, entertainment centers for children, and hotel accommodations. You will also visit Nohur Lake, located in Gabala, which is a beautiful mountain lake that provides stunning views and is a must-see when traveling towards Sheki, though it requires a slight detour. The day concludes with return to your accommodation.Overnight stay in Baku.Day 3Baku city tour with Absheron Flame TourExplore the Old City (Inner City), the historic heart of Baku and the oldest part of the capital, surrounded by well-preserved protective walls. In 2000, this area, including the stunning Palace of the Shirvanshahs and the iconic Maiden Tower, was designated Azerbaijan’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site. With a small community living within its walls, the Old City offers a fascinating glimpse into Baku’s rich past.Next, stroll along Nizami Street, a lively shopping and cultural hub that dates back to Baku’s 1864 town-planning project. Stretching over 3.5 kilometers through the city center, Nizami Street is lined with shops, cafes, and vibrant city life, making it a favorite for both locals and visitors.Then, visit Fountains Square, a popular public gathering spot in downtown Baku known for its numerous fountains originally built during Soviet times. This square comes alive especially after work hours and on weekends, offering a lively atmosphere in the heart of the city.Finally, admire the breathtaking Heydar Aliyev Center, a masterpiece of modern architecture designed by Iraqi-British architect Zaha Hadid. Known for its flowing, curved design that avoids sharp angles, this 57,500 m² building is a symbol of contemporary Azerbaijan and a favorite spot for photos outside.Begin with a visit to the Ateshgah (Fire Worshippers Temple), a historic site used by Hindu and Zoroastrian communities for worship. This pentagonal complex, built in the 17th and 18th centuries, features a courtyard surrounded by monks’ cells and a central tetra pillar altar.Next, travel to the famous Yanardag (Fire Mountain), located about 25 km north of Baku on the Absheron Peninsula. Known as the "Blazing Mountain," Yanardag is a natural gas fire that has been burning continuously on a hillside for centuries, symbolizing Azerbaijan’s title as the “Land of Fire.” Witness the mesmerizing flames dancing on the rocks, creating a truly unforgettable experience. After the tour, return to your accommodation in Baku for a comfortable stayDay 4Gobustan tour with mud volcanoesAfter enjoying breakfast at the hotel, you will proceed on a tour to Gobustan, a region renowned for its ancient rock petroglyphs. This historical area has been inhabited since the 8th millennium BC and spans over 100 square kilometers, showcasing thousands of rock engravings that depict hunting scenes, people, ships, animals, and constellations. Some of these petroglyphs date back as far as the 12th century BC. Recognizing its cultural significance, UNESCO added the Gobustan Rock Art Cultural Landscape to the World Heritage list in 2007. The tour continues with a visit to the fascinating Mud Volcanoes, after which you will return to your accommodation.Overnight stay in Baku.Day 5DepartureToday is the departure day. check out and meet our representative with vehicle who will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to Baku Heydar Aliyev International Airport. Hotel Options4* Gabala Karvansaray Hotel or Similar4* city park hotel or Similar Previous NextInclusion• 01 Night Accommodation in Gabala at hotel mentioned below or similar• 03 Night Accommodation in Baku at hotel mentioned below or similar• Daily breakfast at Hotel• Baku City Tour with Absheron Flame Tour• Full day Gabala Mountain tour • Gobustan tour with mud volcanoes • Entrance Fees: Gabala Cable Car (02 lines), Fire temple + Fire mountain, Taxi to mud volcano• 02-way Airport transfers on private basis• Tours as per itinerary with comfortable vehicles on private basis• English speaking driver cum guide throughout the tour• 02-way Flight ticket in economy class• 20kg check in baggage and 5-7kg hand luggage• Travel InsuranceExclusion• Azerbaijan Visa• Early check-in / Late check-out• Entrances other than mentioned • Anything not mentioned in inclusions Departure & Pricing Per person on Double sharing basis AED 3199 Flights Details Date From To Flight No. Dept. content: Almaty Ultimate Adventure Tour for Thrill & Nature LoversHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysAlmatyBest Of KazakhstanShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryBest of KazakhstanNewFlightTransfersHotelsOverviewJoin us for a refreshing holiday in Almaty, Kazakhstan’s largest city! After this, follow your friendly driver to the vehicle for a seamless transfer to your Almaty accommodation. Complete the check-in procedures and relax in your room.Day 2Almaty City & Koktobe Tour Almaty City & Koktobe TourStart your day with an energizing breakfast session, and then prepare for an exciting exploration of the region on a guided Almaty city tour. Stop at the timeless Park of the 28 Panfilov Guardsmen, dating back to the 19th century. Pay respect to the Memorial of Glory with an eternal flame that has remained lit here since 1975. You will next visit the charming Zenkov Cathedral, which has stood the test of time, and the city’s largest square, Republic Square, with the iconic Independence Monument. Following lunch, you will head to the mountain resort of Oi Qaragai, where unspoiled beauty, revitalizing mountain breeze, and exciting activities guarantee an unforgettable outing.After this moving towards to Koktobe tour, you will set out on a scenic trip to Koktobe, the city’s highest point. The excitement escalates as you board a cable car for an exhilarating ride up to this 1,100-meter-high hill. Treat your eyes to the most captivating and unhindered views that unfold before you at every turn. Catch unhindered views of the 372-meter-high television tower perched atop the hill and take in its other attractions, such as the Alley of Lovers, Ferris Wheel, and Fountain of Desires. The tour ends with a cable car ride and a stress-free transfer to your Almaty accommodation.Day 3Medeu, ShymbulakToday after breakfast, Visit the Medeo skating rink and the popular Shymbulak ski resort. Embark on a cable car ride through the gorge, taking in the stunning natural scenery. From mountains, lush forests, rivers and canyons, the area around Almaty boasts plenty of natural wonders.Medeu Famous skating rink where hundreds of world records were set. Visitors can hike around the lakes or take a horseback riding tour to explore the surrounding wilderness.Charyn Canyon Picture 56, PictureCharyn Canyon - located about 200 kilometers east of Almaty, Charyn Canyon is a stunning natural wonder that stretches over 150 kilometers in length. The canyon is a product of millions of years of erosion by the Charyn River and features impressive rock formations that change color throughout the day. Visitors  can hike along the canyon's rim or venture down to the canyon ﬂoor to explore its unique features, including the Valley of Castles and the Ghost Valley. Day 5Back to the Almaty city and rest day leisureToday after breakfast check out from Kolsay hotel & transfer to the Almaty hotel, after check in formalities you will have an entire day to craft your own travel program. content: 6 Days Golden Triangle Tour Package | 6 Days Delhi Agra Jaipur TourHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDelhiBest Of Golden Triangle Experience 6 DaysShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D3 ImagesView GalleryBest Of Golden Triangle Experience 6 DaysNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewJourney through India’s iconic Golden Triangle on this holiday, covering three celebrated cities: Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur. See Old and New Delhi; stop at Agra’s architectural masterpieces like Agra Fort and Taj Mahal; and check all of Jaipur’s must-sees from your bucket list. The five-night holiday includes accommodation in each city, daily breakfast, guided sightseeing, and comfortable transfers.ItineraryDay 1Delhi arrival – Old & New Delhi sightseeing Kick off your holiday as you arrive in Delhi. After a warm welcome and a smooth transfer, check in to your hotel and take some time to relax. Later, step out to experience Delhi’s fascinating blend of old-world charm and modern grandeur.  Day 2Full Day local Delhi SightseeingFollowing a fulfilling breakfast, discover the best of Old and New Delhi on a guided sightseeing tour. Begin at the majestic Red Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and then proceed to the India Gate, a grand war memorial. You’ll also see Qutub Minar, the world’s tallest brick minaret; explore the serene Lotus Temple; and marvel at the regal Humayun’s Tomb. The spiritual calm of Gurudwara Bangla Sahib, combined with a shopping and culinary experience through the vibrant lanes of Chandni Chowk, ensures a perfect finale to your full-day tour. Day 3Delhi to Agra – Taj Mahal sunset view After memorable two days in Delhi, you’ll leave for India’s eternal city of love, Agra, on a scenic drive. Enjoy a hassle-free check-in before you set out to witness the grandeur of the Taj Mahal. Stroll through its lush gardens and be amazed as this pristine white marble structure shines in the golden hues of the sunset. Day 4Full Day Agra Visit Today, your driver-cum-guide will be ready to pick you up for a sightseeing tour of Agra’s most treasured landmarks, including the stunning Agra Fort. As you journey through the city, you’ll encounter more of Agra’s timeless charm, where each monument and structure narrates Mughal tales of love, power, and artistic brilliance.Day 5Agra to Jaipur – Enroute Fatehpur Sikri Check out of your hotel and meet our representative for a stress-free drive toward Jaipur, famously known as the Pink City. You’ll stop at Fatehpur Sikri, which was once a flourishing Mughal capital during Emperor Akbar’s reign. Feel the aura of its enlightening past as you wander this abandoned red sandstone city. Once you arrive in Agra, check in to your hotel and unwind as you prepare to enjoy Rajasthan’s royal experiences.Day 6Jaipur Sightseeing + Optional Chokhi Dhani DinnerThe whole day is dedicated to sightseeing in Jaipur on a guided excursion. content: Rajasthan Forts and Palaces Tour Package | Best DealsHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysJaipurRoyal Heritage Tour Forts And PalacesShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D3 ImagesView GalleryRoyal Heritage Tour Forts and PalacesNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewSpend seven thrilling days in Rajasthan, with two nights each in Jaipur, Udaipur, and Kumbhalgarh, taking in this royal state’s rich heritage, culture, natural beauty, and wildlife. With accommodations, transfers, and exciting tours, you can be assured of experiencing all of Rajasthan’s top attractions and experiences, from Amber Fort, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, and Hawa Mahal to Lake Pichola boat ride, Jag Mandir, Saheliyon-ki-Bari, Fateh Sagar Lake, Kumbhalgarh Fort, and Badal Mahal. ItineraryDay 1Arrival Jaipur - Evening Light and Sound ShowA relaxed arrival transfer to your pre-arranged accommodation in Jaipur ensures a perfect start to your Rajasthan holiday. Settle into your room before you set out in the evening to watch the mesmerizing Sound & Light Show at Amer Fort, ensuring an enlightening introduction to Jaipur’s royal heritage. Day 2Jaipur - Local SightseeingA full-day, guided tour of Jaipur allows you to admire all of the region’s top claims to fame. Visit the historic Amber Fort, the City Palace, and Jantar Mantar, a one-of-a-kind astronomical marvel. Step back in time as you enter the Hawa Mahal, which will surely blow you away. The tour ends with a shopping session at Bapu Bazaar. Day 3Jaipur - Udaipur - Enroute Chittorgarh Check out of your Jaipur hotel and be ready for a leisurely drive to Udaipur, popularly known as the “City of Lakes.” Enjoy a brief stop at the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Chittorgarh Fort, which echoes timeless tales of Rajput valor. As you arrive in Udaipur, check in to your room and settle in for a peaceful overnight stay. Day 4Udaipur - Local SightseeingSpend the whole day exploring Udaipur, starting at City Palace and continuing with a tranquil boat ride on Lake Pichola. You’ll also tour the stunning island palace, Jag Mandir, amid calm waters, the charming Saheliyon-ki-Bari, and the quaint Fateh Sagar Lake. Return to your room after a shopping adventure in local markets.Day 5Udaipur - Kumbhalgarh; Enroute Eklingji Temple & Haldighati MemorialAfter checking out of the hotel, your friendly driver will transfer you to Kumbhalgarh, with a stop at the 8th-century Eklingji Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva. Another attraction included in your program is the Haldighati Memorial, which pays tribute to the brave battle fought between Maharana Pratap and the Mughals. Once you arrive in Kumbhalgarh, check in and unwind in your room. Day 6Kumbhalgarh - Local SightseeingDedicate your sixth day in Rajasthan to exploring some of Kumbhalgarh’s top sights, such as the majestic Kumbhalgarh Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the enchanting Badal Mahal (Palace of Clouds). meta_description: Discover Rajasthan’s grand heritage - Jaipur, Udaipur, Jaisalmer & more - on this classic tour package with guided excursions, transfers & stays included.

Starting in Jaipur, it also covers the delights of Bikaner, Jaisalmer, Jodhpur, and Udaipur. Accommodation in all these cities, plus convenient transfers and fully guided tours, allows you to experience the region’s top attractions with complete ease and convenience. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Jaipur & Check-In; Sound & Light Show at Amer FortMeet our representative as you arrive in Jaipur! Following a smooth transfer and hotel check-in, relax in your room and then head out in the evening to treat yourself to the stunning Sound & Light Show at Amer Fort, which breathes life into the fort’s historic grandeur. Day 2Amber Fort, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, Hawa Mahal, Bapu Bazaar shoppingThe entire day is dedicated to exploring Jaipur’s top attractions on a guided excursion. Begin at the iconic Amber Fort and then tour the City Palace, before visiting the astonishing Jantar Mantar and the striking Hawa Mahal. A shopping session at the bustling Bapu Bazaar ensures a relaxed end to your city sightseeing. Day 3Jaipur – Mandawa – Bikaner After breakfast and hotel check-out, you’ll travel to Bikaner, where you can absorb Mandawa’s beautifully painted Havelis and rich heritage along the way. Once you reach Bikaner, check in to your room to spend the rest of the day at your relaxed pace. Day 4Bikaner – Jaisalmer Today, you’ll bid farewell to Bikaner before enjoying a pleasant drive to the Golden City of Jaisalmer. Admire the region’s raw desert allure as you make your way to this historic city. As you arrive here, check in to your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay.Day 5Jaisalmer Sightseeing Today, embark on a fully guided tour of Jaisalmer’s best sights and sounds. See ornate Havelis, visit the marvelous Jaisalmer Fort, and be in awe of the region’s intricately carved Jain temples, such as Chandraprabhu, Parasnath, Shitalnath, Sambhavnath, Shantinath, Kunthunath, and Rikhabdev. In the evening, enjoy a desert excursion at the enchanting Sam Sand Dunes, which feasts your senses with exquisite experiences, cultural performances, and gorgeous sunset views. Day 6Jaisalmer – JodhpurPrepare for an exciting journey as you leave Jaisalmer’s golden beauty behind and drive to Jodhpur. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and then spend the rest of the day exploring the city’s top attractions, including the magnificent Mehrangarh Fort, the serene Jaswant Thada, and the ever-effervescent Sardar Bazaar and the bustling Clock Tower area. Day 7Jodhpur – Ranakpur – Udaipur Today, prepare for an exciting drive toward Udaipur, covering the scenic Aravalli Range. Stop at Ranakpur along the way to take in its revered Jain Temple, renowned for its intricate marble carvings. In Udaipur, visit Lake Pichola, offering views of Jag Mandir and Arsi Vilas. Finally, check into your hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay. Day 8Udaipur Sightseeing Enjoy a full-day sightseeing of this charming city. A visit to the magnificent Fateh Prakash Palace kicks off your excursion, which continues to the picturesque Lake Pichola and the sacred Jagdish Temple. Later, wander the beautifully designed Saheliyon Ki Bari and end your day at Shilpgram, an artisan village showcasing Rajasthan’s traditional crafts and unpretentious charm. Day 9Departure Today, you’ll conclude your Rajasthan holiday on a stress-free note as you complete checkout procedures and enjoy a pleasant drive to the airport or railway station. Hotel OptionsThe Hilton or SimilarNarendra Bhawan / Laxmi Niwas Palace or SimilarRawalkot / Rang Mahal or SimilarIndana Palace or SimilarFatehgarh or Similar Previous NextInclusionAccommodation in well-appointed hotelsDaily breakfast at the hotelAll airport, railway station, and intercity transfers by private air-conditioned vehicleAll sightseeing and excursions as per the itinerary by private vehicleToll taxes, parking fees, and driver’s allowances includedExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending citySafari Tickets are not included in package costMonument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing placesMeals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners)Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etc.Any additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itineraryGuide services (unless specified as included)Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuationTipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staffAny cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellationsGST or any other government taxes (if applicable)Important InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. title: 9 Days Rajasthan Heritage and Wildlife Package | Book Now!
meta_description: Book a 9 days Rajasthan heritage and wildlife tour package featuring historic cities, royal monuments and exciting wildlife safaris.
content: 9 Days Rajasthan Heritage and Wildlife Package | Book Now!HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysJaisalmerBest Rajasthan Wildlife And Heritage Trip 9 DaysShareAdd to Wishlist8N / 9D3 ImagesView GalleryBest Rajasthan Wildlife And Heritage Trip 9 DaysNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThis nine-day holiday is your perfect gateway to experiencing the best of Rajasthan. Stay comfortably across Jaipur, Ranthambore, Udaipur, Jodhpur, and Jaisalmer, with efficient transfers, daily breakfast, and immaculately guided sightseeing tours. Enjoy smooth travel, thoughtfully planned itineraries, and all the comforts you need as you explore the region’s most iconic attractions at their best! ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Jaipur & check-in; evening Sound & Light Show – Amer Fort Your vacation begins in the Pink City of Jaipur. Following the meet-and-greet and a smooth transfer, check in to your room and relax. In the evening, set out to watch the stunning Sound & Light Show at the majestic Amer Fort.  Day 2Jaipur Sightseeing After breakfast, prepare to take in some of Jaipur’s best sights and sounds. You’ll first tour the magnificent Amber Fort, perched on a hilltop, followed by a visit to the opulent City Palace, which is instantly recognizable for its blend of Rajput and Mughal architecture; the fascinating Jantar Mantar; and the iconic Hawa Mahal, renowned as “Palace of Winds.” Before the tour ends, indulge in a shopping session at the lively Bapu Bazaar, where you can shop for unique souvenirs and handicraft items.  Day 3Jaipur to Ranthambore Today, check out of your hotel and then head to Ranthambore, one of India’s most prominent wildlife reserves. Enjoy the lush landscapes that unfold during the scenic drive. Upon arrival, settle into your room at the resort and unwind in the natural surroundings. Spend the rest of the day at leisure. Day 4Ranthambore – Chittorgarh – Udaipur After breakfast and hotel check-out, kick off your journey toward the celebrated city of Udaipur. Stop at the UNESCO-listed Chittorgarh Fort, one of the country’s largest forts, where its ramparts, ancient palaces, and timeless shrines echo Rajput tales of valor and sacrifice. Later, upon reaching Udaipur, check in to your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay. Day 5Udaipur Sightseeing Today, you’ll embark on a full-day Udaipur city tour. Tour the architectural masterpiece of City Palace, enjoy a serene boat ride along Lake Pichola, stop at the revered Jag Mandir, and wander the charming saheliyon - ki - Bari gardens. Later, immerse yourself in Fateh Sagar Lake’s picturesque beauty, before heading to explore the enlightening Vintage Car Museum and be in awe of exciting folk performances at Bharatiya Lok Kala Mandal. Before the tour ends, watch the vibrant bagore Ki Haveli Show and brace yourself for a shopping session at local markets.  Day 6Udaipur – Ranakpur – Jodhpur After breakfast and hotel check-out, our representative will drive you to Jodhpur, stopping at ranakpur en route. Visit the venerated ranakpur Jain Temple, renowned for its intricate marble structure and spiritual ambiance. Continue your journey through the breathtaking Aravalli landscapes before arriving in Jodhpur and checking into your hotel. Spend the rest of the evening at your own pace.  Day 7Jodhpur – Jaisalmer Give the day a pleasant start as you visit the magnificent Mehrangarh Fort, a hilltop fort offering sweeping views of the Blue City. Explore its striking palaces, from Sukh Mahal and Phool Mahal to the unmatched Sheesh Mahal. Later, depart for Jaisalmer; enjoy a relaxed drive through Rajasthan’s desert landscapes. Finally, check into your hotel in Jaisalmer for a peaceful overnight stay. Day 8Jaisalmer Sightseeing After breakfast, you’ll explore Jaisalmer’s top attractions. Tour famous Havelis featuring sandstone facades and intricate latticework. Wander through the city’s historic lanes to marvel at architectural gems such as Patwon Ki Haveli and other age-old mansions. Your cultural journey also takes you to sacred Jain temples, including Indraprabhu, Parasnath, shitalnath, sambhavnath, Shantinath, kunthunath, and rikhabdev. Spend your evening at the enchanting Sam Sand Dunes, ensuring a quintessential desert adventure. title: 7 Days Kerala Tour Package & Itinerary | Book Kerala 7 Day Trip
meta_description: Explore the best of Kerala with a 7 days tour package covering hill stations, wildlife, backwaters, beaches and cultural highlights.
content: 7 Days Kerala Tour Package & Itinerary | Book Kerala 7 Day TripHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMUNNARKerala Discovery From Backwaters To BeachesShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D3 ImagesView GalleryKerala Discovery From Backwaters to BeachesNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewWith an impeccable blend of culture, art, history, and breathtaking natural beauty, holidays in Kerala are truly fantastic. Our Kerala package, designed for six nights and seven days, showcases the best sights of Kerala, offering a glimpse of all that makes this wonderful land ‘God’s Own Country.’ Starting from the bustling heart of Kochi and touching the unparalleled beauty of Munnar, to venturing deep into the enigmatic Thekkady, to enjoying a houseboat tour in Alleppey, and exploring Kovalam and Kanyakumari, this holiday will see you perambulating along Kerala’s most scenic attractions. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Kochi, Transfer to Munnar Upon landing in Kochi, kick-start your journey to the scenic hill station of Munnar. Stop to admire the breathtaking Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls along the way, which will take your breath away with their lush greenery and gushing streams. Once you reach Munnar, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at your leisure. Overnight stay in Munnar  Day 2Munnar Local SightseenToday, prepare for a comprehensive sightseeing tour of Munnar, situated at a height of 1600 meters above sea level. It enchants you at every turn, as you visit many breathtaking attractions, including Eravikulam National Park with some unique flora and fauna; Echo Point, offering mind-boggling views; the majestic Mattupetty Dam; the Tea Museum, with displays on the region’s tea history; and the stunning Rose Garden with a variety of colorful flowers.Overnight stay in MunnarDay 3Drive to ThekkadyFollowing hotel check-out, you’ll travel to Thekkady. You’ll be in for a treat as you explore the wild side of Kerala at Thekkady while keeping an eye out for herds of elephants, wild dogs, deer, wild boars, and gaurs during a boat cruise on Periyar Lake. A trip to Thekkady further gives you the chance to enjoy a cultural show and set out on a spice plantation tour. Overnight stay in ThekkadyDay 4Drive to AlleppeyOn the fourth day, you’ll make a trip to Alleppey, some 160 kilometers away from Thekkady. You’ll relax here for a whole day within the cozy comfort of a traditional wooden boat encircled by glorious views. As you float along the timeless backwaters of Alleppey, breathe in fresh air, admire sunset views, and relish freshly prepared cuisines served onboard. Overnight stay in Alleppey Day 5Drive to KovalamToday, you’ll be transferred to Kerala’s capital, Trivandrum, where you’ll head to the internationally acclaimed beach resort of Kovalam, with three beaches like Hawa Beach, Samudra Beach, and Lighthouse Beach. After checking in at the hotel, spend the evening at your relaxed pace. Overnight stay in Kovalam Day 6Excursion to Kanyakumarikananda Rock, Thiruvalluvar Statue, Sunset Point)Today, you’ll visit Kanyakumari, the southernmost tip of India. Tour the celebrated Vivekananda Rock Memorial, dedicated to the great philosopher and spiritual leader, and marvel at the impressive Thiruvalluvar Statue, honoring the legendary Tamil poet and philosopher. Finally, stop at Sunset Point for the most spectacular views of the confluence of the three seas: the Arabian Sea, the Bay of Bengal, and the Indian Ocean. Yes, this all-inclusive holiday reveals the region’s quaint hill-town allure, high-altitude landscapes, and revered cultural attractions, all in eight days. Add to this all travel staples, including comfortable accommodations, convenient transfers, and expert guidance. ItineraryDay 1NJP Railway Station / IXB Airport - Darjeeling Your exciting Himalayan retreat begins as you arrive at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport (IXB) and meet our representative, who transfers you to your accommodation in Darjeeling. Enjoy a pleasant three-hour ride filled with the most astonishing views until you reach your hotel. After check-in, relax or spend the rest of the day at your leisure. Day 2Darjeeling Full Day Sightseeing with Tiger HillFollowing a relaxed transfer, the spectacular sunrise views from Tiger Hill ensure a perfect start to your second day. Be in awe as the sun lights up the snow-covered peaks of Kanchenjunga. Proceed to revered monasteries, lush tea gardens, vibrant local markets, and iconic landmarks that exude Himalayan heritage and colonial charm before you end the tour.Day 3Darjeeling - GangtokAfter breakfast and hotel check-out, embark on an enchanting drive toward Gangtok. This four-hour journey through mountainous routes, mist-clad valleys, and verdant tea gardens is nothing short of alluring. Day 4Excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba MandirDedicate the day to taking in the marvelous Himalayan landscape. Start at the high-altitude Tsomgo Lake at over 12,400 feet, located amid towering snowy peaks. Return transfer is provided.Day 5Gangtok - LachungToday, you’ll head to Lachung on a spectacular six-hour drive from Gangtok. meta_description: Plan a romantic Gangtok Darjeeling tour for couples with scenic views, cozy stays, tea gardens and unforgettable Himalayan moments.
content: Romantic Gangtok Darjeeling Tour for Couples | North East EscapeHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysGangtokLove In The Hills Premium Gangtok Darjeeling Couple PackageShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryLove In The Hills Premium Gangtok Darjeeling Couple PackageNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingMealsOverviewExperience unparalleled nature, history, and culture with this all-inclusive Gangtok–Darjeeling package. From picturesque hill-station drives and serene high-altitude lakes to lively bazaars, monasteries, and iconic viewpoints, this holiday offers exciting experiences. With comfortable accommodations, smooth transfers, and essential permits arranged in advance, it showcases the very best of Sikkim and Darjeeling. ItineraryDay 1NJP Railway Station / IXB Airport - Gangtok (128 kilometers / 5 hours) Welcome to Sikkim as you arrive at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra (IXB) Airport. Our representative will transfer you to Gangtok on a captivating five-hour drive. Journey through charming mountain paths and unspoiled greenery until you reach your hotel. Settle into your room and spend the rest of the day at your leisure.   Day 2Excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir Your day starts early, as a guided excursion will take you to the pristine Tsomgo Lake, about 53 kilometers away. The three-hour drive itself is a major draw, journeying you through exquisite mountains, valleys, and more. You’ll also stop at the sacred Baba Mandir, celebrated for its spiritual setting.  Day 3Gangtok Full Day Local Sightseeing Dedicate the day to taking in Gangtok’s marvelous sights. It starts at Tashi View Point, followed by a stop at the revered Ganesh Tok and Hanuman Tok temples, treating you to spectacular hilltop vistas. You’ll also visit the Cottage Industry and Handicraft Centre and the Institute of Tibetology to learn about Tibetan culture and heritage. Apart from these, prepare for the most scenic experiences at the majestic Gonjang Monastery, Dro-dul Chorten, and the scintillating Banjakhri Falls.   Important note: The Cottage Industry and Handicraft Centre is closed on Sundays and the 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month, and the Institute of Tibetology is closed on Sundays.  Day 4Gangtok – Darjeeling After hotel check-out, enjoy a pleasant four-hour drive to Darjeeling. Marvel at striking landscapes, windy mountain paths, and striking valleys en route, allowing you to appreciate the region’s untouched allure. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the remainder of the day at your own pace.  Day 5Darjeeling Full Day Sightseeing Today, get ready for a pre-dawn adventure as you head to Tiger Hill to witness the spectacular sunrise over the snow-capped peaks of the imposing Kanchenjunga. Explore the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, dedicated to mountaineering legends, followed by a stop at the P.N. Zoological Park (closed on Thursdays), sheltering unique and rare high-altitude wildlife. You’ll next proceed to Tenzing Rock, where an exhilarating ride on the Ropeway awaits, and the Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre (closed on Sundays) to see local crafts. Finally, drive past the marvelous Tea Gardens and stop at the serene Japanese Temple. Return transfer to your hotel is included. Day 6Darjeeling - NJP Railway Station / IXB Airport After breakfast and hotel check-out, our representative will transfer you to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra (IXB) Airport, on a comfortable three-hour drive, ensuring a stress-free end to your holiday.Hotel OptionsDenzong Regency (Heritage Dlx) / Norbughang Retreat Pangthang / SimilarRamada (Prem Kanchenjunga with Balcony) / Planter’s Heritage (First Flush) / Similar Previous Next123InclusionAccommodation in well-appointed hotelsDaily breakfast and Dinner at the hotelExclusive non-AC vehicle for transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary on a point-to-point basis only.All permit fees & hotel taxes (as per itinerary).All sightseeing and excursions as per the itinerary by private vehicleToll taxes, parking fees, and driver’s allowances included.ExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending city Safari Tickets are not included in package cost Monument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing places Meals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners) Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etc. Any additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itinerary Guide services (unless specified as included) Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuation Tipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staff Any cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellations GST or any other government taxes (if applicable)Important InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. Stay comfortably in Port Blair, Havelock, and Neil and tour the region’s top attractions, including Cellular Jail, Radhanagar Beach, and Elephant Beach, to name a few. Convenient transfers, daily breakfasts, and guided sightseeing ensure a unforgettable experience. ItineraryDay 1Arrival Port BlairExperience a professional meet-and-greet as you arrive at Port Blair. After a relaxed transfer, check in to your room and get ready to explore one of Andaman’s most historically significant attractions, Cellular Jail. It walks through the hardships, injustices, and sacrifices endured by inmates during India’s freedom struggle. The iconic Light & Sound Show throws light on these stories in the most compelling way. Night stay in Port Blair Day 2Excursion to Baratang Island – Limestone Caves & Mangrove Boat RideEmbark on a full-day tour to the magnificent Baratang Island, journeying you through lush forests and astonishing landscapes. Board a local boat for an enchanting cruise along the untouched mangrove creeks. Prepare for a scenic stroll as you approach the famous Limestone Caves, with stunning natural formations formed over centuries. Night stay in Port Blair. Day 3Ferry to HavelockAfter hotel check-out, enjoy a peaceful ferry ride to Havelock Island, which will surely take your breath away with its striking beaches. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, visit the renowned Radhanagar Beach, one of Asia’s best beaches. Spend the remainder of the day absorbing the sun, relaxing on its white sands, and admiring its shoreline. Night stay in Havelock Day 4Visit Elephant BeachBe ready for the most exciting experiences as you make your way to the marvelous Elephant Beach, a haven for adventurous activities and exploring marine life. Night stay in HavelockDay 5 Ferry to Neil IslandEnjoy your breakfast, check out of the hotel, and then board a ferry to the picturesque Neil Island. Stay in Neil Day 6Return to Port Blair Today, you’ll take your ferry back to Port Blair, marveling at the spectacular sea views along the way. After hotel check-in, take some time to relax. Travel from Leh to Kargil via the stunning Lamayuru region, cross the iconic Khardung La Pass to explore Nubra Valley and the beautiful border village of Turtuk, and experience the magical blue waters of Pangong Lake via Chang La Pass. Ideal for youth travelers, couples, and adventure lovers, this Leh Ladakh tour package promises unforgettable Himalayan views and memorable experiences.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Leh – Acclimatization & LeisureArrive at Leh Airport and get transferred to your hotel. title: 4 Nights 5 Days Turkey Holiday Package
meta_description: Discover Turkey’s most celebrated and hidden gems with this all-inclusive package. Set out on an Old City Tour, enjoy the Bosphorus dinner cruise, and see Bursa’s delights in five days. Contact our team for more details or bookings.
content: 4 Nights 5 Days Turkey Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysIstanbulCharismatic TurkeyShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D5 ImagesView GalleryCharismatic TurkeyNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewCheck off some of Turkey’s most captivating attractions on this five-day holiday. Go on an enchanting Bosphorus Dinner Cruise, experience the region’s historical grandeur with an old city tour, and explore the Ottoman Empire’s ancient capital by heading to Bursa. Besides guided tours, it includes accommodation in your preferred Turkish hotel and all airport transfers.ItineraryDay 1Arrival at IstanbulDescend at Sabiha Gökçen Airport with absolute peace of mind knowing that our friendly guide awaits you at the airport’s arrival area. After the meet and greet, prepare for a convenient transfer to your Istanbul accommodation, about 1.5 hours away. Check in to the hotel (standard time is 12:00 hrs.) and settle in your room, or spend time exploring the city on your own.Day 2Old City TourOn day three, you will set out for a guided old city tour that allows you to discover the Ottoman and Byzantine empires’ historical heritage and influence. Starting around 08:00–08:30 hrs, this tour with an English-speaking guide will lead you to the legendary Hagia Sophia, a 1400-year-old Byzantine cathedral. You will next pause at the iconic Blue Mosque, also called Sultanahmet Mosque. More sights await you as the tour progresses, such as the Hippodrome Square, the German Fountain and Obelisk, and Topkapi Palace. You also get to explore one of the world’s oldest and largest covered indoor markets, the Grand Bazaar, with more than 1,200 shops. Before the tour ends, by around 16:00–17:00 hrs, you will enjoy lunch at a local restaurant offering vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes.Day 3Bursa City TourYour fourth day in Turkey kicks off with a guided tour of Bursa, one of the country’s most significant destinations being once the capital of the Ottoman Turks. A relaxed three-hour drive will take you to Bursa, where an experienced guide will head you to some of the city’s top attractions like the stunning Green Mosque, the 15th century Green Tomb, and the magnificent Uludag Mountain, which is the center of winter and outdoor sports. Enjoy a cable car ride to absorb the city’s unparalleled beauty and stop for a delightful lunch at a local restaurant. The tour ends with a return transfer to your Istanbul accommodation.Day 4Bosphorus Dinner CruiseToday, you have the whole day at your leisure. Just ensure you are ready when your guide arrives at your doorstep by 19:00-19:30 hrs to transfer you to the port for the Bosphorus Dinner Cruise along the Marmara Sea. As the cruise sets sail, see some of the region’s most iconic and historical gems unfold before you, from the antiquated Dolmabahce Palace, Ciragan Palace, and Rumeli Fortress to the Bosphorus Bridge, bridging the city’s Asian and European parts. But the cruise is not all about the views as you can savor a delicious dinner and watch a spectrum of entertainment shows, such as belly dance, Caucasian dance, Turkish gypsy dance, and the 700-year-old dervish performance. Following a night of superb views, fantastic food, and inspiring shows, you can have a stress-free transfer back to your Istanbul accommodation.Day 5DepartureToday, you will wind up your Turkey holiday. The standard check-out time is 12:00 hrs, and you can expect our representative to pick you up at least four hours before your flight time. meta_description: Explore royal Rajasthan with a Jaipur Jodhpur Jaisalmer Bikaner tour covering forts, palaces, desert landscapes and cultural highlights.
content: Jaipur Jodhpur Jaisalmer Bikaner Tour | Book Royal Rajasthan TripHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysJaisalmerExperience Jaisalmer Desert Camps And Fort Visits Of RajasthanShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryExperience Jaisalmer Desert Camps and Fort Visits of RajasthanNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewDiscover Rajasthan’s unequalled royal landscapes on this all-inclusive seven-day holiday! It includes accommodations in Jaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, and Bikaner, along with sightseeing tours, convenient transfers, desert camp sessions, and daily breakfast. With every detail crafted down to immaculate detail, all you need to do is make the most of your regal getaway. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Jaipur – Local Sightseeing Upon landing in Jaipur, our representative will drop you off at your accommodation. Check in to your room and then prepare to explore the city’s iconic sights, from the magnificent City Palace and Jantar Mantar, an astronomical wonder, to the impressive Hawa Mahal. In the evening, relax in your room or, optionally, tour the traditional village of Chokhi Dhani to be part of cultural activities and relish authentic cuisine.Day 2Jaipur - JodhpurAfter breakfast and hotel check-out, a scenic, six-hour drive will transfer you to Jodhpur. Check in to your hotel and rest, overnight Stay JodhpurDay 3Jodhpur - Local SightseeingBegin your day with a delightful breakfast followed by sightseeing in Jodhpur, covering iconic attractions like Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, and the colorful Clock Tower Market for authentic shopping experiencesDay 4Drive to Jaisalmer What awaits you today is Jaisalmer’s golden beauty, as you depart from Jodhpur and enjoy a thrilling five-hour drive. An optional stop at the iconic Pokhran Fort along the way adds to your journey. After checking into your hotel, you’ll tour the stunning Gadisar Lake and the region’s local markets. Day 5Jaisalmer Sightseeing & Evening Desert Camp Today, Jaisalmer’s wealth of cultural and historical attractions unveils on a sightseeing tour. Visit the region’s historic attractions, such as Jaisalmer Fort, Patwon ki Haveli, and Nathmal ki Haveli. Later, keep your evening free to experience the desert magic with a memorable desert camp session, complete with a camel safari, traditional folk dance performances, and a delicious Rajasthani dinner under the stars.Day 6Drive to Bikaner After breakfast and hotel check out, you’ll travel to Bikaner, approximately 6 hours away. Upon arrival, explore the marvelous Junagarh Fort, known for its intricate architecture and rich history. You’ll also visit the renowned Karni Mata Temple in Deshnok, home to thousands of revered rats. Day 7Bikaner - JaipurToday, you’ll leave Bikaner and travel back to Jaipur. Once you arrive at your hotel, check in to your room and spend the evening at leisure by shopping for charming traditional Rajasthani handicrafts and jewelry at the bustling Bapu Bazaar or Johari Bazaar. Day 8DepartureYour Rajasthan holiday concludes as you check out of the hotel and get transferred to the airport or railway station. Hotel OptionsHOTEL EKANA OR SIMILARHOTEL LORDS INN OR SIMILARHOTEL ANTRA INN OR SIMILAR Previous Next1234InclusionAccommodation in well-appointed hotelsDaily breakfast at the hotelAll airport, railway station, and intercity transfers by private air-conditioned vehicleAll sightseeing and excursions as per the itinerary by private vehicleToll taxes, parking fees, and driver’s allowances includedExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending citySafari Tickets are not included in package costMonument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing placesMeals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners)Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etcAny additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itineraryGuide services (unless specified as included)Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuationTipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staffAny cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellationsGST or any other government taxes (if applicable)Important InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. title: Ladakh Valley and Monasteries Tour Package | Culture & Scenery
meta_description: Book a Ladakh valley and monasteries tour package with sightseeing, comfortable stays and smooth travel across the Himalayas.
content: Ladakh Valley and Monasteries Tour Package | Culture & SceneryHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysLehLeh Ladakh Monastery And Valley TourShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryLeh Ladakh Monastery And Valley TourNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingMealsOverviewExperience the beauty of Ladakh on this 6-day journey, perfect for adventure seekers, young travelers, and couples. Acclimatize in Leh, explore its monasteries, cross the legendary Khardung La Pass to Nubra Valley, visit the stunning Pangong Lake, and return via Chang La Pass. A perfect blend of culture, adventure, and breathtaking landscapes. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Leh – Acclimatization & Leisure  Arrive at Leh Airport and enjoy a seamless transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is reserved for rest, helping you adjust comfortably to the region’s high-altitude climate. Spend the day resting at the hotel and enjoying the peaceful surroundings. In the evening, you may take a short walk nearby to experience the calm vibes of Leh town and enjoy the cool mountain air. Dinner and overnight stay will be at the hotel in Leh. Day 2Leh Monastery Exploration After breakfast, head out to explore the cultural and spiritual side of Ladakh with a monastery excursion around Leh. Visit some of the region’s most important monasteries, known for their beautiful hilltop locations, ancient architecture, and serene prayer halls. These places offer stunning views of the surrounding valleys and give you a glimpse into Ladakh’s rich Buddhist heritage. After completing the sightseeing, they return to Leh by evening for dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel. Day 3Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La After breakfast, begin your journey to the enchanting Nubra Valley, crossing the famous Khardung La Pass at 18,390 feet. The drive is an unforgettable experience, filled with dramatic mountain views and winding roads through high-altitude landscapes. As you descend into Nubra Valley, you will notice a striking change in scenery, with wide open spaces and lush riverbeds. On arrival, check in at your hotel or camp, enjoy dinner, and relax overnight in Nubra Valley. Day 4Nubra Valley to Pangong Lake After an early breakfast, continue your adventure with a scenic drive from Nubra Valley to the stunning Pangong Lake. The route takes you through remote mountain terrain and offers breathtaking views throughout the journey. By afternoon, arrive at Pangong Lake, at an altitude of around 14,000 feet, famous for its crystal-clear waters that change colors with the sunlight. Spend peaceful moments by the lake, soaking in the beauty of the surroundings. Dinner and an overnight stay will be near Pangong Lake. Day 5Pangong Lake to Leh via Chang La Wake up early to witness the serene morning views of Pangong Lake before breakfast. Later, begin your return journey to Leh via Chang La Pass, one of the highest motorable passes in the region. The drive offers spectacular views of snow-covered peaks and rugged landscapes. Reach Leh by evening, check in at your hotel, and enjoy your final dinner in Ladakh, followed by an overnight stay. Day 6Departure from Leh After breakfast, check out of the hotel and transfer to Leh Airport for your onward flight. Depart with unforgettable memories of high mountain passes, peaceful monasteries, dramatic valleys, and the magical beauty of Pangong Lake, making this Ladakh journey a truly memorable Himalayan experience. Hotel OptionsThe Himalaya or SimilarNubra Delight Camp or SimilarPangong Delight Camp or Similar Previous Next1234InclusionAssistance upon arrival at Leh HotelTraditional welcome in the Hotel with Welcome Drink (Hot Tea / Coffee / Kahwa) on arrival03 Nights Accommodation twin/double/triple sharing basis as per the ItineraryMeal Plan - 03 Breakfast & 03 DinnerReturn airport and round-trip transfers along with all sightseeing tours by Non-Ac Innova | Tempo Traveller as per the itineraryWild Life fees & Red Cross feeAll toll taxes/Parking fee/Driver allowanceLadakh Entry FeeEcological development feeExclusionAny Airfare or Service tax (5%)Any Kind of Personal Expenses or Optional Tours / Extra Meals OrderedAnything not specifically mentioned under the head “Prices included”The Services of Vehicle is not included on leisure days & after finishing the sightseeing tour as per the ItineraryGuide fee, Camera fee & any monument EntrancesMedical & Travel insuranceAny changes you may choose to make during your tourAdditional costs due to flight cancellation, road blocks etcImportant InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. This six-day getaway offers an incredible palette of choices, combining indulgence and privacy. From the wild charm of Munnar’s tea- and spice-covered hills to wildlife of Thekkady and the serene pleasure of staying aboard a traditional houseboat, every moment of this holiday is worth cherishing.ItineraryDay 1Arrive in KochiWelcome to Kochi, where you’ll begin your exciting Kerala adventure. Once you’ve freshened up, set out to explore the city’s most enchanting sights. Visit the historic Fort Kochi, admire the traditional Chinese Fishing Nets, and wander the narrow lanes of Jew Town. Discover the cultural charm of Mattancherry Palace and walk along the waterfront Marine Drive. Overnight stay in KochiDay 2Drive to MunnarAfter breakfast, savor your first taste of Kerala’s awe-inspiring greenery with a stop at the magnificent Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls on your way to Munnar. Journey through endless tea plantations before arriving in Munnar, where you’ll check in to your room for a peaceful overnight stay in Munnar Day 3City Tour to MunnarAfter breakfast, set out to explore Munnar’s most cherished attractions. Drive through windy mountain roads, which unfold verdant tea gardens, soaring hills, and scintillating waterfalls. Visit Eravikulam National Park, boasting the endangered Nilgiri Thar, and admire the scenic beauty of Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point. You’ll also tour the Tea Museum and further wander the heavenly Rose Garden. End your day with a bit of local shopping before returning to your hotel for a restful night in Munnar.Day 4Drive to ThekkadyToday, you’ll journey to Thekkady! Experience the region’s rich wildlife and biodiversity up close with a serene boat cruise on Periyar Lake, marveling at the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary’s flora and fauna. Later, enjoy an engaging cultural show and set out on a spice plantation tour, providing a glance into Kerala’s fame as the spice land. Overnight stay in ThekkadyDay 5Drive to AlleppeyAfter breakfast, check out of your hotel in Thekkady and head to Alleppey, where the most exciting part of your holiday awaits. Set sail on Alleppey’s splendid backwaters aboard a traditional houseboat, which drifts you past lush paddy fields, quaint villages, and swaying coconut palms. Absorb the marvelous views and admire the sunset over the waters. Relish freshly prepared local delicacies onboard before preparing for an unforgettable. title: 5 Nights and 6 Days Relaxing Georgia Package
meta_description: Your much-awaited relaxing retreat doesn’t get better than our five-night Georgia package. With accommodations, transfers, and guided tours all included, all you have to do is book, sit back, and soak in the experience.
content: 5 Nights and 6 Days Relaxing Georgia PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysTbilisiRelaxing GeorgiaShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryRelaxing GeorgiaNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewTake off to Georgia during the upcoming EID holiday! With accommodations, airport transfers, sightseeing tours and exciting activities, this itinerary for three nights allows you to make the most of your long weekend. Both directions of your Georgia travel cover flight tickets.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in TbilisiArrival at Tbilisi! As you step out of Shota Rustaveli Tbilisi International Airport, you will be greeted by our representative who will escort you to the vehicle and then drive you to your accommodation or hotel in Tbilisi. Day 2Transfer to Lopota - Kakheti tourAfter breakfast at the hotel, you will be transferred to Lopota. En route, visit the KTW Wine Cellar to experience Georgia’s rich winemaking traditions, followed by a stop at Sighnaghi, the charming Georgian town known as the “City of Love,” located in the eastern Kakheti region and once an important stop along the ancient Silk Road. Enjoy free time to explore this beautiful and romantic city before continuing to Bodbe Monastery, the 9th-century burial place of St. Nino, who converted Georgia to Christianity in the 4th century. Later, proceed to Lopota, check in at the hotel, and enjoy an overnight stay in Lopota.Day 3Day at leisureDay three of your holiday gives you ample leisure time and freedom. Enjoy the flexibility to craft your itinerary and make the most of this day at your own pace. Whether you want to explore the resort's amenities, indulge in various exciting activities, enjoy spa treatments, or unwind in the breathtaking surroundings, the choice is entirely yours.Day 4Tbilisi city tourAfter breakfast, transfer to Tbilisi. Proceed for the Tbilisi city tour. You will set out to discover the region’s blend of iconic structures, legendary monuments, and hidden gems. Enjoy an up-close and detailed look at the splendid Holy Trisnity Cathedral, stop at the iconic Metekhi church, and capture some cool snaps against the monument of Vakhtang Gorgasali – the founder of Tbilisi. As the tour continues, you will head to the Old Town whose highlights range from Narikala Fortress – a Persian Citadel to the antiquated Sulphur Bathhouse District and other monumental gems such as monumental treasures such as Sioni Cathedral. You also get to see the Peace Bridge and visit the marionette theatre of Rezo Gabriadze Theatre as part of your tour. Drop off to your hotel.Day 5Ananuri, Gudauri & Kazbegi tourToday, you will enjoy a refreshing drive away from Tbilisi on a Gudauri Kazbegi Tour. Packed with the most exciting experiences, this tour will head you to the picturesque town of Stepantsminda or Kazbegi where the 14th century Gergeti Trinity Church and the gorgeous views of Chkheri River, Mount Kazbek and Darial Gorge make for a marvelous stop. The tour will further take you to Ananuri Fortress Complex and Jinvali Water Reservoir. This is followed by a stop at Pasanauri – a place of unequaled natural beauty where you get to see the confluence of white and black Aragvi Rivers. Your itinerary also covers a trip to the ski resort of Gudauri. Placed at an altitude of 2,190 meters, it is one of the ultimate places to enjoy activities like skiing (December to April), horse ride, and paragliding to name a few. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysTokyoJapan Discovery Tour PackageShareAdd to Wishlist9N / 10D3 ImagesView GalleryJapan Discovery Tour PackageNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewJapan is an archipelago, or string of islands, on the eastern edge of Asia. There are four main islands: Hokkaido, Honshu, Shikoku, and Kyushu. Although it is only a small country located in the middle of the East Sea, Japan has become one of the most attractive destinations in the world. This place is a blend of tradition and culture with modernity and development, from ancient sacred temples, skyscrapers, clear beaches to majestic natural landscapes.ItineraryDay 1TOKYOWelcome to Japan! After completing customs procedures, you’ll be transferred to your hotel by shared shuttle bus. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at leisure. In the afternoon, you’ll receive details about the start of your tour. Day 2TOKYOIn the morning, we’ll take a long guided tour—about five hours—through this simply stunning city! Its vibrant energy and cutting-edge neighborhoods coexist with areas full of peace and tranquility.We’ll make a short stop at Zojoji Temple to capture the most beautiful view of the Tokyo Tower. You’ll notice hundreds upon hundreds of Jizo statues, stone-carved deities considered guardians of children, adorned with knitted hats, bibs, and pinwheels.Next, we’ll head to the famous Shibuya Crossing, said to be the busiest intersection in the world. Then we’ll visit Meiji Shrine, dedicated to the spirits of Emperor Meiji and his wife.We’ll continue our tour by bus along the elegant Omotesando Avenue, explore the most scenic part of the Imperial Palace and its gardens, and stop to visit the famous Nijubashi Bridge.We’ll drive through AKIHABARA, the “Electric City,” known as the center of Japanese manga and anime culture. Then we’ll head to Tokyo Skytree (admission included), Japan’s tallest structure, where we’ll enjoy an unmatched panoramic view of the city.We’ll end our visit in ASAKUSA, where we’ll explore Sensoji Temple and the famous Nakamise Street. Afterwards, we’ll return to the hotel.6:30 p.m. – We’ll meet our guide in the hotel lobby and take the subway (tickets included) to the Shinjuku area. From there, we’ll enjoy a walk through this lively district before heading to a local restaurant for dinner (included). We’ll return to the hotel by subway, accompanied by our guide.Note: The order of the visits may vary depending on the admission time for Tokyo Skytree. In case of bad weather or other exceptional circumstances, access to Tokyo Skytree may be limited. In that case, an alternative visit to another iconic city viewpoint will be offered.Day 3TOKYO - MOUNT FUJI - KAWAGUCHIKOWe travel toward the beautiful Mount Fuji area, enjoying the scenic landscapes along our route. Our first stop is Arakurayama Sengen Park, famous for its beautiful pagodas and for offering some of the most iconic and breathtaking views of Mount Fuji.We then continue to KAWAGUCHIKO, an idyllic town of charming houses, flowers, and mountains beside a stunning lake. Upon arrival, we’ll visit the Fuji Sengen Shrine, a magical place surrounded by tall trees — traditionally the starting point of the pilgrimage up Mount Fuji. We’ll take a moment to give thanks at the shrine for the opportunity to visit such a spiritually rich and enchanting site.Afterward, we’ll enjoy a pleasant boat ride on Lake Kawaguchiko, then begin our ascent toward Mount Fuji via the road that leads to the “Fifth Station.” Driving through spectacular forests and landscapes, we’ll reach an altitude of 2,305 meters (7,562 feet).Note: In winter, the route to the Fifth Station is often closed due to snow or weather conditions; during those times, we’ll go as far as we’re permitted.We’ll return to Kawaguchiko and stay overnight at a Ryokan (traditional Japanese inn), where you can relax and enjoy the Onsen (public hot spring bath). Dinner included.Note: In the planned Ryokan, some rooms are Japanese-style with tatami mats, while others are Western-style. Occasionally, accommodation may be provided in a Western-style hotel instead.Day 4KAWAGUCHIKO - IYASHI NO SATO NENBA - TOYOTA - KYOTOIn the morning, we’ll follow a scenic road that winds around picturesque lakes to visit Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a small village that was destroyed by a typhoon in 1966 and later restored as an open-air museum. Its traditional houses have been converted into arts and crafts shops, restaurants, and cultural exhibits, offering a glimpse into Japan’s past.Next, we’ll visit the breathtaking Shiraito Falls, one of Japan’s most stunning natural attractions, with cascading water that spans a height of 20 meters.From there, we’ll continue to Nagoya, where we’ll visit the Toyota Museum (admission included), a must-see destination for car enthusiasts and those curious about automotive innovation.Finally, we’ll proceed to Kyoto for our overnight stay. Day 5 KYOTOWe’ll spend the entire day exploring Kyoto, Japan’s capital from 794 to 1868 and home to the Imperial Court. Remarkably, Kyoto was the only major Japanese city spared from bombing during World War II, allowing it to retain its rich artistic heritage. Notably, the Kyoto Protocol, aimed at limiting greenhouse gas emissions, was signed here in 1997.We’ll include a visit to Kyoto’s most iconic landmarks. Our tour will begin in Arashiyama, where we’ll admire the Togetsukyo Bridge, or “Bridge over the Moon.” This spot offers a breathtaking panorama of the surrounding landscape.We’ll then visit the Tenryuji Temple, one of Kyoto’s “five great Zen temples” and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, followed by a serene walk through its mystical bamboo forest.Next, we’ll explore the magnificent Fushimi Inari Shrine; the Imperial Palace; and the Kinkakuji Temple, also known as the “Golden Pavilion,” surrounded by its spectacular gardens. (The order of the visits may vary.)After the tour, you can enjoy some time to stroll through Gion, Kyoto’s vibrant traditional district, known for its lively atmosphere and geishas. Day 6KYOTO - EIHEI-JI - KATSUYAMA-DINOSAUR MUSEUM - KATSUYAMA - KANAZAWA We’ll start our day with breakfast before departing along one of the largest lakes in Japan. Our first stop will be at Shirahige Ginra, a small shrine located by the lake. We’ll then head to Eihei-ji, a temple-monastery founded in 1244 and a central hub of Zen Buddhism in Japan (admission included). Its surroundings, architecture, gardens, and spiritual ambiance make it a key training center for monks who practice Zazen meditation and follow a strict daily diet. Next, in Katsuyama, we’ll visit three key sites. First, the Dinosaur Museum, located at the largest dinosaur fossil site in Japan, where you’ll have free time for lunch and to explore its educational exhibits featuring over 40 dinosaur skeletons. Then, we’ll visit the Great Buddha of Echizen and its grand temple, along with a five-story pagoda, which we can climb to enjoy panoramic views. We’ll arrive in Kanazawa by evening.Day 7 KANAZAWAWe’ll spend a full day in Kanazawa, beginning with a guided city tour in the morning. This city, which once rivaled Kyoto and Tokyo, was spared from destruction during World War II air raids. We’ll visit the castle area, with its impressive walls, and take a stroll through the historic Nagamachi neighborhood, where samurai and their families once lived. This area preserves its historical atmosphere with remaining residences, earthen walls, private entrance gates, narrow alleys, and water canals. We’ll also include admission to Kenrokuen, one of the three most beautiful gardens in Japan. The tour will end at Omicho, a lively traditional market with many options for lunch. The afternoon will be free for you to explore.Day 8KANAZAWA - AINOKURA - SHIRAKAWA - HIDA VILLAGE - TAKAYAMAToday, we’ll journey through beautiful mountain landscapes, forests, and traditional villages as we explore the Gokayama and Shirakawago regions. These villages have been designated as UNESCO World Heritage Sites, and their traditional houses, with steeply sloped roofs, are known as “praying hands” for their resemblance to monks´ hands joined in prayer—designed to withstand heavy winter snowfalls. We’ll stop in Ainokura, a charming small village, and in Shirakawa-go Ogimachi, a larger, more popular village. There will be time to stroll and enjoy lunch. Afterward, we’ll continue to Takayama, where we’ll visit the Hida Folk Village Museum, nestled in a peaceful setting. This open-air museum features over 30 traditional houses from the Edo Period (1603-1868), relocated from their original sites to form this museum in 1971. The buildings showcase tools and utensils used in everyday life in the past. We’ll then have free time to explore the old town, with its wooden houses and traditional shops.Day 9TAKAYAMA - HIDA FURUKAWA - MATSUMOTO - TOKYOAfter breakfast, we’ll depart for Hida Furukawa, where we’ll stroll through its charming old town. The city’s festival has been declared an Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO, known for its large drums and beautifully decorated floats. We’ll include admission to the museum, which showcases the festival’s floats, costumes, and drums. We’ll then continue our journey across the Japanese Alps, renowned for their snow-covered landscapes for much of the year. Upon arrival in Matsumoto, we’ll visit the city’s impressive castle, known as the "Crow Castle" due to its black color, dating back to the 16th century. Afterward, you’ll have free time to enjoy lunch and explore the town. In the afternoon, we’ll depart for Tokyo, arriving by the end of the day.Day 10 TOKYOAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel Options4* title: 4 Nights and 5 Days Exciting Armenia Package
meta_description: Are you ready for a once-in-a-lifetime escape to the land of beautiful scenery, exciting culture, and friendly people? Simply book our four-night Armenia getaway with accommodations, transfers, and sightseeing tours.
content: 4 Nights and 5 Days Exciting Armenia PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysYerevanExciting ArmeniaShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D7 ImagesView GalleryExciting ArmeniaNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewBreathtaking landscapes, charming culture and inspiring experience define this 4 nights and 5 days Armenia package. Visit Yerevan’s unmissable attractions, be in awe at the mesmeric beauty of Tsaghkadzor and Lake Sevan, and enjoy the chance to see the antiquated Kecharis Monastery on this fully guided and well-planned holiday. ItineraryDay 1Welcome to ArmeniaAs you descend over Zvartnots International Airport, our local representative and vehicle will be waiting outside. After meet and greet, enjoy a comfortable ride to your hotel or preferred location in Yerevan. Check in to the hotel and relax in your room or design your own program to spend the rest of the day.Day 2Full Day Tour of Tsaghkadzor - Lake Sevan - Dilijan Parz lake (Timings: 10am - 6pm)You will be driven to the North-Western part of Armenia. The first stop is Tsaghkadzor city (Valley of flowers) considered to be one of the most popular winter resorts of Armenia. It is one of the places of the mountainous country, where the beauty of the nature appears with its whole variety. Opportunity to go up to the mountain peaks by rope way, where you will catch an unforgettable gorgeous panoramic view of this part of the world . The next stop is Lake Sevan that is only 30 minutes’ drive distance from Tsaghkadzor. It is known as a blue gem of the Armenian mountainscape. Lake Sevan is considered  to be one of the largest sweet water lakes in the world, situated at an altitide of 1,897 meters above sea level. Climb on peninsula from where the fascinating view on the Lake is open. Visit Sevanavank monastery, built by the princess Mariam to honor the life of her deceased husband in the 9th century.. Afterwards, go to visit Dilijan. Dilijan is one of the most important resorts of Armenia, famous for its amazing surroundings, situated in Dilijan National Park. This small city, lost in forests and mountains with alpine meadows around, is home to numerous Armenian artists, composers, and filmmakers. Visit to Haghartsin Monastery (X- XIV centuries). Nestled in forested mountains the Monastery creates a magical impression of the lost world.Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 3Half Day Yerevan City Tour with Vernissage Visit (Timings: 10am-3pm)During the tour, you will explore several iconic landmarks of Armenia. Your journey begins at Mother Armenia, a towering statue in Victory Park that symbolizes peace through strength. Next, you will visit the Genocide Complex, Armenia’s official memorial to the victims of the Armenian Genocide, located on the hill of Tsitsernakaberd and built in 1967. The tour continues to the Cascade, a massive stairway connecting the downtown Kentron area of Yerevan with the Monument neighborhood. With over 570 steps, the Cascade not only stands as one of the city’s most striking architectural features but also offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Opera House, Swan Lake, and even Mount Ararat on a clear day, along with a rich display of modern art installations. Following this, you will head to Republic Square, renowned for its captivating dancing water fountains near the National Gallery. Finally, for those interested in shopping and local crafts, a stop at Vernissage — a vibrant open-air market — is the perfect way to end the day.Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 4Day at leisureWith the whole day at your leisure, make the most of this time to discover the city’s gastronomic scene or hidden gems. You can also consider taking a day trip from Yerevan. title: Dubai Fixed Group Departure Package | Dubai Group Travel
meta_description: Join our Dubai Fixed Group Departure holiday package featuring guided tours, transfers, and hotel stays - perfect for affordable group holidays in Dubai.
content: Dubai Fixed Group Departure Package | Dubai Group Travel HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Fixed Group DepartureShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D2 ImagesView GalleryDubai Fixed Group DepartureNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewSpend about a week enjoying the best of Dubai’s sights with the all-inclusive Dubai fixed date tour package. It's one of the most affordable Dubai travel packages for non-peak season visits. Suited for families, budget-tourists, solo travelers, and couples, this all-in-one Dubai group travel package covers everything you need - comfy stays in Dubai, daily meals, private airport transfers, and guided tours. It’s packed with must-do highlights, including visiting the iconic Burj Khalifa and Dubai Frame, a dinner dhow cruise at Dubai Marina, a desert safari with BBQ dinner, and discovering the splendors of Abu Dhabi on a full-day excursion. This Dubai and Abu Dhabi group travel package offers a balanced mix of city bustle, nature adventures, and cultural gems.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai, Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise with DinnerArrive in Dubai, where our friendly driver will take you to your hotel in a private transfer. Check in and rest after the long flight. As evening falls, take a gentle cruise on the dazzling Dubai Marina on a dhow cruise. Tuck into a lavish international buffet dinner (vegetarian and non-vegetarian options available). The lively shows, including mesmerizing Tanura dances with the epic skyline views as a backdrop, are a tranquil, memorable way to start your Dubai escape.Day 2Half-Day Dubai City Tour and Burj KhalifaBegin your day with a flavorsome breakfast at the hotel. Today, find yourself admiring some of Dubai’s most magnificent landmarks on a half-day Dubai city tour. You will drive past popular sights in old and new Dubai, such as Al Fahidi Neighborhood, Dubai Creek, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai Marina. After lunch, head to Burj Khalifa, where you take a high-speed elevator ride to the 124th and 125th levels of Burj Khalifa. Spend the evening cherishing the resplendent sunset and twinkling city view from amid the clouds. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 3Lost Chambers Aquarium & Dolphin Show OR Dubai Miracle Garden and Global Village.After a delicious breakfast at the hotel, head to Palm Jumeirah for thrilling encounters with marine life at Lost Chambers Aquarium and watch playful dolphins at the Dolphin Show at Dolphin Bay. Alternatively, instead of aquatic wonders, you can opt to visit a floral oasis at Dubai Miracle Garden and enjoy a whirlwind tour around the world at Global Village during May departures. After an exciting day, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay. Day 4Dubai Frame Views, Desert Safari with BBQ DinnerOn the fourth day of your Dubai group holiday package, enjoy breakfast at the hotel before heading to visit the stunning Dubai Frame – the biggest frame in the world. Watch this colossal rectangular landmark frame the beauty of Dubai, offering ideal photo opportunities. Once you finish journeying through the past of Dubai, taking the sweeping vistas of Old and New Dubai from the observatory bridge, head back down, while getting a glimpse of Dubai’s futuristic dreams. In the afternoon, it is time to leave the city behind with and explore the beauty and thrills of the Dubai desert with a guide. Buckle up for adrenaline-pumping dune bashing, enjoy camel rides, and unwind with cultural entertainment like belly dancing and tanoura show after sunset. Help yourself to a wholesome BBQ buffet dinner with a lip-smacking spread of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. Drive back to the city and stay overnight at the hotel.Day 5Full Day Abu Dhabi ExperienceAfter breakfast at the hotel, share a ride to the UAE’s capital with a full-day city tour of Abu Dhabi. Witness the shift from Dubai’s bustle to Abu Dhabi’s slow-paced life as you drive past the Corniche, Emirates Palace, and Yas Island. Soak in the cultural beauty with photo stops at the magnificent Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and BAPS Hindu Temple. Overnight at the hotel in Dubai.Day 6Departure from DubaiYou have ample time today after breakfast at your hotel to catch up on last-minute shopping, stroll along the beach, or simply soak in one last view of the city till your private car arrives to drop you off at the airport. title: Dubai Jain Comfort Getaway | Jain Tour Package with Jain Meals
meta_description: Experience a Jain-friendly Dubai holiday with pure Jain meals, sightseeing, hotel stays, and smooth transfers in this well-planned holiday package.
content: Dubai Jain Comfort Getaway | Jain Tour Package with Jain MealsHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Jain Comfort GetawayShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5DView GalleryDubai Jain Comfort GetawayNewHotelsEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewOur Dubai Jain tour package for 5 days/4 nights is designed exclusively for Indian Jain travelers, offering a perfect balance of modern, cultural, and spiritual activities. Enjoy a half-day city tour and visit top attractions such as the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Fountains. Special care is taken for discerning guests' dietary preferences, with the dhow cruise and Desert safari trips featuring a specially prepared Jain meal. This Dubai Jain tour package also lets you explore the city and the magnificent BAPS Hindu Mandir. Ideal for Jain families or couples seeking spiritual vibes and leisure, this 5-day Dubai getaway includes hassle-free transfers, handpicked tours, comfort-focused stays, and sumptuous dinners that respect the Jain lifestyle.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai, Dubai Creek Dhow Cruise with Jain Dinner Upon your arrival in Dubai, you will be transferred to your hotel in a private car. Check into the hotel and relax. In the evening, sail down the Dubai Creek on a Dhow Cruise experience, gliding past the illuminated waterfront, enjoying the peaceful, old-world charms while savoring a flavorful Jain dinner onboard. Soak in the unrushed ambiance with live entertainment until it’s time to head back to the hotel for an overnight stay. Day 2Half-Day Dubai City Tour, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain and Dubai Mall ExperienceEnjoy your breakfast at the hotel before setting out on a half-day tour of Dubai City, visiting iconic sights like Jumeirah Mosque and enjoying photo stops at Burj Al Arab and Dubai Frame. Watch Dubai city shimmer and illuminate on a non-prime hour tour of Burj Khalifa from the 124th level. Spend the rest of the evening exploring the Dubai Mall and enjoying the Dubai Fountain show. Head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.Day 3Dubai Desert Safari Experience with Jain BBQ DinnerOn to day 3, where you have some leisure time after breakfast to get set for a Desert safari experience. Our Dubai tour with Jain meals includes a delicious Jain BBQ dinner after an adventure-filled day of dune bashing and camel rides. The marvelous sunset in the desert, followed by live Arabian entertainment of belly dancing and Tanoura shows, puts you in a light-hearted mood before tucking into a gorgeous spread of Jain dinner in a desert camp. Soak in the tranquil ambiance and reminisce about the adventures before you wrap up your time in the desert and head back to the hotel in the city for an overnight stay.Day 4Full-Day Abu Dhabi City Tour + BAPS Hindu Mandir Photo StopToday, after breakfast, explore Abu Dhabi’s cultural treasures with a Full-Day Abu Dhabi City Tour.  After viewing the landmarks of Abu Dhabi, such as the Corniche, take a photo stop at the colossal Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Experience Indian spirituality in Abu Dhabi at the BAPS Hindu Mandir and capture some memories in photos. Brimming with spiritual essence and beautiful views of the UAE’s capital city, the 4th day of the Dubai Jain package with BAPS Temple visit concludes with a drive back to Dubai city. Overnight stay at the hotel in Dubai.Day 5Departure from DubaiAfter breakfast, your last day in Dubai will mainly revolve around packing up, checking out of the hotel, and heading to the airport by private transfer for your onward flight. If time permits, take a stroll around the city one last time and shop for souvenirs to relive the beautiful times on your Dubai tour package with Jain meals.Hotel OptionsRoyal Ascot Hotel Dubai or
