title: Dubai Easter Family Adventure Package | Dubai Vacation
meta_description: This Easter dive into an adventurous family trip to Dubai, featuring Ferrari-themed amusement park, Desert Safari and more Dubai tour thrills for all ages.
content: Dubai Easter Family Adventure Package | Dubai VacationHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDubai CityDubai Easter Family AdventureShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D2 ImagesView GalleryDubai Easter Family AdventureNewHotelsEntry TicketsMealsActivitiesTransfersOverviewCelebrate Easter with your family with a Dubai Easter family package, along with a trip to Abu Dhabi. Packed with sightseeing, adventure, and entertainment, this tour is designed for families exploring Dubai and Abu Dhabi. During Easter, you can enjoy the perfect beach weather and visit the amazing attractions in both emirates. Be it the city tours in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, the adventurous activities of the desert safari, or an evening spent exploring the Global Village, it’s one of the best luxury Dubai holiday packages.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Dubai and Dhow Cruise DinnerAs you arrive in Dubai with the Dubai Easter family package with a 6-day itinerary, you will be taken to your hotel in a private vehicle. After some rest, you head over to Dubai Marina for your first experience, the dhow cruise dinner. You get to sail along the Dubai Marina on a dhow while relishing a 3-course buffet dinner and Tanoura dance performance.Day 2Dubai City Tour, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Fountain Show + Lake RideBegin your day with breakfast at the hotel, then take a city tour. You will be taken to some of the most iconic spots of Dubai, including Dubai Creek, Jumeirah Beach, Jumeirah Mosque, and the Gold and Spice Souks. There are also stops at the Hotel Atlantis, the Palm, and the Burj Al Arab. The city tour ends at the Burj Khalifa, where you visit the observation deck “At the Top” and watch a beautiful sunset view of the city. The next stop is Dubai Mall, where you visit the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, home to 30,000 marine animals. One of the highlights of the day is the Dubai Fountain Show, which takes place right outside the Dubai Mall. This tour includes a boat tour on the Burj Lake to watch the Dubai Fountain Show up close.Day 3Desert Safari Adventure with BBQ DinnerDay three begins leisurely with breakfast at the hotel. You can relax in your room, go for a spa session at your hotel, or check out a Dubai attraction. This is also a good time to go souvenir shopping. After an early (and light) lunch, get ready for the highlight of your tour, the Dubai desert safari. It begins with the most thrilling activities: dune bashing, sandboarding, quad biking, and more. Take pictures of the desert sunset, wear traditional Arabic clothes, get henna designs on your palms, and smoke a shisha. Watch performances like fire show, Tanoura dance, and belly dance. Enjoy a 3-course BBQ dinner before heading back to your hotel.Day 4Abu Dhabi City Tour with Ferrari WorldDay four is dedicated to the capital of the UAE, Abu Dhabi. The tour begins at your hotel in Dubai in a shared vehicle. This guided tour introduces you to the top Abu Dhabi attractions like the Grand Mosque, Emirates Palace, Abu Dhabi Corniche, and more. The tour also includes a visit to Ferrari World on Yas Island, a Formula One theme park, with over 40 heart-pounding rides, including Formula Rossa, the fastest rollercoaster on earth. Day 5Dubai Miracle Garden and Global VillageDay five of your trip with the Dubai and Abu Dhabi Easter family package covers two of Dubai’s most popular seasonal attractions. Your day begins with a visit to Dubai Miracle Garden, the world’s largest natural flower garden. Walk around this floral paradise, home to more than 150 million colorful flowers and plants. It is a true delight to check out the iconic floral installation, which includes floral replicas of iconic structures and famous characters. Spend the rest of the evening in Global Village Dubai, the city’s ultimate entertainment destination. Explore the pavilions showcasing handicrafts, products, food, and culture of 90 countries around the world. Watch musical concerts and dance performances, enjoy rides and attractions, and try a variety of foods at Global Village.Day 6DepartureIt is time to pack your bags and say goodbye to Dubai. A private vehicle will help you reach the Dubai International Airport to catch your flight.Hotel OptionsGrand Excelsior Hotel or SimilarCrowne Plaza Dubai - Deira or Similar Previous Next12InclusionAccommodation for 5 nights at the selected hotelDaily breakfast at the hotelTickets to the dhow cruise dinner at Dubai Marina (shared transfers)Half-day Dubai city tour (shared transfers)Entry tickets to Burj Khalifa “At the Top” (prime hour)Entry tickets to Dubai Aquarium & Underwater ZooTickets for the Dubai Fountain Show and boat ride on Burj LakeDubai Mall exploration (one-way transfer from the mall to the hotel)Tickets to Desert Safari with entertainment, camel ride, and BBQ dinner (shared transfers)Full day Abu Dhabi city tour and entry tickets to Ferrari World (shared transfers)Entry tickets to Global Village Dubai (shared transfers)Entry tickets to Dubai Miracle Garden (shared transfers)Airport transfer from the Dubai Hotel in a private vehicleUAE tourist visaUAE travel insuranceExclusionDomestic / International Flight ticketsGST and TCS, if applicableLaundry ChargesInternational or National CallsMeals not mentioned in above ItineraryAdditional Transfers or Sightseeing not mentioned in itineraryTIPS / Porter Charges / Room serviceTourism Dirhams (15-20 AED per room per night approx.)Departure & PricingPackage price: Per person For 2 Pax | Currency: AED  | Travel Date: Till AprilHotel      CategoryAdult- Double   OccupancySingle OccupancyTripleOccupancyChild WithBedChild WithoutBed4*360948893410301519895*57458815483530151989Stay optionsCityStay4*5*Dubai5 NightsGrand Excelsior Hotel Bur DubaiCrowne Plaza Dubai - title: From Island Waves to City Wonders in Just 5 Days
meta_description: Enjoy the perfect Thailand city and beach holiday with Bangkok sightseeing, Pattaya beaches, island tours, nightlife and smooth transfers.
content: From Island Waves to City Wonders in Just 5 DaysHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBangkokFrom Island Waves To City Wonders In Just 5 DaysShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D4 ImagesView GalleryFrom Island Waves to City Wonders in Just 5 DaysNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewEmbark on an unforgettable 5-day journey through the vibrant cities of Bangkok and Pattaya, where the modern marvels of Thailand blend seamlessly with its rich cultural tapestry. From relaxing on the sun-kissed shores of Coral Island to marveling at the architectural splendor of Buddhist temples, and from thrilling encounters with majestic tigers to dazzling performances at the Alcazar Show, this trip offers the perfect mix of leisure, adventure, and cultural immersion.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bangkok & Transfer to PattayaYour journey begins as you arrive at Bangkok’s international airport, where a private vehicle awaits to take you on a scenic drive to the lively coastal city of Pattaya. Check-in to your chosen hotel. The rest of the day is yours to unwind or explore the colorful streets nearby, filled with local markets, beachside cafés, and vibrant nightlife. This first evening is a gentle introduction to Thailand's coastal charm.Day 2Coral Island Excursion with LunchWake up to the sounds of the sea and prepare for a day of tropical delight as you set off on an exciting excursion to Coral Island (Koh Larn). Reach the island by speedboat and be welcomed by pristine white sands and turquoise waters. Spend your day basking in the sun, swimming, or indulging in optional water sports like parasailing or jet-skiing. A delicious local Thai lunch by the beach enhances your island experience. Return to Pattaya by afternoon, with free time to relax or explore on your own.Day 3Tiger Park Encounter & Alcazar Cabaret ShowToday promises a blend of wild adventure and theatrical glamour. Begin your day with a visit to Tiger Park Pattaya, where you'll have the thrilling opportunity to come up close with majestic tigers in a safe and well-managed environment. Pose for stunning photographs or simply admire these powerful creatures. After some rest back at your hotel, the evening lights up with a visit to the legendary Alcazar Cabaret Show. Prepare to be dazzled by vibrant costumes, music, and captivating performances in one of Asia’s most famous ladyboy cabarets. It’s an evening of pure magic and cultural sparkle.Day 4Transfer to Bangkok with City TourBid farewell to Pattaya and journey back to Bangkok, Thailand’s electrifying capital. On the way, immerse yourself in Bangkok’s spiritual and artistic essence through a guided city tour. Visit two of the city’s most revered temples - the iconic Wat Traimit, home to the world’s largest gold Buddha, and the serene Marble Temple, admired for its graceful architecture. A short visit to the Gems Gallery showcases Thailand’s world-renowned jewelry artistry. Check-in to your Bangkok hotel and spend the evening exploring nearby shopping streets or simply enjoying the vibrant city vibe.Day 5Departure from BangkokAfter a wonderful stay, it’s time to say goodbye to the Land of Smiles. Enjoy your breakfast, pack your memories, and take a private transfer to the airport for your onward journey. Whether it was the golden temples, the turquoise seas, the thrilling tiger encounters, or the dazzling performances - Thailand surely leaves you enchanted, with memories to last a lifetime.Hotel OptionsGolden Beach Pattaya or SimilarEcotel Bangkok or Similar Previous Next12345InclusionAll airport and hotel transfers in private vehiclesInter-city travel (Bangkok ↔ Pattaya)2 Night Accomodation in Golden Bech Pattaya or similar property in Bangkok2 Night Accomodation in Ecotel Bangkok or Similar PropertyCoral Island tour with speedboat and lunchEntry to Tiger Park Pattaya (Medium Package)Tickets to Alcazar Cabaret ShowBangkok city tour (2 temples + Gems Gallery)ExclusionFlights and visa chargesOptional water sports at Coral IslandMeals not mentioned in the itineraryTravel insurancePersonal expenses like tips, laundry, shopping, etc.Early check-in or late check-outImportant InformationRayna Tours – Easy Terms & Conditions for Your TripWe want your travel experience to be smooth and enjoyable. meta_description: Explore stunning Thai islands with an island hopping tour featuring beach adventures, nightlife and the legendary Full Moon Party.

This journey blends relaxation, exploration, and thrilling nightlife, with the highlight being the legendary Full Moon Party at Koh Phangan – an electrifying beach celebration under the starlit sky.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Phuket | Transfer to KrabiArrive at Phuket International Airport, where a private transfer will whisk you away on a scenic drive to Krabi. Check into your chosen hotel - whether it’s the cozy Glow Ao Nang or the chic Marina Express Hotel or similar category hotel. Spend the evening at leisure, perhaps strolling along Ao Nang beach and enjoying a relaxed Thai dinner.Day 2Krabi Rainforest DiscoveryStep into nature’s paradise with a guided jungle safari. Experience the soothing Hot Spring Waterfall, take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear Emerald Pool, and challenge yourself with a climb up the iconic Tiger Cave Temple, where panoramic views reward your effort. A delicious Thai lunch is included to keep your energy high throughout the adventure.Day 3Transfer to Koh Samui | Full Moon PartyAfter breakfast, travel by ferry and land transfers to Koh Samui. Check into your resort. In the evening, get ready for an unforgettable experience:The Full Moon Party at Koh Phangan Join thousands of travelers on the beach, dancing under neon lights and the glowing full moon. With world-class DJs, fire shows, and an electrifying atmosphere, this will be the highlight of your trip.Day 4Leisure Day in Koh SamuiAfter a lively night, enjoy a slow-paced day at leisure. Relax on Samui’s pristine beaches, indulge in spa treatments, or explore local cafés and shops. This day is all about unwinding at your own pace.Day 5Transfer to PhuketSay goodbye to Koh Samui as you board your ferry and land transfer to Phuket. Check into your hotel - choose among the modern Journeyhub Phuket or the vibrant Ashlee Plaza Patong or similar category hotel. In the evening, explore Patong’s bustling streets, nightlife, and vibrant street food culture.Day 6Phi Phi Island Tour by SpeedboatToday, set off on a thrilling speedboat adventure to the Phi Phi Islands - famous for their breathtaking lagoons, limestone cliffs, and turquoise waters. Swim, snorkel, and soak up the sun at stunning beaches. A delicious lunch is included, making this a perfect island-hopping escape. (National park fee of 400 THB per person to be paid locally).Day 7Departure from PhuketAfter breakfast, check out from your hotel and enjoy a private transfer to Phuket Airport for your onward journey. content: Abu Dhabi Stay And Play Luxury Package | Abu Dhabi Luxury HolidaysHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysAbu DhabiAbu Dhabi Stay And Play Luxury PackageShareAdd to Wishlist2N / 3DView GalleryAbu Dhabi Stay And Play Luxury PackageNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersOverviewLooking for a short holiday that blends relaxation and thrill? This Abu Dhabi 3-day 2-night package is just the one for you. Along with the chance to stay at one of the most luxurious resorts in Abu Dhabi, enjoy a fun-filled visit to an amusement park of your choice on Yas Island. This is one of the Abu Dhabi luxury holidays, perfect for families and group of friends who want to take a quick break from their routine.ItineraryDay 1Arrival and LeisureEnjoy a private ride in a luxury vehicle from the Abu Dhabi airport to your hotel with this Abu Dhabi luxury package. Once you complete the check-in formalities, settle into your room. Spend the rest of the day as you please. You are free to relax in your room, explore the luxurious hotel and its numerous amenities, or even step out to check out the attractions of Abu Dhabi. With no schedules and itineraries, it is the ideal way to begin your holiday.Day 2Yas Island Theme Park ExperienceThe next day begins with a hearty breakfast at the hotel, followed by a shuttle bus taking you to one of the Yas Island theme parks you have chosen: Warner Bros. World, Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, or SeaWorld Abu Dhabi. Ferrari World is a Formula One theme park with record-breaking rides, while Warner Bros. is one where you can enjoy zones, rides, and attractions based on the Warner Bros. franchise. Sea World Abu Dhabi is a marine life theme park, complete with aquariums and marine-themed rides and attractions. Yas Waterworld is the best water park in Abu Dhabi, home to world-class slides, rides, and water coasters. The package includes visiting different landmarks and attractions of Abu Dhabi, including cultural, spiritual, adventurous, and entertaining avenues. A day is dedicated to a city tour, another to a theme park on Yas Island, and one to an evening safari in the deserts of Abu Dhabi. With a luxury stay, private transfers, and a UAE visa included in the tour package, you can enjoy a comfortable and hassle-free holiday.ItineraryDay 1Arrival and LeisureA private vehicle, along with a chauffeur, awaits you at the Abu Dhabi Airport to drive you to your hotel on this Abu Dhabi and Dubai grand package. title: Four Days Best of Turkey
meta_description: Unlock the best of Turkey with this all-inclusive package. From the Old City Tour and a Bosphorus Dinner Cruise to a Princess Island Tour, check off all the must-experiences in four days. Call our specialists for more information.
content: Four Days Best of TurkeyHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysIstanbulTurkish DelightsShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D5 ImagesView GalleryTurkish DelightsNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewCheck off some of Turkey’s most captivating attractions on this five-day holiday. Go on an enchanting Bosphorus Dinner Cruise, experience the region’s historical grandeur with an old city tour, and explore the Ottoman Empire’s ancient capital by heading to Bursa. Besides guided tours, it includes accommodation in your preferred Turkish hotel and all airport transfers.ItineraryDay 1Istanbul Arrival Arrive Istanbul Airport or Sabiha Gokcen AirportMeet with your welcoming guide at the outside with ''WELCOME TO TURKEY'' sign (In Istanbul airport at 14th gate, in Sabiha Gokcen Airport at 10th column).After your name check is done, he / she lead you till your transfer vehicle.Meet with your driver and private transfer to hotel. (Approximately 1hrs 30 mins distance, depends on traffic)Proceed to hotel & check in (International check-in time 14:00)Day 2OLD CITY TOURYou'll be picked up from your hotel by your driver and guide then start your city tour 🏙.Places to be visited:BLUE MOSQUEAYASOFYA-I KEBIR CAMI-I SERIFI (HAGIA SOPHIA - FROM OUTSIDE)TOPKAPI PALACEGRAND BAZAARLunch will be served at a local restaurant 🍽. After your tour ends, you'll be transferred back to your hotel.--------------Blue MosqueBlue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque): Admire its magnificent architecture 🏛, intricate tilework, and the grandeur of its interior. Learn about its historical significance as one of Istanbul's most significant landmarks.Ayasofya-i Kebir Cami-i Serifi (From Outside)Ayasofya-i Kebir Cami-i Serifi (Hagia Sophia - From Outside): A world heritage mosque that has survived for decades with its fascinating architecture 🏛 and history.Topkapi Palace Topkapi Palace: Explore this grand palace , used as the administrative center of the state for 400 years during the Ottoman Empire's 600-year history 🏛. Discover where the Ottoman sultans lived and ruled Grand Bazaar Grand Bazaar: One of the largest and oldest covered bazaars in the world. With approximately 4,000 shops 🛒, it’s a bustling marketplace for all sorts of goods.SHOPPING OPPORTUNITIES: Legendary Turkish Delight Shops, Famous Leather Shops, and Traditional Turkish Handmade Carpet Shops.Day 3Bosphorus Dinner CruiseYou'll be picked up from your hotel and then transferred to the port.After you reach the port you'll sail to the Marmara Sea. There will be entertainment shows on the boat.Shows: SWORD DANCE, TURKISH GYPSY DANCE, BELLY DANCE SHOW, WHIRLING DERVISH SHOW, DJ PERFORMANCE.Dinner will be served on the board.After your experience ends you'll be transferred to your hotel from the port.--------------------You'll sail to the Marmara Sea. A Sufi dance, steered by rhythmic breathing and chants of “Allah” as they seek to become one with God.DJ PERFORMANCE: A DJ show that is performed by an International DJ. You can join by dancing or you can just listen.Day 4PRINCESS ISLAND TOURYou'll be picked up from your hotel by your guide and driver, then start your tour.Places to be visited:Princes' Islands Buyukada Lunch will be served at a local restaurant.You'll have free time in Buyukada, with many optional activities to choose from.After your tour ends, you'll be transferred back to your hotel.-----------The Princes' Islands An archipelago in the northeastern part of the Marmara Sea, off the southern coast of the Anatolian side of Istanbul. It consists of 9 islands, large and small, and two rocks close to the shore.BuyukadaThe largest of the islands off the coast of Istanbul, also known as the Prince Islands. Its ancient Greek name is Prinkipos, which means "Prince" in Greek.Optional activities After lunch, you'll have the option to engage in various activities on the island. title: 4 Nights 5 Days Stunning Seychelles Tour Package
meta_description: Your calling for pristine beaches, turquoise waters, sun and sand, ends with Seychelles Holidays. A paradise found in the Islands of the Indian ocean for a relaxed yet adventurous sojourn.  Check out Seychelles Holiday Packages.
content: 4 Nights 5 Days Stunning Seychelles Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMaheStunning Seychelles- 04N & 05DShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryStunning Seychelles- 04N & 05DNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewSeychelles, a nation of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean, is a popular tourist destination known for its stunning beaches, vibrant marine life, and lush landscapes. The archipelago offers a mix of relaxation and adventure, with opportunities for snorkeling, diving, hiking, and exploring unique ecosystems. With its ancient granite boulders, crystal-clear shallows, and lush jungle backdrop, La Digue delivers exactly the scenery that defines the Seychelles in the world's imagination.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in MaheThe romance-filled Seychelles package starts with a leisure day in Mahe. A warm welcome to the beautiful world of islands that sits serenely in the vast Indian Ocean - Seychelles. As you arrive at the international airport in Mahe, an agent’s representative will receive you and help you in getting transferred to your hotel in Mahe Island. Upon arrival at the hotel, check in to the hotel and relax as rest of the day is at leisure.Day 2Mahe Island Tour with LunchHave breakfast at the Mahé hotel and proceed for a sightseeing tour of the island. The various attractions covered in this Seychelles tour package include Clock Tower, Sans Souci Mission Lodge, Le Jardin Du Roi Spice Garden, and Catholic Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception.   After lunch at a local restaurant, you will be taken to the beautiful Anse Royale beach. Thereafter, you will be taken for a tour of the Artisanal Craft Village. Retire to the hotel in the evening for dinner and night stay.Day 3Full day Reef safari with with BBQ LunchAfter breakfast, Depart Eden Island Marina by glass bottom boat to discover the underwater world of this unique and protected tropical coral reef. On this relaxing excursion you will spend the day experiencing the wonders of the Marine Park with its dazzling turquoise waters, beautiful scenery and a never to forget snorkeling experience where you can observe a large amount of fish species in their natural habitats as well as doing a spot of fish feeding by hand.Disembark on Cerf Island to enjoy a delicious creole BBQ. After Lunch if you wish to relax or stroll along the beach you are free to do so. You will get the chance to visit the tortoise and also do some more snorkeling before heading back to Mahe.Day 4Full day Praslin & LA Digue Island tour with LunchNamed after one of the vessels in explorer Marion Dufresne’s fleet, La Digue is the fourth largest island of the Seychelles group. Here, time stand still and the use of bicycles and ox-cart are until today king. With an area of 10.1 square mile and a population of just over 2000 and a rich flora, La Digue is home to one of the rarest birds on earth - the Paradise Flycatcher. Known for preserving traditions, the island’s ‘trademark’ is the must-visit union Estate, still sporting its traditional coconut oil mill, the old copra kiln and a fine colonial house set amongst vanilla and coconut plantations. As you stroll along, pet the gentle giant land tortoises before settling down on the picturesque Anse Source d’Argent, voted as one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Set against exceptional rock formation, the place remains a source of inspiration for artistes and will simply take away your breath. Relax and take memorable pictures of one of the few natural places in the world where you can hear your heart beating! with over 7000 inhabitants, the island, second largest of the archipelago covers an area of over 37sqm. Named after Le Duc de Praslin, a French Minister, the isle of Praslin boasts one of UNESCO’s World Heritage sites, the renowned Vallée de Mai, believed to be the original ‘Garden of Eden’. As you stroll through this amazing forest, meet the World’s biggest nut, the inspiring Coco de Mer. Your tour will then take you to the ex quisite Anse Lazio beach which over recent years has appeared on the list of top 10 beaches in the world and has graced the front page of several publications. Your visit to these two islands will not only be a dream come true, but a memorable experience…for you will have been seduced!Day 5Mahe Island: Goodbye SeychellesWake up to a wholesome breakfast with your loved-one at the hotel. Post breakfast, get ready with your bags packed as this being the last day of your Seychelles, you will complete the checkout formalities. A representative will help you in keeping your luggage safely at the hotel itself as you go out for some shopping in the local market of Mahe. Later in the evening, your transfers will be arranged to the international airport as it’s time to fly back home with some cherish able memories.Hotel Options3* BERJAYA BEAU MAHE4* CORAL STRAND MAHE5* content: 5 Nights 6 Days Amazing Seychelles Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMaheAmazing Seychelles - 05N & 06DShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryAmazing Seychelles - 05N & 06DNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewSeychelles, a nation of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean, is a popular tourist destination known for its stunning beaches, vibrant marine life, and lush landscapes. The archipelago offers a mix of relaxation and adventure, with opportunities for snorkeling, diving, hiking, and exploring unique ecosystems. With its ancient granite boulders, crystal-clear shallows, and lush jungle backdrop, La Digue delivers exactly the scenery that defines the Seychelles in the world's imagination.ItineraryDay 1Praslin: Arrival at Mahé airport and Ferry ride to PraslinOn arrival at the Mahé Airport, you will be received by a representative of the travel agent. He will escort you to the jetty for a ferry ride to Praslin.Day 2Praslin: Day trip to la digue islandStart the day with a healthy breakfast. Spend moments in the picturesque location along with your group. See the best that La Digue Island has to offer during this full-day, small-group excursion from Praslin Island. Leave the Baie Sainte Anne Jetty for the short crossing to the neighboring island. Visit the L’Union Estate for a tour of the plantation house and to see giant land tortoises as well as the spectacular Anse Source d’Argent Beach. Take a full-day tour from Praslin to La Digue Island See giant land tortoises and relax on the beach.Day 3Mahe: Transfer back to Mahé for eventful dayAfter days in Praslin, head to Mahé for days packed with sightseeing tours and activities. Post breakfast, check-out from the hotel. A boat will take you from Anse La Farine jetty in Praslin to the Inter Island Quay on the Mahé Island. Check-in at the hotel and relax for a while. The rest of the day is free for you to explore the resort and take a stroll to the nearby beaches. Have dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at the resort.Day 4Mahe: Full day island tour with lunch at a local restaurantAfter breakfast, you will be escorted for a day tour of the Mahé island. Let's start with a visit at the center of Victoria, the world’s smallest capital. First stop is at the brightly painted Hindu temple, a distinguished structure differentiated by its unique design. A place where the faithful join for prayer. A few more steps across the road and we will come upon the colorful market, filled with fresh fruits & vegetables, a variety of fish and local spices; the perfect combination for an appetizing creole dish. The tour then takes a turn to the prominent Clock Tower, one of the most iconic historical features of Seychelles. Inaugurated since 1903, it is set in the middle of a cross-section in the town center, impossible to miss. Another interesting place to visit is the Botanical Garden. This beautiful haven is just 5 minutes out of Victoria, accommodating the rarest endemic flora of the island and home to some spirited land tortoises. There's bound to be plenty of postcard worthy pictures to take back home. This is all part of an exciting morning designed to work up your appetite before settling for lunch. Our last stop will be at Domaine de Val des Pres (craft village) or to one of the stunning beaches of Seychelles.Day 5Mahe: Full Day Glass Bottom BoatAfter breakfast, Depart Eden Island Marina by glass bottom boat to discover the underwater world of this unique and protected tropical coral reef. On this relaxing excursion you will spend the day experiencing the wonders of the Marine Park with its dazzling turquoise waters, beautiful scenery and a never to forget snorkeling experience where you can observe a large amount of fish species in their natural habitats as well as doing a spot of fish feeding by hand. Disembark on Cerf Island to enjoy a delicious creole BBQ.After Lunch if you wish to relax or stroll along the beach you are free to do so. You will get the chance to visit the tortoise and also do some more snorkeling before heading back to Mahe.Day 6Mahe: Shopping at Victoria market & departure from SeychellesGo shopping at the Victoria market in the morning on own arrangement, before finally catching a return flight. Enjoy your morning breakfast at the hotel. In the morning, Buy souvenirs from the local shops. Stay in Mahe Island and enjoy a mix of relaxation and adventure with an island sightseeing tour, a full-day reef safari with BBQ lunch, and a memorable Praslin & La Digue island excursion covering some of the world’s most beautiful beaches. With comfortable hotel stays, daily breakfast, selected lunches, seamless transfers, and honeymoon add-ons, this package promises a truly romantic and refreshing island getaway.ItineraryDay 1MaheThe romance-filled Seychelles package starts with a leisure day in Mahe. A warm welcome to the beautiful world of islands that sits serenely in the vast Indian Ocean - Seychelles. As you arrive at the international airport in Mahe, an agent’s representative will receive you and help you in getting transferred to your hotel in Mahe Island. Upon arrival at the hotel, check in to the hotel and relax as rest of the day is at leisure.Day 2Mahe: MAHE ISLAND TOUR WITH LUNCHHave breakfast at the Mahé hotel and proceed for a sightseeing tour of the island. The various attractions covered in this Seychelles tour package include Clock Tower, Sans Souci Mission Lodge, Le Jardin Du Roi Spice Garden, and Catholic Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception.   After lunch at a local restaurant, you will be taken to the beautiful Anse Royale beach. Thereafter, you will be taken for a tour of the Artisanal Craft Village. Retire to the hotel in the evening for dinner and night stayDay 3Mahe: FULL DAY REEF SAFARI WITH WITH BBQ LUNCHAfter breakfast, Depart Eden Island Marina by glass bottom boat to discover the underwater world of this unique and protected tropical coral reef. On this relaxing excursion you will spend the day experiencing the wonders of the Marine Park with its dazzling turquoise waters, beautiful scenery and a never to forget snorkeling experience where you can observe a large amount of fish species in their natural habitats as well as doing a spot of fish feeding by hand. Disembark on Cerf Island to enjoy a delicious creole BBQ. After Lunch if you wish to relax or stroll along the beach you are free to do so. You will get the chance to visit the tortoise and also do some more snorkeling before heading back to Mahe.Day 4Mahe: FULL DAY PRASLIN & LA DIGUE ISLAND TOUR WITH LUNCHNamed after one of the vessels in explorer Marion Dufresne’s fleet, La Digue is the fourth largest island of the Seychelles group. Here, time stand still and the use of bicycles and ox-cart are until today king. With an area of 10.1 square mile and a population of just over 2000 and a rich flora, La Digue is home to one of the rarest birds on earth - the Paradise Flycatcher. Known for preserving traditions, the island’s ‘trademark’ is the must-visit l’Union Estate, still sporting its traditional coconut oil mill, the old copra kiln and a fine colonial house set amongst vanilla and coconut plantations. As you stroll along, pet the gentle giant land tortoises before settling down on the picturesque Anse Source d’Argent, voted as one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Set against exceptional rock formation, the place remains a source of inspiration for artistes and will simply take away your breath. Relax and take memorable pictures of one of the few natural places in the world where you can hear your heart beating! with over 7000 inhabitants, the island, second largest of the archipelago covers an area of over 37sqm. Named after Le Duc de Praslin, a French Minister, the isle of Praslin boasts one of UNESCO’s World Heritage sites, the renowned Vallée de Mai, believed to be the original ‘Garden of Eden’. As you stroll through this amazing forest, meet the World’s biggest nut, the inspiring Coco de Mer. Your tour will then take you to the exquisite Anse Lazio beach which over recent years has appeared on the list of top 10 beaches in the world and has graced the front page of several publications. Your visit to these two islands will not only be a dream come true, but a memorable experience…for you will have been seduced!Day 5Mahe Island: Goodbye SeychellesWake up to a wholesome breakfast with your loved-one at the hotel. Post breakfast, get ready with your bags packed as this being the last day of your Seychelles honeymoon package, you will complete the checkout formalities.A representative will help you in keeping your luggage safely at the hotel itself as you go out for some shopping in the local market of Mahe. It includes a comfortable stay in a four-star or five-star accommodation and comes with all transfers. The main highlight is a fully guided Manama City Tour that will promise you an enlightening overview of the capital city’s unrivaled sights and sounds.ItineraryDay 1Welcome to BahrainMeet our representative upon your arrival at Bahrain International Airport, before you will be escorted to the vehicle that will transfer you to your accommodation. Make your first stop at the stunning Al Fateh Mosque, which is the country’s largest mosque. It is so vast that it can hosts up to 7,000 worshippers at any given time. Check out its marvelous features including the largest of its kind fiberglass dome and the intricate yet magnificent Kulic calligraphy that graces its walls. As the tour continues, stop for some exuberant shopping experience at Muharraq Souq. You will also visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Qal'at al-Bahrain (also known as Bahrain Fort) as part of your sightseeing tour. The last stop is at Bab al Bahrain – a historical landmark that is translated as Gateway of Bahrain. title: Mysore Coorg Ooty Scenic Family Holiday Tour
meta_description: Unwind with family on a 6-day Mysore, Coorg & Ooty tour featuring palaces, wildlife drives via Bandipur, waterfalls, gardens, hills, transfers and breakfast daily.
content: Mysore Coorg Ooty Scenic Family Holiday TourHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMysoreMysore Coorg Ooty Scenic Family TourShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryMysore Coorg Ooty Scenic Family TourNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewExplore South India’s most stunning cultures, unequaled landscapes, and natural gems on this all-inclusive holiday. With accommodations in Mysore, Coorg, and Ooty, it allows you to strike off all of the region’s top architectural marvels, shrines, wildlife attractions, and lush gardens, including Mysore Palace, Brindavan Gardens, Omkareshwar Temple, Bandipur National Park, and Rose Garden. ItineraryDay 1Arrival Bangalore transfer to Mysore Welcome to Bangalore! After a professional meet-and-greet, enjoy a pleasant drive to Mysore. Check into your room and then set out to explore the region’s top attractions, including the iconic Mysore Palace and the magnificent Brindavan Gardens, a lush paradise sprawling over 60 acres. Wrap up your day by watching the spectacular musical fountain show.  Overnight stay in Mysore Day 2Drive to Coorg (approx. 3.5 hrs)Today, you’ll be transferred to the scenic hills of Coorg, stopping at Bylakuppe’s Golden Temple and the tranquil Nisargadhama, a serene island on the Cauvery River along the way. Upon arrival in Coorg, settle into your room for a relaxed evening. Overnight stay in CoorgDay 3Coorg City Tour After breakfast, prepare for a sightseeing tour that takes you to some of Coorg’s must-sees. The first stop is at Dubare Elephant Camp for an up-close interaction with majestic elephants. You’ll next visit the scintillating Abbey Falls and absorb enchanting views from Raja’s Seat, before concluding the tour at the revered Omkareshwar Temple. Overnight stay in Coorg Day 4Scenic drive via Bandipur National Park to OotyToday, you’ll journey through the most picturesque landscapes, passing through the celebrated Bandipur National Park on the Mysore-Ooty Highway, which shelters unique and diverse wildlife species. Overnight stay in Ooty  Day 5Ooty City TourGet ready for a sightseeing tour of Ooty, covering all of its marvelous sights. Immerse yourself in the compelling charm of the Botanical Garden, stop at the serene Ooty Lake, take in panoramic views from Doddabetta Peak, and wander the breathtaking Rose Garden. You can also take an optional excursion to nearby Coonoor. Overnight stay in Ooty  Day 6DepartureFollowing a fulfilling breakfast, check out from your hotel and end your memorable holiday with a convenient transfer to the airport or railway station.Hotel OptionsFortune Jp Palace/similarwildflower Resort & Spa/similarGem park/similar Previous Next123InclusionAccommodation in well-appointed hotels Daily breakfast at the hotelAll airport, railway station, and intercity transfers by private air-conditioned vehicleAll sightseeing and excursions as per the itinerary by private vehicleToll taxes, parking fees, and driver’s allowances includedExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending citySafari Tickets are not included in package costMonument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing placesMeals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners)Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etc.Any additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itineraryGuide services (unless specified as included)Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuationTipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staffAny cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellationsGST or any other government taxes (if applicable)Important InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. This all-inclusive, six-night package, with stays in Bengaluru, Mysore, Coorg, and Ooty, promises a holiday of a lifetime. Yes, prepare to strike off your wish list as you visit the revered Sri Chamundeshwari Temple, the historic Namdroling Monastery, the scenic Abbey Falls, and the breathtaking Nilgiri Hills. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bengaluru & Transfer to MysoreUpon touching down in Bengaluru, our representative will transfer you to your accommodation in Mysore. Check in to your room, relax, and then set out to explore the region’s most visited attractions. Stop at the venerated Sri Chamundeshwari Temple, located on Chamundi Hill, and then proceed to the bustling Devaraja Market, featuring vibrant stalls of handicrafts, flowers, spices, and sandalwood. Overnight stay in Mysore Day 2Mysore to Coorg Today, you’ll journey to Coorg after Hotel check-out. Begin at some of the most scenic spots along the way, such as Bylakuppe Namdroling Monastery, one of South India’s largest Tibetan monasteries, and Raja’s Seat, which was once a royal sanctuary and now a beloved leisure attraction in Madikeri. Following your arrival in Coorg, check in to your room and spend a leisurely evening. Overnight stay in CoorgDay 3Coorg Sightseeing Today, an exciting sightseeing tour of Coorg awaits you! Start at the panoramic Abbey Falls, a major draw for nature lovers and photography enthusiasts with its verdant surroundings. You’ll next tour the Dubbare Elephant Camp for an up-close interaction with its adorable residents. Overnight stay in CoorgDay 4Coorg to Ooty Today, you’ll briefly leave Karnataka and head to Ooty in Tamil Nadu. Enjoy a soul-stirring drive through the picturesque Nilgiri Hills, blanketed with tea plantations and greenery. After a smooth arrival, check in to your room and enjoy a tranquil evening in Ooty. Overnight stay in OotyDay 5Ooty SightseeingThe main attraction of the fifth day is a full-day tour of Ooty. Admire the lush beauty of Ooty Botanical Gardens, set sail on a boat ride at the quaint Ooty Lake, and catch the region’s most gorgeous views from the highest point in the Nilgiri Hills. Overnight stay in Ooty Day 6Ooty to BengaluruToday, you’ll travel back to Karnataka as our representative will drive you to Bengaluru. After check-in, enjoy your free time to relax in your room or discover Bengaluru’s mix of historic, cultural, and leisure attractions. meta_description: Discover Mysore, Coorg & Wayanad’s nature, waterfalls, temples, lakes and lush landscapes on a 7-day escape with guided sightseeing, transfers & comfortable stays.

Visit the revered Sri Chamundeshwari Temple, perched on Chamundi Hill. Experience Mysore’s rich culture as you wander the ever-effervescent Devaraja Market, where you can shop for unique traditional crafts and local produce. Overnight stay in MysoreDay 2Mysore to CoorgToday, enjoy an exciting drive to Coorg, stopping at Bylakuppe majestic Golden Temple along the way. Overnight stay in CoorgDay 3Coorg SightseeingAfter breakfast, embark on a guided tour of Coorg! Start your day at the enchanting Abbey Falls, whose striking surroundings with coffee plantations and a hanging bridge will surely take your breath away! Overnight stay in Coorg  Day 4Coorg to Wayanad Today, upon hotel-out, Wayand’s unrivaled natural beauty beckons you as you leave Karnataka behind and journey to Kerala on a relaxed drive. Travel through verdant forests, rolling valleys, and scenic hills, among others, until you arrive in Wayanad. Check into your room and enjoy a peaceful evening. Overnight Stay in Wayanad Day 5Wayanad SightseeingExperience Wayanad’s most scenic and thrilling attractions on a tour. track with mystical forests, dragons, tunnels, twists, turns, bends, hairpin corners, etc. (depending on your chosen trail). Experience absolute safety as you ride a state-of-the-art, three-wheeled first luge with your Skyline Luge tickets. Located on Sentosa Island, the track recreates a downhill that extends for 2.6 kilometers and is categorized into four fantastic trails, such as the Kupu Kupu Trail, Expedition Trail, Dragon Trail, and Jungle Trail. It is a gravity-powered adventure aboard an advanced and safe luge cart; its speed can be managed with effortless handlebar movements. You can also take in the region’s breathtaking views from above on a four-seater Skyride session. Subject to your ticket choice, enjoy a Night Luge. WHAT TO EXPECT Ride Southeast Asia’s First Luge As you take to the region's first-of-its-kind Sentosa Luge Ride, an unforgettable adventure awaits you! With access to the most cutting-edge yet easy-to-maneuver luge carts, you can embark on a gravity-driven ride where an easy and smooth shift of the handlebar (to green or red) lets you customize your unique adventure's speed. It makes it ideal for all skill levels and ages above six years.Choose Your Trail & Unleash the Thrills The Skyline Luge track spans 2.6 kilometers downhill, with four trails at your disposal. The longest is the 688-meter-long Dragon Trail, where you watch out for the fictitious dragons in the lush forest surrounding the track. The next is the Expedition Trail, 658 meters in length; it whizzes you past a verdant rainforest, covering exhilarating turns, twists, and tunnels. meta_description: Explore Uzbekistan on an all-inclusive retreat! It takes you to Tashkent, Amirsoy Mountain Resort, Chimgan, and Chorvoq, all in five days. Call our specialists for more information or lock in this package at the best rate.
content: 4 Nights and 5 Days Uzbekistan Travel PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysTashkentExplore UzbekistanShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryExplore UzbekistanNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewUzbekistan, a Central Asian nation steeped in history, is a mesmerising destination known for its captivating architecture, rich cultural heritage, and warm hospitality. From the enchanting Silk Road cities to its varied landscapes, Uzbekistan offers a unique blend of adventure and discoveryItineraryDay 1Arrival in TashkentOnce you land at Islam Karimov Tashkent International Airport, our friendly representative will greet you and escort you and transfer to the hotel in Tashkent. Check-in to the hotel. Rest day at Leisure.Overnight stay in Tashkent.Day 2Full-Day Tashkent City TourToday, following breakfast, you will enjoy a pleasant day trip exploring the vibrant city of Tashkent, the capital of Uzbekistan, known for its rich history, diverse museums, and a unique blend of modern and Soviet-era architecture. Your city tour begins with a visit to Chorsu Bazaar, a bustling traditional market where you can shop for souvenirs, spices, and sample local street snacks. Next, you’ll head to the stunning Minor Mosque, a modern white-marble mosque located near the scenic Ankhor River. You may also choose to visit the Plov Center (Central Asian Plov House) to taste Uzbekistan’s famous national dish, plov, cooked in massive cauldrons—an optional but highly recommended experience. Continue your tour at Magic City, a contemporary entertainment complex featuring European-style streets, charming cafes, and fun attractions. The day also includes a visit to Khast Imam Square, the spiritual heart of Tashkent, where you'll find the Muyi Muborak Library that houses the world's oldest Quran. After a full day of exploration, you will be dropped off at your hotel for an overnight stay in Tashkent.Day 3Amirsoy Mountain Resort, Chimgan & ChorvoqToday, following breakfast, you will proceed to the Amirsoy Mountain Resort, the largest and most modern ski resort in Uzbekistan, and a standout destination in Central Asia. Opened in 2019 and nestled in the Western Tian Shan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the resort has even been dubbed “next season’s St. Moritz” by Lonely Planet. At Amirsoy Mountain Resort, you can enjoy breathtaking mountain views and a variety of optional activities such as cable car rides, ziplining, ATV adventures, and chair lifts. The journey continues to the Chimgan Mountains, a serene natural escape offering beautiful landscapes perfect for nature walks, horse riding, or simply unwinding in the fresh mountain air. After lunch at a local restaurant, you’ll visit the scenic Chorvoq Lake, surrounded by majestic mountains and ideal for photography, leisurely walks, or a short boat ride. At the end of the day, you’ll return to Tashkent for an overnight stay at your hotel.Day 4Historic Tashkent City TourEmbark on a full-day historic city tour of Tashkent, exploring some of the city's most iconic landmarks. Your tour begins at Independence Square, the main square of Tashkent symbolizing the country’s freedom and national pride. Next, you will visit the Lal Bahadur Shastri Monument, honoring the former Indian Prime Minister and the strong Uzbekistan–India friendship. Continue to the Earthquake Memorial, a poignant tribute to the resilience of Tashkent’s people following the devastating 1966 earthquake. You’ll also experience a ride on the Underground Metro, one of the most beautiful and artistically designed metro systems in the world. The day concludes with a relaxing stroll through Tashkent City Park, a modern green space featuring walking paths, fountains, and recreational areas.Day 5Departure from TashkentDepending on your flight timing, your vehicle with driver will be ready to promptly transfer you back to Airport. Overnight in Gudauri.  Day 2Transfer to Tbilisi – On the way cover Ananuri, Gudauri & Kazbegi tourAfter breakfast in Gudauri hotel, check-out & proceed to enjoy a refreshing drive away Packed with the most exciting experiences, this tour will head you to the picturesque town of Stepantsminda or Kazbegi, where the 14th century Gergeti Trinity Church and the gorgeous views of Chkheri River, Mount Kazbek and Darial Gorge make for a marvelous stop. title: 6 Nights and 7 Days Japan Travel Package
meta_description: Discover the best of Japan and beyond with our all-inclusive Central Japan Express. From Tokyo’s vibrant energy and Mount Fuji’s breathtaking majesty to Kyoto’s timeless elegance, it promises the holiday of a lifetime. Book now.
content: 6 Nights and 7 Days Japan Travel PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysTokyoCentral Japan ExpressShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D7 ImagesView GalleryCentral Japan ExpressNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewJapan is an archipelago, or string of islands, on the eastern edge of Asia. There are four main islands: Hokkaido, Honshu, Shikoku, and Kyushu. Although it is only a small country located in the middle of the East Sea, Japan has become one of the most attractive destinations in the world. This place is a blend of tradition and culture with modernity and development, from ancient sacred temples, skyscrapers, clear beaches to majestic natural landscapes.ItineraryDay 1TOKYOWelcome to Japan! After completing customs procedures, you’ll be transferred to your hotel by shared shuttle bus. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at leisure. In the afternoon, you’ll receive details about the start of your tour. Day 2TOKYOIn the morning, we’ll enjoy an extensive guided tour of this truly mesmerizing city, lasting approximately five hours. Tokyo’s vibrant energy and cutting-edge neighborhoods coexist beautifully with its tranquil, serene spaces.We’ll begin with a brief stop at Zojoji Temple, where you’ll capture one of the most iconic views of the Tokyo Tower. The temple grounds are adorned with hundreds of Jizo statues, intricately carved stone figures believed to be protectors of children, dressed in colorful knit caps, bibs, and windmills.Next, we’ll head to the famous Shibuya Crossing, often hailed as the busiest intersection in the world, followed by a visit to the Meiji Shrine, dedicated to the spirits of Emperor Meiji and his wife. Our journey will continue by bus along the elegant Omotesando Avenue. We’ll then see the most picturesque parts of the Imperial Palace and its gardens and stop to admire the iconic Nijubashi Bridge.As we proceed, we’ll pass through the vibrant Akihabara district, also known as the “Electric Town,” a hub for Japanese manga and anime culture. We’ll also drive past the Kokugikan, Japan’s renowned sumo wrestling arena.We’ll conclude our tour in Asakusa, visiting the historic Sensoji Temple and the famous Nakamise Street. Lunch will be included at a local restaurant. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel.At 6:30 p.m., we’ll meet our guide in the hotel lobby and take the metro (tickets included) to the lively Shinjuku district. Here, we’ll enjoy a stroll through its bustling streets, renowned for their vibrant nightlife, as we head to a local restaurant for dinner (included). Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel by metro, accompanied by our guide. Day 3TOKYO - MOUNT FUJI - KAWAGUCHIKOWe’ll journey to the stunning Mount Fuji area, traveling through picturesque landscapes along the way.Our first stop will be the Arakurayama Sengen Park, home to beautiful pagodas and offering the most iconic views of Mount Fuji. From here, we’ll continue to Kawaguchiko, a charming town surrounded by mountains, vibrant flowers, and its namesake lake. Upon arrival, we’ll visit the Fuji Sengen Shrine, a serene site nestled among towering trees, which marks the traditional starting point for pilgrimages up Mount Fuji. During our visit, we’ll take a moment to express gratitude for experiencing such a magical place.The tour will also include a delightful boat ride on Lake Kawaguchiko, where you can soak in the area’s tranquil beauty. After, we’ll ascend Mount Fuji via the scenic road to the Fifth Station, at 2,305 meters, surrounded by breathtaking forests and vistas.Note: In winter, the ascent to Mount Fuji may be closed due to snow or adverse weather conditions. During this season, we will go as far as permitted.We’ll return to Kawaguchiko, with time to enjoy a leisurely stroll along the lake. Tonight, we’ll stay in a ryokan, a traditional Japanese inn, where you can relax in the onsen (public bath). Dinner will be included.Note: At the planned ryokan, some rooms feature traditional Japanese-style tatami mats, while others are Western-style. Occasionally, accommodation may be arranged in a Western-style hotel.Day 4KAWAGUCHIKO - IYASHI NO SATO NENBA - TOYOTA - KYOTOIn the morning, we’ll follow a scenic road that winds around picturesque lakes to visit Iyashi no Sato Nenba, a small village that was destroyed by a typhoon in 1966 and later restored as an open-air museum. Its traditional houses have been converted into arts and crafts shops, restaurants, and cultural exhibits, offering a glimpse into Japan’s past.Next, we’ll visit the breathtaking Shiraito Falls, one of Japan’s most stunning natural attractions, with cascading water that spans a height of 20 meters.From there, we’ll continue to Nagoya, where we’ll visit the Toyota Museum (admission included), a must-see destination for car enthusiasts and those curious about automotive innovation.Finally, we’ll proceed to Kyoto for our overnight stay. Day 5KYOTOWe’ll spend the entire day exploring Kyoto, Japan’s capital from 794 to 1868 and home to the Imperial Court. Remarkably, Kyoto was the only major Japanese city spared from bombing during World War II, allowing it to retain its rich artistic heritage. Notably, the Kyoto Protocol, aimed at limiting greenhouse gas emissions, was signed here in 1997.We’ll include a visit to Kyoto’s most iconic landmarks. Our tour will begin in Arashiyama, where we’ll admire the Togetsukyo Bridge, or “Bridge over the Moon.” This spot offers a breathtaking panorama of the surrounding landscape.We’ll then visit the Tenryuji Temple, one of Kyoto’s “five great Zen temples” and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, followed by a serene walk through its mystical bamboo forest.Next, we’ll explore the magnificent Fushimi Inari Shrine; the Imperial Palace; and the Kinkakuji Temple, also known as the “Golden Pavilion,” surrounded by its spectacular gardens. (The order of the visits may vary.)After the tour, you can enjoy some time to stroll through Gion, Kyoto’s vibrant traditional district, known for its lively atmosphere and geishas. Day 6KYOTO - TSUMAGO - MATSUMOTO - TOKYOWe’ll travel through beautiful rural landscapes to Tsumago, a charming wooden village considered one of the most picturesque in Japan. You’ll have free time to stroll around and soak in its traditional atmosphere. Lunch will be included at a local restaurant. Afterward, we’ll continue to Matsumoto, a popular tourist city where we’ll visit its impressive 16th-century castle, known as the "The Crow" due to its black color. Following the visit, there will be free time to explore the town. In the afternoon, we’ll depart for Tokyo, arriving by the end of the day.Day 7TOKYOAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny of the mentioned hotelsInclusionTravel by bus with English speaking guidehotel and breakfast buffetIncludes arrival transferCity tour in: Kyoto, TokyoBoat: Kawaguchiko LakeEvening transfer: Traditional quarter of Gion, Shinjuku Ticket admission: Village Museum, Tenryu-ji Temple, Arashiyama bamboo forest in Kyoto, Fushimi Inari, Imperial Palace, Kinkakuji Temple , Matsumoto Castle , Arakurayama Sengen Park , Metro, Zojoji Temple, Meiji Temple, Sensoji Temple , Toyota Museum2 Lunch Included in: Tokyo, Tsumago 2 dinner included in: Kawaguchiko, Tokyo Basic travel insuranceExclusionAdmission tickets other than mentionedAnything not covered in the ‘inclusions’ such as meals, laundry, other items of personal nature International/Domestic flights VisaDeparture & PricingDeparture Date: Month Date July 2025 05, 12, 19, 26 August 2025 02, 09, 16, 23, 30 September 2025 06, 13, 20, 27 October 2025 04, 11, 18, 25 November 2025 01, 08 Pricing: Double Per person Triple Per person Single Per person Child with Extra bed Child without bed Infant (6 - 9.99 yrs.) Next, we’ll continue to Matsumoto, a lively tourist city where we’ll visit the impressive 16th-century castle, famously known as the “The Crow.” Afterward, you’ll have free time to explore this bustling city at your own pace. Our journey will then take us to Nagano, where we’ll spend the night.Day 7NAGANO - MONKEY PARK - KUSATSU - IKAHOIn Nagano, we’ll visit the Zenko-ji, a revered pilgrimage site housing the first Buddhist image brought to Japan. The Gomakuyo ceremony, included in your journey, will bring blessings and good fortune. Next, we’ll travel to the stunning Japanese Alps, venturing into the mountains to visit the Jigokudani Monkey Park. Here, you’ll enjoy lunch, followed by a serene stroll through forests, rivers, and hot springs, where colonies of Japanese macaques live and bathe.We’ll then ascend to breathtaking high mountain scenery, reaching altitudes of 2,172 meters, and pass semi-active volcanoes. Our journey will continue to Kusatsu, a charming spa town with a lively main square. We’ll take a leisurely walk through the city park, home to an open-air onsen. Afterward, we’ll proceed to Ikaho, a picturesque spa town where we’ll wander its historic center, famed for its stair-stepped streets. Tonight, we’ll stay at a ryokan, a traditional Japanese-style hotel, where you’ll enjoy its baths and a traditional Japanese dinner will be included.Note: During autumn, the movement of monkeys can be unpredictable depending on mountain fruit availability. If the macaques do not descend, the park may be closed. Additionally, the visit to Kusatsu may be canceled due to weather conditions from November to April.Day 8IKAHO - NIKKO - TOKYOWe’ll continue our journey to Nikko, a fantastic town where we’ll visit the impressive Nikko-Toshogu Temple, known for its famous “room with the sound of a dragon.” We’ll also explore the Taiyuinbyo Mausoleum, a serene and awe-inspiring site. Afterward, we’ll take a stroll along the Kanmangafuchi Abyss, where hundreds of Jizo statues silently watch over the riverbanks. You’ll have free time to explore the town center before we head back to Tokyo, arriving at approximately 06:30 p.m.Day 9TOKYOAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memoriesHotel OptionsAny of the mentioned hotelsInclusionTravel by bus with English speaking guidehotel and breakfast buffetIncludes arrival transferCity tour in: Kyoto, TokyoBoat: Kawaguchiko LakeEvening transfer: Traditional quarter of Gion, Shinjuku Ticket admission: Village Museum, Tenryu-ji Temple, Arashiyama bamboo forest in Kyoto, Fushimi Inari, Imperial Palace, Kinkakuji Temple , Matsumoto Castle , Arakurayama Sengen Park , Zenko-ji Temple, Gomakuyo ceremony,Jigokudani Monkey Park in Nagano , Nikko Toshogu Shrine, Taiyuinbyo Mausoleum in Nikko , Metro, Zojoji Temple, Meiji Temple, Sensoji Temple , Toyota Museum 3 Lunch Included in: Nagano, Tokyo, Tsumago 3 dinner included in: Ikaho, Kawaguchiko, Tokyo Basic travel insuranceExclusionAdmission tickets other than mentionedAnything not covered in the ‘inclusions’ such as meals, laundry, other items of personal nature VisaInternational/Domestic flightsDeparture & PricingDeparture Date: Month Date July 2025 05, 12, 19, 26 August 2025 02, 09, 16, 23, 30 September 2025 06, 13, 20, 27 October 2025 04, 11, 18, 25 November 2025 01, 08, 15, 22, 29 December 2025 06, 13, 20 January 2025 03, 10, 17, 24, 31 February 2025 07, 14, 21, 28 March 2025 07, 14, 21, 28 Pricing: Double Per person Triple Per person Single Per person Child with Extra bed Child without bed Infant (6 - 9.99 yrs.) content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBerlinAuthentic GermanyShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GalleryAuthentic GermanyNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThis 6-day Germany tour with Rayna Tours offers a perfect mix of history, culture, and scenic beauty from Berlin to Munich. The journey covers iconic cities and towns including Wolfsburg, Hannover, Dresden, Leipzig, Nuremberg, and Munich. Highlights include UNESCO World Heritage Sites, Wartburg Castle, a Danube Gorge cruise, and visits to BMW Welt and Dachau. Ideal for travelers seeking a compact yet immersive German experience.ItineraryDay 1BERLIN - WOLFSBURG - CELLE - HANNOVERWelcome to your tour with Rayna Tours!We’ll travel to Lower Saxony and visit Wolfsburg, a city founded in 1938 as a planned settlement for the workers of the Volkswagen factory during the Nazi era. The entire city revolves around the German automobile giant. We’ll include admission to Autostadt, the city of automobiles, featuring gardens and exhibitions. You’ll have time for a walk and lunch. We’ll then continue to Celle, where you can stroll through its old town, known for its half-timbered houses from the 16th and 17th centuries, as well as its imposing Renaissance castle. We’ll arrive in Hannover in the mid-afternoon, where you can explore the capital of Lower Saxony, an important economic, cultural, and scientific hub in the country. Its architecture blends historic and modern buildings, along with extensive parks. Accommodation will be here. Day 2HANNOVER - GOSLAR - GOTTINGEN - BAD SOODEN-ALLENDORF - EISENACH After breakfast, we travel to the RAMMELSBERG MINES, a historic silver mining center near Goslar that was exploited since the Middle Ages and has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Entrance to the museum, which tells the story of this mine, is included. We then continue on to GOSLAR, with its magnificent medieval old town, also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, noted for its half-timbered houses, cobblestone streets, and the majestic Church of St. Peter.Our journey continues to GÖTTINGEN, an important university and scientific center where the Brothers Grimm once lived. We will have time for lunch and a stroll through its historic old town. In the afternoon, we head toward Thuringia, stopping in BAD SOODEN, a small and picturesque spa town nestled among mountains and beautifully preserved. Afterwards, we continue to EISENACH, a city with a splendid Baroque and Renaissance old town, home to the Bach House and Luther House. Dinner included. Day 3EISENACH - GOTHA - ERFURT - LEIPZIGWe’ll start the day with a visit to the impressive Wartburg Castle (tickets included), a UNESCO World Heritage Site where Martin Luther translated the New Testament into German. Perched high above the town of Eisenach, this fortress offers not only a journey through German history, but also breathtaking views of the surrounding landscapes.After the visit, we’ll return to Eisenach, where you’ll have free time for lunch and to explore at your own pace. If you’re passionate about music, you might want to visit the Bach House, the birthplace of Johann Sebastian Bach. Alternatively, you can explore the Automobile Museum, located in the former main factory of East Germany’s car industry, home to an impressive collection of vintage vehicles.Our journey will continue to Gotha, where we’ll admire its majestic Baroque palace (exterior visit) and stroll through its charming historic center.We’ll then travel to Erfurt, the capital of Thuringia, a lively city known for its grand cathedral and beautifully preserved medieval old town. One of its highlights is a picturesque bridge lined with houses, continuously inhabited for more than 500 years.By late afternoon, we’ll arrive in Leipzig, one of Germany’s most culturally and historically rich cities. This vibrant metropolis was home to renowned composers such as Bach and Wagner, played a major industrial role during the era of the GDR, and today thrives with a population of over half a million. Day 4LEIPZIG - DRESDEN - BAMBERG - NUREMBERGLeaving Leipzig, we’ll stop at the Monument to the Battle of the Nations, inaugurated in 1913 and standing 91 meters tall. This monument commemorates a famous battle during the Napoleonic Wars. We’ll then continue to Dresden, the capital of Saxony, renowned for its Baroque and Renaissance architecture, its palaces, and its beautiful riverside promenades along the Elbe River. Next, we’ll head to Bavaria, arriving in Bamberg, a stunning, lively city—don’t miss a stroll through its picturesque Little Venice. Our journey will then take us to Nuremberg, the second-largest city in Bavaria, with a rich history. We recommend visiting the site where Hitler’s Coliseum once stood.Day 5NUREMBERG - KLOSTER WELTENBURG - DACHAU - MUNICHToday’s journey will be full of surprises. From Kelheim, we’ll board a boat for a short cruise along the Danube valley, passing through the Danube Gorge. Our first stop will be Kloster Weltenburg, a beautiful Benedictine monastery founded in 1040. Next, we’ll visit Dachau, where we’ll tour the Nazi concentration camp museum. After having lunch, we’ll continue to Munich, where we’ll visit the impressive BMW Welt, a modern multifunctional exhibition facility of the prestigious German vehicle brand BMW Group. We’ll also see the park that houses the Olympiastadion, an architectural marvel where the 1972 Olympic Games were held. After this, you’ll have free time in the historic center. You can stroll through Marienplatz, the heart of Munich, visit the picturesque Viktualienmarkt open-air market, relax in the Englischer Garten, or enjoy the traditional beer houses.Note: In winter or when Danube’s water level is too low, the cruise will not operate. In this case, this section of the circuit will be adapted so we can stop to visit Landshut. Kloster Wetelbug will also be closed in winter, but you will still be able to see it from the outside.Day 6MUNICH - DEPARTUREAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel Options4* MARITIM AIRPORT HOTEL HANNOVER OR SIMILAR4* PENTAHOTEL EISENACH OR SIMILAR4* PENTAHOTEL LEIPZIG OR SIMILAR4* NH NUERNBERG CITY OR SIMILAR4* LEONARDO MUNICH OLIMPIAPARK OR SIMILAR Previous Next123InclusionTravel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Boat: Along the Danube ValleyEvening transfer: Neighborhood of Breweries in MunichTicket admission: Autostadt in Celle, Rammelsberg Mine Museum, Wartburg Castle in Eisenach, Dachau Concentration Camp Museum; BMW WELT in Munich1 Dinner Included in: EisenachAirport pick up and drop off on private basisExclusionTravel InsuranceFlight/ Train ticketsVisa to EuropeAny Entrances other than mentioned Anything not mentioned in inclusions.Departure & Pricing Per person on double sharing basis AED 4550 Departure date: Month Date March 11, 18, 25 Important InformationConfirmation Vouchers & Travel Documents:You will receive the Booking Confirmation with flight ticket within 24 hours of the payment made. Hotel confirmation, Land voucher and travel insurance will be given to you 72 hours prior to departure Please carry your original travel documents while travelling like valid passport with valid UAE residence permit, Emirates Id card, the hard copies of flight ticket, hotel & land confirmation voucher, Vaccination certificate, PCR test if required, travel insurance and other related documents. You are requested to check in online prior to the departureImportant note:Rooms and rates are subject to availability at the time of booking. title: 8 Nights and 9 Days Three Capitals Holiday Package
meta_description: Rayna Tours’ Three Capitals tour package gives you the chance to visit three countries, including Germany, Czech Republic, and Austria. Book this 9-day Europe holiday today.
content: 8 Nights and 9 Days Three Capitals Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBerlinThree CapitalsShareAdd to Wishlist8N / 9D3 ImagesView GalleryThree CapitalsNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as Germany, Czech Republic and Austria on a single holiday! This eight-night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Germany, you will travel through Czech Republic before your break ends in the city of Vienna.ItineraryDay 1BERLINWelcome to Europe! Upon arriving at the airport, we will be waiting to transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details of the welcome meeting with your guide and fellow travelers.Day 2 BERLINmmerse yourself in the local culture with a tour of Berlin, the incredible capital of Germany, accompanied by a local guide. From our coach, you´ll have the chance to see the Museum Island, the Television Tower, the city center’s main shopping streets, the old cathedral destroyed during World War II, the Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag, and the city’s expansive parks. We’ll stop to visit the Holocaust Memorial and the Berlin Wall Memorial Museum—two powerful landmarks that remind us of Germany’s challenging history in the previous century. You’ll have the afternoon free to explore the city at your own pace. In the early evening, we’ll provide a transfer to the lively Kantstrasse area.Day 3BERLIN - DRESDEN - PRAGUEWe’ll journey through forests towards Dresden, a city renowned for its exceptional architectural and artistic heritage, making it one of Germany’s top tourist destinations. You’ll have time to explore some of the impressive palaces and enjoy lunch at one of its many restaurants and coffee shops. Later, we’ll depart for the Czech Republic, arriving in Prague. We’ll head to the Old Town Square, a vibrant area full of energy and tourist activities, ideal for your first experience of Prague. Dine at one of the numerous restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterwards, we’ll return to the hotel.Day 4PRAGUEToday, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 5PRAGUE - MUNICH - INNSBRUCKWe´ll depart early and head to Bavaria, Germany. We’ll arrive in Munich by midday, where you´ll have free time to stroll through the historic city center and enjoy lunch. In the afternoon, we’ll continue to Austria. Upon arrival in the heart of the Alps, you´ll have time to explore Innsbruck, the capital of Tyrol. There will be time for dinner in the Golden Roof area and Old Town.Day 6INNSBRUCK - SALZBURGToday, we’ll visit the Swarovski Museum (admission included), the renowned home of crystals. We’ll explore its impressive gardens and learn how these exquisite crystal pieces are made. Next, you’ll have free time to stroll through the historic center of Innsbruck. Our journey will continue along scenic mountain roads until we reach Kitzbühel, a Tyrolean town famous for its ski resort where you can enjoy snow nearly year-round. This town hosts the legendary Hahnenkamm Race, one of the most prestigious and thrilling alpine skiing events in the world. We´ll reach Salzburg by the end of the day.Day 7SALZBURG - LAKE TRAUNSEE - VIENNAToday, we’ll get to know Austria better. During the morning, we´ll explore Salzburg, Mozart’s city. Its Renaissance and Baroque center is filled with beauty, all in the shadow of the grand castle. Next, we’ll travel through lakes and mountains to reach St. Wolfgang, a renowned pilgrimage site in Austria. Starting and ending in Berlin, the journey includes iconic cities such as Dresden, Leipzig, Hannover, and Eisenach. Travelers will explore UNESCO World Heritage Sites, medieval towns, and famous landmarks like Wartburg Castle and the Berlin Wall. The tour is ideal for those seeking a compact yet enriching experience of Germany.ItineraryDay 1BERLIN ARRIVALWelcome to your tour with Rayna Tours! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2PANORAMIC TOUR OF BERLINImmerse yourself in the local culture with a guided panoramic tour of Berlin, the captivating capital of Germany. We’ll see the historic center, Museum Island, the Reichstag, the Brandenburg Gate, the shopping streets and the city’s beautiful parks. Our visit will also include stops at the Holocaust Memorial and the Berlin Wall Memorial Museum. For an optional excursion, you can visit Potsdam and its stunning palacesDay 3BERLIN - WOLFSBURG - CELLE - HANNOVERWe’ll travel to Lower Saxony and visit Wolfsburg, a city founded in 1938 as a planned settlement for the workers of the Volkswagen factory during the Nazi era. The entire city revolves around the German automobile giant. We’ll include admission to Autostadt, the city of automobiles, featuring gardens and exhibitions. You’ll have time for a walk and lunch. We’ll then continue to Celle, where you can stroll through its old town, known for its half-timbered houses from the 16th and 17th centuries, as well as its imposing Renaissance castle. We’ll arrive in Hannover in the mid-afternoon, where you can explore the capital of Lower Saxony, an important economic, cultural, and scientific hub in the country. Its architecture blends historic and modern buildings, along with extensive parks. Accommodation will be here.Day 4HANNOVER - GOSLAR - GOTTINGEN - BAD SOODEN-ALLENDORF - EISENACHAfter breakfast, we travel to the RAMMELSBERG MINES, a historic silver mining center near Goslar that was exploited since the Middle Ages and has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Entrance to the museum, which tells the story of this mine, is included. We then continue on to GOSLAR, with its magnificent medieval old town, also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, noted for its half-timbered houses, cobblestone streets, and the majestic Church of St. Peter.Our journey continues to GÖTTINGEN, an important university and scientific center where the Brothers Grimm once lived. We will have time for lunch and a stroll through its historic old town. In the afternoon, we head toward Thuringia, stopping in BAD SOODEN, a small and picturesque spa town nestled among mountains and beautifully preserved. Afterwards, we continue to EISENACH, a city with a splendid Baroque and Renaissance old town, home to the Bach House and Luther House. Dinner included.Day 5EISENACH - GOTHA - ERFURT - LEIPZIGWe’ll start the day with a visit to the impressive Wartburg Castle (tickets included), a UNESCO World Heritage Site where Martin Luther translated the New Testament into German. Perched high above the town of Eisenach, this fortress offers not only a journey through German history, but also breathtaking views of the surrounding landscapes.After the visit, we’ll return to Eisenach, where you’ll have free time for lunch and to explore at your own pace. If you’re passionate about music, you might want to visit the Bach House, the birthplace of Johann Sebastian Bach. Alternatively, you can explore the Automobile Museum, located in the former main factory of East Germany’s car industry, home to an impressive collection of vintage vehicles.Our journey will continue to Gotha, where we’ll admire its majestic Baroque palace (exterior visit) and stroll through its charming historic center.We’ll then travel to Erfurt, the capital of Thuringia, a lively city known for its grand cathedral and beautifully preserved medieval old town. One of its highlights is a picturesque bridge lined with houses, continuously inhabited for more than 500 years.By late afternoon, we’ll arrive in Leipzig, one of Germany’s most culturally and historically rich cities. This vibrant metropolis was home to renowned composers such as Bach and Wagner, played a major industrial role during the era of the GDR, and today thrives with a population of over half a million.Day 6LEIPZIG - DRESDEN - MEISSEN - MORITZBURG - BERLINLeaving Leipzig, we’ll stop at the Monument to the Battle of the Nations, inaugurated in 1913 and standing 91 meters tall, commemorating a famous battle from the Napoleonic Wars. We’ll then continue to Dresden, the capital of Saxony, known for its Baroque and Renaissance architecture, grand palaces, and scenic walks along the Elbe River.Nearby is Meissen, renowned for its porcelain, which has been manufactured here since the 18th century. We’ll have time to stroll and enjoy lunch in the old town of this small, lively city, dominated by its large castle and cathedral.In Moritzburg, we’ll take a stroll through “Cinderella’s Castle,” located on an island in an artificial lake, featuring magnificent architecture and expansive gardens.
