We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2PANORAMIC TOUR OF BERLINImmerse yourself in the local culture with a guided panoramic tour of Berlin, the captivating capital of Germany. We’ll see the historic center, Museum Island, the Reichstag, the Brandenburg Gate, the shopping streets and the city’s beautiful parks. Our visit will also include stops at the Holocaust Memorial and the Berlin Wall Memorial Museum. For an optional excursion, you can visit Potsdam and its stunning palaces.Day 3BERLIN - DRESDEN - BAMBERG - NUREMBERGWe’ll travel to Dresden, a city on the River Elbe, where you’ll be able to admire its stunning palace. Then, we’ll head to Bavaria, arriving in Bamberg, a lively and picturesque city—don’t miss Little Venice! Next, we’ll continue to Nuremberg, the second-largest city in Bavaria, renowned for its rich history. We suggest visiting the site where Hitler’s Coliseum once stood.Day 4NUREMBERG - KLOSTER WELTENBURG - DACHAU - MUNICHToday’s journey will be full of surprises. From Kelheim, we’ll board a boat for a short cruise along the Danube valley, passing through the Danube Gorge. Our first stop will be Kloster Weltenburg, a beautiful Benedictine monastery founded in 1040. Next, we’ll visit Dachau, where we’ll tour the Nazi concentration camp museum. After having lunch, we’ll continue to Munich, where we’ll visit the impressive BMW Welt, a modern multifunctional exhibition facility of the prestigious German vehicle brand BMW Group. We’ll also see the park that houses the Olympiastadion, an architectural marvel where the 1972 Olympic Games were held. After this, you’ll have free time in the historic center. You can stroll through Marienplatz, the heart of Munich, visit the picturesque Viktualienmarkt open-air market, relax in the Englischer Garten, or enjoy the traditional beer houses.Note: In winter or when Danube’s water level is too low, the cruise will not operate. In this case, this section of the circuit will be adapted so we can stop to visit Landshut. Kloster Wetelbug will also be closed in winter, but you will still be able to see it from the outside.Day 5MUNICH - FUSSEN - ROTHENBURG - FRANKFURTAmidst alpine summits and breathtaking scenery, we’ll travel to Füssen and the Neuschwanstein Castle. We’ll take a bus to Mary’s Bridge to admire the fantastic views of the gorge. From here, you can either return on foot or by horse carriage (not included). Continuing along our Romantic Road, we’ll head to Rothenburg, a picturesque walled city where we’ll visit the beautiful Christmas Museum (admission included). We’ll then head to Frankfurt, Germany’s financial capital.Day 6FRANKFURT - CRUISE ON THE RHINE - COLOGNE - DORTMUNDToday, we’ll explore the Rhine and Moselle Valleys, two rivers full of history and dotted with charming villages. We´ll begin with a short cruise on the Rhine, between the villages of Rüdesheim and Sankt Goar, undoubtedly the most picturesque section of the river. Next, we’ll head to the Moselle River, stopping for lunch in Cochem, a picturesque village on the Rhine riverbank overlooked by its imposing castle, which dates back over a thousand years. Afterward, we’ll travel to Cologne, where you´ll have time to visit its impressive Gothic cathedral. Standing at 154 meters tall, it was the tallest building in the world until the late 19th century. You can also enjoy a walk along the Rhine River and through the lively city center before we continue to our hotel in Dortmund.Note: During fairs or congresses, accommodation may be in a nearby city.Day 7DORTMUND - FAIRY TALE ROUTE - HANNOVERToday, we’ll embark on a magical journey, reminiscing about our favorite childhood stories and movies as we travel through the towns that inspired the Brothers Grimm, now known as the Fairy Tale Route. Our first stop will be Trendelburg, a picturesque walled village where we’ll visit the large medieval castle and its famous Rapunzel Tower (admission included).We’ll continue along scenic roads, crossing forests that will remind us of the tale of Hansel and Gretel. We’ll stop for lunch in Höxter, a vibrant town where we’ll visit Corvey Abbey, an ancient 9th-century monastery and World Heritage Site (admission included). We’ll then stop in Polle to visit the ruins of Cinderella’s Castle (admission included). Our journey will continue to Hamelin, renowned for the tale of “The Pied Piper of Hamelin”. After following the mouse tracks, we’ll proceed to Hanover, where there will be time to take a stroll near the old town hall.Notes: -During fairs or conferences, accommodation may be arranged in a nearby city.-Corvey Abbey is closed from November to February.Day 8HANNOVER - GOSLAR - BERLINAfter breakfast, our route will continue to Goslar, one of the most beautiful villages in Germany with wooden architecture, ancient walls, and squares. You´ll have time to explore. Next, we proceed to Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage Site celebrated for its historic center with over 2,100 half-timbered houses that have remained nearly unscathed for centuries. meta_description: Book a 7 days Kuala Lumpur Langkawi holiday package with hotels, sightseeing, island tours and smooth transfers for a perfect Malaysia trip.
content: 7 Days Kuala Lumpur & Langkawi Holiday Package | Book NowHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysKuala LumpurBest Of Kuala Lumpur And LangkawiShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7D4 ImagesView GalleryBest of Kuala lumpur and LangkawiNewSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersHotelsOverviewFrom the dynamic skyline of Kuala Lumpur to the tranquil beaches of Langkawi, this 6-day journey is designed to immerse you in the best of Malaysia. Walk among the clouds atop the KL Tower, chase adrenaline at Sunway Lagoon, ascend the cool peaks of Genting Highlands, and unwind under the golden hues of a Langkawi sunset cruise. Let your days be filled with vibrant culture, natural wonders, exciting activities, and moments of pure tropical serenity.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Kuala Lumpur + City Tour with KL Tower Observation DeckArrive in the vibrant city of Kuala Lumpur, where your adventure begins. Upon landing at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, you’ll be greeted by our representative and transferred to your hotel, Ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Fraser Business Park or Similar. After checking in and refreshing, head out for an afternoon panoramic city tour. Capture the charm and heritage of KL as you visit iconic landmarks like Merdeka Square, the Petronas Twin Towers (photo stop), the grand Istana Negara (King’s Palace), the impressive National Mosque, and local gems such as the Handicraft Centre and Chocolate Factory. The highlight of the day is a visit to the KL Tower Observation Deck, where you'll enjoy panoramic 360° views of the city skyline from one of the tallest towers in the world. As the sun sets, spend your evening at leisure - explore nearby malls, sample local street food, or chill out at a café in the heart of Malaysia’s bustling capital.Day 2Full-Day Thrills at Sunway Lagoon Theme ParkAfter breakfast, get ready for a full day of wild fun and water-fueled adrenaline at Sunway Lagoon, Malaysia’s most exciting theme park. With access to six different themed zones, you and the boys can spend the day conquering water slides, wave pools, and heart-pounding rides. Feel the rush at the Extreme Park, chill at the Water Park, wander through the Wildlife Park, and take on unique experiences like the Nickelodeon Lost Lagoon. Whether you're racing down rides or floating on lazy rivers, this is your day to unleash your inner kid and make some unforgettable memories. As the sun sets, head back to the hotel for a relaxed evening. You might want to hit up one of KL’s lively night markets or rooftop lounges to keep the energy going.Day 3Genting Highlands + Batu Caves + Skytropolis Indoor Theme ParkFuel up at breakfast and prepare for a day trip filled with scenic views, culture, and fun at altitude. First, make a brief stop at the famous Batu Caves—a towering limestone hill with colorful steps leading up to sacred Hindu temples and the iconic golden Lord Murugan statue. After capturing some Instagram-worthy shots, continue to Genting Highlands, Malaysia’s most famous hill resort. Board a two-way cable car ride offering stunning aerial views of the rainforest below as you glide toward the mountaintop. Once there, explore Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park, a futuristic amusement zone packed with rides, games, and entertainment. Test your skills, scream on a ride, or just vibe out with your crew. After a thrilling day in the cool mountain air, return to Kuala Lumpur in the evening for one last night in the city.Day 4Fly to Langkawi + Check-In + Sunset Dinner Cruise (Sharing)This morning, enjoy breakfast and check out of your hotel before heading to the airport for your short flight to Langkawi, the jewel of Malaysia’s west coast. Upon arrival, transfer to your beachfront accommodation at Bayview Hotel Langkawi. After settling in, get ready for a stunning evening as you embark on a shared sunset dinner cruise. Sail through the calm waters of the Andaman Sea aboard a luxury catamaran while soaking in golden-hour views, grooving to music, and indulging in a delicious BBQ dinner on deck. Relax in the saltwater Jacuzzi net, toast to the good life, and enjoy the laid-back, tropical vibes with your crew. This is what bachelor trips were made for.Day 5Langkawi City Tour + SkyCab Cable Car ComboStart your day with breakfast, followed by a half-day Langkawi city tour that takes you through the island’s most iconic spots. Visit the majestic Eagle Square (Dataran Lang), a symbol of Langkawi, and browse local crafts and souvenirs at Atma Alam Batik Village. Enjoy a bit of retail therapy at Kuah Town and explore the island’s duty-free shopping scene. Then, gear up for an exciting experience with the Langkawi Cable Car Combo—ride the SkyCab to the peak of Gunung Mat Cincang, walk along the gravity-defying Sky Bridge, and visit attractions like the 3D Art Museum, SkyDome, and SkyRex. It’s a mix of thrills, views, and interactive fun. The evening is yours to chill - whether it's sipping cocktails by the beach, hitting a bar, or just lounging under the stars.Day 6Mangrove Tour + Optional Water SportsOn your final day in paradise, you’ll dive into nature with a thrilling Mangrove Tour at Kilim Geoforest Park. Hop on a boat and cruise through mangrove forests, limestone caves, and hidden lagoons. Watch majestic eagles swoop across the sky, explore Bat Caves, and visit floating fish farms. Later, head to the beach for some action-packed optional water sports. Recommendation:- You can enjoy water sports activity such as Jet sking, Banana boat ride or parasailing with panoramic island tour.Day 7Departure from Langkawi - Until Next TimeWake up to your final morning in tropical paradise and soak in the last moments of island serenity. After breakfast, check out from Bayview Hotel Langkawi and transfer to Langkawi International Airport for your return flight. As you fly out, carry with you unforgettable memories—towering city skylines, wild rides, golden sunsets, and the kind of laughter only a bachelor trip brings. title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Prague to Paris Tour Package
meta_description: Enjoy a fantastic journey from Prague to Paris with this amazing tour package. Your holiday starts in Prague and continues to Pilsen, Rothenburg, Frankfurt, Cologne, Amsterdam, Bruges, and finally Paris.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Prague to Paris Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysParisFrom Prague To ParisShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryFrom Prague to ParisNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as the Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and France, on a single holiday! This seven-night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Prague, you will travel through Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Brussels, and Bruges before your break ends in the city of lights, Paris.ItineraryDay 1PRAGUETODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Welcome to Prague! Upon arriving at the airport, we’ll transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide.In the evening, we’ll transfer you to the Old Town Square, a lively area bustling with tourist activity. You can enjoy dinner at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterward, there will be a return transfer to the hotel.Day 2PRAGUETODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 3PRAGUE - PILSEN - ROTHENBURG - FRANKFURT We’ll depart early from Prague and stop in Pilsen, in western Bohemia, a city renowned for its beer. You’ll have time to stroll through its historic center, where you’ll find the Old Town Square, the cathedral, the Plague Column, and a Renaissance-era town hall. We’ll then cross into Germany and follow part of the Romantic Road. We’ll visit Rothenburg, a town that seems to come straight out of a fairy tale and is considered one of the most beautiful villages in the country. Afterward, we’ll head to Frankfurt, the financial capital of Germany. After our arrival in the evening, enjoy free time in the historic city center, where you’ll find a wide variety of restaurants offering Indian, Asian, Italian, and international cuisines.Day 4FRANKFURT - CRUISE ON THE RIVER RHINE - COLOGNE - AMSTERDAM TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll take a scenic cruise on the Rhine between the villages of Rüdesheim and St. Goar, the river’s most picturesque section. After that, we’ll travel to Cologne, known for its immense Gothic cathedral. Then, we’ll head to Holland, arriving in Amsterdam in the evening.Day 5AMSTERDAM TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll be visiting some very picturesque spots - the Holland of our dreams. We’ll start by visiting Zaanse Schans, known for its windmills, canals, and houses. Next, we’ll explore Volendam, a picturesque fishing village. A short boat trip from Volendam will take us to Marken, an island connected to the mainland by a dike, where the houses are built on stilts. Afterward, we’ll head to Amsterdam for a panoramic tour of the city, including its narrow canals, official buildings, and parks. We’ll also see a diamond-cutting demonstration. For dinner, you’ll have time in Rembrandtplein, an area with numerous international restaurants, located near the Red Light District, celebrated for its progressive values.Day 6AMSTERDAM - BRUGES - PARIS We will head to Bruges, a charming medieval city often called the "Venice of the North" because of its scenic canals. The city offers a magical atmosphere with its cobblestone streets, historic buildings, and romantic bridges. If you’d like, you can climb the Belfry Tower for stunning views. How about trying some Belgian chocolate? Or perhaps you´d prefer a local craft beer? We will then continue our journey to Paris, arriving by the end of the day.Day 7PARIS We’ll immerse ourselves in the rich history of France at the magnificent Palace of Versailles (admission not included), renowned for its stunning gardens. On our return to Paris, we’ll visit Montmartre, where a cable car (included) will take us up to this charming bohemian neighborhood, famous for its artists, painters, and cabarets. To fully appreciate the grandeur of Paris, we’ll embark on a panoramic city tour with a local guide, showcasing the city’s impressive avenues and iconic monuments. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel. For those interested, there is an optional variety show in the evening.Day 8PARISWe’ll start our day in central Paris, beginning with a visit to the iconic Eiffel Tower. You´ll have the chance to go up to the second floor of this famous iron landmark (tickets included). Afterwards, we’ll enjoy a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine, which will last approximately one hour and fifteen minutes. You’ll have a free afternoon to explore the city at your own pace.Note: If wait times at the Eiffel Tower are too long, we might reschedule the visit to a different time (or on Sunday) for your convenience.Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of your flight in case you might need an additional night.Hotel OptionsAny from title: Udaipur and Mount Abu Tour Package | Lakes, Hills & Heritage!
meta_description: Explore romantic Udaipur and scenic Mount Abu with a tour package covering lakes, palaces, hill views and cultural attractions.
content: Udaipur and Mount Abu Tour Package | Lakes, Hills & Heritage!HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysUdaipurThe Majestic Duo Udaipur And Mount Abu EleganceShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryThe Majestic Duo Udaipur and Mount Abu EleganceNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewExperience Rajasthan’s timeless beauty and regal artistry with this all-inclusive holiday. From Mount Abu’s marvelous settings to the regal allure of Udaipur, this four-day holiday promises experiences of a lifetime. Take in the Dilwara Jain Temples’ architectural brilliance, Eklingji’s spiritual aura, Udaipur’s unrivaled beauty, and Lake Pichola’s astonishing landscapes. It includes comfortable stays, meals, and convenient transfers for a hassle-free exploration from start to finish. ItineraryDay 1Arrival - Mount Abuoff your holiday as you land at Rajasthan’s tranquil hill station, Mount Abu. Following a smooth transfer and hotel check Kick -in, relax in your room or step out to absorb the refreshing mountain breeze. Later, explore the stunning yet mysterious Nakki Lake. You’ll also head to Sunset Point to catch the compelling views of the sun dipping to the horizon against the Aravalli ranges. Overnight stay in Mount abuDay 2Mount Abu - Local SightseeingYour second day begins with a trip to the magnificent Dilwara Jain Temples, an architectural splendor with elaborate marble carvings and spiritual serenity. Next, proceed to Guru Shikhar, the highest peak of the Aravalli range, and Toad Rock, one of the region’s most fascinating natural formations. A visit to Honeymoon Point follows; its majestic views and mind blowing settings make for a truly romantic experience. Explore Mount Abu’s local markets before you end your day. Overnight Stay in Mount Abu Day 3Drive to Udaipur; En route Visit Eklingji Temple & Haldighati MemorialAfter hotel check-out, join our representative for a stress-free drive to Rajasthan’s royal city, Udaipur. Stop at the venerated Eklingji Temple, a centuries-old shrine devoted to Lord Shiva, and then tour the historic Haldighati Memorial, which honors the legendary battle fought between Maharana Pratap and the Mughal forces. With the mighty Aravalli hills in the background, this memorial is a tribute to the Rajputs’ courage and sacrifice. overnight Stay in UdaipurDay 4Udaipur - Local SightseeingToday, set out on a full-day tour of Udaipur. Known as the birthplace of the Renaissance, it is home to masterpieces that shape the world's cultural landscape. Whether you're an art aficionado or simply someone looking to bask in its historic charm, this guide serves as your companion to exploring this captivating city and choosing the right Florence travel packages, particularly for travelers from India and the UAE.Popular Florence Tour PackagesWhen traveling from India or the UAE, exploring Florence packages can provide convenience and curated experiences. And some of our most popular all-inclusive holidays are: Popular PackagesWhen traveling from India or the UAE, exploring Florence packages can provide convenience and curated experiences. And some of our most popular all-inclusive holidays are: Packages by ThemeFlorence is set amidst the picturesque landscapes of Tuscany, seamlessly merges its rich Renaissance heritage with modern Italian charm. So browse our themed Florence tour packages that promise memorable journeys through the heart of Italy's artistic and scenic charm.Classic Florence Tour: This 5-day package is perfect for first-time visitors, featuring guided tours of Florence's most renowned attractions. Guests will marvel at masterpieces in the Uffizi Gallery and explore Michelangelo's David at the Accademia Gallery. Additionally, the package includes a comprehensive walking tour of the historical center, ensuring travelers uncover the city's vibrant history and culture.Romantic Tuscany Escape: Crafted especially for couples seeking a romantic getaway, this package combines the allure of Florence with the charm of Tuscany's rolling hills. Couples can enjoy intimate experiences including wine-tasting sessions in the renowned Chianti region, allowing them to savor the rich flavors that this iconic area has to offer.Family Discovery: Designed with family fun in mind, this package offers activities that will delight guests of all ages. Families will enjoy visits to local amusement parks and engage in interactive workshops at various museums. A highlight of this package is the exciting day trip to nearby Pisa, where families can discover the wonders beyond Florence.Adventure and Outdoors: For those who crave active pursuits, this package provides thrilling outdoor experiences. Travelers can embark on biking tours along the scenic Arno River and explore the lush hiking trails in the Tuscan countryside. This is ideal for adventure seekers ready to experience the natural beauty and invigorating landscapes just outside the city.Why Rayna Tours and Travels Florence is a destination that promises to captivate and inspire travelers with its harmonious blend of history, culture, and modern-day allure. Our Florence holiday packages are thoughtfully designed to offer personalized and memorable experiences, ensuring your trip is everything you imagined and more. Here's why you should choose our Florence holiday packages:Immaculately Curated Experiences: Each of our packages is crafted by a team of local experts who are passionate about sharing the hidden gems and renowned highlights of Florence and the Tuscan region. This ensures that your travel itinerary will include both the iconic landmarks and the lesser-known treasures that make Florence truly special.Customized Itineraries: Understanding that every traveler has unique interests, we offer the flexibility to personalize your experience. Whether you're an art enthusiast eager to explore the Renaissance masterpieces, a foodie keen on diving into Italian culinary delights, or an outdoor aficionado ready to explore Tuscany's landscapes, there is a package tailored just for you.Unforgettable Culinary Adventures: Florence is as much a feast for the taste buds as it is for the eyes. Our packages include exclusive culinary experiences, from private wine-tasting tours in the Chianti region to authentic Tuscan cooking classes. You'll have the opportunity to savor delicious local specialties that will leave a lasting impression.Hassle-Free Travel Planning: Leave the complexities of travel planning to us. Our comprehensive packages take care of accommodation, guided tours, and transportation, allowing you to focus entirely on enjoying your journey. We handle every detail, providing you with peace of mind and the ability to fully immerse yourself in the magic of Florence.Enriching Cultural Experiences: Experience Florence through the lens of its vibrant culture and history. Our themed tours bring you closer to the city's essence, with immersive activities and storytelling by knowledgeable guides who bring history to life. This depth of cultural immersion ensures you leave with a deeper understanding and appreciation of this timeless city.Exceptional Customer Service: From the moment you inquire about our Florence holiday packages, our dedicated customer service team is here to assist you. We prioritize your comfort and satisfaction, ensuring that your travel experience is smooth, enjoyable, and exceeds expectations.Best Time to Visit FlorenceNo matter when you choose to visit, Florence's rich art, history, and culinary experiences promise a rewarding and memorable journey.Spring (March to May): Spring is a delightful time to explore Florence. The weather is mild, and the city is in full bloom, casting a romantic ambiance over its historic streets and gardens. This season offers an ideal climate for walking tours and outdoor activities, making it perfect for those eager to experience Florence's natural beauty and vibrant cultural events.Fall (September to November): Autumn in Florence brings cooler temperatures and a stunning palette of seasonal colors. The post-summer dip in tourist crowds allows for a more intimate exploration of the city's landmarks and museums. October, in particular, is a favorite among visitors, merging pleasant weather with the grape harvest season in nearby vineyards.Summer (June to August): Summer is marked by bustling energy and numerous cultural festivals. While it can be crowded and hot, especially in July and August, it's the best season for those who enjoy lively atmospheres and extended daylight hours. Booking in advance and planning early morning or evening excursions can help beat the heat and crowds.Winter (December to February): Visiting Florence in winter brings a different perspective. The cooler temperatures and off-peak tourist season translate to more affordable accommodations and fewer crowds at popular attractions. The festive holiday decor and events add a charming touch to the city, making it a cozy destination for winter travelers.Quick GuideTop AttractionsFlorence Cathedral: An architectural marvel that dominates the city's skyline, the Florence Cathedral, or Cattedrale di Santa Maria del Fiore, is renowned for its exceptional beauty and historical significance. Its iconic red-tiled dome, engineered by Filippo Brunelleschi, was a groundbreaking feat of architecture during the Renaissance and remains one of Italy's most admired features. Accademia Gallery: Home to the illustrious David statue by Michelangelo, the Accademia Gallery is a must-visit for art enthusiasts. Beyond this iconic masterpiece, the gallery houses a superb collection of Renaissance art that provides insight into the period's cultural and artistic richness. Exploring the gallery allows visitors to delve into Michelangelo's process and appreciate the detailed craftsmanship that has rendered his David one of the world’s most famous sculptures.Piazza della Signoria: This lively square is the political hub of Florence and boasts a vibrant atmosphere perfect for people-watching. Surrounded by notable landmarks such as the Palazzo Vecchio and the Uffizi Gallery, the square serves as an open-air museum with statues and fountains that depict significant historical events and mythological tales. Santa Croce: Known for its exquisitely decorated chapels, Santa Croce is one of Florence’s most significant churches, often dubbed the "Temple of the Italian Glories." It is the final resting place of some of Italy's most illustrious figures, including Michelangelo, Galileo, and Machiavelli. Visitors can explore its tranquil cloisters, admire its stunning frescoes, and learn about the lives and contributions of the literary and scientific giants interred there.CultureFlorence is not merely a city to visit; it's a city to experience. Its cultural vitality is palpable in every corner, inviting you to immerse yourself fully in its artistic and historical splendor. From exploring its iconic landmarks to engaging with the local traditions and lifestyles, Florence promises a cultural journey that is both illuminating and unforgettable.CuisineFlorentine culture is best savored through its cuisine, which reflects the bounty and simplicity of Tuscan produce. Enjoying a meal of "bistecca alla Fiorentina" in a rustic trattoria or sipping a glass of Chianti amid the backdrop of bustling street life offers insight into the city's social fabric. Gathering over food is a cherished tradition, embodying the warmth and hospitality that Florence is known for.Practical Travel TipsEuro (€) is the local currency. Italian is predominantly spoken but most people in the tourism industry speak English.Florence is pedestrian-friendly. Biking is also a popular option, while buses are efficient for longer distances.Florence is generally safe for tourists; however, be cautious of pickpockets, especially in crowded areas.Florence is famous for its leather goods, so consider purchasing a handcrafted purse or jacket. The San Lorenzo Market is a popular spot for shopping, but don't hesitate to explore smaller artisan shops for unique finds.Visa & DocumentationFor Indian Travelers: Indian nationals require a Schengen Visa to visit Italy. It's advisable to apply at least a month before your planned travel dates. The application process involves submitting financial proofs, travel insurance, and confirmed travel itineraries.For UAE Travelers: UAE nationals need a Schengen Visa, however, the process is streamlined with assistance available from numerous visa service providers.Rayna Tours and Travels Visa Assistance Our international visa packages are both comprehensive and client-focused. From initial consultation to the final visa stamping, they offer step-by-step guidance, making the entire process stress-free. Whether you have questions about the required documentation or need assistance with filling out forms, their dedicated team is always ready to help.Top Things to Do in FlorenceExplore the Uffizi Gallery: Home to works by Leonardo da Vinci, Botticelli, and Michelangelo, the Uffizi Gallery is a treasure trove of Renaissance art, significant for understanding the depths of Western art history.Ascend the Duomo: Climbing the Dome of the Florence Cathedral offers not only insight into architectural ingenuity but also a stunning panoramic view of the city.Visit the Ponte Vecchio: This medieval stone bridge is an iconic Florence landmark. Known for its shops selling jewelry, it's a perfect spot for a romantic sunset walk.Wander through Boboli Gardens: These historical gardens behind the Pitti Palace provide a serene escape with fountains, sculptures, and meticulously manicured hedges.How to Reach FlorenceWhether you prefer the speed of flying, the convenience of trains, or the flexibility of driving, reaching Florence is an accessible and rewarding start to your Tuscan adventure.By Air: Amerigo Vespucci Airport (FLR) is Florence’s main airport, also known as Peretola, It’s located approximately 4 km northwest of the city center. It offers connections to major European cities. By Rail: Santa Maria Novella Station (SMN) is Florence’s primary train station is centrally located and well-connected with Italy's high-speed train network. High-speed trains from major Italian cities like Rome, Milan, and Venice offer a quick and scenic journey to Florence. Trenitalia and Italo are the two main operators, providing frequent services with varying levels of comfort and pricing. Booking in advance can secure lower prices, especially for high-speed trains.By Road: If you prefer driving, the A1 Highway (Autostrada del Sole) connects Florence to major Italian cities. This route offers a picturesque drive through the Tuscan countryside. Be prepared for tolls and consider parking outside the city center to avoid ZTL (Restricted Traffic Zones). meta_description: Discover Mauritius in six nights on this all-encompassing holiday, with thrilling North and South tours, plus a full day at Ile Aux Cerf. Contact our specialists to book now or for more information.
content: Mauritius Family Holiday Package: 5 Nights 6 Days TripHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMauritiusExplore MauritiusShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D4 ImagesView GalleryExplore MauritiusNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewForget all hassles of planning an immaculate holiday with our all-inclusive getaway amid Mauritius’ pristine beaches and marvelous natural wonders. Every aspect of your five-day holiday is taken care, from airport transfers and accommodations to sightseeing tours that journey you to its impressive landscapes.ItineraryDay 1ArrivalArrive at Sir S. Ramgoolam International Airport & transfer to hotel. Check in to Hotel. Day free for Leisure. Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.Day 2Full Day Ile Aux Cerf Tour (Beach Day)After having breakfast you’ll be doing The Île Aux Cerfs Island Tour is a spectacular full-day getaway to one of Mauritius’s most picturesque and adventure-filled destinations, located off the island’s east coast. The tour typically begins with a scenic speedboat or catamaran ride from Trou d’Eau Douce, often including a stop at the stunning Grand River South East Waterfall for photos and sightseeing. Upon arrival at Île Aux Cerfs, visitors are greeted with powdery white sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and a wide array of water sports and adventure activities. Thrill-seekers can enjoy parasailing, undersea walking, tube rides, kayaking, and more, while others may choose to swim, snorkel, or simply relax under the palm trees. The island also features the prestigious Île Aux Cerfs Golf Club, set against a backdrop of ocean views and tropical greenery. Many tours include a delicious BBQ lunch served on the beach or a nearby islet, often accompanied by refreshing drinks and local entertainment such as Sega dance performances. Whether you're looking for adrenaline-pumping fun or a tranquil beach escape, the Île Aux Cerfs tour offers the perfect mix of nature, relaxation, and adventure in a truly idyllic setting. Return to the mainland by speedboat and enjoy unperturbed transportation back to your accommodation.Overnight stay at Hotel.Day 3Full Day North TourToday, have breakfast & you will be doing The North Island Tour of Mauritius offers a rich blend of culture, history, and natural beauty in a full-day guided experience. The tour begins in the vibrant capital city of Port Louis, where you’ll discover landmarks such as the historic Champ de Mars racecourse, the Government House, and the Cathedral of St. Louis, followed by a visit to the bustling Central Market, famous for its local spices, handicrafts, and street food. A stop at the popular Caudan Waterfront allows time for shopping, exploring local boutiques, and enjoying the waterfront ambiance. You’ll then head to the elevated Citadel Fort Adelaide, offering panoramic views of Port Louis and its harbor — perfect for photography. The tour’s main highlight is the renowned Pamplemousses Botanical Garden, one of the oldest in the Southern Hemisphere, celebrated for its giant water lilies, rare palm species, and lush tropical vegetation. An optional stop at L’Aventure du Sucre (Sugar Museum) provides insights into Mauritius’s sugarcane heritage, along with tastings of unrefined sugars and local rum. The day ends in the coastal town of Grand Baie, a popular beach destination where you can relax by the sea, enjoy a seaside lunch, or indulge in some shopping. Return to Hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.Day 4Full Day South Tour (Nature & Adventure Tour)The Scenic South Island Tour of Mauritius is an exhilarating full-day journey through the island’s most breathtaking natural wonders and cultural landmarks. The adventure begins at Trou aux Cerfs, a dormant volcanic crater offering 360° panoramic views of lush forests and nearby towns. From there, the tour heads to Grand Bassin (Ganga Talao), a sacred Hindu lake nestled in the highlands, where the towering 33-meter statue of Lord Shiva and surrounding temples create a serene spiritual atmosphere. As you descend through winding mountain roads, you'll enter the stunning Black River Gorges National Park, a haven for hikers and nature lovers, known for its lush rainforest, waterfalls, and endemic wildlife. One of the key highlights is the spectacular Chamarel Waterfall, plunging from a height of 100 meters amidst dense greenery, followed by a visit to the world-famous Chamarel Seven Colored Earths, where surreal sand dunes in red, yellow, violet, and brown hues form a natural geological wonder. For those seeking a touch of thrill, optional activities like ziplining, quad biking, or rum tasting at a local Chamarel distillery can be added. This tour blends scenic beauty, cultural exploration, and adventure, making it ideal for travelers who want to immerse themselves in Mauritius’s wild, untouched south. Overnight stay at Hotel.Day 5Full day at Leisure in MauritiusToday After breakfast day free you can opt Mauritius Shopping Centre Bagatelle - Mall of Mauritius and overnight stay at hotel.Day 6DepartureToday, after relishing your final moments in the hotel, complete the check-out procedures before our team promptly transports you to the airport for your onward journey.Hotel Options4* Ambre Hotel or Similar4* Ambre Hotel or Similar4* Ambre Hotel or SimilarInclusion05 Night Accommodation in Mauritius at hotel mentioned below or similarDaily Breakfast and Dinner02-way Airport transfers on Sharing basisFull day City Tour - North Tour on Sharing basis (Operates- Mondays & Thursdays)Full day South Island Tour on sharing basis (Operates- Wednesday & Saturday)Full day Ile aux Cerfs tour on Sharing basis (Operates- Tuesday & Fridays)All Sightseeing tours as per itinerary with comfortable vehicles on Sharing basisEnglish speaking driver throughout the tourAll applicable local taxesTravel InsuranceReturn Flights from Dubai with 02 Piece check in baggage ExclusionFlight ticketMeal other than mentioned Any Entrance Fees, unless specifiedEarly check-in & Late Check-outVisa ChargesAnything not mentioned in inclusionsNote:Rooms are subject to availability at the time of bookingIn case the mentioned hotel is not available we will give alternate optionsRates are not valid festive/blackout datesDeparture & Pricing City Hotel Room Type Meals Mauritius (5N) 4* Ambre Mauritius Superior Sea Facing Breakfast & Dinner Package Cost: Per Person Per Adult on Double/Twin sharing INR 56,999/- Flights Details Date From To Flight No. Dept. content: 3 Nights and 4 Days Scenic Mauritius PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMauritiusScenic MauritiusShareAdd to Wishlist3N / 4D3 ImagesView GalleryScenic MauritiusNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewForget all hassles of planning an immaculate holiday with our all-inclusive getaway amid Mauritius’ pristine beaches and marvelous natural wonders. Every aspect of your five-day holiday is taken care, from airport transfers and accommodations to sightseeing tours that journey you to its impressive landscapes. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in MauritiusWelcome to the land of endless bliss! Your Mauritius holiday begins with your arrival at the airport. After a warm meet and greet, our representative will transport you to the hotel, allowing you to kick off your holiday in this island paradise on a stress-free note. Check in to your room and the day at your leisure. Day 2North TourToday, you will step out for a fascinating North Tour. This guided excursion will lead you to Mauritius' capital, Port Louis. Visit the citadel fort, surrounded by exquisite city views, and go on a shopping spree at the renowned Caudan Water Front. An orientation city tour of Port Louis will introduce you to the city's unmissable sights like the high court building, Port Louis Theatre, colonial-era French structures, the Catholic church, and the mosque. Delve into the island's historical significance with a visit to Aapravasi Ghat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site steeped in history. You will also stop at Kuanfu Tea Factory to appreciate the art of tea production. Make sure you choose comfortable clothing and shoes for an enjoyable day. Day 3 Scenic SouthOn day three, you will tour Mauritius' Scenic South. It begins with a drive to the remarkable Grand Bassin, also known as the Sacred Lake, where you'll encounter the majestic 108ft statue of Lord Shiva. Continue your adventure through Plaine Champagne, passing by the Bassin Blanc, an extinct volcanic crater, and make your way to the Valley of Colours. Thrill-seekers can partake in a range of exhilarating, optional land activities such as crossing the Nepalese bridge, zip-lining, and enjoying a Jeep ride (all activities at optional cost and subject to availability). Next, you will check out the Model Ship Factory and explore the dormant volcano of Trou Aux Cerfs, offering a panoramic viewpoint. Remember to wear light clothes and comfy shoes to get the best out of this tour. Day 4 DepartureToday, you will bid adieu to this gorgeous island destination. title: 5 Nights and 6 Days Russia Tour Package
meta_description: Immerse yourself in Russia’s rich blend of timeless culture, enlightening history, and astonishing modernity, thanks to our all-inclusive, five-night Majestic Russia. But don’t wait; secure your spot now.
content: 5 Nights and 6 Days Russia Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMoscowMajestic RussiaShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D7 ImagesView GalleryMajestic RussiaNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewJoin us for a refreshing holiday in Russia! The six-day getaway invites you to revel in the region’s mix of breathtaking natural beauty, legendary cultural riches, and fantastic leisure choices. It promises the utmost convenience, with accommodations, guided sightseeing tours, and prompt airport transfers all included in the package.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Moscow- Arbat street and shopping tour- Overnight in MoscowUpon your arrival at Moscow Domodedovo International Airport (DME), meet our representative, who will escort you to the vehicle and transfer you to the hotel in Moscow.After that be ready for the walking tour of Old Arbat Street and shopping, one of the oldest and most culturally rich streets in Moscow. Known for its artistic vibe, Old Arbat is home to street performers, local craftsmen, and quaint cafes. It has been a favorite of poets, writers, and artists for centuries. You’ll enjoy the street’s vibrant energy while browsing its souvenir shops and discovering the historic charm that makes Arbat Street a must-see for visitors.Overnight in Moscow.Day 2Moscow city tour & Transfer to St PetersburgAfter Breakfast, checkout from the Hotel. Get ready for Moscow city tour. Uncover the timeless grandeur of Russia’s most iconic fortress with our Kremlin Architectural Highlights Tour, complete with a professional guide experience. This immersive journey through the heart of Moscow’s Kremlin offers a deep dive into its monumental cathedrals, imperial symbols, and architectural brilliance.Begin at the legendary Cathedral Square, where centuries of history come alive through majestic medieval structures. Marvel at the towering Ivan the Great Bell Tower, and stand before the immense Tsar Cannon and Tsar Bell—testaments to Russian ingenuity and power.Your tour includes entrance to two of the Kremlin’s most historically significant cathedrals, each revealing a chapter of Russia’s religious and architectural evolution. With expertly curated audio commentary, you’ll gain rich insights into the stories, artistry, and symbolism behind these sacred landmarks.Whether you're a history enthusiast or first-time visitor, this experience offers the perfect balance of education, awe, and cultural depth.Make your way to the meeting point and prepare for an unforgettable tour through the heart of Moscow. Begin with a guided walking tour of the legendary Red Square, a symbol of Russia's rich history. Marvel at the architectural brilliance of St. Basil's Cathedral, with its colorful domes and intricate designs, and explore the grandeur of GUM, the iconic shopping center filled with luxury stores and cafes.Continue your journey along Nikolskaya Street, a lively and picturesque area lined with charming boutiques and local shops, perfect for finding unique souvenirs or simply soaking in the vibrant atmosphere. Cap off your day at Vokrug Sveta Gastromarket, a culinary haven where you’ll enjoy a variety of delicious dishes ranging from traditional Russian cuisine to international flavors. Whether you're a history enthusiast, a foodie, or a shopping lover, this tour offers the perfect mix of culture, indulgence, and discovery.Explore the heart of Moscow with our comprehensive city tour, featuring stops at iconic Red Square and Sparrow Hills for breathtaking panoramic views of the city. Depending on time and circumstances, we may also include visits to Christ the Savior Cathedral with its magnificent Patriarshy Bridge, the historic Novodevichy Convent, and the modern Moscow City business district. As the tours ends, you will be transferred to the St Petesburg by high-speed train, meet our representative, who will escort you to the vehicle and transfer you to the hotel in St Petersburg. Overnight in St Petersburg.Day 3St Petersburg city tour with Paul Fortress tour & River cruiseThis morning, your day kicks off with a tour of St Petersburg city with Paul Fortress, with a friendly guide in town. Venture on a captivating journey through the heart of St. Petersburg at Peter and Paul Fortress, the city's original settlement. This historic complex offers a fascinating blend of attractions that showcase the city's rich past.Admire the stunning architecture of the Cathedral of the Saint Apostles Peter and Paul, the final resting place for many Russian tsars. Delve into the history of St. Petersburg through exhibits and artifacts housed in the Commandant's House Museum. Explore the fascinating world of engineering and technology at the Engineer's House Museum. Discover the achievements of Russian cosmonauts and learn about space exploration at the Museum of Space Exploration. Witness the intricate process of minting coins and printing paper money at the Mint and Printing Workshops. Take a chilling tour of Trubetskoy Bastion Prison, a symbol of St. Petersburg's darker past. Admire the impressive architecture of the Neva Curtain Wall Archway, a historic gateway to the fortress.After Lunch proceed to River cruise. Embark on a relaxing river and canal cruise, gliding through the city’s picturesque waterways. Admire the elegant bridges, historic landmarks, and awe-inspiring architecture that define St. Petersburg’s charm. This scenic journey offers a unique perspective of the city’s grandeur.Overnight in St Petersburg.Day 4Day at Leisure & Transfer to MoscowToday, you will have an entire day to craft your own travel program. Yes, you can discover the city & surrounding area at your own pace or you can opt for an optional tour like Excursion Hermitage or Peterhoff lower park.In the evening you will be transferred to the Moscow by high-speed train, meet our representative who will escort you to the vehicle and transfer you to the hotel in Moscow.Overnight in Moscow.Day 5Izmaylovo Kremlin and Vernissage tour & VDNH park tour + Moscow Metro tourToday After Breakfast, you will set out for uncover the hidden gems of Russian history and culture with the Izmailovo Kremlin and Market Adventure. Begin your tour at the eye-catching Izmailovo Kremlin, an architectural complex inspired by ancient Russian citadels, where modern reconstructions provide a vivid immersion into the country’s traditions. You’ll explore the museums and workshops nestled within its colorful walls, gaining insight into Russian art, folklore, and heritage.Next, lose yourself in the lively Flea Market at Vernissage, where a treasure trove of antique and vintage goods awaits. From rare military relics and porcelain to ornate jewelry and handcrafted furniture, this bustling market offers a glimpse into Russia's history, with each artifact carrying its own unique story. Whether you're a collector or a casual shopper, this tour offers an intriguing mix of cultural exploration and unique shopping opportunities.Experience the best of Moscow with this immersive tour that blends history and stunning views! Begin with a guided walking tour of VDNH, one of Moscow’s most iconic exhibition parks, where you’ll marvel at Soviet-era architecture, grand fountains, and lush gardens.The VDNH Air Tram offers stunning aerial views of pavilions, parks, and fountains — a peaceful and picturesque way to experience one of Moscow’s most iconic sites from above.Proceed to enchanting Moscow Metro tour, where you'll explore one of the world's most beautiful underground systems. Marvel at the stunning architecture and intricate designs of various stations, each telling a unique story of Russian history and culture. The tour ends and a stress-free transfer to your Moscow accommodation or you can choose optional tour for River cruise by Radisson Flotilla. Overnight in Moscow.Day 6DepartureUpon completion of the tour, our representative will drop you off at Moscow Domodedovo International Airport (DME), ensuring you have adequate time to comply with all immigration checks before you board the departure flight with the most prized memories.Hotel Options4* Hotel Sadu Hotel MoscowHotel Saint Petersburg Previous Next123Inclusion03 Night Accommodation in Moscow in 4* Sadu Hotel Moscow or similar02 Night Accommodation in St. Petersburg in Hotel 4* St.Petersburg or similarTransfer ap – hotel – train station – hotel – train – station – hotel - ap Meal: Breakfast at the hotelTransport & guide according programTrain ticket by “Sapsan” Moscow – St – Petersburg – Moscow/2nd class Entrance tickets: Kremlin territory, Metro, cable car «Air tram», River cruise (St. Petersburg)E-Visa (Eligible Nationality)Travel InsuranceReturn flight tickets to Moscow from Sharjah20 kilo check in baggage and hand luggageExclusionRegistration feeUnmentioned excursionsTips to guides and drivers Porterage service at hotels and train stations Personal expensesMedical insurance Departure & Pricing Departure Double Per person Triple Per person Single Per person Child with Extra bed (6 - 11 yrs.) Best Time to Visit Innsbruck Innsbruck, nestled in the heart of the Austrian Alps, is a year-round destination that offers something special in every season. The best time to visit largely depends on your interests and what kind of adventure or relaxation you seek. Here's a seasonal breakdown to help you decide when the ideal time for your Innsbruck getaway is. Winter (December to February): Winter transforms Innsbruck into a snowy paradise, making it an ideal destination for skiing and snowboarding enthusiasts. The city is surrounded by excellent ski resorts, and the Nordkette mountain range provides breathtaking views and exhilarating runs. The festive season brings Christmas markets and celebrations, adding a magical touch to your visit. If winter sports or cozying up in alpine lodges is your idea of a perfect holiday, this is the time to go. Spring (March to May): Spring in Innsbruck sees the melting of snow and the bloom of vibrant flowers, creating a picturesque setting. The weather is milder, making it perfect for hiking and exploring the countryside. During this season, you can enjoy both the last of the skiing opportunities in early spring and the beginning of outdoor activities like biking and sightseeing as the mountains turn green. It's a great time to experience a blend of winter and spring activities without the crowd. Summer (June to August): Summer in Innsbruck is characterized by warm weather and long, sunny days, making it an excellent season for outdoor activities. Hiking, mountain biking, and paragliding are popular pursuits, allowing you to explore the stunning alpine landscapes. The city also hosts various festivals and cultural events during summer, providing a lively atmosphere for visitors. Whether you're looking to enjoy the great outdoors or soak up some culture, summer in Innsbruck won't disappoint. Autumn (September to November): Autumn brings a burst of colors as the foliage turns to shades of red, orange, and gold. It's a quieter time in Innsbruck, with fewer tourists, allowing you to enjoy a peaceful, scenic retreat. The cooler temperatures are perfect for exploring the city's historical sites and museums. This season is also a great opportunity to indulge in Tyrolean cuisine as local harvests come into play. If you prefer a more relaxed and intimate experience, autumn is your time. Top Things to Do in Innsbruck Innsbruck, nestled in the heart of the Austrian Alps, offers an unforgettable blend of outdoor adventures, cultural experiences, and historical sites. Whether you're a thrill-seeker, history buff, or nature lover, Innsbruck has something for everyone. Here's a closer look at the top things to do in this charming alpine city: Alpine Adventures: Innsbruck is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, with its majestic mountains providing the perfect backdrop for a range of activities. In winter, the city transforms into a skiing paradise, offering world-class slopes just minutes away from the city center. The Nordkette Cable Car will whisk you up to exhilarating ski runs, breathtaking hiking trails, and panoramic views of the surrounding peaks. Historical and Cultural Highlights: Delve into Innsbruck's rich history by visiting the Imperial Palace and the iconic Golden Roof. The Imperial Palace (Hof) is a stunning example of Baroque architecture, while the Golden Roof, a symbol of the city, boasts an intricate balcony adorned with gold-plated tiles. For art enthusiasts, the Tyrolean State Museum and the Museum of Tyrolean Folk Art offer intriguing exhibits that explore the region's cultural heritage. Enjoy Old Town Charm: Stroll through Innsbruck's Old Town (Altstadt) and you'll find yourself surrounded by medieval buildings, charming shops, and inviting cafes. The vibrant Maria-Theresien-Strasse, with its bustling atmosphere, is perfect for shopping and sampling delicious local delicacies. Don't miss the opportunity to explore the city’s unique blend of Gothic and Baroque architecture as you wander these picturesque streets. Nature and Wildlife Encounters: For those who love nature, the Alpenzoo Innsbruck is a must-visit. Nestled on the slopes of the Nordkette Mountains, this zoo is home to a variety of alpine animals and offers a magnificent view over Innsbruck. You can also explore the enchanting natural landscape by visiting nearby attractions such as the Swarovski Crystal Worlds, a mesmerizing display of artistry and nature, located just a short distance from Innsbruck. Local Delicacies: No visit to Innsbruck is complete without indulging in its culinary offerings. The region is known for its hearty Tyrolean cuisine, with dishes such as Käsespätzle (cheese noodles) and Tiroler Gröstl (fried potatoes with meat) popular among locals and tourists alike. Pair your meal with a refreshing local beer or a glass of Austrian wine for an authentic dining experience. Vibrant Nightlife and Events: Innsbruck comes alive at night with a vibrant nightlife scene that caters to every taste. From cozy traditional pubs to modern bars and clubs, there's plenty to explore after dark. Additionally, the city hosts a variety of events and festivals throughout the year, ranging from classical music concerts to lively folk festivals, offering entertainment for all ages. How to Reach Innsbruck With convenient travel options, reaching Innsbruck is both straightforward and enjoyable, setting the stage for a memorable visit to this enchanting alpine city. By Air: Located just four kilometers from the city center, Innsbruck Airport is the primary gateway for travelers flying into the region. It offers a range of direct flights from major European cities, especially during the ski season. By Road: Renting a car is a popular option for those who prefer to explore the scenic routes. Innsbruck is well connected to major highways, making it easily accessible from various neighboring countries. Several international and regional bus companies operate services to Innsbruck, offering a budget-friendly and comfortable travel option. By Rail: Innsbruck's main railway station is a crucial hub in the European rail network, providing regular connections to major cities such as Vienna, Munich, and Zurich. Enjoy the breathtaking alpine scenery by choosing popular train routes such as the Arlberg Railway from eastern Austria or the Brenner Pass if traveling from Italy. Innsbruck Cathedral: Known for its Baroque architecture and beautifully painted ceilings. The Swarovski Crystal Worlds: A short drive from Innsbruck, this dazzling attraction is a mesmerizing journey into the world of crystals. Culture Innsbruck is not only a gateway to breathtaking natural landscapes but also a vibrant hub of cultural heritage and history. It comes alive with various cultural festivals throughout the year. So prepare to dive into Innsbruck's rich cultural backdrop as you explore its storied past, architectural splendors, vibrant festivals, and culinary delights. This enchanting city promises a journey through time, offering a cultural experience as awe-inspiring as its alpine surroundings. Cuisine Innsbruck’s cultural identity is also expressed through its culinary traditions and artisanal crafts. Savor authentic Tyrolean dishes such as Tiroler Gröstl (a hearty potato and meat stir-fry) and Kaspressknödel (cheese dumplings), paired with locally brewed beer or schnapps. Craftsmanship is highly valued in Innsbruck, with skilled artisans producing everything from intricate wood carvings to traditional dirndl dresses and Lederhosen. Practical Tips Austria uses the Euro (€), and cash is commonly used in smaller establishments. However, credit cards are widely accepted, particularly in hotels, restaurants, and shops. German is the official language spoken in Innsbruck, but English is widely understood, especially in tourist areas. Respect for local customs and etiquette is important. Austrians value politeness, so remember to greet people with a friendly "Grüß Gott" (Good day) or "Hallo" (Hello). Quick Guide Top Attractions St. Mark's Basilica: One of the most iconic landmarks in Venice, St. Mark’s Basilica is a masterpiece of Byzantine architecture adorned with stunning mosaics and opulent details. Situated in the renowned Piazza San Marco, it is an essential stop for visitors wanting to explore Venice's religious and architectural heritage. Doge's Palace: Once the residence of the Doge of Venice, this Gothic palace is a symbol of the city’s past political power and influence. It features grand halls, opulent chambers, and a fascinating museum. Don’t miss the Bridge of Sighs, which connects the palace to the prison, offering a glimpse into the history of the Venetian justice system. The Grand Canal: The main waterway of Venice, the Grand Canal is a bustling hub of gondolas, vaporettos, and private boats offering breathtaking views of Venice’s historic palaces lining its banks. A gondola ride or a waterbus tour along the Grand Canal provides a unique perspective of the city’s architecture and romantic ambiance. Rialto Bridge: One of the oldest and most famous bridges in Venice, the Rialto Bridge spans the Grand Canal and is a bustling area filled with shops and markets. Its architectural elegance and strategic location make it a favorite spot for tourists to snap photos and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere. Peggy Guggenheim Collection: Housed in the Palazzo Venier dei Leoni on the Grand Canal, this museum showcases an impressive collection of modern art from prominent artists such as Picasso, Pollock, and Dalí. It’s a cultural haven for art enthusiasts, offering a serene escape from the city’s bustling streets. Murano and Burano Islands: Famous for glassmaking and lace production respectively, these islands provide a delightful day-trip escape. Murano is renowned for its artisan glass workshops, while Burano is celebrated for its brightly colored houses and intricate lace craftsmanship. Explore workshops, meet artisans, and purchase unique local products as souvenirs. Top Things to Do in Venice Explore the Grand Canal: The Grand Canal, the main artery of Venice, is a spectacle not to be missed. Hop on a vaporetto (water bus) for a leisurely ride along the canal, marveling at the stunning architecture of palazzos that line its banks. For a more romantic experience, consider a gondola ride at sunset, where the soft glow of the city creates an unforgettable ambiance. Visit St. Mark’s Basilica: St. Mark’s Basilica, a masterpiece of Italo-Byzantine architecture, is a must-visit landmark. Situated in the iconic St. Mark’s Square, this basilica is known for its opulent design, intricate mosaics, and stunning golden altarpiece. Spend time wandering through the square, indulging in a cappuccino at one of the many historic cafés, and soaking in the vibrant atmosphere. Discover the Rialto Market: For a taste of local life, head to the bustling Rialto Market. This market, rich in history, offers a variety of fresh produce, seafood, and regional specialties. It's an ideal spot to immerse yourself in Venetian culture and perhaps pick up some authentic ingredients to try your hand at local recipes. Wander Through Cannaregio: Cannaregio, one of the six historic sestieri (districts) of Venice, exudes charm and authenticity. Stroll along its quiet canals and discover hidden gems, such as the Jewish Ghetto, one of the oldest in the world, and the elegant church of Madonna dell'Orto. The area's relaxed vibe and local eateries make it perfect for leisurely exploration away from the tourist crowds. Enjoy Art at the Peggy Guggenheim Collection: Art enthusiasts should not miss the Peggy Guggenheim Collection, one of Italy's most important museums of European and American modern art. Situated along the Grand Canal, this museum showcases works by celebrated artists such as Picasso, Pollock, and Dalí. The sculpture garden and the scenic views of Venice from the museum's terraces add to the cultural experience. Experience a Venetian Carnival: If timing allows, experience the extravagance of the Venetian Carnival. This annual event, famously known for its elaborate masks and costumes, transforms the city into a lively celebration of history and tradition. Both locals and visitors participate in masquerade balls and parades, offering a glimpse into the vibrant cultural heritage of Venice. How to Reach Venice Traveling to Venice is a unique experience, and there are several ways to arrive in this iconic city, depending on your starting point and preferences. Here are the main options for reaching Venice: By Air: Venice Marco Polo Airport (VCE) is the primary airport serving Venice, located about 13 kilometers from the city center. Regular flights connect Venice with major cities across Europe, Asia, and North America. From the airport, you can reach the city by water taxis, buses, or airport shuttles. By Road: While Venice itself doesn't allow private vehicles, you can drive to nearby parking areas, such as Tronchetto or Piazzale Roma, at the edge of the city. From there, you can continue your journey by foot, water bus, or water taxi. Various bus services, including long-distance coaches, connect Venice with other Italian and European cities. These buses usually drop passengers at Piazzale Roma, the main entry point into Venice. By Rail: Santa Lucia Train Station is Venice’s main railway station, located right on the Grand Canal. High-speed trains link Venice with major Italian cities such as Milan, Rome, and Florence, as well as international destinations. From the station, you can easily access water buses or taxis to navigate the city. This guide aims to provide visitors from India and the UAE with a comprehensive look at what Vienna has to offer, along with tips to ensure a seamless holiday experience through well-curated Vienna tour packages. Best Time to Visit Vienna Vienna is a year-round destination, but for Indian and UAE travelers, considering climate and festivals can enhance the experience: Spring (April to June): As the city awakes from winter, the mild temperatures make exploring on foot pleasant, and the vibrant blossoms add a splash of color to Vienna's parks and gardens. Don’t miss the Vienna Marathon and the annual Vienna Festival, which offers a diverse program of music, theater, and visual arts. Summer (July to August): The city buzzes with life and outdoor activities. Enjoy open-air concerts, or relax by the Danube River. Even though tourist numbers peak, scheduling sightseeing early or later in the day can help beat the crowds. Consider attending the Film Festival at Rathausplatz, a free event showcasing culinary delights alongside international films. Autumn (September to October): Known for its mild weather and fewer tourists, autumn is perfect for exploring Viennese vineyards. Participate in the city’s Wine Hiking Day, when locals and tourists can stroll through vineyards and enjoy breathtaking city views. It’s also a great time to experience Vienna’s numerous baroque architecture and galleries. Winter (November to March): The festive season brings a magical touch with Christmas markets popping up throughout the city, offering traditional crafts, festive decorations, and warm drinks such as mulled wine. Vienna’s New Year’s Eve trail is a popular attraction, and the Ball Season, with its cultural and social events, peaks during the winter months. If you’re here in February, the Vienna Philharmonic Ball is a must-attend highlight. Quick Guide Top Attractions Schönbrunn Palace and Gardens: Step into the opulence of imperial living with a visit to this magnificent Baroque palace, once the summer residence of the Habsburgs. The gardens are perfect for a leisurely stroll. St. Stephen's Cathedral: A symbol of Viennese pride, this Gothic masterpiece stands tall in the city center. Climb the South Tower for breathtaking views of Vienna. The Belvedere: Home to Gustav Klimt's iconic painting "The Kiss," this historic site combines art and stunning architecture. Vienna State Opera: Dive into Vienna's musical heritage by attending a captivating opera performance in one of the world's most prestigious opera houses. Culture Vienna boasts a rich cultural landscape woven with classical music, art, and theater. The annual Vienna Philharmonic New Year's Concert is a must-listen for classical music aficionados. The city's myriad museums, such as the Leopold Museum and Kunsthistorisches Museum, house world-class art collections, while the MuseumQuartier serves as a hub for contemporary art. Cuisine Vienna's culinary scene offers a tantalizing mix of traditional Austrian dishes and modern gastronomy. Delight your taste buds with Wiener Schnitzel, a breaded and fried veal cutlet, or savor the famous Sachertorte, a decadent chocolate cake. Don't forget to stop by a traditional coffeehouse for a strong espresso and a slice of Apfelstrudel. Practical Tips Getting Around: Vienna has an efficient public transport system, including trams, buses, and the U-Bahn (subway), making city exploration convenient. Language: While German is the official language, English is widely spoken in tourist areas. Currency: Austria uses the Euro. Credit cards are accepted, but having some cash for small purchases is advisable. Weather: Vienna experiences a continental climate. Summers are warm, while winters can be cold with a chance of snow. From opulent palaces to dynamic coffee houses, the city offers a rich selection of activities for every traveler. These experiences encapsulate the essence of Vienna, showcasing its rich history, vibrant culture, and unmistakable allure. Whether you’re interested in art, history, or simply enjoying the local lifestyle, Vienna offers a diverse array of experiences that will enrich your visit. Explore the Schönbrunn Palace: Regarded as one of Europe’s most beautiful Baroque palaces, the Schönbrunn Palace provides a fascinating glimpse into Austria's imperial history. Wander through the grand rooms, beautifully maintained gardens, and the immaculate Gloriette offering panoramic city views. Visit the Hofburg Palace: For history enthusiasts, the Hofburg Palace, the former imperial winter residence, is a must-visit. Located in the city center, this sprawling complex includes the Sisi Museum, Imperial Apartments and the stunning Imperial Silver Collection. Marvel at St. Stephen’s Cathedral: An architectural jewel, St. Stephen’s Cathedral stands proudly in the heart of Vienna. Climb the South Tower for a breathtaking view of the city and explore the cathedral’s magnificent interior, rich with historical artifacts and sacred art. Stroll Through the Belvedere Palace: The Belvedere Palace is not only a stunning example of Baroque architecture but also hosts an impressive art collection, including works by Gustav Klimt, with 'The Kiss' being the standout piece. The lush gardens are perfect for a leisurely stroll. Experience Viennese Coffee Culture: Vienna’s coffee houses are legendary. Visit iconic cafes like Café Zentral or Café Sacher for a taste of traditional Viennese coffee culture. Pair your coffee with a slice of Sachertorte, a decadent chocolate cake that’s a local favorite. Enjoy the Vienna State Opera: Opera lovers should not miss the opportunity to attend a performance at the Vienna State Opera. Renowned for its exceptional acoustics and stunning architecture, this venue offers an unforgettable cultural experience. Discover MuseumsQuartier: For art aficionados, the MuseumsQuartier is a hive of creativity. This area houses several major museums, including the Leopold Museum and the Museum of Modern Art. The complex’s lively plazas are great for socializing and relaxing. Walk Along the Ringstrasse: The Ringstrasse, a grand boulevard encircling the inner city, is where you’ll find many of Vienna’s monumental buildings, including the Rathaus (City Hall), the Parliament building, and the Burgtheater. Walking or taking a tram along this route offers a view of Viennese grandeur. Relax in the Stadtpark: Escape to nature in Stadtpark, one of Vienna's most picturesque parks. Whether you're enjoying a peaceful walk, relaxing by the pond, or taking a picture next to the famous statue of composer Johann Strauss II, this park is a serene retreat in the city. Experience the Prater Amusement Park: End your day with some fun at the Prater, Vienna’s historic amusement park. A ride on the Giant Ferris Wheel offers stunning views of the city, while the park’s lively atmosphere and numerous attractions promise entertainment for all ages. Next, visit a Spice & Herbal Garden, where you can discover the diverse flora and learn about the traditional uses of spices in Sri Lankan cuisine and Ayurvedic medicine.You will continue your journey to Kandy, a UNESCO-listed and historically significant city. With our Six-day Sri Lanka package, you can have an unforgettable holiday in this mesmerizing destination. On arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the evening at leisure, relaxing after the journey.Overnight stay in Sigiriya.Day 2Sigiriya – Trincomalee – SigiriyaAfter breakfast at the hotel, depart at around 08:00 AM for Trincomalee, a drive of approximately 2.5 hours. In the evening, return to Sigiriya.Overnight stay in Sigiriya.Day 3Sigiriya – KandyAfter an early breakfast, check out and visit the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its stunning views and ancient ruins. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDammamEssence Of Saudi ArabiaShareAdd to Wishlist6N / 7DView GalleryEssence of Saudi ArabiaNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersOverviewExperience the diverse beauty and heritage of Saudi Arabia with this 06-night journey through Dammam, Riyadh, and AlUla. Designed to offer a perfect balance of culture, history, and natural wonders, this tour takes you from the coastal charm of the Eastern Province to the dynamic capital city and onward to one of the world’s most remarkable ancient landscapes.ItineraryDay 1Arrive DammamUpon arrival at Dammam Airport, proceed to Passport Control for immigration followed by baggage collection and clearing customs formalities. After baggage collection, walk towards the arrival lounge where you shall be met by our representative who will assist while transferring to hotel and check in formalities.Dammam, a vibrant port city in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, offers more than just its famous port. Enjoy the serene Arabian Gulf views, stroll along the Dammam Corniche, or visit the lush King Fahad Park, one of Saudi's largest. Explore Al Marjan Island, Saudi's first man-made island, or relax at Half Moon Bay. The city is becoming a hub for entertainment, with options ranging from movies at Ithra in Dhahran to shopping at Othaim Mall or the Dammam Souq, where local crafts and jewelry abound.Day 2Full day Dammam & Khobar tourImmerse yourself in the cultural richness of Dammam with a city tour, capturing the scenic beauty of Marjan Island. Transition to Al-Khobar for a vibrant city tour, followed by an enriching visit to Ithra near Aramco. Relish Traditional Arabic Food at Recommended restaurant (own expense), Afternoon adventures include exploring the Heritage village. Day 3Dammam - Riyadh (en-route Al Ahsa caves)Morning after breakfast, drive to Riyadh en-route visiting the Ibrahim palace, a historical fortress (World Heritage site) dominated by its white mosque, built in 1556 by the Ottomans. After that we will visit Al-Ahsa Caves and the serene beauty of Yellow Lake Later we will drive onto Riyadh (4 Hrs), upon arrival in Riyadh check in to your hotel. Overnight at Riyadh hotelDay 4Full Day city tour RiyadhMorning after breakfast, enjoy a full day sightseeing tour of the city including  Murabba palace (Photostop only) is among the most important palace built by King Abdul-Aziz. this Palace was to accommodate his family. It was built on the local traditional Nadji style by using local building material only,  visit the Masmak fort and National museum, Enjoy and step back in time and explore Saudi Arabia’s roots. A short documentary also re-enacts the capture of the fortress by King Abdul Aziz, whose spearhead you can still see embedded in its wooden gate & Dira Souq is famous for its variety of old copper and brass objects including silver daggers, silver Bedouins Jewelry and dresses. Dira Souq is worth buying antique carpets and other useful Saudi heritage antiques. After the visit we will stop for lunch break at traditional Arabic restaurant -  at own expense.After Lunch continue on a cultural journey of Historical Diriyah, exploring the richness of At-Turaif World Heritage Site and the traditional charm of Al Bujairy district Overnight at Riyadh hotel.Day 5Riyadh - Alula After some rest at the hotel embark on a tour to Alula Old Town & Al Jadidah art district. Al-Ula Heritage Village (ghost town), also known as Ad-Deerah, is the traditional Arabian village where people of the oasis moved some 8 centuries ago and inhabited until the 20th century. It was built on a higher part of the valley to be clear from the floods that can occur during the raining season. At its maximum expansion the town contained over 1 000 houses that were built adjacent to one another thereby forming a wall around the town to defend the population. At sunset enjoy the majestic view of Elephant Rock.  Elephant Rock is particularly magical at dusk when the fading sun casts a bewitching deep crimson light over the trunk and body of AlUla’s famous geological pachyderm.  Overnight at AlUla Hotel.Day 6AlulaIn the morning enjoy a visit to Hegra (shared tour). Hegra is the most iconic historical site of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the first to be listed as a UNESCO Word Heritage, back in 2008. The Nabateans, called it Hijra (as it appears in some ancient inscriptions at the site), and the Romans used to call it Hegra.The extensive settlement of the site took place during the 1st century AD, when it came under the rule of the Nabatean king Arêtes IV Philopatries (Al-Harith IV) (9 – 40 BC), who made Madain Saleh the kingdom's first capital, before Petra, located 500 kilometers to the north.Later visit Maraya (photostop) Maraya is an architectural wonder that has quickly reached icon status. Upon approaching this magnificent mirrored structure in AlUla’s Ashar Valley you may feel your eyes are deceiving you as Maraya seems to disappear into the surrounding sandstone cliffs before swiftly reappearing. Also visit Dadan & Jabal Ikmah (shared tour)The first stop on this journey back in time is Dadan, the ancient Kingdom of the Lihyanite and Dadanite civilisations. Next,  a 10-minute drive take you to Jabal Ikmah. Set in a stunning desert canyon, this ‘open-air library’ has the most impressive collection of inscriptions, rock art, and petroglyphs in AlUla and is the largest of its kind in Saudi Arabia. Overnight at Alula Hotel.Day 7Alula - Fly OutIn time transfer to Alula airport to board your return flight back home (TBA).Hotel OptionsHoliday InnWarwick HotelCloud-7InclusionAccommodation for 06 nights on above mentioned meal plans.Arrival/departure transfers using private air-conditioned vehicle.Assistance on arrival and departure.Services of English speaking guide during the sightseeing including applicable entrances.Shared bus for Hegra and Dadan & Jabal Ikmah tour.All Applicable Taxes.ExclusionVISAFlightsAny Personal ExpensesDrinks during MealsAny services other than mentioned above.Meals other than specified above.Tips & Gratuities. Travel InsuranceFlights DetailsFlights not included in this package.Important InformationRayna Tours – Easy Terms & Conditions for Your TripWe want your travel experience to be smooth and enjoyable.
