Al-Ula Heritage Village (ghost town), also known as Ad-Deerah, is the traditional Arabian village where people of the oasis moved some 8 centuries ago and inhabited until the 20th century. It was built on a higher part of the valley to be clear from the floods that can occur during the raining season. At its maximum expansion the town contained over 1 000 houses that were built adjacent to one another thereby forming a wall around the town to defend the population Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant on your own expense. Later proceed to visit Dadan & Jabal Ikmah The first stop on this journey back in time is Dadan, the ancient Kingdom of the Lihyanite and Dadanite civilizations. Next, a 10-minute drive takes you to Jabal Ikmah. Set in a stunning desert canyon, this ‘open-air library’ has the most impressive collection of inscriptions, rock art, and petroglyphs in AlUla and is the largest of its kind in Saudi Arabia. Overnight at Alula Hotel.Day 6Alula - Hail en-route TaymaToday after breakfast we have a long day ahead as we leave from Alula and drive towards Hail. En route, we take a detour to the village of Tayma for a visit to the Hadaj Well, of biblical importance. Discover the 'Land of Kings' and learn how Tayma has played a pivotal role in the history of ancient Arabia. After lunch at Taymam (own expense), we will continue our journey to Hail, upon arrival we check into our hotel and have the remainder of the day at leisure. Dinner & Overnight at Hail.Day 7Hail - Jubbah - HailHail, nestled in the heart of northern Saudi Arabia, is a city known for its rich historical heritage and captivating landscapes. Surrounded by Rocky Mountains and vast expanses of desert, Hail offers a unique blend of traditional Saudi Arabian culture and modern development. As a key center in the Kingdom, Hail showcases a deep connection to its roots while embracing the progress of the present day .Our visit this morning takes us an hour’s drive out of the city to the UNESCO World Heritage site at Jubbah, where we see the thousands of fascinating and exceptionally well-preserved petroglyphs, inscriptions and rock art. On our return, we will take in a few of Hail’s fascinating sites which include Al Qishlah Castles and an array of Souq’s and markets that give an excellent insight into desert life. Dinner and overnight at HailDay 8Hail - BuraydahThis morning we continue our exploration of Hail with a visit to the A'arif Fort is the oldest historical building in the city of Hail. It was built in order to guard the city against enemies. During the Saudi rule. Later return for lunch at hotel (included) and for some last minute shopping in Hail’s bazaars to collect some souvenirs for friends and family. In the afternoon, we head for Buraydah (3 hours), the capital of the Qassim district, located equal distance between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Oman. On arrival, we check into our hotel in the heart of the city. Overnight at BuraydahDay 9Buraydah - Ushaiqer - RiyadhThis morning we have an early start as we set to visit Buraydah’s lively camel market located at the edge of the town. After the visit we return back to the hotel, pack the stuff and depart for the next adventure that awaits.Late morning, we drive toward the capital city of Riyadh en-route visiting the heritage village of Ushaiqer, one of the oldest and most attractive settlements in northern Arabia and home to the traditional Najdi style of architecture. (2 hrs drive). Following lunch, we continue our journey towards the capital city of Riyadh (2hrs 30 mins), where we check-in at our hotel. Overnight at RiyadhDay 10Riyadh with Edge of the WorldThis morning we visit sites of Riyadh including the Al-Masmak Fortress, The National Museum displaying a unique collection of the Kingdom’s historical part and a series of historic mud-brick buildings, giving an insight into the traditional lifestyle of local people. We also visit the Kingdom Tower, showcasing the gleaming modern-day architecture of the city. After lunch, we will head out to Jabal Fihrayan, also called as' The Edge of the World’ for a spectacular view to experience sunset from the top of the 300-meter-high desert cliffs overlooking the never-ending surrounding plains, which was once a sea bed.Day 11Riyadh Our final visit of the tour is a leisurely visit to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of D’iriyah, the historic home of the Saudi state. Your afternoon will be at leisure to explore the city on your own or relax in your hotel, Riyadh offers excellent opportunities for dining out, and shopping. Enjoy farewell dinner at traditional Arabic restaurant. title: 4 Nights and 5 Days Sri Lanka Holiday Package
meta_description: Get ready to experience Sri Lanka’s unrivaled lush beauty! Our four-night ‘Discover Sri Lanka’ retreat begins in Kandy and journeys you through Nuwara Eliya to Colombo. Reserve your spot now for an unforgettable holiday.
content: 4 Nights and 5 Days Sri Lanka Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysKandyDiscover Sri LankaShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryDiscover Sri LankaNewFlightTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewSri Lanka is the pearl of the Indian Ocean, known for its unspoiled nature, rich history, and outstanding cultural treasures. With our five-day Sri Lanka package, you can have an unforgettable holiday in this mesmerizing destination. You will visit Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, and Colombo on your all-inclusive holiday, which covers accommodations, airport transfers, and guided sightseeing tours.ItineraryDay 1ARRIVAL – KANDYUpon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by our friendly representative at the arrival lounge, following the completion of immigration and visa formalities. For easy identification, your name will be displayed on a placard. From the airport, you will begin your transfer to Kandy. Along the way, you will enjoy a visit to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can observe and interact with these gentle giants, followed by a tour of a Spice and Herbal Garden, offering insights into Sri Lanka's rich traditions in natural remedies and spices. Afterward, you will proceed to Kandy and check in to your hotel. DINNER & OVERNIGHT STAY AT HOTEL IN KANDY.Day 2KANDY After enjoying a delicious breakfast at the hotel, you will proceed for a sightseeing tour of Kandy, Kandy, a charming city nestled in Sri Lanka's central highlands, is renowned for its scenic beauty, historical importance, and vibrant cultural heritage. It is home to the sacred Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, one of the most revered religious sites in the country. During your tour, you will visit the Peradeniya Royal Botanical Garden, known for its extensive collection of exotic plants and beautifully landscaped grounds. You will also explore the Gem Museum & Lapidary, where you can witness the art of gem cutting and learn about Sri Lanka’s renowned gemstone industry. The tour continues with a relaxing Kandy Upper Lake drive & View Point, offering panoramic views of the city, followed by a captivating Cultural Dance Show that showcases traditional Sri Lankan music and dance. After an enriching day, you will return to your hotel for rest and relaxation.DINNER & OVERNIGHT STAY AT HOTEL IN KANDY.Day 3KANDY – NUWARA ELIYAAfter enjoying breakfast at the hotel, you will check out and begin your transfer to Nuwara Eliya at 8:00 a.m. En route, you will visit several key attractions that highlight the natural beauty and cultural richness of the region. Your journey includes a stop at a Tea Plantation & Tea Factory, where you can witness the tea-making process and sample some of Sri Lanka's finest tea. You will also visit the sacred Sri Bhakta Hanuman Temple, a site of spiritual significance, followed by a stop at the breathtaking Ramboda Water Falls, known for its stunning cascade and scenic surroundings.Upon arrival in Nuwara Eliya—often referred to as Sri Lanka's "Little England"—you will check in to your hotel. This charming highland town is celebrated for its cool climate, lush tea estates, colonial-era architecture, and picturesque landscapes. In the evening, you will explore more of Nuwara Eliya with visits to the Seetha Amman Temple & Ashok Vanam, believed to be connected to the Ramayana legend, and enjoy the serene beauty of Lake Gregory Park. You’ll also have the opportunity to enjoy a walk in Nuwara Eliya Town, soaking in its quaint atmosphere and local charm. After a fulfilling day, you will return to the hotel for a restful night.DINNER & OVERNIGHT STAY AT HOTEL IN NUWARA ELIYADay 4NUWARA ELIYA - COLOMBOAfter enjoying breakfast at the hotel, you will check out and begin your transfer to Colombo at 8:00 a.m. Along the way, you will stop to admire the natural beauty of St. Clair’s & Devon Falls, two of Sri Lanka’s most picturesque waterfalls nestled amidst lush tea-covered hills. Your journey continues with an exhilarating experience of White Water Rafting in Kitulgala, a thrilling adventure through the rapids of the Kelani River, perfect for nature and adventure enthusiasts.Upon arrival in Colombo, you will embark on an evening city tour to explore the highlights of Sri Lanka’s vibrant commercial capital. The tour includes a visit to Independence Square, a historic site commemorating the country’s independence; the revered Gangaramaya Temple, which blends religious, cultural, and architectural significance; the scenic seaside promenade of Galle Face Green, ideal for a relaxing stroll; and the iconic Lotus Tower, the tallest structure in South Asia, offering panoramic views of the city. After the tour, you will return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Colombo.DINNER & OVERNIGHT STAY AT HOTEL IN COLOMBO.Day 5DEPARTUREEnjoy breakfast at the hotel, then proceed to the airport for your departure flight. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysRiyadhSaudi Arabian OdysseyShareAdd to Wishlist8N / 9D2 ImagesView GallerySaudi Arabian OdysseyNewHotelsSightseeingEntry TicketsActivitiesTransfersOverviewEmbark on an unforgettable journey through the heart of the Kingdom with our 08-Night Saudi Arabia Odyssey Tour, a carefully curated experience that showcases Saudi Arabia’s rich heritage, dramatic landscapes, and modern transformation. From the vibrant capital of Riyadh to the ancient wonders of AlUla and the historic coastal charm of Jeddah, this immersive journey offers a perfect blend of culture, history, adventure, and authentic Arabian hospitality.ItineraryDay 1Arrive Riyadh Upon arrival to Riyadh Airport, proceed to Passport Control for immigration followed by baggage collection and clearing customs formalities. After baggage collection, walk towards the arrival lounge where you shall be met by our representative who will assist while transferring to hotel and check in formalities.Welcome to one of the wealthiest cities in the world, home to Saudi Arabia's best museum, a World Heritage Site that relates the Kingdom's genesis story, and some of the finest hotels and restaurants in the country.  Overnight at Riyadh hotel.Day 2Full Day Riyadh city tourMorning after breakfast around 10:00 AM, enjoy a full day sightseeing tour of the city including  Murabba palace (Photostop) is among the most important palace built by King Abdul-Aziz. This Palace was to accommodate his family. It was built on the local traditional Nadji style by using local building material only, visit the Masmak fort and National museum, Enjoy and step back in time and explore Saudi Arabia’s roots. A short documentary also re-enacts the capture of the fortress by King Abdul Aziz, whose spearhead you can still see embedded in its wooden gate also visit Souq Al Zal which is famous for its variety of old copper and brass objects including silver daggers, silver Bedouins Jewelry and dresses, Later stop for lunch at Traditional Arabic restaurant (Najd village) – own expense, before proceeding to  the cultural journey of Historical Diriyah, exploring the richness of At-Turaif World Heritage Site and the traditional charm of Al Bujairy  district. Overnight at Riyadh.Day 3Riyadh - Tabuk Morning after breakfast, transfer to the airport to catch your flight to Tabuk (self-arranged) .Upon arrival met and transferred to your hotel in Tabuk. Enjoy lunch at hotel (own expense), later after lunch proceed to explore Tabuk and its ancient history; your journey will start with a visit to ancient Tabuk Ottoman Castle. It is among some of the most well-known attractions of the city and includes a mosque as well as well-preserved guard towers. This old castle also houses a museum that offers tourists a detailed timeline of the interesting history of the province, after the visit proceed to visit the Hijaz Railway Station (Tabuk station)  which is another great historical spot of the Ottoman era. Overnight stay at Tabuk. Day 4Tabuk - Wadi DIsah - AlulaMorning after breakfast hop on in your 4x4 vehicle  and drive to the heritage city of Alula, en-route visiting Wadi Disah  Wadi Disah, is a mountainous region and one of the most beautiful natural landscapes in Saudi Arabia. The valley is nestled between majestic cliffs, reaching heights of 400 metres. Al Disah, known as the “valley of palm trees,” is a picture-perfect landscape. Enjoy lunch at Oasis, Later proceed to drive onto Alula, upon arrival in Alula check-in to your hotel. Overnight at Alula. Al-Ula is an ancient Arabic oasis city located in Medina Province, Saudi Arabia. Situated in the Hejaz, a region that features prominently in the history of Islam as well as several pre-Islamic Semitic civilizations, Alula was a market city on the historic incense route that linked India and the Persian Gulf to the Levant and Europe. Day 5AlulaIn the morning enjoy a visit to Hegra (shared tour). Hegra is the most iconic historical site of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the first to be listed as a UNESCO Word Heritage, back in 2008. The Nabateans, called it Hijra (as it appears in some ancient inscriptions at the site), and the Romans used to call it Hegra. Return back to the hotel for some rest.Late afternoon we will proceed to Alula Old town (shared tour) Wander the maze of historic alleys and hundreds of houses built of mud brick, lined up next to each other like an impenetrable fortress. This is AlUla's Old Town, its winding paths seeped with memories whose origins date back almost a millennium. With every step, feel history become instantly and movingly tangible and experience the heritage that fills Old Town's thriving streets with life, enjoy dinner at a traditional Arabic restaurant (included) before heading back to your hotel. Overnight at Alula Hotel.At sunset enjoy the majestic view of Elephant Rock.  Elephant Rock is particularly magical at dusk when the fading sun casts a bewitching deep crimson light over the trunk and body of AlUla’s famous geological pachyderm.  Overnight at AlUla Hotel.Day 6Alula - MadinahMorning after breakfast, drive to Medina, upon arrival in Madinah stop for lunch at a local restaurant (own expense), later proceed for a short orientation tour of Medina including Masjid Quba, Masjid an Nawabi & Mount Uhud. Quba Mosque, the first mosque in Islam, was built-up by Prophet Mohammed (peace be upon him) in 622 AD, the year when he migrated from Makkah to Yathrib, an event considered by Muslims the start of the Islamic calendar. Overnight at Medina hotel. (Note: Non-Muslims are only allowed to take photos from outside at Quba Masjid & Masjid an Nawabi).  Overnight at Medina Hotel.Day 7Madinah - JeddahToday morning after a leisurely breakfast drive to Jeddah (5 Hrs), upon arrival in Jeddah check-in at the hotel. Overnight at Jeddah hotel.In the evening you have the option to take a stroll at lively Jeddah Corniche and see the world’s largest fountain comes alive – on your own. Overnight at Jeddah.Day 8Jeddah city tourEmbark on an enriching journey of Jeddah city tour. Immerse yourself in the cultural tapestry of Al Tayebat International City, followed by a leisurely exploration of the scenic King Fahad Fountain and a delightful shopping spree at the Red Sea Mall. Traverse the historic Al-Balad, discovering its gems like Beit Nassif and capturing the essence of Makkah gate. Indulge in traditional Saudi cuisine at local restaurants (own expense), offering an authentic taste of the region. From the iconic Historical Jeddah North Gate to the vibrant Souk and Al Shafi Mosque, each stop promises a glimpse into the city's rich heritage. Overnight at Jeddah Hotel. Day 9Jeddah - Fly OutIn time transfer to the airport to board your return flight (TBA).Hotel OptionsWarwick RiyadhMena HotelCloud-7Delights InnCentro SalamaInclusionAccommodation for 08 nights on above mentioned hotels or similar.Arrival/departure transfers and all road travel using private air-conditioned vehicle (Sedan).Assistance on arrival and departure by flight.4x4 vehicle for Wadi Disah visit including picnic lunch.Meals as specified above.Services of an English speaking guide for sightseeing including applicable entrances.Shared tour of Hegra & Alula Old town.02 bottles of water per person per day.All Applicable Taxes.ExclusionVISAInternational flightsInternal flightsAny Personal ExpensesDrinks during MealsAny services other than mentioned above.Meals other than specified above.Tips & Gratuities. Travel InsuranceFlights DetailsFlights are not included with this package.Important InformationRayna Tours – Easy Terms & Conditions for Your TripWe want your travel experience to be smooth and enjoyable. Known as the world's first Christian nation, Armenia offers visitors a unique blend of historical monuments, medieval churches, stunning mountains, and warm hospitality. From the majestic peaks of Mount Ararat to the tranquil shores of Lake Sevan, Armenia's natural beauty is simply unmatched.ItineraryDay 1Welcome to ArmeniaUpon your arrival at Yerevan Zvartnots International Airport, our local representative and vehicle will be waiting outside. Check in to the hotel and free time to relax.Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 2Yerevan City Tour with Vernissage VisitDuring the tour, you will explore several iconic landmarks of Armenia. Your journey begins at Mother Armenia, a towering statue in Victory Park that symbolizes peace through strength. Next, you will visit the Genocide Complex, Armenia’s official memorial to the victims of the Armenian Genocide, located on the hill of Tsitsernakaberd and built in 1967. The tour continues to the Cascade, a massive stairway connecting the downtown Kentron area of Yerevan with the Monument neighborhood. With over 570 steps, the Cascade not only stands as one of the city’s most striking architectural features but also offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Opera House, Swan Lake, and even Mount Ararat on a clear day, along with a rich display of modern art installations. Following this, you will head to Republic Square, renowned for its captivating dancing water fountains near the National Gallery. Finally, for those interested in shopping and local crafts, a stop at Vernissage — a vibrant open-air market — is the perfect way to end the day.Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 3Tsaghkadzor Lake Sevan Tour with Kecharis MonasteryDuring the tour, you will discover some of Armenia’s most scenic and culturally rich destinations. Your journey begins at Lake Sevan, it is not only the largest body of water in Armenia and the Caucasus region but also one of the largest freshwater high-altitude lakes in the world, situated at 1,897 meters above sea level, known for its stunning natural beauty. Nearby, you will visit Sevanavank Monastery a 9th-century religious complex built by Princess Mariam in memory of her husband.The tour then takes you to Tsaghkadzor City, a picturesque spa town and one of Armenia’s most popular winter and health resorts. Nestled in the mountains, it offers a stunning natural landscape throughout the year. While there, you have the option to experience the Tsaghkadzor Ropeway, an arm-chaired lift with five stations that carries you to the mountain peaks, offering breathtaking panoramic views. You will also explore the Kecharis Monastery, a beautifully preserved medieval complex that dates from the 11th to 13th centuries. Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 4DepartureToday, check out and meet our representative with vehicle who will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to Zvartnots International Airport, ensuring that you will reach right in time to catch your departure flight.Hotel Options4* Ani Central Inn or Similar Previous Next123Inclusion03 Night Accommodation in Yerevan at hotel mentioned below or similarDaily breakfast at HotelHalf Day Yerevan City Tour with Vernissage visitFull Day Tsaghkadzor Lake Sevan Tour with Kecharis Monastery02-way Airport transfers on private basisTours as per itinerary with comfortable vehicles on private basisEnglish speaking driver cum guide throughout the tour02-way Flight ticket in economy class20kg check in baggage and 5-7kg hand luggageTravel InsuranceExclusionArmenia E-visaEarly check-in / Late check-outProfessional guide serviceEntrance fees other than mentioned Tsaghkadzor ropeway fee (45 AED per person)Anything not mentioned in inclusions Departure & Pricing Pricing Per person on Double Per person on Triple Per person on Single Child with Extra bed (6 - 11 yrs.) The first stop is Tsaghkadzor city (Valley of flowers) considered to be one of the most popular winter resorts of Armenia. It is one of the places of the mountainous country, where the beauty of the nature appears with its whole variety. Opportunity to go up to the mountain peaks by rope way, where you will catch an unforgettable gorgeous panoramic view of this part of the world . The next stop is Lake Sevan that is only 30 minutes’ drive distance from Tsaghkadzor. It is known as a blue gem of the Armenian mountainscape. Lake Sevan is considered  to be one of the largest sweet water lakes in the world, situated at an altitide of 1,897 meters above sea level. Climb on peninsula from where the fascinating view on the Lake is open. Visit Sevanavank monastery, built by the princess Mariam to honor the life of her deceased husband in the 9th century.. Afterwards, go to visit Dilijan. Dilijan is one of the most important resorts of Armenia, famous for its amazing surroundings, situated in Dilijan National Park. This small city, lost in forests and mountains with alpine meadows around, is home to numerous Armenian artists, composers, and filmmakers. Visit to Haghartsin Monastery (X- XIV centuries). Nestled in forested mountains the Monastery creates a magical impression of the lost world.Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 3Half Day Yerevan City Tour with Vernissage Visit + Garni Geghard TourDuring the tour, you will explore several iconic landmarks of Armenia. Your journey begins at Mother Armenia, a towering statue in Victory Park that symbolizes peace through strength. Next, you will visit the Genocide Complex, Armenia’s official memorial to the victims of the Armenian Genocide, located on the hill of Tsitsernakaberd and built in 1967. The tour continues to the Cascade, a massive stairway connecting the downtown Kentron area of Yerevan with the Monument neighborhood. With over 570 steps, the Cascade not only stands as one of the city’s most striking architectural features but also offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Opera House, Swan Lake, and even Mount Ararat on a clear day, along with a rich display of modern art installations. Following this, you will head to Republic Square, renowned for its captivating dancing water fountains near the National Gallery. Finally, for those interested in shopping and local crafts, a stop at Vernissage — a vibrant open-air market — is the perfect way to end the day.Explore Armenia’s UNESCO World Heritage–listed treasures on this Garni-Geghard day tour. Visit the iconic Temple of Garni — widely considered the country’s most important symbol of pre-Christian Armenia and admire the classical Hellenistic architecture you find. Enjoy breathtaking views over Mt Ararat on route to the UNESCO–listed monastery complex of Geghard. Within our tour we will be in the valley of Azat river where there are mayn historical and natural monuments. We will go to the Pagan Temple of Garni. The Pagan Temple of Garni is the only non-Christian temple currently standing in ArmeniaThe architectural complex of Garni was Armenia's foremost center of Hellenistic culture and the summer residence of Armenian kings.  Drive to the unique caved temple St. Geghard (12th -13th cc.), the name of which means “holy spear” in the honor of the long-preserved spear, the same spear that pierced the body of crucified Christ. At the moment this spear is kept in the museum of Etchmiadzin.  Geghard Monastery is included in the UNESCO World Heritage list (2000). Drive back to Yerevan.Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 4Khor Virap-Noravank-Areni Winery We begin the journey by heading to the South from Yerevan – through Ararat Province to Vayots Dzor Province – and will come closer to Ararat's piedmont near Armenian-Turkish border. As we know, the most famous symbol for Armenians – Mount Ararat isn't located on the territory of Republic of Armenia. Nonetheless, Khor Virap offers the best view to admire the mount. And here we will take our first stop.Later we shall visit Noravank meaning “New Monastery” in Armenian. A visit to the winery will give you the opportunity to taste 15 sorts of wine, watch a short-length film about the history of the factory, wine-making in Armenia and its historical background. Afterwards you are welcome to have a walk in the cellars of the factory.Overnight stay in Yerevan.Day 5DepartureToday, check out and meet our representative with vehicle who will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to Zvartnots International Airport, ensuring that you will reach right in time to catch your departure flight.Hotel Options4* Elegant Hotel or Similar4* Felinger Collection Hotel Previous Next123Inclusion01 Night Accommodation in Tsaghkadzor at hotel mentioned below or similar03 Night Accommodation in Yerevan at hotel mentioned below or similarDaily breakfast at HotelYerevan City Tour with Vernissage visitTsaghkadzor - Lake Sevan - Dilijan Parz lake Garni Geghard TourKhor Virap-Noravank-Areni Winery tour02-way Airport transfers on private basisTours as per itinerary with comfortable vehicles on private basisEnglish speaking driver cum guide throughout the tour02-way Flight ticket in economy class20kg check in baggage and 5-7kg hand luggageTravel InsuranceExclusionArmenia E-visaEarly check-in / Late check-outProfessional guide serviceEntrance fees other than mentioned Tsaghkadzor ropeway fee (45 AED per person)Anything not mentioned in inclusions Departure & Pricing Package Cost Per Adult on Double Sharing basis AED 3499 Flights DetailsAirline: Air Arabia Date From To Flight No. Dept. This eight-night itinerary ensures a balance of adventure, cultural immersion, and relaxation across Bali's captivating landscapes. Embrace the adrenaline rush with exciting activities and revel in the peacefulness of serene Bali landscapes. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Bali and Transfer to Ubud Upon your arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport, you'll be warmly welcomed and transferred to your accommodation in Ubud, Bali's cultural heart. As you settle in, take the time to explore the art-filled streets, cozy cafes, and lush surroundings. Let the tranquil ambiance of Ubud set the perfect stage for your adventures ahead. Day 2Kintamani, Coffee Plantation, Rice Terrace, Waterfall, and Bali Swing Start your journey with a visit to Kintamani, where the majestic views of Mount Batur offer a stunning backdrop. Immerse yourself in the aromatic experience of a coffee plantation tour, followed by a scenic walk through the iconic rice terraces, showcasing Bali's agrarian beauty. Unwind at a picturesque waterfall, and satisfy your adventurous spirit with an exciting Bali Swing, offering breathtaking views of the lush surroundings. Day 3ATV Ride and White River Rafting Prepare for an adrenaline-packed day as you embark on a thrilling ATV ride through Bali's diverse terrain, navigating through forests, plantations, and traditional villages. Follow this with an exhilarating white river rafting adventure, where you'll tackle rapids surrounded by verdant landscapes, ensuring a fun and unforgettable experience. Day 4: Transfer to Gili Islands from Bali Dive into the serene atmosphere of the Gili Islands as you transfer from Bali via a swift speed boat. Enjoy the sun-kissed beaches, crystal-clear waters, and laid-back island vibes. Use the day to relax, snorkel, or explore the island at your own pace, immersing yourself in this tropical paradise. Day 5Transfer back to Bali from Gili Islands Return to Bali and take your time to unwind at your leisure, preparing yourself for the cultural and scenic wonders you are yet to discover on the island. Day 6Handara Gate, Ulun Danu Temple, and Tanah Lot Sunset Tour Embark on a cultural tour starting with the iconic Handara Gate, capturing quintessential Balinese architecture. Visit the serene Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, situated on the tranquil shores of Lake Beratan. Conclude your day with a visit to the legendary Tanah Lot Temple, watching a memorable and mesmerizing sunset over the ocean, creating a perfect end to the day. Day 7Nusa Penida West Tour Discover the untouched beauty of Nusa Penida, taking the west tour to explore its most stunning sights. Marvel at the natural wonders of Kelingking Beach, Angel’s Billabong, and Broken Beach, where dramatic cliffs meet azure waters. Capture these picture-perfect moments, creating memories that will last a lifetime. Day 8: Watersports Activities and Uluwatu Sunset Tour with Kecak Fire Dance Show Experience the thrill of watersports, beginning with a fun-filled banana boat ride, followed by the excitement of couple parasailing and a thrilling Jet Ski session. In the evening, head to Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on a cliff, to witness an enchanting sunset. End your day with the captivating Kecak Fire Dance Show, a mesmerizing performance that embodies Bali's rich cultural heritage. Day 9Departure As your enchanting journey comes to an end, it's time to say goodbye to Bali. You'll be conveniently transferred to the airport for your departure, taking home unforgettable memories and experiences from this unique Balinese adventure. content: Sikkim Scenic Tour Package | Nature Himalayan Escape!HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysGangtokSikkim Nature Escape TourShareAdd to Wishlist5N / 6D3 ImagesView GallerySikkim Nature Escape TourNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingMealsOverviewEnjoy five nights in some of East India’s most stunning destinations. Whether you’re an adventurer, a nature enthusiast, or someone traveling with your family and kids, this all-inclusive package, with accommodations in Gangtok and Lachung, has something to delight every interest. Add to this convenient transfers, daily breakfasts, and guided tours with essential permits. ItineraryDay 1NJP Rly Station / IXB Airport – GangtokKick off your holiday with a warm meet-and-greet at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra (IXB) Airport. It’s followed by a comfortable five-hour drive to Gangtok, passing through the most exquisite landscapes. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, spend the rest of the day at your pace. Day 2Excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba MandirAfter breakfast, a refreshing tour of the stunning Tsomgo Lake awaits you! Perched at over 12,400 feet, this lake will enchant you with its unrivaled scenic settings and crystal-clear waters. You’ll next make your way to the revered Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir, known for its enigmatic charm and picture-perfect ambiance. Important Notes:To visit Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir, guests must carry two passport-size photographs and a photocopy of a valid Photo ID proof. If accompanied by children below 18 years, don’t forget their birth certificate or school/college ID. You should also bring original documents. If a landslide or unexpected road closures occur, an alternate travel plan will be arranged.Day 3Gangtok – LachungAfter breakfast and hotel check-out, prepare for an unforgettable journey to the quaint mountain village of Lachung, driving through some of North Sikkim’s most scenic routes. En route, make a stop at the magnificent Naga Waterfall to absorb its unequaled scenery, and later at Chungthang, a picturesque town where the two stunning Himalayan Rivers, Lachen Chu and Lachung Chu, meet. Before you arrive, you will also visit the towering Bhim Nala Waterfall, dubbed Amitabh Bachchan Falls, thanks to its impressive height. Finally, settle into your room for a relaxed overnight stay. Day 4Excursion to Yumthang Valley North Sikkim’s breathtaking natural gems beckon you, and this dedicated tour allows you to strike off your travel wish list. Stop at Yumthang Valley, which is perched at over 12,000 feet and fondly called the Valley of Flowers for its exuberant landscapes with meadow, snow-blanked peaks, and rivers. So what better way to soak in the panoramic views and enjoy the crisp Himalayan mountain air? The tour ends with a stress-free return transfer to your accommodation. Day 5Lachung - Gangtok Today, you’ll return to Gangtok on a scenic six-hour drive, allowing you to appreciate the breathtaking natural landscapes that unfold along the way. Upon arrival, check in and spend the remainder of the day at your leisure. Day 6Gangtok - NJP Rly Station / IXB AirportAfter hotel check-out, give a stress-free end to your holiday as your professional driver will drop you off at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport (IXB), following a mesmerizing drive through serene valleys, dense forests, and meandering rivers. Hotel OptionsGangtok - Denzong Regency (Heritage Dlx) / Norbughang Retreat Pangthang / SimilarLachung - Yarlam Resort / Similar Previous Next1234InclusionAccommodation in well-appointed hotelsDaily breakfast and Dinner at the hotelExclusive non-AC vehicle for transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary on a point-to-point basis only.All permit fees & hotel taxes (as per itinerary)All sightseeing and excursions as per the itinerary by private vehicleToll taxes, parking fees, and driver’s allowances includedExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending citySafari Tickets are not included in package costMonument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing placesMeals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners)Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etcAny additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itineraryGuide services (unless specified as included)Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuationTipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staffAny cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellationsGST or any other government taxes (if applicable)Important InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. This six-night holiday promises unforgettable moments, with accommodations in Gangtok, Pelling, and Darjeeling; convenient transfers; and well-planned sightseeing. From enlightening monasteries and majestic sunrise views to visiting lush tea gardens, a lot of things to see and do await you here. so all you need to do is pack your bag; this carefully crafted package will take care of every detail of your getaway.  ItineraryDay 1Arrival at NJP/Bagdogra, transfer to Gangtok, Leisure evening at MG Marg Kick off your Himalayan getaway with a professional meet-and-greet at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. content: Golden Triangle Package | Book Delhi Agra Jaipur Tour Package!HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysDelhiClassic Golden Triangle Of IndiaShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryClassic Golden Triangle Of IndiaNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingActivitiesOverviewExplore the Golden Triangle route as you travel through some of India’s celebrated cities on this exciting five-day holiday with accommodations, guided tours, and transfers. Start at the capital, Delhi, where the country’s centuries-old history comes alive. Continue to Agra to admire the Agra Fort and the Taj Mahal, the eternal symbol of love. Be in awe of Fatehpur Sikri’s classic grandeur before traveling to Jaipur. Dubbed the Pink City, Jaipur’s royal splendor is reflected in its top attractions, including the Amber Fort, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, and Hawa Mahal. ItineraryDay 1Arrive Delhi & Local SightseeingMeet your representative as you land in Delhi. Enjoy a comfortable transfer to your pre-arranged accommodation. After Check in, spend the day relaxing in your room, savoring the region’s delicious cuisine, or exploring the top claims to fame across Old and New Delhi, such as the towering Qutub Minar and the iconic India Gate, to name a few. Day 2Delhi - Agra - Visit Taj Mahal & Agra Fort After breakfast and hotel check-out, leave behind Delhi’s hustle and bustle and head to Agra, a city that immaculately preserves the glory of the Mughal era. Marvel at the timeless beauty of the Taj Mahal, which is also one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Next, visit the UNESCO-listed Agra Fort, which was once the residence of Mughal emperors, offering a glance into the country’s royal past.  Day 3Agra - Jaipur - Enroute Fatehpur Sikri Following a satisfying breakfast, check out of the hotel and set out to Rajasthan’s capital, Jaipur. Along the way, stop at Fatehpur Sikri, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, which was once a glorious Mughal city during the reign of Emperor Akbar in the 16th century. Upon arriving in Jaipur, check in to your room and unwind, enjoying the rest of the day at your pace.Day 4Jaipur - Local SightseeingToday’s highlight is a fully guided city tour that takes you to Jaipur’s must-see attractions. Begin at the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Amber Fort, an enormous fort-palace constructed from white and red sandstone, and then explore City Palace, a sprawling 17th-century palace complex that seamlessly blends Rajput, Mughal, and English architectural styles. What awaits you next is Jantar Mantar, a splendid astronomical wonder, and Hawa Mahal, which will blow you away with its clever architectural style that lets in uninterrupted wind through its 953 small windows. You’ll also stop at local markets before winding up the tour. Day 5Departure from JaipurAfter breakfast, you can spend some time shopping or revisiting your favorite sights, depending on your flight schedule. When it’s time to check out, our representative will ensure a smooth transfer to the airport, providing a hassle-free conclusion to your memorable holiday. Hotel OptionsHotel Rahul Palace By Golden Tree / SimilarHotel Avalon Palms Agra/ Hotel Karan Vilas/ Hotel The Rs Casa Agra/ SimilarSpree Hotel / Similar Previous Next12Inclusion04 nights’ accommodation in well-appointed hotels (1N Delhi, 1N Agra, 2N Jaipur)Daily breakfast at the hotelAll airport, railway station, and intercity transfers by private air-conditioned vehicleAll sightseeing and excursions as per the itinerary by private vehicleToll taxes, parking fees, and driver’s allowances includedExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending cityMonument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing placesMeals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners)Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etc.Any additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itineraryGuide services (unless specified as included)Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuationTipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staffAny cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellationsGST or any other government taxes (if applicable)Important InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. Explore the highlights of Old and New Delhi, admire Agra’s classic Taj Mahal and Agra Fort, visit the historic Mughal city of Fatehpur Sikri, and immerse yourself in Jaipur’s royal legacy, all in one trip. Your trip includes comfortable accommodations in Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur, daily breakfast, guided sightseeing tours, and convenient transfers throughout. ItineraryDay 1Delhi arrival – Old & New Delhi sightseeing Today, you’ll arrive in Delhi. After a meet-and-greet and a prompt hotel transfer, check in to your room and then get ready to see the top sights India’s celebrated capital. From the majestic Red Fort and timeless Chandni Chowk to India Gate, the Parliament House, and the serene Lotus Temple, be in awe of how the historical splendor and contemporary charm beautifully coexist in Old and New Delhi.Day 2Full Day local Delhi Sightseeing After breakfast, set out on a full-day Delhi city tour. Join an experienced, knowledgeable guide as he leads you to the region’s dynamic streets, traditional bazaars, and architectural wonders. Depending on your preferences, you’ll tour Qutub Minar and Humayun’s Tomb, to name a few. Rest assured that you’ll wind up your sightseeing with some prized moments to take home.  Day 3Delhi to Agra – Taj Mahal sunset viewToday, you’ll leave Delhi and journey to Agra, a city steeped in Mughal history. Begin your visit with the Taj Mahal, an ever-lasting symbol of love built by Emperor Shah Jahan for his wife Mumtaz Mahal. Experience its breathtaking beauty at sunset, when this white-marble structured glows in the golden sunlight. Next, feel like a royal as you step into Agra Fort, a historical fortress that once served as Mughal emperors’ residence.  Day 4Agra to Jaipur – Enroute Fatehpur SikriAfter hotel check-out, you’ll travel to Jaipur, the capital of Rajasthan. En route, pause at the UNESCO-listed Fatehpur Sikri, a 16th-century Mughal city built by Emperor Akbar. Once you arrive in Jaipur, complete all check-in formalities and relax, preparing to take in the exciting attractions that await you here. Day 5Jaipur Sightseeing + Optional Chokhi Dhani dinner Today, experience Jaipur’s royal heritage and architectural marvels on a full-day city tour. It covers a visit to all of the region’s top attractions, from the majestic Amber Fort, perched on a hilltop, and the opulent City Palace to the iconic Hawa Mahal and the astronomical wonders of Jantar Mantar. You’ll also have the option to tour Chokhi Dhani, a vibrant cultural village highlighting Rajasthan’s traditions with folk performances, camel rides, and authentic Rajasthani cuisine.  Day 6DepartureAfter breakfast, take time to discover Jaipur at your own pace based on your flight. The journey takes you through charming hill towns, scenic valleys, and popular attractions, including Shimla, Kufri, Manali, Solang Valley, and Chandigarh. Enjoy breathtaking mountain views, peaceful temples, colonial landmarks, and refreshing natural beauty throughout the trip. Perfect for families, couples, and nature lovers, this tour offers a perfect mix of sightseeing, relaxation, and adventure in the heart of the Himalayas.ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Delhi – Chandigarh – ShimlaArrive in Delhi and begin your journey towards Shimla via Chandigarh. En route, visit Sukhna Lake and the famous Rock Garden in Chandigarh. Continue your drive along scenic mountain roads to reach Shimla. In the evening, explore Mall Road and enjoy the cool hill atmosphere. Overnight stay in Shimla.Day 2Shimla Sightseeing – Kufri & Local AttractionsAfter breakfast, proceed for sightseeing in and around Shimla. Return to the hotel and relax. Overnight stay in Shimla.Day 3Shimla to Manali via KulluAfter breakfast, check out and drive to Manali via Kullu. title: Jaipur and Udaipur Tour Package | Book Royal Rajasthan Trip!
meta_description: Explore royal palaces and scenic lakes with a Jaipur and Udaipur tour package featuring heritage sights, culture and comfortable stays.
content: Jaipur and Udaipur Tour Package | Book Royal Rajasthan Trip!HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysJaipurThe Crown Jewels Of RajasthanShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D3 ImagesView GalleryThe Crown Jewels of RajasthanNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewSet out on this four-night holiday that unfolds Rajasthan’s royal past and rich cultural heritage. Get ready for the most prized experiences the moment you receive a regal welcome in Jaipur, which is fondly called the Pink City. Strike all of Jaipur’s iconic attractions, like Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, and Jantar Mantar, before you head to explore Udaipur’s palaces, lakes, and artistic traditions. With two nights’ accommodation in each city, complemented by all staples of a comfortable stay, it allows you to return home with the most memorable moments.ItineraryDay 1Arrival & transfer; Sound & Light Show – Amer Fort- Jaipur Touch down in Jaipur, knowing that a vehicle with a driver is ready to drop you off at the hotel. After a stress-free transfer, check in to your room and relax. Later, in the evening, prepare to enjoy an exciting introduction to Jaipur’s royal heritage, thanks to the Sound & Light Show at Amer Fort. It presents the region’s fascinating history, royal legends, and tales of valor through a mesmerizing display of lights, blending age-old architecture and culture.Day 2Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, City Palace, Panna Meena ka Kund, Amer Fort, Bapu Market Today is dedicated to a comprehensive tour of Jaipur’s must-sees on a fully guided excursion. The first stop is at the stunning Hawa Maha, or the Palace of Minds, which takes your breath away with its intricate façade. Next, tour the UNESCO-listed astronomical splendor, Jantar Mantar, and then continue to the magnificent City Palace, a stunning blend of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture. Panna Meena ka Kund, an ancient stepwell with a symmetrical design, and Amer Fort are other attractions included in your program. Conclude your day with a stroll through Bapu Market, where you can shop for traditional handicrafts, textiles, jewelry, and souvenirs. Day 3Transfer to Udaipur, En route visit the Statue of Belief (Shiva) After breakfast and hotel check-out, join our representative for an exciting drive to Udaipur. The highlight of the day is a stop at the Statue of Belief (Shiva) in Nathdwara, standing tall at over 360 feet and ranking among the world’s tallest statues of Lord Shiva. Take time to soak in its serene and spiritual atmosphere before continuing to Udaipur, where you’ll check in to your hotel and relax for the remainder of the dayDay 4Moti Magri, City Palace, Jag Mandir (Boat Ride), Traditional Music & Dance Show, ShoppingA full-day tour of Udaipur’s royal heritage and lakeside beauty, with an experienced guide, awaits you! Visit Moti Magri, the Hill of Pearls, offering panoramic views of the surrounding; stop at the majestic Lake Pichola; and discover the magnificent City Palace, a sprawling complex of palaces, courtyards, and museums. You’ll also take a serene boat ride to Jag Mandir, a beautiful island palace on the lake. Spend your evening experiencing the vibrant local culture with a traditional music and dance show, and a shopping adventure at nearby markets. Day 5Departure After breakfast and hotel check-out, a prompt departure transfer will ensure a perfect conclusion to your royal Rajasthan getaway!Hotel OptionsHOTEL EKANA OR SIMILARHOTEL RUDRA KRIPA OR SIMILAR Previous Next1234Inclusion04 nights’ accommodation in well-appointed hotels Daily breakfast at the hotelAll airport, railway station, and intercity transfers by private air-conditioned vehicleAll sightseeing and excursions as per the itinerary by private vehicleToll taxes, parking fees, and driver’s allowances includedExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending cityMonument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing placesMeals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners)Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etc.Any additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itineraryGuide services (unless specified as included)Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuationTipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staffAny cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellationsGST or any other government taxes (if applicable)Important InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. A leisurely stroll through the region’s exuberant local markets ensures a perfect end to your first day in Rajasthan. Day 2Local Sightseeing - Visit Saheliyon ki Bari, Fateh Sagar Lake, Sajjangarh (Monsoon Palace), Shilpgram or Vintage Car MuseumToday, see more of Udaipur’s both celebrated and hidden gems! Later, get a slice of Rajasthani arts and royal past as you tour one of these attractions: Shilpgram, a crafts village, or the Vintage Car Museum, home to a fascinating collection of classic automobiles. Day 3Udaipur - Chittorgarh - JaipurAfter breakfast, check out of the hotel and then enjoy a relaxed drive to Rajasthan’s capital, Jaipur. Check in to your hotel and rest, overnight Stay JodhpurDay 3Jodhpur - Local SightseeingBegin your day with a delightful breakfast followed by sightseeing in Jodhpur, covering iconic attractions like Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, and the colorful Clock Tower Market for authentic shopping experiencesDay 4Drive to Jaisalmer What awaits you today is Jaisalmer’s golden beauty, as you depart from Jodhpur and enjoy a thrilling five-hour drive. An optional stop at the iconic Pokhran Fort along the way adds to your journey. After checking into your hotel, you’ll tour the stunning Gadisar Lake and the region’s local markets. Day 5Jaisalmer Sightseeing & Evening Desert Camp Today, Jaisalmer’s wealth of cultural and historical attractions unveils on a sightseeing tour. title: Rajasthan Family Tour | Witness Culture, Heritage & Wildlife
meta_description: Plan a memorable Rajasthan family holiday with culture tours and wildlife safaris. Easy booking, expert planning and great value.
content: Rajasthan Family Tour | Witness Culture, Heritage & WildlifeHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysJaisalmerRajasthan Culture And Wildlife Family TourShareAdd to Wishlist11N / 12D3 ImagesView GalleryRajasthan Culture and Wildlife Family TourNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThe ultimate Rajasthan adventure awaits you on this comprehensive 12-day tour, covering the region’s most iconic cities, cultural landmarks, and natural wonders. Stay in Jaipur, Bikaner, Jaisalmer, Jodhpur, Mount Abu, and Udaipur. You can also be part of wildlife adventures in Ranthambore National Park and historic explorations in Chittorgarh. With stress-free transfers, daily breakfast, guided sightseeing, and immersive cultural experiences, this holiday lets you discover Rajasthan’s royal heritage, desert landscapes, and vibrant traditions like never before. ItineraryDay 1Arrival in Jaipur Welcome to Jaipur, the Pink City of Rajasthan! After a smooth transfer, check in to your hotel and next get ready to glimpse into the city’s royal heritage by learning about Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh, Jaipur’s founder and visionary ruler.  Day 2Jaipur City TourAfter a fulfilling breakfast, set out on a full-day tour of Jaipur’s iconic attractions. Visit the majestic hilltop fort, Amer Fort, facing the serene Mgota Lake. You’ll next tour the City Palace, which will blow you away with its Rajput and Mughal architecture styles, and Jantar Mantar, the UNESCO-listed astronomical observatory. End the day with leisure time or an optional shopping session.  Day 3Jaipur – Bikaner Today, enjoy breakfast and check out of your hotel, then take a scenic drive to Bikaner. The first thing that awaits you here is a half-day city tour, kicking off at the magnificent Junagarh Fort, known for its intricate carvings, impressive courtyards, and fascinating museums. Explore the fort grand palaces and learn about Bikaner’s fascinating past before checking in to your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay.  Day 4Bikaner – Jaisalmer Today, you’ll journey to Jaisalmer, renowned as the Golden City, passing through Rajasthan’s desert landscapes, quaint, charming villages, and rustic allure. Upon arrival in Jaisalmer, check in to your hotel and spend the evening at leisure. Day 5Jaisalmer City Tour Start your day admiring Jaisalmer’s architectural delights, as you visit its renowned havelis, including Patwon Ki Haveli and Nathmal Ki Haveli and stop at the revered Jain temples: Chandraprabhu, Parasnath, Shitalnath, sambhavanath, Shantinath, Kunthunath, and rikhabdev Temple. Dedicate your evening to enjoying an unforgettable excursion to the Sam Sand Dunes. Participate in a camel ride or jeep safari across the golden desert, witness mesmerizing sunset views and Soak in traditional Rajasthani music and dance. Day 6Jaisalmer – Jodhpur After breakfast and hotel check-out, join our team for a thrilling drive to Jodhpur, dubbed the Blue City of Rajasthan. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and then brace yourself for local sightseeing. Visit the majestic Mehrangarh Fort, perched atop the city, and explore its impressive palaces, museums, and courtyards. Discover the bustling streets of the old city, admiring the charm of the blue-painted houses, vibrant markets, and local bazaars. Spend the evening at leisure. Day 7Jodhpur – Ranakpur – Mount Abu Today, following hotel check-out, our representative will drive you toward Mount Abu, with a stop at Ranakpur along the way. You’ll visit the exquisite Jain temples, including the famed Surya Temple and other beautifully carved shrines, showcasing intricate marble architecture. Continue your journey to Mount Abu, Rajasthan’s only hill station. Once arriving here, prepare to discover the renowned Dilwara Temples, celebrated for their stunning marble craftsmanship. Visit Nakki Lake and Achaleshwar Temple, treating your eyes to extraordinary views of the Aravalli hills. Spend the evening at your own pace. Day 8MOUNT ABU – UDAIPUR After bidding farewell to Mount Abu, you’ll travel to Udaipur, the enchanting City of Lakes. Check into your hotel upon arrival and then head out for sightseeing. The major draw is a visit to Lake Pichola, where you can take a boat ride to soak in the tranquil surroundings and take in the views of palaces and ghats.  Day 9Udaipur City Tour Today, join a full-day sightseeing tour of Udaipur that starts at the Jagdish Temple, noteworthy for its Indo-Aryan architecture. Next, tour the scenic Fatehsagar Lake, ideal for leisurely strolls and exquisite views of the surrounding hills. Explore the lush Saheliyon - ki - Bari, a beautifully landscaped garden, and culminate your excursion at the Bharatiya Lok Kala Mandir (Folk Art Museum), where you can acquaint yourself with traditional Rajasthani art, crafts, and performances. Spend the rest of the evening at leisure. Day 10Udaipur – Chittorgarh – Ranthambore Check out of your hotel and journey toward Ranthambore, with a stop at Chittorgarh, one of the country’s most historic forts. Marvel at its sprawling complex, including massive gates, grand palaces, and temples that tell tales of Rajput valor and heritage. You’ll continue your drive to Ranthambore, famous for its wildlife and tiger reserve. Upon arrival, check in to your resort and spend the evening at leisure. Day 11Ranthambore Spend the day at your own relaxed pace. You can opt for the iconic Ranthambore National Park safari, which lets you spot the mighty Bengal tiger along with leopards, sloth bears, marsh crocodiles, and a variety of exotic birds in their natural habitat. Day 12Departure After a satisfying breakfast, you’ll return to Jaipur on a relaxed transfer. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysRomeThe Essential Of ItalyShareAdd to Wishlist10N / 11D3 ImagesView GalleryThe Essential of ItalyNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThe Essential of Italy is an 11-day guided tour through Italy’s most iconic destinations, starting in Rome and ending in Venice. You’ll explore ancient history, Renaissance art, medieval towns, scenic coasts, and elegant cities with included guided visits and free time for optional excursions. Key stops include Rome, Siena, Florence, Pisa, the Cinque Terre, Genoa, Portofino, Milan, the Italian Lakes region, Verona, and Venice—offering a mix of culture, architecture, and landscapes.ItineraryDay 1ROMEWelcome to Rome! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2ROMEIn the morning, we’ll take a three-hour guided tour of the Eternal City, combining a walking tour through Imperial Rome with a panoramic bus ride to admire one of the oldest and most influential cities in Western civilization. During the tour, we’ll see iconic landmarks such as the Arch of Constantine, the exterior of the Colosseum and the Imperial Forums, the Circus Maximus, the Baths of Caracalla, the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, the Pyramid of Cestius, and Castel Sant’Angelo.The tour will end at VATICAN CITY around 11:00 a.m. Afterward, our guide will offer an optional visit to explore the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel.At the end of the day, we’ll include a transfer to the popular Trastevere neighborhood, known for its cozy restaurants and lively atmosphere. Return to the hotel will be around 8:30 p.m.Day 3ROMEFree day. If you wish, you’ll have the option to join an optional excursion. From April to October, enjoy a visit to the island of Capri; from November to March, discover Naples and Pompeii.Day 4ROME - ORVIETO - CASTIGLIONE DEL LAGO - SIENAToday we’ll embark on an enchanting journey through the beautiful region of Umbria. Our first stop will be Orvieto, a medieval city majestically set atop a flat summit. Before entering the city, we’ll pause to admire the breathtaking views from its viewpoint. We’ll then ride the escalators that connect the lower part of the town with the medieval center, where we’ll marvel at the cathedral, a stunning masterpiece of Italian Gothic art. Next, we’ll travel to Castiglione del Lago, nestled on the banks of Lake Trasimeno. Here, you’ll have time for a leisurely stroll and lunch. After lunch, our journey will continue to Siena, Tuscany, renowned for its famous Piazza del Campo and Duomo. We’ll spend the afternoon in Siena.Day 5SIENA - MONTERIGGIONI - SAN GIMIGNANO - FLORENCEWe will depart from SIENA and stop to visit MONTERIGGIONE, a charming medieval village with cobbled streets and ancient walls. After that, we continue to SAN GIMIGNANO, a delightful small town famous for its tall medieval towers. After lunch, we travel to FLORENCE, the capital of TUSCANY. We arrive in the early afternoon and head to the city’s historic center, where we can enjoy Florence’s lively atmosphere. We suggest that those interested in art visit one of its magnificent museums today, since they are closed on Mondays, such as the Uffizi Gallery (considered the finest art museum in Italy) or the Accademia Gallery (home to Michelangelo’s original David). Dinner is included.Day 6FLORENCEAfter capturing a photo at the Michelangelo viewpoint, where we’ll enjoy one of the most breathtaking views of the city, we will walk to the historic city center, where we will have guided tour of the capital of Tuscany, one of the most visited cities in the country. This city, known as the cradle of the Renaissance, has inspired some of the most influential artists and thinkers in history, such as Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Botticelli, and Raphael. We’ll marvel at the Gothic Cathedral (Duomo di Firenze), the ancient stone bridge (Ponte Vecchio) with its goldsmith stores, and Piazza della Signoria, the political heart of the city with the town hall in a medieval building. Free time will follow the tour.Note: We recommend wearing comfortable shoes for the city tour in Florence.Day 7FLORENCE - PISA - CINQUE TERRE - GENOAToday, we’ll travel to Pisa. A little tourist train will take us to the Piazza dei Miracoli (Square of Miracles), home of the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa. After this, we’ll head to the Ligurian Riviera, renowned for some of the prettiest coastlines in Europe. We’ll visit the Cinque Terre, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This area comprises five villages, famous world-wide, almost isolated by road, which currently live on tourism. We’ll arrive by train, tickets included, to one of its charming towns (normally Vernazza, but on busy tourist dates, it could be Manarola or Corniglia, very similar towns that are somewhat less crowded). We’ll have time for lunch. Afterwards, we’ll travel by train to Levanto, where we’ll take the bus to continue to Genoa. There, you’ll have some free time to explore the city center, a reminder of its grandeur as a powerful republic during the Middle Ages.Note: The train to Cinque Terre is a regular commuter service, not a tourist train. During peak tourism times, there can be long waits as trains may be full, and seat reservations are not available. In some cases, the journey might be done standing.Day 8GENOA - PORTOFINO - MILANWe’ll continue our journey to the nearby city of Santa Margherita Ligure, where we’ll embark for Portofino, one of the most exclusive places in Europe. Enjoy a stroll by the sea and time at leisure. After lunch, we’ll continue to Milan, where you’ll have free time to stroll through this elegant city—now a symbol of modernity and culture in northern Italy. We recommend visiting its stunning Gothic cathedral in Piazza del Duomo, as well as the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, built in honor of the first king of a unified Italy.Note: From May 30th to November 2nd, tourist buses are not allowed access to Santa Margherita Ligure. During this period, the stop will be in RAPALLO, another stunning coastal destination in the Liguria region, where we will board the boat to Portofino.Additional note: Due to adverse weather conditions or during winter, the boat crossing to Portofino (whether from Santa Margherita or Rapallo) may not be operational due to weather conditions.Day 9MILAN - LAKES REGION - VERONAToday we’ll see one of the most beautiful scenic areas in Europe, the region of the Italian Lakes. First, we’ll travel to Lake Orta in Orta San Giulio, a well-preserved medieval city. We’ll take a train ride to reach the medieval center of the town and then a boat to the Island of San Giulio, a little island on the lake with a monastery. After this, we’ll go on to Lake Maggiore, making a stop in Stresa, where we’ll have the option to visit the Borromean Islands. The highlight is Isola Bella, featuring its gardens and palace (closed in the winter). We´ll have some time for lunch and then we’ll head to Verona.Day 10VERONA - VENICEWe’ll have time to explore Verona, the enchanting city of Romeo and Juliet, before departing for Venice, arriving around 01:00 p.m. A delightful boat trip to St. Mark’s Square is included, followed by a guided walking tour of the City of Canals, including a visit to see Murano glasswork. Afterwards, enjoy some leisure time—perhaps a gondola ride? Accommodation will be in the Mestre district.Day 11VENICEAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel Options4* Ergife Hotel or similar4* Four title: 12 Nights and 13 Days South of Europe Holiday Package
meta_description: Rayna Tours’ South of Europe holiday package is your chance of exploring numerous popular European cities in one tour. You get to visit Milan, Rome, Zurich, Florence, and Venice with this package.
content: 12 Nights and 13 Days South of Europe Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysRomeSouth Of EuropeShareAdd to Wishlist12N / 13D6 ImagesView GallerySouth of EuropeNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as Visit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as Madird,Zaragoza, Poblet, Barcelona, Girona, Chambéry, Leysin, Interlaken, Lucerne, Zurich, Milan, Rome, Florence, and Venice, on a single holiday! This eight - night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Zurich, you will travel through Milan, Germany, Rome, and Florence before your break ends in the city of lights Venice. on a single holiday! This eight - night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Madird, you will travel through Zaragoza, Poblet, Barcelona, Girona, Chambéry, Leysin, Interlaken, Lucerne, Zurich, Milan, Rome, Florence before your break ends in the city of lights Venice.ItineraryDay 1MADRIDWelcome to Madrid! Upon arrival at the airport, we’ll be ready to transfer you to your hotel. You’ll have some free time until the tour begins. Please check the information signs in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide and fellow travelers.In the evening, we’ll provide a transfer to Plaza Mayor and La Latina, Madrid’s most famous neighborhood for nightlife and tapas restaurants. You can choose to dine at a restaurant of your preference—options include Indian, Chinese, Spanish, and Middle Eastern cuisines.Day 2MADRIDThe morning will begin with a comprehensive tour of central Madrid, featuring highlights like Paseo del Prado, Cibeles, Neptuno, Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Colón, and Plaza Mayor. We’ll then visit Retiro Park, a beautiful oasis in the city center, where we’ll see the lake and the Palacio de Cristal. Admission is included to the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, the home of Real Madrid—considered by many to be the best football club in the world. Enjoy the rest of the afternoon at your leisure. In the evening, we’ll provide a return transfer to the hotel.Day 3MADRID- ZARAGOZA- POBLET – BARCELONAIn the morning, we’ll leave for Aragon, travelling through the lands of Castile. Our first stop will be in Zaragoza to admire the stunning Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar. We’ll then journey to the serene Poblet Abbey, one of the best-preserved medieval monasteries in the world (tickets included). Finally, we’ll head to Barcelona, where we’ll arrive in the evening.Day 4BARCELONA- GIRONAIn the morning, we´ll embark on a tour of the City of Counts. This vibrant city, nestled along the Mediterranean Sea, is famous for Gaudi’s modernist architecture, the bustling Ramblas, and its rich history, highlighted by the Universal Exposition and the Olympics hosted here. Barcelona is renowned as one of the most beautiful and fascinating European capitals. In the evening, we’ll leave Barcelona and travel north into Catalonia. Before settling into our hotel, we’ll take a walk in Girona, exploring its historic center, known for its colorful houses, the old Jewish quarter, and its impressive cathedral.Day 5GIRONA- CAREERS OF LIGHTS - CHAMBÉRYWe’ll head to France, traveling through the Provence region. Our first stop will be Arles, a small UNESCO World Heritage city known for its connections to Van Gogh. Here, we can visit the Roman theater and quaint Romanesque churches. There will be time to explore and have lunch. Next, we’ll include a visit to Carrières des Lumières, an incredible underground art experience featuring a captivating display of art, images, and sound in an ancient quarry. We’ll arrive in Chambery, the charming capital of Savoy, for the evening, a medieval style city with beautiful historic center and large castle.Note: If tickets for the Carrières des Lumières show are unavailable due to high demand, we will provide an alternative visit to the Pont du Gard, a famous Roman aqueductDay 6CHAMBÉRY- GENEVA - GRUYERES - LEYSINWe’ll journey to Switzerland, arriving in Geneva. With our guide, we’ll go to Palais des Nations (headquarters of the United Nations in Europe), and we’ll see the beautiful English Garden with its flower clock, and admire the Jet d’Eau, the tallest fountain in Europe. Our next stop will be the charming, walled village of Gruyères, world-renowned for its cheese. Nearby, there are some of Switzerland´s major chocolate factories, including Nestlé. Our tour includes admission to the Maison Cailler Chocolate Factory, where you’ll enjoy a sweet tasting experience!We’ll continue our journey along scenic roads, passing through bucolic mountain landscapes and picturesque wooden villages, until we reach Chillon Castle, built on the shores of Lake Geneva (admission included). We’ll arrive in Leysin by mid-afternoon, a charming holiday village with spectacular views of the Rhône Valley and Mont Blanc. Leysin is well-known for its winter sports resort and hiking options. Dinner will be includedNote: Depending on availability, accommodation may sometimes be in another charming Swiss town nestled in the Alps, such as Martigny.Day 7LEYSIN- INTERLAKEN - LUCERNE – ZURICHWe’ll experience stunning mountain scenery today, so be sure to pack your winter clothes. We’ll ascend to Glacier 3000 by cable car ride, one of the most spectacular spots in Switzerland featuring ice and snow year-round, and where you can walk on the suspended bridge between two mountain peaks, explore the Ice Cathedral, or enjoy the Fun Park. We’ll stop in Interlaken for lunch before traveling to Lucerne, one of the most beautiful cities in Switzerland. In the evening, we’ll arrive in Zurich, with some time to explore the center before heading to the hotel.Note: In case of adverse weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances, the Glacier 3000 cable car may be closed. If this happens, we will offer an equally spectacular alternative to enjoy the alpine landscapes.Day 8ZURICH - BELLINZONA - COMO - MILANWe’ll leave Zurich early in the morning, crossing the Alps to reach the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. Our first stop will be Bellinzona, renowned for its three medieval castles, which are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Perched on the hills overlooking the city, these castles highlight Bellinzona´s historical significance as a key alpine stronghold. Enjoy some free time to wander through the charming streets of the center. Next, we´ll enter Italy and stop in the charming town of Como for lunch. This town is considered the jewel of Lombardy, known for its beautiful gardens beside the lake and its spectacular cathedral. We’ll continue to Milan, where our guide will take us to the impressive Piazza del Duomo. You’ll have some time to wander around before we transfer you to the hotel.Day 9MILAN- PISA- ROMToday, we’ll continue our journey to Pisa. We´ll ride a small tourist train to the Piazza dei Miracoli (Square of Miracles), where you´ll have time to admire one of the most captivating and beautiful art complexes in Italy, including the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa. Afterwards, we’ll head to Rome, arriving later in the day.Day 10ROMEIn the morning, we’ll go on a three-hour panoramic tour of Rome with a local guide, combining a bus ride with a walking section through part of Imperial Rome. We’ll see, among other highlights, the Arch of Constantine, the exterior of the Colosseum, and the Imperial Forums—an architectural complex that was the political heart of the ancient world. During the bus route, we’ll pass by some of the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the Circus Maximus, the Baths of Caracalla, the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, the Pyramid of Cestius, and the exterior of Castel Sant’Angelo.The tour will end in Vatican City at around 11:00 a.m., an independent state within the city of Rome and the center of the Catholic Church. After the panoramic tour, our guide will offer an optional visit to explore the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel in greater detail. The afternoon will be free.At the end of the day, we’ll include a transfer to the popular Trastevere district, known for its charming restaurants and lively atmosphere. Return to the hotel around 8:30 p.m.Day 11ROME – FLORENCEToday, we’ll leave Rome and head north, taking in the beautiful landscapes along the way. Upon reaching Florence, we’ll go directly to the stunning Piazzale Michelangelo for breathtaking views of the city. In the evening, we’ll enjoy a guided walking tour with a local expert through the historic center, visiting landmarks such as the Ponte Vecchio, the Duomo, and Piazza della Signoria. This city is like an open-air museum. Afterward, you´ll have some free time to explore at your leisure. In the evening, you’ll have plenty of options for dinner, as this district offers many restaurants with a variety of international cuisines.Day 12FLORENCE- VENICEToday, we’ll enjoy the stunning mountain landscapes as we cross the Apennines. Upon arriving in Venice, we’ll take a boat across the Giudecca Canal to the Island of Venice. With a local guide, we’ll visit the marvelous St. Mark’s Square. Afterwards, we’ll tour the Murano Glass Factory, where you’ll see the fascinating techniques used to create this ancient glass. You´ll have some free time to explore on your own. Accommodation will be in the Mestre district.Day 13VENICEAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from the below mentioned hotelsInclusionTravel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: Barcelona, Florence, Madrid, Rome, VeniceBoat: to the island of VeniceEvening transfer: Plaza Mayor and la Latina in Madrid, Trastevere in RomeExperiences: Glacier 3000 cable car in the AlpsTransfer: Piazzale Michelangelo in FlorenceTicket admission: Carrieres de Lumiere Show, Chillon castle;
