title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Classical Spain Tour Package
meta_description: Go on a detailed tour of Spain with Rayna Tours’ Classical Spain tour package. You can book this package that gives you the chance to stay in Spain for 7 nights and 8 days.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Classical Spain Tour PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBarcelonaClassical SpainShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D5 ImagesView GalleryClassical SpainNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewExplore Spain’s four iconic cities in seven nights with this ultimate holiday! From Madrid’s rich architecture and Granada’s laid-back ambiance to Seville’s artistic heritage and Barcelona’s unmatched vibrancy, a world of splendid attractions and experiences awaits you! Enjoy absolute convenience and flexibility from start to finish as you stay in the hotels of your choice, savor daily breakfasts, and bask in the comfort of fully guided excursions.ItineraryDay 1MADRID Upon arrival at the airport, we’ll be ready to transfer you to your hotel. You’ll have some free time until the tour begins. Please check the information signs in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide and fellow travelers.In the evening, we’ll provide a transfer to Plaza Mayor and La Latina, Madrid’s most famous neighborhood for nightlife and tapas restaurants. You can choose to dine at a restaurant of your preference—options include Indian, Chinese, Spanish, and Middle Eastern cuisines.Day 2MADRID The morning will begin with a comprehensive tour of central Madrid, featuring highlights like Paseo del Prado, Cibeles, Neptuno, Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Colón, and Plaza Mayor. We’ll then visit Retiro Park, a beautiful oasis in the city center, where we’ll see the lake and the Palacio de Cristal. Admission is included to the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, the home of Real Madrid—considered by many to be the best football club in the world. Enjoy the rest of the afternoon at your leisure. In the evening, we’ll provide a return transfer to the hotel.Day 3MADRID - GRANADAWe will depart from Madrid early in the morning, heading south through La Mancha. Our first stop will be in Puerto Lápice, a charming Manchego village evocative of Don Quixote. We will then continue into Andalusia via Despeñaperros, arriving in Granada, where lunch will be included. In the afternoon, if you have chosen the option that includes a visit to the Alhambra, we will explore the magnificent Alhambra Palace and its beautiful Generalife Gardens, both built during the Arab period, with a local guide.VERY IMPORTANT NOTE: The number of visitors allowed into the Alhambra is strictly regulated by law. To ensure your admission, tickets will be issued upon confirming your tour reservation. It´s essential to provide accurate personal details (full name and passport/ID number) at the time of booking. Please be aware that ticket costs are non-refundable in case of cancellation. In rare cases where the Alhambra visit is not possible, we will instead tour the Royal Alcázar of Seville, which offers similar historical and architectural significance.Day 4GRANADA – MALAGA- MARBELLA- RONDA- SEVILLEToday, Departure from Granada. We´ll head towards the Costa del Sol. First stop, Malaga, where we´ll have time for a stroll through its historic district, famous for its cathedral and the Picasso Museum. Afterward, we´ll proceed along the coastal highway, enjoying picturesque views of the Mediterranean. Puerto Banús, in Marbella, is a stunning and sophisticated recreational harbor. In the afternoon, we´ll continue our journey through the mountains listening to stories of bandits before reaching Ronda, a picturesque white town known for its cliffside location and a deep canyon that divides the town. Finally, Seville. We’ll arrive in the evening.Day 5SEVILLEIn the morning, we´ll embark on a city tour of Seville, where you´ll visit the cathedral with its famous Giralda, explore the banks of the Guadalquivir River, and wander through the popular neighborhoods of Santa Cruz and Triana. After the tour, enjoy a relaxing boat ride on the Guadalquivir River offering stunning panoramic views (included). In the evening, you´ll have the option to attend a popular flamenco tablao.Day 6SEVILLE - ZARAGOZA – POBLET- BARCELONAAfter breakfast, we’ll provide a transfer to the train station to take the high-speed train to Zaragoza, covering 850 km in just under four hours. You’ll have free time in Zaragoza to visit the impressive Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar and explore the city center.After lunch, we’ll head to the Poblet Abbey, nestled in a beautiful setting and surrounded by historic walls. It’s one of the best-preserved medieval monasteries in the world (admission included). We’ll then continue to Barcelona, arriving in the evening.Day 7BARCELONAIn the morning, we´ll embark on a panoramic tour of Barcelona, renowned as one of the most fascinating European capitals. This vibrant city, nestled along the Mediterranean Sea, is famous for Gaudi’s modernist architecture, the bustling Ramblas, and its rich history, highlighted by the Universal Exposition and the Olympics hosted here. You´ll have free time in the afternoon. In the evening, we´ll provide a transfer to Maremagnum, a contemporary entertainment and dining complex by the sea, located near Plaza de Colón. Here, you can enjoy a leisurely stroll through the lively area and choose from a variety of dining options.Day 8BARCELONAAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from the below mentioned hotelsInclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: MADRID, SEVILLE, BARCELONABoat: Guadalquivir River in SevilleEvening transfer: Plaza Mayor and la Latina in Madrid, Seville´s historic center, Maremagnum in BarcelonaTicket admission: Santiago Bernabeu Stadium in Madrid, visit to the Alhambra Palace and Generalife Gardens in Granada only option with Alhambra ticket included. title: 12 Nights and 13 Days South of Europe Holiday Package
meta_description: Rayna Tours’ South of Europe holiday package is your chance of exploring numerous popular European cities in one tour. You get to visit Milan, Rome, Zurich, Florence, and Venice with this package.
content: 12 Nights and 13 Days South of Europe Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMadridSouth Of EuropeShareAdd to Wishlist12N / 13D6 ImagesView GallerySouth of EuropeNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewVisit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as Visit some of Europe’s most fantastic destinations, such as Madird,Zaragoza, Poblet, Barcelona, Girona, Chambéry, Leysin, Interlaken, Lucerne, Zurich, Milan, Rome, Florence, and Venice, on a single holiday! This eight - night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Zurich, you will travel through Milan, Germany, Rome, and Florence before your break ends in the city of lights Venice. on a single holiday! This eight - night retreat lets you see the best of the classic European cities, with all accommodations, transfers, and guided excursions included in the package. Starting in Madird, you will travel through Zaragoza, Poblet, Barcelona, Girona, Chambéry, Leysin, Interlaken, Lucerne, Zurich, Milan, Rome, Florence before your break ends in the city of lights Venice.ItineraryDay 1MADRIDWelcome to Madrid! Upon arrival at the airport, we’ll be ready to transfer you to your hotel. You’ll have some free time until the tour begins. Please check the information signs in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide and fellow travelers.In the evening, we’ll provide a transfer to Plaza Mayor and La Latina, Madrid’s most famous neighborhood for nightlife and tapas restaurants. You can choose to dine at a restaurant of your preference—options include Indian, Chinese, Spanish, and Middle Eastern cuisines.Day 2MADRIDThe morning will begin with a comprehensive tour of central Madrid, featuring highlights like Paseo del Prado, Cibeles, Neptuno, Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Colón, and Plaza Mayor. We’ll then visit Retiro Park, a beautiful oasis in the city center, where we’ll see the lake and the Palacio de Cristal. Admission is included to the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, the home of Real Madrid—considered by many to be the best football club in the world. Enjoy the rest of the afternoon at your leisure. In the evening, we’ll provide a return transfer to the hotel.Day 3MADRID- ZARAGOZA- POBLET – BARCELONAIn the morning, we’ll leave for Aragon, travelling through the lands of Castile. Our first stop will be in Zaragoza to admire the stunning Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar. We’ll then journey to the serene Poblet Abbey, one of the best-preserved medieval monasteries in the world (tickets included). Finally, we’ll head to Barcelona, where we’ll arrive in the evening.Day 4BARCELONA- GIRONAIn the morning, we´ll embark on a tour of the City of Counts. This vibrant city, nestled along the Mediterranean Sea, is famous for Gaudi’s modernist architecture, the bustling Ramblas, and its rich history, highlighted by the Universal Exposition and the Olympics hosted here. Barcelona is renowned as one of the most beautiful and fascinating European capitals. In the evening, we’ll leave Barcelona and travel north into Catalonia. Before settling into our hotel, we’ll take a walk in Girona, exploring its historic center, known for its colorful houses, the old Jewish quarter, and its impressive cathedral.Day 5GIRONA- CAREERS OF LIGHTS - CHAMBÉRYWe’ll head to France, traveling through the Provence region. Our first stop will be Arles, a small UNESCO World Heritage city known for its connections to Van Gogh. Here, we can visit the Roman theater and quaint Romanesque churches. There will be time to explore and have lunch. Next, we’ll include a visit to Carrières des Lumières, an incredible underground art experience featuring a captivating display of art, images, and sound in an ancient quarry. We’ll arrive in Chambery, the charming capital of Savoy, for the evening, a medieval style city with beautiful historic center and large castle.Note: If tickets for the Carrières des Lumières show are unavailable due to high demand, we will provide an alternative visit to the Pont du Gard, a famous Roman aqueductDay 6CHAMBÉRY- GENEVA - GRUYERES - LEYSINWe’ll journey to Switzerland, arriving in Geneva. With our guide, we’ll go to Palais des Nations (headquarters of the United Nations in Europe), and we’ll see the beautiful English Garden with its flower clock, and admire the Jet d’Eau, the tallest fountain in Europe. Our next stop will be the charming, walled village of Gruyères, world-renowned for its cheese. Nearby, there are some of Switzerland´s major chocolate factories, including Nestlé. Our tour includes admission to the Maison Cailler Chocolate Factory, where you’ll enjoy a sweet tasting experience!We’ll continue our journey along scenic roads, passing through bucolic mountain landscapes and picturesque wooden villages, until we reach Chillon Castle, built on the shores of Lake Geneva (admission included). We’ll arrive in Leysin by mid-afternoon, a charming holiday village with spectacular views of the Rhône Valley and Mont Blanc. Leysin is well-known for its winter sports resort and hiking options. Dinner will be includedNote: Depending on availability, accommodation may sometimes be in another charming Swiss town nestled in the Alps, such as Martigny.Day 7LEYSIN- INTERLAKEN - LUCERNE – ZURICHWe’ll experience stunning mountain scenery today, so be sure to pack your winter clothes. We’ll ascend to Glacier 3000 by cable car ride, one of the most spectacular spots in Switzerland featuring ice and snow year-round, and where you can walk on the suspended bridge between two mountain peaks, explore the Ice Cathedral, or enjoy the Fun Park. We’ll stop in Interlaken for lunch before traveling to Lucerne, one of the most beautiful cities in Switzerland. In the evening, we’ll arrive in Zurich, with some time to explore the center before heading to the hotel.Note: In case of adverse weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances, the Glacier 3000 cable car may be closed. If this happens, we will offer an equally spectacular alternative to enjoy the alpine landscapes.Day 8ZURICH - BELLINZONA - COMO - MILANWe’ll leave Zurich early in the morning, crossing the Alps to reach the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. Our first stop will be Bellinzona, renowned for its three medieval castles, which are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Perched on the hills overlooking the city, these castles highlight Bellinzona´s historical significance as a key alpine stronghold. Enjoy some free time to wander through the charming streets of the center. Next, we´ll enter Italy and stop in the charming town of Como for lunch. This town is considered the jewel of Lombardy, known for its beautiful gardens beside the lake and its spectacular cathedral. We’ll continue to Milan, where our guide will take us to the impressive Piazza del Duomo. You’ll have some time to wander around before we transfer you to the hotel.Day 9MILAN- PISA- ROMToday, we’ll continue our journey to Pisa. We´ll ride a small tourist train to the Piazza dei Miracoli (Square of Miracles), where you´ll have time to admire one of the most captivating and beautiful art complexes in Italy, including the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa. Afterwards, we’ll head to Rome, arriving later in the day.Day 10ROMEIn the morning, we’ll go on a three-hour panoramic tour of Rome with a local guide, combining a bus ride with a walking section through part of Imperial Rome. We’ll see, among other highlights, the Arch of Constantine, the exterior of the Colosseum, and the Imperial Forums—an architectural complex that was the political heart of the ancient world. During the bus route, we’ll pass by some of the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the Circus Maximus, the Baths of Caracalla, the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, the Pyramid of Cestius, and the exterior of Castel Sant’Angelo.The tour will end in Vatican City at around 11:00 a.m., an independent state within the city of Rome and the center of the Catholic Church. After the panoramic tour, our guide will offer an optional visit to explore the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel in greater detail. The afternoon will be free.At the end of the day, we’ll include a transfer to the popular Trastevere district, known for its charming restaurants and lively atmosphere. Return to the hotel around 8:30 p.m.Day 11ROME – FLORENCEToday, we’ll leave Rome and head north, taking in the beautiful landscapes along the way. Upon reaching Florence, we’ll go directly to the stunning Piazzale Michelangelo for breathtaking views of the city. In the evening, we’ll enjoy a guided walking tour with a local expert through the historic center, visiting landmarks such as the Ponte Vecchio, the Duomo, and Piazza della Signoria. This city is like an open-air museum. Afterward, you´ll have some free time to explore at your leisure. In the evening, you’ll have plenty of options for dinner, as this district offers many restaurants with a variety of international cuisines.Day 12FLORENCE- VENICEToday, we’ll enjoy the stunning mountain landscapes as we cross the Apennines. Upon arriving in Venice, we’ll take a boat across the Giudecca Canal to the Island of Venice. With a local guide, we’ll visit the marvelous St. Mark’s Square. Afterwards, we’ll tour the Murano Glass Factory, where you’ll see the fascinating techniques used to create this ancient glass. You´ll have some free time to explore on your own. Accommodation will be in the Mestre district.Day 13VENICEAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from the below mentioned hotelsInclusionTravel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: Barcelona, Florence, Madrid, Rome, VeniceBoat: to the island of VeniceEvening transfer: Plaza Mayor and la Latina in Madrid, Trastevere in RomeExperiences: Glacier 3000 cable car in the AlpsTransfer: Piazzale Michelangelo in FlorenceTicket admission: Carrieres de Lumiere Show, Chillon castle; Before settling into our hotel, we’ll take a walk in Girona, exploring its historic center, known for its colorful houses, the old Jewish quarter, and its impressive cathedral.Day 5GIRONA - CAREERS OF LIGHT - CHAMBERYWe’ll head to France, traveling through the Provence region. Our first stop will be Arles, a small UNESCO World Heritage city known for its connections to Van Gogh. Here, we can visit the Roman theater and quaint Romanesque churches. There will be time to explore and have lunch. Next, we’ll include a visit to Carrières des Lumières, an incredible underground art experience featuring a captivating display of art, images, and sound in an ancient quarry. We’ll arrive in Chambery, the charming capital of Savoy, for the evening, a medieval style city with beautiful historic center and large castle.Note: If tickets for the Carrières des Lumières show are unavailable due to high demand, we will provide an alternative visit to the Pont du Gard, a famous Roman aqueductDay 6CHAMBERY - GENEVA - GRUYERES - LEYSINWe’ll journey to Switzerland, arriving in Geneva. With our guide, we’ll go to Palais des Nations (headquarters of the United Nations in Europe), and we’ll see the beautiful English Garden with its flower clock, and admire the Jet d’Eau, the tallest fountain in Europe. Our next stop will be the charming, walled village of Gruyères, world-renowned for its cheese. Nearby, there are some of Switzerland´s major chocolate factories, including Nestlé. Our tour includes admission to the Maison Cailler Chocolate Factory, where you’ll enjoy a sweet tasting experience!We’ll continue our journey along scenic roads, passing through bucolic mountain landscapes and picturesque wooden villages, until we reach Chillon Castle, built on the shores of Lake Geneva (admission included). We’ll arrive in Leysin by mid-afternoon, a charming holiday village with spectacular views of the Rhône Valley and Mont Blanc. Leysin is well-known for its winter sports resort and hiking options. Dinner will be includedNote: Depending on availability, accommodation may sometimes be in another charming Swiss town nestled in the Alps, such as Martigny.Day 7LEYSIN - INTERLAKEN - LUCERNE - ZURICHWe’ll experience stunning mountain scenery today, so be sure to pack your winter clothes. We’ll ascend to Glacier 3000 by cable car ride, one of the most spectacular spots in Switzerland featuring ice and snow year-round, and where you can walk on the suspended bridge between two mountain peaks, explore the Ice Cathedral, or enjoy the Fun Park. We’ll stop in Interlaken for lunch before traveling to Lucerne, one of the most beautiful cities in Switzerland. In the evening, we’ll arrive in Zurich, with some time to explore the center before heading to the hotel.Note: In case of adverse weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances, the Glacier 3000 cable car may be closed. If this happens, we will offer an equally spectacular alternative to enjoy the alpine landscapes.Day 8ZURICHAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel OptionsAny from the below mentioned hotelsInclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: Madrid, BarcelonaEvening transfer: Plaza Mayor and la Latina in MadridExperiences: Glacier 3000 cable car in the AlpsTicket admission: Santiago Bernabeu Stadium in Madrid, Poblet Monastery, Carrieres de Lumiere Show, Chillon castle; content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysMadridClassical Spain With Paris GOShareAdd to Wishlist9N / 10D4 ImagesView GalleryClassical Spain with Paris GONewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThis 10-day journey takes you through the cultural heart of Spain and France, beginning in Madrid with guided city tours, famous landmarks, and lively tapas districts. You travel south through La Mancha to Granada, where the magnificent Alhambra Palace awaits, followed by a scenic coastal drive via Nerja and Málaga and the dramatic cliff town of Ronda, ending in vibrant Seville with a river cruise and historic city tour.From Seville, a high-speed train takes you to Zaragoza, where you explore its grand basilica and historic center before continuing to Barcelona via the medieval Poblet Abbey. Barcelona offers stunning modernist architecture, Mediterranean charm, and a guided panoramic tour.You then travel by high-speed train to Paris, where highlights include Versailles, Montmartre, a full Paris city tour, the Eiffel Tower (2nd level), and a Seine River cruise, concluding your European experience in one of the world’s most iconic cities.A perfect blend of history, culture, scenic landscapes, and iconic landmarks across Spain and FranceItineraryDay 1MadridWelcome to Madrid! Upon arrival at the airport, we’ll be ready to transfer you to your hotel. You’ll have some free time until the tour begins. Please check the information signs in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide and fellow travelers.In the evening, we’ll provide a transfer to Plaza Mayor and La Latina, Madrid’s most famous neighborhood for nightlife and tapas restaurants. You can choose to dine at a restaurant of your preference options include Indian, Chinese, Spanish, and Middle Eastern cuisines.Day 2MadridThe morning will begin with a comprehensive tour of central Madrid, featuring highlights like Paseo del Prado, Cibeles, Neptuno, Puerta de Alcalá, Plaza de Colón, and Plaza Mayor. We’ll then visit Retiro Park, a beautiful oasis in the city center, where we’ll see the lake and the Palacio de Cristal. Admission is included to the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium, the home of Real Madrid considered by many to be the best football club in the world. Enjoy the rest of the afternoon at your leisure. In the evening, we’ll provide a return transfer to the hotel.Day 3Madrid - Granada We will depart from Madrid early in the morning, heading south through La Mancha. Our first stop will be in Puerto Lápice, a charming Manchego village evocative of Don Quixote. We will then continue into Andalusia via Despeñaperros, arriving in Granada, where lunch will be included. In the afternoon, if you have chosen the option that includes a visit to the Alhambra, we will explore the magnificent Alhambra Palace and its beautiful Generalife Gardens, both built during the Arab period, with a local guide.VERY IMPORTANT NOTE: The number of visitors allowed into the Alhambra is strictly regulated by law. To ensure your admission, tickets will be issued upon confirming your tour reservation. It´s essential to provide accurate personal details (full name and passport/ID number) at the time of booking. Please be aware that ticket costs are non-refundable in case of cancellation. In rare cases where the Alhambra visit is not possible, we will instead tour the Royal Alcázar of Seville, which offers similar historical and architectural significance.Day 4Granada - Nerja - Malaga - Ronda - SevilleToday we’ll enjoy spectacular landscapes as we leave behind the Sierra Nevada mountain range. We’ll then continue along the Mediterranean, on the so-called Tropical Coast, where the mild year-round microclimate allows for the cultivation of tropical fruits such as guavas, mangoes, and avocados, and in the past, sugar cane.We stop in NERJA, a charming seaside town with impressive cliffs. We continue on to MÁLAGA, the capital of the Costa del Sol, full of life and boasting a beautiful historic center. Time for lunch and a stroll through the city center.Afterward, we head into the Andalusian sierras and arrive in RONDA, a stunning white town famous for its dramatic gorge that splits the city in two.We continue to SEVILLE, arriving in the late afternoon. Dinner included at the hotel.Day 5Seville - Zaragoza In the morning, we’ll include a panoramic tour of the city. You’ll visit the cathedral and its famous Giralda, the banks of the Guadalquivir River, and the popular neighborhoods of Santa Cruz and Triana. After the tour, we’ll include a boat ride on the Guadalquivir River. In the afternoon, you’ll be transferred to the station to board the high-speed train, scheduled to depart around 4:30 p.m., covering the 850 km to Zaragoza in just under four hours. Upon arrival in Zaragoza, you’ll be transferred to the hotel.Note: The train journey will be without an accompanying guide.Day 6Zaragoza - Poblet - Barcelona We’ll start the day with a morning panoramic tour of Zaragoza guided by a local expert. Our first stop will be the Cathedral-Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar. We´ll also delve into the works of the famous painter Goya and discover some of his masterpieces. The tour will move on to the Roman theatre and a Renaissance palace, and then we’ll take a stroll by the Aljafería Palace.After lunch, we’ll head to Catalonia to visit the Poblet Abbey, a stunning walled monastery set amidst beautiful scenery. It is one of the best-preserved medieval monasteries in the world (tickets included). Our journey will then take us to Barcelona, where we’ll arrive in the evening.Day 7BarcelonaIn the morning, we include a panoramic tour of BARCELONA, considered one of Europe’s most fascinating capitals. Open to the Mediterranean Sea, the city is renowned for Gaudí and its modernist architecture, as well as for its lively Ramblas and the legacy of the World Expositions and Olympic Games held here. Barcelona is often regarded as one of the most beautiful and captivating cities in Europe. The tour ends at the Maremagnum, a modern leisure and dining complex by the sea next to Columbus Square, where you can stroll through this lively area. Afternoon at leisure. Return to the hotel at the end of the day.Day 8Barcelona - ParisAt the scheduled time, we’ll provide a transfer to the station for your high-speed train journey from Barcelona to Paris, which is included in your trip. In just over 6 hours of comfortable travel, you’ll arrive at your destination. Upon arrival, another transfer will take you to your hotel. Your guide will contact you in the evening, or you can check the information signs provided at the hotel reception.Note: The train journey will be without an guide.Day 9ParisWe’ll immerse ourselves in the rich history of FRANCE at the magnificent Palace of Versailles (admission not included), renowned for its stunning gardens. On our return to PARIS, we’ll visit Montmartre, a charming bohemian neighborhood famous for its artists, painters, and cabarets. To fully appreciate the grandeur of Paris, we’ll embark on a panoramic city tour with a local guide, showcasing the city’s impressive avenues and iconic monuments. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel. For those interested, there is an optional variety show in the evening.Day 10Paris - DepartureWe’ll start our day in central PARIS, beginning with a visit to the iconic Eiffel Tower. You´ll have the chance to go up to the second floor of this famous iron landmark (tickets included). Afterwards, we’ll enjoy a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine, which will last approximately one hour and fifteen minutes. You’ll have a free afternoon to explore the city at your own pace (transfer back to the hotel not included).Note: If wait times at the Eiffel Tower are too long, we might reschedule the visit to a different time (or on Sunday) for your convenience. Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of your flight in case you might need an additional night.Hotel OptionsHotel Praga Madrid or SimilarHotel Saray Granada or SimilarEurostars Al-Ándalus or SimilarHampton by Hilton Barcelona Fira Gran Via or SimilarMama Paris La Défense or Similar Previous NextInclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, and breakfast buffet. Includes: arrival and departure transfer Excursion: Versailles in Paris (entrance not included).Boat: Guadalquivir River in Seville, Boat Trip along River Seine in Paris.City tour in: Madrid, Seville, Barcelona, Paris.Evening Transfer: Plaza Mayor and la Latina in Madrid, Maremagnum in Barcelona.Ticket admission: Santiago Bernabeu Stadium in Madrid, visit to the Alhambra Palace and Generalife Gardens in Granada only option with Alhambra ticket included., Poblet Monastery, 2nd Floor Eiffel Tower in Paris.High Speed Train: Seville- Zaragoza, Barcelona to Paris.2 Lunch or Dinner Included in: Granada, Seville.ExclusionFlight TicketsVisa to EuropeEntrances other than mentioned Anything not mentioned in inclusions Travel InsuranceDeparture & PricingPricing: Package Cost: Ground Services Per Person on Double/Twin sharing: AED 11,199 Important InformationRooms and rates are subject to availability at the time of booking. title: MSC Euribia Cruise: Copenhagen to Norway & Germany

content: MSC Euribia Cruise: Copenhagen to Norway & GermanyHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeCruisesCopenhagenMsc Euirbia-Copenhagen-Hellesylt-Alesund-Flaam-KielShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D7 ImagesView GalleryMsc Euirbia-Copenhagen-Hellesylt-Alesund-Flaam-KielNewUpcoming DeparturesMealsOnboard ActivitiesKids Clubs and ChildcareFitness FacilitiesPort Taxes and FeesAccommodationsSwimming PoolTheater showsOverviewMSC Euribia is named after the ancient goddess Euribia who harnessed the winds, weather, and constellations to master the seas, furthering the vision of the ship to master the deployment of state-of-the-art technology to minimize its impact on the precious marine ecosystem. The ship is also empowered with striking new features. Not only do the decks boast numerous original works of art, for the first time the hull itself is a visual masterpiece. On this unique ship where art meets innovation.ItineraryDay 1Copenhagen DenmarkBegin your journey in Denmark’s vibrant capital, a city where fairy-tale charm meets sleek Scandinavian design. Explore colorful Nyhavn, the royal palaces, and the cozy cafés that line cobblestone streets. As you sail away, enjoy views of the city’s spires and the calm waters.Day 2Day At SeaRelax and unwind as you sail through the North Sea, enjoying your ship’s amenities and panoramic ocean views. Take this time to explore onboard dining, entertainment, and spa options. The fresh sea breeze and open horizon set the perfect tone for the adventures ahead.Day 3Hellesylt Sail through Norway’s stunning fjord country, stopping briefly in Hellesylt before continuing to Geiranger. Towering cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and crystal-blue waters create unforgettable scenery. It’s a day filled with the very best of Norway’s natural beauty.Day 4Alesund NorwayÅlesund is known for its elegant Art Nouveau architecture, rebuilt after a fire in 1904 with colorful, turreted buildings. Climb the 418 steps to Mount Aksla for panoramic views of the town and surrounding islands. This charming coastal city perfectly blends history, design, and natural beauty.Day 5Flaam NorwaySet deep within the Aurlandsfjord, Flåm is a picturesque village famous for the scenic Flåmsbana Railway — one of the steepest train rides in the world. The journey offers dramatic mountain and waterfall views. Nature lovers will find endless hiking trails and peaceful fjord cruises to enjoy.Day 6Day At SeaSpend a relaxing day cruising back toward continental Europe. Attend onboard activities, enjoy fine dining, or simply watch the endless seascape from your balcony. It’s a perfect time to reflect on Norway’s majestic landscapes.Day 7 Kiel GermanyKiel, a lively port city on the Baltic Sea, is known for its maritime heritage and relaxed atmosphere. Visit the historic harbor, the Kiel Canal, or explore nearby Lübeck for its medieval charm. The city’s waterfront promenades and cafés make for a pleasant day ashore.Day 8Copenhagen DenmarkReturn to the Danish capital where your journey began, perhaps with a new appreciation for Northern Europe’s beauty. Enjoy a final stroll through the city or visit any sights you may have missed. It’s the perfect farewell to a scenic and unforgettable cruise.InclusionAccommodation as per the cabin or deck selected, within the duration of the stayMeals – international buffet – breakfast, lunch, and dinner (most of the cruises includes majority of the restaurants on the cruise)Entertainment and On-board activities: games, tournaments, themed evenings, and contestsFacilities: sun beds, swimming pools, library, hot tub, disco, and jogging trackLuggage transport service in the port during embarkation and disembarkation.GratuitiesCruise taxes and feesPort chargesExclusionAir transportation, optional shores, transfers, and land excursionsOffshore meals and accommodationAll drinksCasino gamingIn-room telephone callsInternet Wi-FiSpecialty restaurantsPurchases from ship storesPersonal services: laundry, medical services, salon services, and spa servicesAll the items that are not mentioned in the inclusionsVisa – (Can be provided at an additional cost)Optional ToursExploring the Destinations: During your cruise, you have the flexibility to explore the places you visit on your own or book an excursion onboard.Please note that booking excursions will incur an additional charge.TimingsDay 1:Copenhagen DenmarkDepart 06:00 PMDay 2:At SeaDay 3:Hellesylt Norway09:00 AM To 09:45 AMDay 3:Geiranger Norway12:00 PM To 09:00 PMDay 4:Alesund Norway07:00 AM To 05:00 PMDay 5:Flaam Norway07:00 AM To 06:00 PMDay 6:At SeaDay 7:Kiel Germany09:00 AM To 07:00 PMDay 8:Copenhagen DenmarkArrive 08:00 AMImportant InformationFor reservations involving the first and second guest, adult rates will be applicable, irrespective of age.Passport with Extended Validity: Ensure your passport has a minimum validity of 6 months beyond your intended travel dates. A physical passport is required at the time of check-in. Infant Travel with MSC Cruises: Infants below 6 months are permitted on MSC Cruises provided they possess a valid passport and visa at the time of sailing. These documents are crucial for compliance with international travel regulations and ensure a smooth boarding process. title: 7-Night Costa Smeralda Mediterranean Escape
meta_description: Sail across the Mediterranean gems aboard the luxurious Costa Smeralda, departing from Barcelona. But it’s selling fast; secure your spot quickly.
content: 7-Night Costa Smeralda Mediterranean Escape HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeCruisesBarcelonaCosta Smeralda Mediterranean Spring Escape CruiseShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D8 ImagesView GalleryCosta Smeralda Mediterranean Spring Escape CruiseNewUpcoming DeparturesMar 2026022330Apr 202613May 202611Sep 202614MealsOnboard ActivitiesFitness FacilitiesPort Taxes and FeesAccommodationsSwimming PoolTheater showsOverviewCosta Smeralda is synonymous with the Italian dolce vita: it is carefree, it is the breeze that ruffles your hair, and it is always overlooking the sea. You’ll be treated to new performances and shows every night, an aqua park on the highest deck of the ship, a next-generation spa and gym and so much more. Costa Smeralda cares for the environment, paving the way for responsible innovation and increasingly sustainable travel.ItineraryDay 1BARCELONAknown for its stunning architecture by Antoni Gaudí, such as the Sagrada Família and Park Güell, Barcelona is a vibrant coastal city. For lively street scenes and local tapas, you may wander down La Rambla. The  Mediterranean charm and artistic flair make it the perfect embarkation point for visitors. Day 2Day At SeaRelax and enjoy your ship’s amenities, whether indulging in a spa treatment, taking a refreshing swim,or savoring fine dining onboard. A day at sea is the perfect opportunity to unwind and recharge before discovering your next destination. Day 3LA GOULETTEThe beautiful gateway to Tunis, La Goulette, is where you can explore the ancient ruins of Carthage and the charming blue-and-white village of Sidi Bou Said. The city blends North African culture with French colonial influences and the local markets and Mediterranean cuisine add to its exotic appeal. Day 4PALERMOThe bustling street markets ,mix of history, culture, and cuisine, featuring Norman palaces, Arabesque churches, all make Palermo captivating. Visit the Palermo Cathedral and the historic Quattro Canti square and not to be missed are Sicilian specialties like arancini and cannoli.Day 5CIVITAVECCHIAThis is the port city serving Rome, and is home to iconic landmarks like the Colosseum, Vatican City, and the Trevi Fountain. Civitavecchia connects you to Italy’s capital by a short train or bus ride. A day for art, history, and unforgettable sights awaits here. Day 6SavonaA charming Ligurian port with medieval towers, seaside promenades, and nearby access to Genoa or the Italian Riviera, Savona is mesmerizing. For panoramic views, visit the Priamar Fortress. The relaxed pace and coastal atmosphere make it a hidden gem of northern Italy. Day 7MARSEILLEFrance’s oldest city, a lively melting pot with a scenic harbor and Mediterranean flair, Marseille is known for its provençal culture and fresh seafood. Explore the Old Port, the historic Le Panier district, and the hilltop Basilica of Notre-Dame de la Garde.Day 8BARCELONA. Return to Barcelona for another chance to explore its museums, beaches, and boutique-lined boulevards. Visit the Gothic Quarter or relax at Barceloneta Beach. content: Inside Burj Al Arab Butler-Guided Tour | Rayna ToursHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeActivitiesDubai CityBurj Al Arab ToursGuided Inside Burj Al Arab TourShareAdd to Wishlist3 ImagesView GalleryGuided Inside Burj Al Arab Tour5(14 Reviews)Operating HoursApprox 10:00 am to 7:00 pmInstant ConfirmationInstant Tour Confirmation will be Provided.Mobile Voucher AcceptedUse your phone or print your voucherNon RefundableEnglishGoogle MapGuided Inside Burj Al Arab Tour Highlights Admire Burj Al Arab’s architectural grandeur and get a taste of the regal Emirati hospitality on this exclusive 90-minute tour. Enter some of this legendary hotel’s most prestigious sections whose access was earlier reserved only to its premium guests. Gain a detailed look inside the Royal Suite - one of the world’s most expensive suites that cost an average of $25,000 per night. Enjoy the chance to stand in the largest atrium, further take in the digital interactives at the Experience Suite, and mostly, gain entry to UMA lounge with the sweeping views over the Arabian Gulf. Capture iconic pictures against the jaw-dropping backdrops. Guided Inside Burj Al Arab Tour InclusionsInside Burj Al Arab ticket Butler guided tour of the hotel  Welcome by Emirati Host Transfers (If selected)Note: Please check Option wise inclusions for every product before booking.Guided Inside Burj Al Arab Tour ExclusionsAll personal expenses spend for shopping, drinks and dining etc on-site during the tour.Guided Inside Burj Al Arab Tour How to RedeemPlease check your mailbox and download the ticket. Present it at the venue or turnstile for scanning. Once scanned, you can enter the VenueGuided Inside Burj Al Arab Tour OverviewCurious to know what is the interiors of the world’s most expensive hotel look like! Your Inside Burj Al Arab ticket lets you experience it, however, without splashing out on a stay here. Check out some of the hotel’s most compelling and majestic sections as you pass through the world’s largest atrium, and make your way to the luxurious (and one of the priciest) ever Royal Suite. Besides ample exciting photo ops, more attractions await you on this 90 minutes tour, with the Experience Suite WHAT TO EXPECTBuggy Ride & Perfect Photo Moments The tour begins at the ticketing lounge of Inside Burj Al Arab (at Jumeirah Beach Hotel). Hop on to a buggy that sets you off to the hotel via the bridge road that connects the main road to the private island (where the hotel is majestically placed). There will be quick stops along the way which allows you to return with some amazing photos against this marvelous structure. First-Hand Look at the Hotel’s Out of the World Wonders Upon your arrival at the hotel, you will be greeted in a traditional way by your Emirati host with rose water and hand towels. You will get to know about the never-before-heard interesting stories of this structure, including the insightful vision of Dubai’s ruler, which led to the making of this internationally renowned hotel two decades ago. You will be next escorted to the colorful lobby and then the tallest-of-its-kind cavernous atrium, featuring stunning water elements enriched by a burst of pleasing colors. Explore the Crown Jewel of Burj Al Arab Following a panoramic glass elevator ride to the 25th floor, be ready to be blown away as the doors of the imposing Royal Suite are opened for you. It is a true residential masterpiece where each of its rooms, bathrooms, amenities etc is designed down to immaculate detail with the priciest and finest materials. Feel the pinnacle of opulence as you see ‘his’ and ‘hers’ suites, sit on the master bedroom’s rotating bed, and step into the bath area with rich marble tubs and 24-carat gold tiles. Get Interactive at the Experience Suite & Visit UMA Lounge Step back in time as you enter the Experience Suite. With the cool digital interactives and the real architectural sketches, it gives you a glance into how the brilliant architect (Tom Wright) and the creative designer (Khuan Chew) breath in life to this marvelous structure. The drive offers breathtaking views of snow-capped mountains and rugged landscapes, making it a dream experience for young travelers and couples seeking adventure in Ladakh. Spend some time at the top capturing memorable photographs and enjoying the thrill of being at such an iconic high-altitude destination. Later, descend back to Leh by evening, where you can unwind at the hotel with dinner and an overnight stay. Day 4Departure from Leh After breakfast, check out of the hotel and transfer to Leh Airport for your onward flight. Stop to admire glaciers, alpine meadows, and mountain vistas. Continue the scenic drive through rugged Himalayan terrain, arriving in Kargil in the evening. Explore the local market and learn about the region’s history and culture.Day 3Kargil to LehCross the historic Fotu La and Namika La passes, enjoying panoramic views of the surrounding mountains along the way. Visit the Dras War Memorial, a symbol of valor in one of the coldest inhabited places on earth. Arrive in Leh by late afternoon, check into your accommodation, and then explore Leh Bazaar and Leh Palace. Witness the sunset from Shanti Stupa for a breathtaking view of the valley.Day 4Leh to Nubra ValleyTravel through the iconic Khardung La Pass, one of the highest motorable roads in the world. Reach Nubra Valley, known for its surreal desert landscape amidst snow-capped mountains. Enjoy a camel ride over the white sand dunes in Hunder and explore ancient monasteries. Camp under the stars or stay in a cozy guesthouse, soaking in the tranquility of this remote region.Day 5Nubra Valley to Pangong LakeDepart from Nubra Valley and drive along the rugged Shyok River valley, crossing high-altitude terrain and mountain passes. Arrive at Pangong Lake, famous for its changing hues and stunning Himalayan backdrop. Spend the afternoon relaxing by the lake, engaging in water activities, or capturing photographs of the remarkable scenery. Camp by the lake and enjoy stargazing under the clear night sky.Day 6Pangong Lake to Hanle via Rezang LaTravel through the historic Rezang La pass to reach Hanle, home to the world’s highest astronomical observatory. Experience the remote beauty of Hanle’s high-altitude landscape and learn about traditional Ladakhi life. Spend the evening stargazing and exploring the local villages.Day 7Hanle and Umlinga TopJourney to Umlinga Top for panoramic views of the Himalayan ranges. Engage in light trekking or photography to soak in the serenity of this remote location. Marvel at the breathtaking vistas and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of high-altitude Ladakh.Day 8Hanle to Tsomoriri LakeDrive to Tsomoriri Lake, one of Ladakh’s most pristine and tranquil lakes. Explore the lakeside, birdwatching and capturing stunning photographs of migratory birds and the high-altitude landscape. Visit the local nomadic settlements and camp near the lake, enjoying the peaceful environment.Day 9Tsomoriri Lake to SarchuJourney through rugged terrains and high mountain passes en route to Sarchu, a popular high-altitude stopover. Experience the thrill of camping amidst the majestic mountains, or stay in tents and enjoy the star-filled night sky. Engage in high-altitude trekking and photography.Day 10Sarchu to Manali via Atal TunnelDescend though scenic mountain passes like Lachulung La and Baralacha La, then pass through the modern Atal Tunnel, the world’s longest high-altitude tunnel. Enjoy the breathtaking drive through snow-capped peaks and lush valleys, arriving in Manali in the late afternoon. Explore vibrant markets and indulge in adventure sports such as river rafting, mountain biking, or paragliding. Day 11Departure from ManaliConclude your adventure with unforgettable memories of Himalayan landscapes, cultural encounters, and adrenaline-filled activities. meta_description: Enjoy a Vaishno Devi pilgrimage with a scenic Kashmir tour including Srinagar, Gulmarg and Pahalgam for a perfect spiritual holiday.
content: Vaishno Devi and Kashmir Tour Package | Spiritual & Scenic TripHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysSrinagarVaishno Devi Darshan With Kashmir Scenic TourShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView GalleryVaishno Devi Darshan With Kashmir Scenic TourNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingMealsOverviewExperience the perfect blend of spirituality, nature, and luxury with our Vaishno Devi and Kashmir Tour Package. This carefully designed holiday takes you from the sacred Mata Vaishno Devi shrine in Katra to the breathtaking landscapes of Kashmir, covering Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam. Enjoy comfortable hotel stays, a deluxe houseboat experience on Dal Lake, scenic mountain drives, Mughal Garden sightseeing, Gondola rides, and a peaceful Shikara ride. Ideal for families, couples, and senior travelers, this all-inclusive Kashmir tour package offers seamless transfers, guided sightseeing, and unforgettable Himalayan views — making it one of the best value holiday packages in North India. ItineraryDay 1Arrival at Jammu – Transfer to Katra  Arrive at Jammu Railway Station / Jammu Airport, where our representative will greet you and assist with your transfer to Katra (approx. 2 hours’ drive). Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax after your journey. The rest of the day is free for leisure, allowing you to explore the local markets or prepare for the holy pilgrimage. Overnight stay in Katra. Day 2Mata Vaishno Devi Darshan Early morning, head to the sacred Mata Vaishno Devi Temple Darshan. Pilgrims can undertake the trek on foot or opt for pony, palki, or helicopter services (direct payment). Seek blessings at the holy shrine and soak in the spiritual atmosphere of the Trikuta Hills. Return to Katra by evening and relax at the hotel. Overnight stay in Katra.Day 3Katra – Srinagar Transfer After breakfast, drive towards Srinagar, the heart of Kashmir (approx. 8–9 hours). Enjoy scenic mountain views, rivers, and charming villages along the way. On arrival, check in at your hotel and unwind. In the evening, enjoy leisure time near Dal Lake or explore nearby markets. Overnight stay in Srinagar.  Day 4Srinagar Local Sightseeing After breakfast, explore the beautiful Mughal Gardens, including Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Chashme Shahi, famous for their terraced lawns and panoramic views. Visit the sacred Shankaracharya Temple, offering stunning views of Srinagar city and Dal Lake. Later, explore local handicraft markets for souvenirs and traditional Kashmiri products. Overnight stay in Srinagar. Day 5Srinagar – Gulmarg Excursion Post breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion to Gulmarg, known for its lush meadows, snow-capped peaks, and adventure activities (approx. 2 hours one way). Enjoy the famous Gondola Cable Car Ride (optional) for breathtaking Himalayan views. During winter, indulge in snow activities like skiing and sledging, while summer offers scenic walks and photography opportunities. Return to Srinagar by evening. Overnight stay in Srinagar.Day 6Srinagar – Pahalgam Transfer After breakfast, enjoy a four-hour drive to Pahalgam. En route, visit the colorful Saffron Fields and historic Avantipura Ruins. On arrival, check in to your hotel and relax by the riverside. You may explore nearby valleys such as Aru Valley and Betaab Valley (optional, local vehicle on direct payment). Overnight stay in Pahalgam. Day 7Pahalgam – Srinagar | Houseboat Stay & Shikara Ride After breakfast, return to Srinagar and check into a beautiful Deluxe Houseboat on Dal Lake. Relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings of floating gardens and scenic mountain views. In the evening, enjoy a memorable Shikara Ride on Dal Lake, witnessing the sunset and vibrant floating markets. Overnight stay on the houseboat. Day 8Departure from Srinagar After breakfast, check out from the houseboat and transfer to Srinagar Airport for your onward journey with beautiful memories of your spiritual and scenic holiday. Hotel OptionsHotel The Dewaan or SimilarDeluxe Houseboat or SimilarForest Hill Resort or SimilarRamada by Wyndham Katra or Similar Previous Next1234InclusionAccommodation in well-appointed hotels Daily Breakfast and Dinner as per package Shikara ride in famous Dal Lake for 01 Hour Rooms as per Double Sharing All Sightseeing’s by Private transfers as per mentioned Itinerary All driver allowances and parking charges  Toll taxes, wages etc.ExclusionAirfare or train fare to and from the starting/ending city Pony Ride at Pahalgam, Sonmarg & Gulmarg  Chained Vehicle in Gulmarg & Sonmarg. Thajiwas Glacier | Zero Point visit at Sonmarg.  Gondola tickets in Gulmarg. Rafting, fishing, or trekking activities. Monument entrance fees, camera/video charges at sightseeing places Meals other than those specified in the inclusions (lunches & dinners) Personal expenses such as laundry, telephone calls, room service, mini-bar, etc. Any additional sightseeing or activities not mentioned in the itinerary Guide services (unless specified as included) Travel insurance, medical expenses, or emergency evacuation Tipping for drivers, guides, or hotel staff Any cost arising due to natural calamities, political disturbances, flight/train delays, or cancellations Additional costs due to flight cancellation, road blocks etc. GST or any other taxesImportant InformationWe aim to make your journey as seamless and enjoyable as possible. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysPragueCentral Europe Romance Tour With Prague To Venice For CouplesShareAdd to Wishlist10N / 11D7 ImagesView GalleryCentral Europe Romance Tour With Prague to Venice for CouplesNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThis 11-day Europe tour covers some of the most beautiful and iconic destinations across Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Italy. The journey begins in Prague, with guided city tours, a castle visit, and a river cruise. You’ll travel through Munich and Innsbruck, enjoy alpine scenery, and explore Zurich, Grindelwald, Lucerne, and the Swiss Alps.The tour continues through Bellinzona, Como, and Milan, followed by classic Italian highlights including Pisa, Rome, Florence, and Venice. Key experiences include city sightseeing, scenic mountain cable cars, historic landmarks, boat rides, and free time to explore at your own pace. The tour ends in Venice, leaving you with unforgettable European memories.ItineraryDay 1PRAGUEWelcome to Prague! Upon arriving at the airport, we’ll transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide.In the evening, we’ll transfer you to the Old Town Square, a lively area bustling with tourist activity. You can enjoy dinner at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterward, there will be a return transfer to the hotel.Day 2PRAGUE TOURToday, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 3PRAGUE - MUNICH – INNSBRUCKWe´ll depart early and head to Bavaria, Germany. We’ll arrive in Munich by midday, where you´ll have free time to stroll through the historic city center and enjoy lunch. In the afternoon, we’ll continue to Austria. Upon arrival in the heart of the Alps, you´ll have time to explore Innsbruck, the capital of Tyrol. There will be time for dinner in the Golden Roof area and Old Town.Day 4INNSBRUCK – ZURICHStart your day with a visit to the Swarovski Museum, the famous home of crystals. We’ll explore its impressive gardens and learn about the creation process behind the stunning Swarovski pieces. Afterward, enjoy some free time to stroll around before we head to Zurich, enjoying the beautiful Tyrolean scenery along the way. In Zurich, spend the evening in the historic center by the lake, where you can choose from a variety of restaurants offering Indian, Oriental, Italian, International, and Swiss cuisine.Day 5ZURICH - LUCERNE – ZURICHToday´s journey features stunning landscapes with tall mountains and pristine lakes. We’ll enjoy breathtaking scenery in the Interlaken region. Our first stop will be Grindelwald, where we’ll have time for a coffee before taking the cable car up the mountain. Once there, we’ll walk along a winding path leading to a suspended bridge. For those who are adventurous, crossing the bridge offers spectacular views of the surrounding glaciers. We’ll have lunch on the mountain (included) before heading back down. Our next destination is Lucerne, one of Switzerland´s most beautiful cities, where you’ll have time to explore and enjoy the charming cityscape. We’ll then return to Zurich.Note: The guide will offer an optional full-day excursion, starting in the morning. After some free time in Lucerne, we’ll take a rotating cable car to the summit of Mount Titlis. At over 3,000 meters above sea level, the alpine summit offers breathtaking views of the glacier and the Alps.Day 6ZURICH - BELLINZONA - COMO – MILANWe’ll leave Zurich early in the morning, crossing the Alps to reach the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland. Our first stop will be Bellinzona, renowned for its three medieval castles, which are UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Perched on the hills overlooking the city, these castles highlight Bellinzona´s historical significance as a key alpine stronghold. Enjoy some free time to wander through the charming streets of the center. Next, we´ll enter Italy and stop in the charming town of Como for lunch. This town is considered the jewel of Lombardy, known for its beautiful gardens beside the lake and its spectacular cathedral. We’ll continue to Milan, where our guide will take us to the impressive Piazza del Duomo. You’ll have some time to wander around before we transfer you to the hotel.Day 7MILAN - PISA – ROMEToday, we’ll continue our journey to Pisa. We´ll ride a small tourist train to the Piazza dei Miracoli (Square of Miracles), where you´ll have time to admire one of the most captivating and beautiful art complexes in Italy, including the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa. Afterwards, we’ll head to Rome, arriving later in the day.Day 8ROMEIn the morning, we’ll take a three-hour guided tour of the Eternal City, combining a walking tour through Imperial Rome with a panoramic bus ride to admire one of the oldest and most influential cities in Western civilization. During the tour, we’ll see iconic landmarks such as the Arch of Constantine, the exterior of the Colosseum and the Imperial Forums, the Circus Maximus, the Baths of Caracalla, the Basilica of Saint Mary Major, the Pyramid of Cestius, and Castel Sant’Angelo.The tour will end at VATICAN CITY around 11:00 a.m. Afterward, our guide will offer an optional visit to explore the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel.At the end of the day, we’ll include a transfer to the popular Trastevere neighborhood, known for its cozy restaurants and lively atmosphere. Return to the hotel will be around 8:30 p.m.Day 9ROME – FLORENCEToday, we’ll leave Rome and head north, taking in the beautiful landscapes along the way. Upon reaching Florence, we’ll go directly to the stunning Piazzale Michelangelo for breathtaking views of the city. We will then walk toward the historic center where, after some time for lunch, we’ll enjoy a guided walking tour with a local expert through the historic center, visiting landmarks such as the Ponte Vecchio, the Duomo, and Piazza della Signoria. This city is like an open-air museum.Afterward, you´ll have some free time to explore at your leisure. In the evening, you’ll have plenty of options for dinner, as this district offers many restaurants with a variety of international cuisines.Day 10FLORENCE – VENICEToday, we’ll enjoy the stunning mountain landscapes as we cross the Apennines. Upon arriving in Venice, we’ll take a boat across the Giudecca Canal to the Island of Venice. With a local guide, we’ll visit the marvelous St. Mark’s Square. Afterwards, we’ll tour the Murano Glass Factory, where you’ll see the fascinating techniques used to create this ancient glass. You´ll have some free time to explore on your own. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysBudapestEurope Family Holiday With Hungary To Czech RepublicShareAdd to Wishlist14N / 15D4 ImagesView GalleryEurope Family Holiday with Hungary to Czech RepublicNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThis grand Central & Northern Europe tour starts in Budapest and travels through Slovakia, Poland, Sweden, Denmark, Germany, and the Czech Republic. Highlights include guided city tours, historic old towns, UNESCO World Heritage Sites, and scenic ferry crossings across the Baltic Sea.Key experiences include Budapest and Krakow sightseeing, a visit to Auschwitz, medieval castles like Malbork, cultural cities such as Warsaw, Gdansk, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Berlin, and the charming beauty of Prague. The tour perfectly blends history, culture, scenic landscapes, and iconic European cities before ending in Prague.ItineraryDay 1BUDAPESTWelcome to Budapest! Transfer to the hotel will be included.In the late afternoon, we’ll take you to the city’s pedestrian area, a lively district filled with charming traditional restaurants, many of them featuring live music—the perfect way to start exploring the city.Day 2BUDAPEST TOURWe’ll include a panoramic tour of the city, divided by the Danube River. We’ll visit Buda, with its historic old town, and Pest, known for its lively commercial districts. You’ll have the opportunity to experience the charm of this magnificent city. The afternoon will be free for you to explore at your leisure.Day 3BUDAPEST - BRATISLAVA - TRENCIN - KRAKOWWe’ll depart early from Budapest and travel through Slovakia, where we’ll visit Bratislava, the country’s capital on the banks of the Danube. There will be time for a stroll through its historic center, nestled at the foot of the imposing castle.Our journey will then take us to Trencin, a charming medieval town in western Slovakia, known for its impressive castle and vibrant historic center. There will be time to explore and enjoy lunch.In the afternoon, we’ll continue our route through picturesque landscapes of forests and rolling hills as we make our way to Poland. We’ll arrive in Krakow at the end of the day.Day 4KRAKOW - AUSCHWITZ - CZESTOCHOWA - WARSAWWe head south of the CZECH REPUBLIC to discover the landscapes of Bohemia. We visit České Budějovice, with its charming historic center, and then Český Krumlov, a medieval gem declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. After free time, we return to PRAGUE, arriving in the mid-afternoon.In the morning we include a panoramic visit with a local guide in KRAKOW, the capital of “Little Poland,” founded in the 7th century, whose old town has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. During our visit, we will see, in addition to its beautiful medieval streets, the Market Square, one of the largest in Europe and the heart of the city, as well as Wawel Hill, the former residence of Polish kings.After lunchtime we travel to AUSCHWITZ-BIRKENAU, the former concentration camp that reminds us of dark moments in Europe’s history. We will visit Camp II, Birkenau, where trains arrived from all over Europe.Later in CZESTOCHOWA, we visit the Monastery of Jasna Góra, home to the Black Madonna, a highly frequented pilgrimage site.Arrival in WARSAW at the end of the afternoon.Note: Sometimes it can be difficult to obtain the required entry tickets for Auschwitz. In such cases, the program may be modified (usually by entering the concentration camp at a later hour and visiting Wadowice instead of Czestochowa).Day 5WARSAWWe’ll start the day with a panoramic tour of WARSAW with a local guide. Home to nearly two million people, this political and economic hub of Poland boasts a blend of modern architecture and meticulously restored historic buildings. We’ll stroll through the charming old town, featuring many old buildings, the Royal Palace, and cobbled streets, all restored after their destruction in World War II and now declared a World Heritage Site. We’ll visit the Palace of Culture, a skyscraper gifted by the Soviet Union, reflect on the history of what was once the largest Jewish ghetto in Europe, and wander through Lazienki Park, home to the Chopin Monument.You’ll have free time in the afternoon to visit museums, such as the National Museum and the Warsaw Rising Museum, or to explore the lively city center filled with shops and activities.Day 6WARSAW - OLSZTYN - ELBLAG CANAL - MALBORK - GDANSKAfter breakfast, we’ll depart for northern POLAND. Our first stop will be OLSZTYNEK, where we’ll visit the open-air Museum of Folk Architecture (admission included). Here, you can admire wooden houses, old mills, and a traditional church, making it feel like you’ve stepped back in time! We’ll then continue to the Elblag Canal, the longest navigable canal in Poland, where we’ll visit a museum located in an area where boats are hauled over land on rails to navigate elevation changes. Next, we’ll head to MALBORK to visit its impressive castle (admission included, green route), one of the largest medieval castles in Europe, built in the 13th century by the Teutonic Order and now a UNESCO World Heritage Site. We’ll arrive in GDANSK — formerly known as DANZIG—in the evening. The historic center is stunning and lively, and we highly recommend an evening stroll to experience its vibrant atmosphere.Day 7GDANSK - SOPOT - FERRY SOPOT KARLSKRONAAfter breakfast, we’ll depart for northern POLAND. Our first stop will be OLSZTYNEK, where we’ll visit the open-air Museum of Folk Architecture (admission included). Here, you can admire wooden houses, old mills, and a traditional church, making it feel like you’ve stepped back in time! We’ll then continue to the Elblag Canal, the longest navigable canal in Poland, where we’ll visit a museum located in an area where boats are hauled over land on rails to navigate elevation changes. Next, we’ll head to MALBORK to visit its impressive castle (admission included, green route), one of the largest medieval castles in Europe, built in the 13th century by the Teutonic Order and now a UNESCO World Heritage Site. We’ll arrive in GDANSK — formerly known as DANZIG—in the evening. The historic center is stunning and lively, and we highly recommend an evening stroll to experience its vibrant atmosphere.Day 8FERRY SOPOT KARLSKRONA - VASTERVIK - STOCKHOLMAfter a pleasant journey, our ferry will arrive in KARLSKRONA in southern SWEDEN around 06:30 a.m. We’ll continue to STOCKHOLM, with a stop in VÄSTERVIK, a charming seaside town with a picturesque historic center. In the afternoon, we’ll arrive in Stockholm, the capital of Sweden, a beautiful city spread across fourteen islands in the Baltic Sea archipelago, connected by numerous bridges and ferries. Stockholm is renowned for its rich history, stunning architecture, and its blend of modernity and tradition. The afternoon is yours to enjoy. We recommend taking a stroll through the historic center and visiting its museums and parks.Day 9STOCKHOLMToday we’ll embark on a panoramic tour of this beautiful capital city, built on 14 interconnected islands. We’ll visit Gamla Stan, also known as the “the city between bridges”, the lively old quarter filled with monumental buildings such as the Nobel Prize Museum, located right beside the main square of Stortorget which honors Nobel Prize winners, the Cathedral, and the Royal Palace. Whenever possible, we’ll enjoy the stunning views from the Fjällgatan viewpoint. Afterwards, you’ll have leisure time to explore. We recommend visiting the museums and parks. Optionally, you can visit the City Hall and the Vasa Museum.Day 10STOCKHOLM - HELSINGOR - COPENHAGENWe’ll head south. After spending some time in the vibrant coastal town of HELSINGBORG, we’ll take a ferry from SWEDEN TO HELSINGOR in DENMARK in the early afternoon. You’ll get to enjoy some time in Helsingor, Hamlet’s hometown, where the impressive Kronborg Castle stands out, before we continue our journey to Copenhagen, arriving in the evening.Day 11COPENHAGEN - BERLINIn the morning, we’ll enjoy a panoramic city tour with a local guide of the Danish capital, known for its exceptional quality of life, commitment to sustainability and rich cultural life. We’ll see The Little Mermaid, Nyhavn harbor with its colorful historic buildings, the exterior of Amalienborg Palace, home to the Danish royal family, the Town Hall Square, and the Tivoli Park area. After that we’ll leave for the south of DENMARK. In GEDSER we’ll take a two-hour ferry to cross to GERMANY. We’ll arrive in Warnemünde and continue towards BERLIN, arriving at the end of the day.Note: If only a few passengers are traveling between Copenhagen and Berlin, this route may be completed using a regular passenger line without altering the content of this stage’s itinerary.Day 12BERLINImmerse yourself in the local culture with a guided panoramic tour of BERLIN, the captivating capital of GERMANY. We’ll see the historic center, Museum Island, the Reichstag, the Brandenburg Gate, the shopping streets and the city’s beautiful parks. Our visit will also include stops at the Holocaust Memorial and the Berlin Wall Memorial Museum. For an optional excursion, you can visit Potsdam and its stunning palaces.Day 13BERLIN - DRESDEN - PRAGUEWe’ll travel through scenic forests to DRESDEN, a city renowned for its exceptional architectural and artistic heritage, making it one of Germany’s top tourist destinations. There will be time to admire its magnificent palaces and enjoy lunch at your leisure.Afterward, we’ll cross into the CZECH REPUBLIC, arriving in PRAGUE in the mid-afternoon. title: 7 Nights and 8 Days Central European Ring Holiday Package
meta_description: The Central European Ring tour package covers some phenomenal European countries like Austria, Czech Republic, Germany, Hungary, and Slovakia. You can visit all these countries during the 8-day tour.
content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Central European Ring Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysInnsbruck8 Days Central European RingShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView Gallery8 Days Central European RingNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewTravel through some of the most famed European destinations, including the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Slovakia, with this ultimate seven-night package. Yes, it covers everything from the prized gems of Prague, Munich, and Innsbruck to the charming ski resort of Kitzbuhel and the pulsating vibe of Budapest and Bratislava. Add to this all accommodations, transfers, and guided tours, making the whole experience as smooth and stress-free as possible.  ItineraryDay 1Arrival in PragueWelcome to Prague! Upon arriving at the airport, we’ll transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide.In the evening, we’ll transfer you to the Old Town Square, a lively area bustling with tourist activity. You can enjoy dinner at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterward, there will be a return transfer to the hotel.Day 2Prague City TourTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 3Travel to Munich and InnsbruckTODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Bavaria and Tyrol. We will leave early and travel to Bavaria, arriving in MUNICH free time to stroll through the monumental center and have lunch at one of the famous traditional beerhouses. In the afternoon, we will continue to Austria. Arriving to INNSBRUCK in the evening, we will have time for dinner in the Golden Roof area at the Old Town.Day 4Swarovski Crystal Museum and KitzbuhelTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: The major draw of today is a tour of the Swarovski Museum, where you will enter the dazzling world of crystals and learn about the intricate artistry and craftsmanship behind the creation of stunning crystal pieces. Continue your tour to Innsbruck’s timeless historic center and later take a scenic drive through the mountains to Kitzbuhel, an idyllic village and a popular ski resort. Relish a tasty dinner with vegetarian options before you wind up the day. Day 5Salzburg, St. Wolfgang, Traunsee Lake, and Vienna TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll get to know Austria better. Departing in the morning, we’ll take a cable car ride in Steinplatte up to the high mountains of the Alps, where snow lasts for nine months of the year and the scenery is breathtaking. The incredible landscapes from the viewing platform and the dinosaur exhibition will create unforgettable memories. We’ll then continue exploring Austria, traveling through the mountains until we arrive in Salzburg, Mozart’s city. Its Renaissance and Baroque center is filled with beauty, all in the shadow of the grand castle. Next, we’ll travel through lakes and mountains to reach St. Wolfgang, a renowned pilgrimage site in Austria. We’ll then head to Traunkirchen, located beside the beautiful Traunsee Lake, where we’ll take a cruise to see four of the lake´s castles before disembarking in Gmunden. Afterward, we’ll continue to Vienna, arriving in the evening.Day 6Vienna city tour TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll embark on a panoramic tour of this impressive city with a local guide. We’ll explore its majestic avenues, beautiful palaces, large parks and vibrant city center. In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore on your own. In the evening, we’ll include a transfer to the Grinzing district, an old wine-growing village now part of the city, known for its traditional taverns. You’ll have free time to dine in the area.Day 7Arrival in Budapest & Boat cruise TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: After about three hours of travel, we’ll arrive in Budapest, the capital of Hungary. Our first stop will be the lively area of Váci utca, where you’ll have free time for lunch. After, we’ll kick off our exploration of Budapest with an included boat trip on the Danube River, with historic Buda on one bank and cosmopolitan Pest on the other. The views are unbeatable. Following this, we’ll begin a panoramic tour of the so-called "Queen of the Danube." You’ll have some free time afterwards. In the evening, we’ll offer an optional outing to a Magyar show, with dinner included.Day 8Bratislava and PragueWe will leave Budapest early and head for Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia, a charming city along the Danube with an attractive historic center. You´ll have time to explore and enjoy lunch. After, we’ll continue our journey to the Czech Republic, arriving in Prague in the evening.Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of Discover Vienna’s imperial charm, cruise through the scenic Wachau Valley, and visit historic towns like Dürnstein, Melk, and Linz. Enjoy Austria’s stunning lakes region, explore Salzburg—Mozart’s birthplace—and travel through breathtaking alpine landscapes including Zell am See and the Krimml Waterfalls. The tour also covers Innsbruck and nearby highlights such as Swarovski Crystal Worlds, Seefeld, and Mittenwald, blending culture, nature, and picturesque towns for a memorable European holidayItineraryDay 1VIENNAWelcome to your tour with us! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2VIENNA TOURIn the morning, we’ll enjoy a panoramic tour of the city, during which we’ll discover its majestic avenues, impressive palaces, elegant parks, and charming historic center. At nightfall, we’ll have a transfer to the Town Hall Square, where you can admire the beautiful illumination and enjoy the lively evening atmosphere of the surrounding streets.Day 3VIENNA - DÜRNSTEIN - MELK - LINZToday we will tour the Wachau Valley, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, always following the course of the Danube. Our first stop will be KREMS, a charming town on the banks of the Danube, known for its medieval old town. After that, along a small road following the Danube, we will reach DURNSTEIN, a picturesque medieval village on the banks of the Danube, surrounded by vineyards and green hills, and famous for the ruins of the castle where Richard the Lionheart was once imprisoned.We will then continue along the Danube Valley to MELK, where you will have time for lunch before visiting the majestic Benedictine Abbey. Admission to Melk Abbey is included—a Baroque jewel with its extraordinary library, the Marble Hall, and its beautiful gardens.We will continue our route with a brief stop in ST. FLORIAN, to admire the exterior of its impressive abbey. Arrival in LINZ will be in the mid-afternoon, the third-largest city in Austria, on the banks of the Danube. We suggest strolling through the historic center and its lively Hauptplatz.Day 4LINZ - GMUNDEN - ST. WOLFGANG - SALZBURGToday will be the “day of the lakes,” filled with beautiful landscapes and picturesque small towns. We’ll depart for GMUNDEN, on the shores of Lake Traunsee, surrounded by mountains and elegant 19th-century villas. Here, we’ll enjoy a cruise on Lake Traunsee (approximate duration: 1 hour). We disembark in Ebensee and continue our route to ST WOLFGANG, one of the most picturesque villages in Austria, located on the shores of Lake Wolfgangsee and a famous pilgrimage site. Its narrow streets, alpine façades, and charming cafés invite you to discover it at leisure. You’ll have free time for lunch and a stroll. We then continue to SALZBURG, where we’ll arrive around 4:00 p.m. Free afternoon in this UNESCO World Heritage city, boasting a perfectly preserved Baroque old town, medieval squares, Renaissance churches, and an imposing fortress; it is also the birthplace of Mozart.Day 5SALZBURG - SALZWELTEN MINES - ZELL AM SEE - KRIMML FALLS - INNSBRUCKToday will be the “day of the mountain landscapes.” We’ll set off for SALZWELTEN, the largest salt mines in Austria, where we’ll take the tour (underground train and boat ride on the saline lake included). Afterwards, through the mountains, we’ll head to ZELL AM SEE, a charming town on a lake surrounded by alpine peaks, with a historic center and a medieval tower. You’ll have free time to stroll and have lunch. We’ll then continue to the KRIMML waterfalls (admission included), in the heart of the Hohe Tauern National Park; with a total drop of 380 m over three tiers, they are the highest in Austria and among the most impressive in Europe. We proceed to INNSBRUCK, the capital of Tyrol, nestled among mountains and featuring a delightful pedestrian center where the famous Golden Roof stands out.Day 6INNSBRUCKToday we’ll explore some places near the capital of Tyrol. Our first stop will be at SWAROVSKI, where we’ll enjoy the impressive Crystal Museum (admission included), with immersive rooms, contemporary art, and the iconic giant head covered in crystals. Next, heading up the mountain, we’ll stop in SEEFELD, a popular ski resort boasting a pleasant pedestrian center. After crossing into Bavaria, in Germany, we’ll reach MITTENWALD, a charming town famous for its fresco-painted houses and long-standing tradition of violin making. You’ll have free time to stroll and have lunch. Finally, we return to INNSBRUCK; arrival in the early afternoon and free time.Day 7INNSBRUCK - VIENNATransfer to the station to take the train to Vienna. Arrival in VIENNA (scheduled arrival around 1:45 p.m.).Notes: The train journey will be made without an Europamundo guide; tickets will be provided and transfer to the station in Innsbruck included. In some cases, depending on the number of travelers, the trip to Vienna will be made by coach with our guide.Day 8VIENNAAfter breakfast, our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful lasting memories.Hotel Options4* MOXY VIENNA CITY EAST or similar4* AMEDIA LINZ or similar4* HARRYS XL SALZBURG or similar4* ALPHOTEL INNSBRUCK or similar4* CITADINES APART’HOTEL SOUTH VIENNA or similar Previous Next123InclusionGeneral Services: Travel by bus with English speaking guide, basic travel insurance, hotel and breakfast buffet.Includes arrival transferCity tour in: ViennaBoat: Lake Traunsee in GmundenEvening transfer: Vienna City Hall SquareExperiences: Underground train and saline boat ride in the Salzwelten salt minesTicket admission: Melk Abbey, Krimml Waterfalls , Swarovski Crystal MuseumHigh speed train: Innsbruck -
