content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysViennaBest Of Central EuropeShareAdd to Wishlist8N / 9D3 ImagesView GalleryBest of Central EuropeNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewExplore the heart of Europe on this 9-day journey through six countries. Starting in Vienna, you’ll visit the imperial capitals of Budapest, Bratislava, and Prague, featuring guided tours of palaces and castles. Experience a scenic Rhine River cruise in Germany and the fairytale charm of Rothenburg. Finally, discover the iconic windmills and canals of the Netherlands. With included Indian meals and expert guides, it’s an unforgettable cultural adventure.ItineraryDay 1VIENNAWelcome to Rayna Tours!After we transfer you to your hotel, enjoy some free time to settle in. Check the reception area this afternoon for tour details posted on the information boards. Enjoy a warm Indian dinner at the hotel.Overnight in Vienna.Day 2VIENNAFollowing a delicious buffet breakfast, head out on a guided journey through Vienna. We’ll showcase everything from majestic avenues to royal residences, giving you a perfect introduction to the city's vibrant heart. After this panoramic overview, you’ll have the rest of the day free to explore the city's charming cafes and shops at your own pace. End the day with a delicious Indian dinner at a restaurant.Overnight in Vienna.Day 3VIENNA – BUDAPESTAfter breakfast and check-out, a three-hour drive brings you to Budapest. Explore the lively Váci utca before an included Danube cruise, offering stunning views of historic Buda and modern Pest. Next, enjoy a guided tour of the "Queen of the Danube" and an included lunch. Enjoy some leisure time to explore at your own pace. Later this evening, you can join an optional excursion to an authentic Magyar folklore show, complete with a traditional dinner.Overnight in BudapestDay 4BUDAPEST - BRATISLAVA – PRAGUEWe’ll depart Budapest early and head for Bratislava, the charming capital of Slovakia. This picturesque city along the Danube features a beautiful historic center, which you will have time to explore and enjoy lunch in. Afterward, we continue to the Czech Republic. Upon arrival in Prague by evening, you’ll visit the iconic Old Town Square, a central hub perfect for soaking in Prague’s lively energy and historic architecture.  Later, check in to your hotel and have a relaxed Indian dinner.Overnight in Prague.Day 5PRAGUEAfter a good buffet breakfast. Today you explore Prague, often called the "Baroque Jewel of Europe." Join an expert local guide for an insightful panoramic tour of Prague’s legendary landmarks, featuring a guided visit to the historic Prague Castle (entry tickets included). Afterward, enjoy a relaxing boat cruise on the Vltava River. Post your lunch at a restaurant. The afternoon is set free at leisure. Discover the city’s charm independently.Overnight in Prague.Day 6PRAGUE - PILSEN - ROTHENBURG – FRANKFURTLeaving Prague early, you head to Pilsen, Bohemia, to admire its iconic Plague Column and historic architecture. After crossing into Germany, you’ll travel the Romantic Road to visit Rothenburg, widely considered one of the country's most beautiful medieval towns. Finally, you arrive in Frankfurt, Germany’s financial hub. Enjoy a free evening in the city’s historic heart followed by a delicious Indian dinner.Overnight in Frankfurt.Day 7FRANKFURT - CRUISE ON THE RHINE - COLOGNE – AMSTERDAMToday, we enjoy a scenic cruise along the most picturesque stretch of the Rhine, sailing between the charming villages of Rüdesheim and St. Goar. Next, you head to Cologne for a stop at its iconic, towering cathedral before crossing into Holland. Your journey then continues into the Netherlands, arriving in Amsterdam this evening. An Indian dinner is included to end the day.Overnight in Amsterdam.Day 8AMSTERDAMToday is all about the classic Dutch landscape. On completion of your breakfast, you visit the windmills at Zaanse Schans, the charming village of Volendam, and the historic stilt houses of Marken via a short boat ride. Later, enjoy a guided tour of Amsterdam’s highlights, like the iconic image of the windmill, the Rembrandt statue, and the diamond cutting at Museum Square. Finally, the tour ends with a walk into the heart of the city. Spend your leisure time exploring Amsterdam’s world-famous canals, bustling local markets, and charming street-side cafés. Enjoy Indian dinner by the end of the day. Overnight in Amsterdam.Day 9AMSTERDAMYour adventure wraps up after breakfast today, leaving you with beautiful memories to last a lifetime. content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysViennaEast To West Europe Family Holiday PackageShareAdd to Wishlist10N / 11D3 ImagesView GalleryEast to West Europe Family Holiday PackageNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThis 11-day European journey takes you through Austria, Hungary, Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and France. Begin in Vienna, then explore the beauty of Budapest, Prague, and Germany’s Romantic Road. Enjoy a scenic Rhine River cruise, discover the windmills and fishing villages of Holland, and wander through the medieval charm of Bruges. The tour concludes in Paris, featuring highlights like the Eiffel Tower, a Seine River cruise, Montmartre, and a panoramic city tour—offering a perfect blend of culture, history, and iconic European experiences.ItineraryDay 1VIENNAWelcome to your tour with us! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2VIENNA TOURToday, we’ll embark on a panoramic tour of this impressive city with a local guide. We’ll explore its majestic avenues, beautiful palaces, large parks and vibrant city center. In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore on your own. In the evening, we’ll include a transfer to the Grinzing district, an old wine-growing village now part of the city, known for its traditional taverns. You’ll have free time to dine in the area.Day 3VIENNA - BUDAPESTAfter about three hours of travel, we’ll arrive in Budapest, the capital of Hungary. Our first stop will be the lively area of Váci utca, where you’ll have free time for lunch. After, we’ll kick off our exploration of Budapest with an included boat trip on the Danube River, with historic Buda on one bank and cosmopolitan Pest on the other. The views are unbeatable. Following this, we’ll begin a panoramic tour of the so-called "Queen of the Danube." You’ll have some free time afterwards. In the evening, we’ll offer an optional outing to a Magyar show, with dinner included.Day 4BUDAPEST - BRATISLAVA - PRAGUEWe will leave Budapest early and head for Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia, a charming city along the Danube with an attractive historic center. You´ll have time to explore and enjoy lunch. After, we’ll continue our journey to the Czech Republic, arriving in Prague in the evening. We’ll provide a transfer to the Old Town Square, a central spot that offers a fantastic introduction to Prague with its vibrant atmosphere and numerous tourist activities. You can have dinner at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel.Day 5PRAGUEToday, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 6PRAGUE - PILSEN - ROTHENBURG - FRANKFURTWe’ll depart early from PRAGUE and stop in PILSEN, in western Bohemia, a city renowned for its beer. You’ll have time to stroll through its historic center, where you’ll find the Old Town Square, the cathedral, the Plague Column, and a Renaissance-era town hall. We’ll then cross into GERMANY and follow part of the Romantic Road. We’ll visit ROTHENBURG, a town that seems to come straight out of a fairy tale and is considered one of the most beautiful villages in the country. Afterward, we’ll head to FRANKFURT, the financial capital of Germany. After our arrival in the evening, enjoy free time in the historic city center, where you’ll find a wide variety of restaurants offering Indian, Asian, Italian, and international cuisines.Day 7FRANKFURT - CRUISE ON THE RHINE - COLOGNE - AMSTERDAMToday, we’ll take a scenic cruise on the Rhine between the villages of Rüdesheim and St. Goar, the river’s most picturesque section. After that, we’ll travel to Cologne, known for its immense Gothic cathedral. Then, we’ll head to Holand, arriving in Amsterdam in the evening.Day 8AMSTERDAMToday we’ll visit some truly picturesque places; the Holland of our dreams. First, we head to ZAANSE SCHANS, with its charming houses, canals, and windmills. Then on to VOLENDAM, a very scenic fishing village.From Volendam, we’ll take a short boat ride to Marken, once an island now connected to the mainland by a fixed dike. Its houses were traditionally built on stilts to protect from flooding.In the afternoon, we’ll enjoy a guided tour of AMSTERDAM, combining several highlights: the iconic image of the windmill and the Rembrandt statue, the contemporary elegance of the South District, and the centuries-old magic of diamond cutting at Museum Square. Finally, we’ll leave the bus and walk into the heart of the city, where the tour will end. Free time to explore Amsterdam’s famous canals, markets, and cafés.Day 9AMSTERDAM - BRUGES - PARISWe will head to BRUGES, a charming medieval city often called the "Venice of the North" because of its scenic canals. The city offers a magical atmosphere with its cobblestone streets, historic buildings, and romantic bridges. If you’d like, you can climb the Belfry Tower for stunning views. How about trying some Belgian chocolate? Or perhaps you´d prefer a local craft beer? We will then continue our journey to PARIS, arriving by the end of the day.Day 10PARISWe’ll immerse ourselves in the rich history of France at the magnificent Palace of Versailles (admission not included), renowned for its stunning gardens. On our return to Paris, we’ll visit Montmartre, a charming bohemian neighborhood famous for its artists, painters, and cabarets. To fully appreciate the grandeur of Paris, we’ll embark on a panoramic city tour with a local guide, showcasing the city’s impressive avenues and iconic monuments. Afterward, we’ll return to the hotel. For those interested, there is an optional variety show in the evening.Day 11PARIS DEPRTUREWe’ll start our day in central PARIS, beginning with a visit to the iconic Eiffel Tower. You´ll have the chance to go up to the second floor of this famous iron landmark (tickets included). Afterwards, we’ll enjoy a relaxing boat cruise along the Seine, which will last approximately one hour and fifteen minutes. You’ll have a free afternoon to explore the city at your own pace (transfer back to the hotel not included).Note: If wait times at the Eiffel Tower are too long, we might reschedule the visit to a content: HelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysViennaClassic Austria And Switzerland Tour For CouplesShareAdd to Wishlist9N / 10D3 ImagesView GalleryClassic Austria and Switzerland Tour for CouplesNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewThis 10-day journey takes you through the heart of Austria, Germany, and Switzerland, blending imperial cities, alpine landscapes, scenic lakes, and charming medieval towns. Start in Vienna with its grand palaces and historic streets, cruise through the beautiful Wachau Valley, and explore Salzburg, Zell am See, and Innsbruck amid stunning mountain scenery. Experience highlights like Zugspitze, Rhine Falls, Lake Zurich, and Glacier 3000. The tour continues through storybook towns such as Stein am Rhein and St. Gallen, before ending in Geneva, a global city set on the shores of Lake Geneva—an unforgettable mix of culture, nature, and iconic European sights.ItineraryDay 1VIENNAWelcome to your tour with us! We’ll transfer you to the hotel and you’ll have some free time. In the afternoon, you’ll find information about the start of your tour on the boards located at the hotel reception.Day 2VIENNA TOURIn the morning, we’ll enjoy a panoramic tour of the city, during which we’ll discover its majestic avenues, impressive palaces, elegant parks, and charming historic center. At nightfall, we’ll have a transfer to the Town Hall Square, where you can admire the beautiful illumination and enjoy the lively evening atmosphere of the surrounding streets.Day 3VIENNA - DÜRNSTEIN - MELK - LINZToday we will tour the Wachau Valley, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, always following the course of the Danube. Our first stop will be KREMS, a charming town on the banks of the Danube, known for its medieval old town. After that, along a small road following the Danube, we will reach DURNSTEIN, a picturesque medieval village on the banks of the Danube, surrounded by vineyards and green hills, and famous for the ruins of the castle where Richard the Lionheart was once imprisoned.We will then continue along the Danube Valley to MELK, where you will have time for lunch before visiting the majestic Benedictine Abbey. Admission to Melk Abbey is included—a Baroque jewel with its extraordinary library, the Marble Hall, and its beautiful gardens.We will continue our route with a brief stop in ST. FLORIAN, to admire the exterior of its impressive abbey. Arrival in LINZ will be in the mid-afternoon, the third-largest city in Austria, on the banks of the Danube. We suggest strolling through the historic center and its lively Hauptplatz.Day 4LINZ - GMUNDEN - ST. WOLFGANG - SALZBURGToday will be the “day of the lakes,” filled with beautiful landscapes and picturesque small towns. We’ll depart for GMUNDEN, on the shores of Lake Traunsee, surrounded by mountains and elegant 19th-century villas. Here, we’ll enjoy a cruise on Lake Traunsee (approximate duration: 1 hour). We disembark in Ebensee and continue our route to ST WOLFGANG, one of the most picturesque villages in Austria, located on the shores of Lake Wolfgangsee and a famous pilgrimage site. Its narrow streets, alpine façades, and charming cafés invite you to discover it at leisure. You’ll have free time for lunch and a stroll. We then continue to SALZBURG, where we’ll arrive around 4:00 p.m. Free afternoon in this UNESCO World Heritage city, boasting a perfectly preserved Baroque old town, medieval squares, Renaissance churches, and an imposing fortress; it is also the birthplace of Mozart.Day 5SALZBURG - SALZWELTEN MINES - ZELL AM SEE - KRIMML FALLS - INNSBRUCKToday will be the “day of the mountain landscapes.” We’ll set off for SALZWELTEN, the largest salt mines in Austria, where we’ll take the tour (underground train and boat ride on the saline lake included). Afterwards, through the mountains, we’ll head to ZELL AM SEE, a charming town on a lake surrounded by alpine peaks, with a historic center and a medieval tower. You’ll have free time to stroll and have lunch. We’ll then continue to the KRIMML waterfalls (admission included), in the heart of the Hohe Tauern National Park; with a total drop of 380 m over three tiers, they are the highest in Austria and among the most impressive in Europe. We proceed to INNSBRUCK, the capital of Tyrol, nestled among mountains and featuring a delightful pedestrian center where the famous Golden Roof stands out.Day 6INNSBRUCK - ZUGSPITZE - FELDKIRCHToday we’ll enjoy a day filled with extraordinary scenery. We’ll head to ZUGSPITZE, on the border between AUSTRIA and GERMANY. We’ll take the cable car (included) up to the summit of Germany’s highest mountain. On clear days, you can see a panoramic view of the snow-covered peaks stretching across four countries. After that, we’ll travel to REUTTE, where we’ll walk across the longest “Tibetan bridge” in Europe (admission included), surrounded by breathtaking landscapes. We’ll then continue to FELDKIRCH, near the borders of Switzerland, Liechtenstein, and Germany—an enchanting walled town with a beautiful medieval old town and a castle. Free time.Day 7FELDKIRCH - ST. GALLEN - CONSTANCE - STEIN AM RHEIN - RHINE FALLS - ZURICHWe’ll depart for St. Gallen, whose historic center has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. We’ll include admission to the library of its magnificent abbey, featuring a baroque hall that houses 170,000 volumes and the Egyptian mummy of Schepenese. The library is also UNESCO World Heritage Site. Afterward, we’ll continue our journey along the shores of Lake Constance, situated between Germany and Switzerland, until we reach Constance, a German city with a beautiful medieval old town known for its cathedral and the Market Square. You’ll have time to stroll and enjoy lunch. We’ll then return to Switzerland to visit Stein am Rhein, a charming village on the banks of the Rhine, famous for its beautifully painted houses. We’ll also visit the Rhine Falls (tickets included), the most powerful waterfalls in Europe. We recommend an optional boat ride that will make you feel like you can almost touch the cascading waters. Arrival in Zurich will be in the evening.Day 8ZURICHWith our guide, we’ll explore Zurich, the most populous city in Switzerland, and its financial and cultural heart. Known for its banks, Zurich has been twice recognized as the city with the best quality of life in the world. Afterwards, we’ll embark on a scenic cruise of nearly two hours on Lake Zurich, with brief stops to enjoy the charming villages along the route. We’ll disembark in Rapperswil, a picturesque village renowned for its medieval castle. We’ll return to Zurich by train, providing an opportunity to experience the efficiency and punctuality of the Swiss railway system.Note: Depending on the number of travelers, transfers to and from the city center may be via public transport.Day 9ZURICH - CHILLON CASTLE - GENEVAWe’ll set off for the capital of the country, Bern, one of the most beautiful historic cities in Switzerland. We’ll go to the Rose Garden viewpoint to admire the beautiful landscape of the city, and you’ll have free time in the center. We’ll continue along a scenic road winding through stunning high mountain landscapes, passing charming villages with traditional wooden architecture and traveling through the Gstaad region, renowned for its ski resorts. We’ll include the cable car ride and lunch at Glacier 3000. From its terraces, you’ll enjoy breathtaking views and have the chance to walk across the suspension bridge that connects two peaks. After descending, we’ll journey toward Lake Geneva, an area known for its mild climate and extensive vineyards. We’ll visit Chillon Castle (tickets included), a medieval fortress built on the waters of the lake. Our journey will then take us through the heart of Montreux, an elegant town famous for its jazz festival, following the lake’s shoreline until we reach Geneva. Arrival will be at the end of the day.Note: Our hotel is usually located on the French outskirts of the city.Day 10GENEVAAfter breakfast, we’ll include a panoramic tour with our guide or a local guide in Geneva, a city situated by Lake Geneva and home to the European headquarters of the United Nations, the International Labour Organization, the Red Cross, and many other international organizations. The tour will end in the city center.Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of your flight in case you might need an additional content: 7 Nights and 8 Days Central European Ring Holiday PackageHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeHolidaysVienna8 Days Central European RingShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D3 ImagesView Gallery8 Days Central European RingNewTransfersHotelsSightseeingOverviewTravel through some of the most famed European destinations, including the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Slovakia, with this ultimate seven-night package. Yes, it covers everything from the prized gems of Prague, Munich, and Innsbruck to the charming ski resort of Kitzbuhel and the pulsating vibe of Budapest and Bratislava. Add to this all accommodations, transfers, and guided tours, making the whole experience as smooth and stress-free as possible.  ItineraryDay 1Arrival in PragueWelcome to Prague! Upon arriving at the airport, we’ll transfer you to your hotel. Check the information boards in the hotel reception area for details about the welcome meeting with your guide.In the evening, we’ll transfer you to the Old Town Square, a lively area bustling with tourist activity. You can enjoy dinner at one of the many restaurants offering a variety of international cuisines, including Czech, Chinese, Indian, and Italian. Afterward, there will be a return transfer to the hotel.Day 2Prague City TourTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll visit the capital, Prague, the Baroque jewel of Europe. Our local tour guide will lead an informative panoramic tour, highlighting the city’s most outstanding monuments. During the tour, there will be a visit to Prague Castle (admission included). After that, enjoy a boat ride on the Vltava River (included). In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore the city on your own.Day 3Travel to Munich and InnsbruckTODAY´S HIGHLIGHTS: Bavaria and Tyrol. We will leave early and travel to Bavaria, arriving in MUNICH free time to stroll through the monumental center and have lunch at one of the famous traditional beerhouses. In the afternoon, we will continue to Austria. Arriving to INNSBRUCK in the evening, we will have time for dinner in the Golden Roof area at the Old Town.Day 4Swarovski Crystal Museum and KitzbuhelTODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: The major draw of today is a tour of the Swarovski Museum, where you will enter the dazzling world of crystals and learn about the intricate artistry and craftsmanship behind the creation of stunning crystal pieces. Continue your tour to Innsbruck’s timeless historic center and later take a scenic drive through the mountains to Kitzbuhel, an idyllic village and a popular ski resort. Relish a tasty dinner with vegetarian options before you wind up the day. Day 5Salzburg, St. Wolfgang, Traunsee Lake, and Vienna TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll get to know Austria better. Departing in the morning, we’ll take a cable car ride in Steinplatte up to the high mountains of the Alps, where snow lasts for nine months of the year and the scenery is breathtaking. The incredible landscapes from the viewing platform and the dinosaur exhibition will create unforgettable memories. We’ll then continue exploring Austria, traveling through the mountains until we arrive in Salzburg, Mozart’s city. Its Renaissance and Baroque center is filled with beauty, all in the shadow of the grand castle. Next, we’ll travel through lakes and mountains to reach St. Wolfgang, a renowned pilgrimage site in Austria. We’ll then head to Traunkirchen, located beside the beautiful Traunsee Lake, where we’ll take a cruise to see four of the lake´s castles before disembarking in Gmunden. Afterward, we’ll continue to Vienna, arriving in the evening.Day 6Vienna city tour TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: Today, we’ll embark on a panoramic tour of this impressive city with a local guide. We’ll explore its majestic avenues, beautiful palaces, large parks and vibrant city center. In the afternoon, you’ll have free time to explore on your own. In the evening, we’ll include a transfer to the Grinzing district, an old wine-growing village now part of the city, known for its traditional taverns. You’ll have free time to dine in the area.Day 7Arrival in Budapest & Boat cruise TODAY’S HIGHLIGHTS: After about three hours of travel, we’ll arrive in Budapest, the capital of Hungary. Our first stop will be the lively area of Váci utca, where you’ll have free time for lunch. After, we’ll kick off our exploration of Budapest with an included boat trip on the Danube River, with historic Buda on one bank and cosmopolitan Pest on the other. The views are unbeatable. Following this, we’ll begin a panoramic tour of the so-called "Queen of the Danube." You’ll have some free time afterwards. In the evening, we’ll offer an optional outing to a Magyar show, with dinner included.Day 8Bratislava and PragueWe will leave Budapest early and head for Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia, a charming city along the Danube with an attractive historic center. You´ll have time to explore and enjoy lunch. After, we’ll continue our journey to the Czech Republic, arriving in Prague in the evening.Our journey will come to an end, leaving you with wonderful and lasting memories.Please, check the time of title: Aroya Dubai to Oman Cruise: Coastal Escape
meta_description: Sail on an Aroya Cruise from Dubai to Oman, exploring stunning coastlines, cultural landmarks, relaxing sea days, luxury dining, and Arabian hospitality.
content: Aroya Dubai to Oman Cruise: Coastal EscapeHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeCruisesDubai CityAroya Oman Coast CruiseShareAdd to Wishlist4N / 5D7 ImagesView GalleryAroya Oman Coast CruiseNewUpcoming DeparturesMealsOnboard ActivitiesKids Clubs and ChildcareFitness FacilitiesPort Taxes and FeesAccommodationsGratuitiesSwimming PoolTheater showsOverviewEnjoy a memorable 4-night cruise aboard Aroya, sailing from Dubai and exploring the stunning destinations of Khasab and Muscat. Experience dramatic fjords, cultural landmarks, and coastal beauty, with a relaxing day at sea to unwind. This short getaway offers the perfect blend of adventure, culture, and onboard comfort.ItineraryDay 1DubaiEmbark on Aroya in Dubai and set sail late at night to begin your Arabian Gulf cruise. Day 2Khasab, OmanExplore Khasab’s dramatic fjords, clear waters, and natural beauty, perfect for sightseeing and relaxation. Day 3Muscat, OmanDiscover Muscat’s rich culture, historic landmarks, and beautiful coastline during a full-day visit. title: MSC Euribia Cruise: Copenhagen to Norway & Germany
meta_description: Sail from Copenhagen on MSC Euribia. Explore Norway’s fjords, scenic towns, and Germany’s Kiel on this 8-day unforgettable cruise adventure.
content: MSC Euribia Cruise: Copenhagen to Norway & GermanyHelplineEnglish / AEDHomeCruisesCopenhagenMsc Euirbia-Copenhagen-Hellesylt-Alesund-Flaam-KielShareAdd to Wishlist7N / 8D7 ImagesView GalleryMsc Euirbia-Copenhagen-Hellesylt-Alesund-Flaam-KielNewUpcoming DeparturesMealsOnboard ActivitiesKids Clubs and ChildcareFitness FacilitiesPort Taxes and FeesAccommodationsSwimming PoolTheater showsOverviewMSC Euribia is named after the ancient goddess Euribia who harnessed the winds, weather, and constellations to master the seas, furthering the vision of the ship to master the deployment of state-of-the-art technology to minimize its impact on the precious marine ecosystem. The ship is also empowered with striking new features. Not only do the decks boast numerous original works of art, for the first time the hull itself is a visual masterpiece. On this unique ship where art meets innovation.ItineraryDay 1Copenhagen DenmarkBegin your journey in Denmark’s vibrant capital, a city where fairy-tale charm meets sleek Scandinavian design. Explore colorful Nyhavn, the royal palaces, and the cozy cafés that line cobblestone streets. As you sail away, enjoy views of the city’s spires and the calm waters.Day 2Day At SeaRelax and unwind as you sail through the North Sea, enjoying your ship’s amenities and panoramic ocean views. Take this time to explore onboard dining, entertainment, and spa options. The fresh sea breeze and open horizon set the perfect tone for the adventures ahead.Day 3Hellesylt Sail through Norway’s stunning fjord country, stopping briefly in Hellesylt before continuing to Geiranger. Towering cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and crystal-blue waters create unforgettable scenery. It’s a day filled with the very best of Norway’s natural beauty.Day 4Alesund NorwayÅlesund is known for its elegant Art Nouveau architecture, rebuilt after a fire in 1904 with colorful, turreted buildings. Climb the 418 steps to Mount Aksla for panoramic views of the town and surrounding islands. This charming coastal city perfectly blends history, design, and natural beauty.Day 5Flaam NorwaySet deep within the Aurlandsfjord, Flåm is a picturesque village famous for the scenic Flåmsbana Railway — one of the steepest train rides in the world. The journey offers dramatic mountain and waterfall views. Nature lovers will find endless hiking trails and peaceful fjord cruises to enjoy.Day 6Day At SeaSpend a relaxing day cruising back toward continental Europe. Attend onboard activities, enjoy fine dining, or simply watch the endless seascape from your balcony. It’s a perfect time to reflect on Norway’s majestic landscapes.Day 7 Kiel GermanyKiel, a lively port city on the Baltic Sea, is known for its maritime heritage and relaxed atmosphere. Visit the historic harbor, the Kiel Canal, or explore nearby Lübeck for its medieval charm. The city’s waterfront promenades and cafés make for a pleasant day ashore.Day 8Copenhagen DenmarkReturn to the Danish capital where your journey began, perhaps with a new appreciation for Northern Europe’s beauty. Enjoy a final stroll through the city or visit any sights you may have missed. It’s the perfect farewell to a scenic and unforgettable cruise.InclusionAccommodation as per the cabin or deck selected, within the duration of the stayMeals – international buffet – breakfast, lunch, and dinner (most of the cruises includes majority of the restaurants on the cruise)Entertainment and On-board activities: games, tournaments, themed evenings, and contestsFacilities: sun beds, swimming pools, library, hot tub, disco, and jogging trackLuggage transport service in the port during embarkation and disembarkation.GratuitiesCruise taxes and feesPort chargesExclusionAir transportation, optional shores, transfers, and land excursionsOffshore meals and accommodationAll drinksCasino gamingIn-room telephone callsInternet Wi-FiSpecialty restaurantsPurchases from ship storesPersonal services: laundry, medical services, salon services, and spa servicesAll the items that are not mentioned in the inclusionsVisa – (Can be provided at an additional cost)Optional ToursExploring the Destinations: During your cruise, you have the flexibility to explore the places you visit on your own or book an excursion onboard.Please note that booking excursions will incur an additional charge.TimingsDay 1:Copenhagen DenmarkDepart 06:00 PMDay 2:At SeaDay 3:Hellesylt Norway09:00 AM To 09:45 AMDay 3:Geiranger Norway12:00 PM To 09:00 PMDay 4:Alesund Norway07:00 AM To 05:00 PMDay 5:Flaam Norway07:00 AM To 06:00 PMDay 6:At SeaDay 7:Kiel Germany09:00 AM To 07:00 PMDay 8:Copenhagen DenmarkArrive 08:00 AMImportant InformationFor reservations involving the first and second guest, adult rates will be applicable, irrespective of age.Passport with Extended Validity: Ensure your passport has a minimum validity of 6 months beyond your intended travel dates. Simply choose our Guided Inside Burj Al Arab Open-Dated Tickets! This butler guided tour begins with a thrilling buggy ride. Following this, the hotel’s most treasured segments unfolds before you, including the largest-of-its-kind atrium and the lavish Royal Suite. The 90-minute experience also includes access to the interactive Experience Suite and concludes in style at the elegant UMA Lounge.WHAT TO EXPECT Explore Dubai’s Icon of Luxury, Anytime You Choose Enjoy an exclusive look at the world’s most luxurious hotels, thanks to the Guided Inside Burj Al Arab Open-Dated Tickets. Experience a traditional Emirati style welcome before entering the lobby and the world’s tallest atrium. An astonishing elevator ride to the 25th floor takes you to the majestic Royal Suite, with amenities fit for royalty! It features a rotating bed and ornate details with touches of 24-carat gold in its ‘his’ and ‘hers’ suites. Discover, Indulge, and UnwindDigital exhibits, architectural sketches, and exclusive memorabilia at the Experience Suite showcase the hotel’s rich legacy.
